guidance.statement: Revenue target of INR500-550 crores for FY28
guidance.quote: Sir, we are looking at a revenue target of roughly around INR500 crores to INR550 crores for FY28.

demand.statement: South market estimated at 4-5 lakh tons annually, entering with modest capacity
demand.quote: you can understand that it is a market of at least 400,000 to 500,000 tons a year. But with the capacity we are coming with right now, we are entering with a very modest capacity.

demand.statement: Strong demand visibility with 20,000-25,000 tons/month consumption in 30km radius of Eastern plant
demand.quote: I see roughly 20 ,000 to 25,000 per metric ton per month consumption in my district, forget about the state. That is like 30 km radius from my plant.

margin.statement: EBITDA margin expected to improve 4-5% from current levels due to raw material cost reduction
margin.quote: should be at least 4% to 5% better than wherever we are sitting, at the minimum, at the very low.

capex.statement: Capex of INR45 crores for two new plants with 3 lakh tons combined capacity
capex.quote: Together, these two facilities represent a combined additional capacity of 3 lakh metric ton per annum with approx total capital expenditure of just INR45 crores.

capex.statement: FY27 capex estimated at INR10-15 crores for land and development of new projects
capex.quote: Yes, around INR10 crores, INR15 crores in FY27 on the land part and the developments that are going to happen in that to new projects.

product_mix.statement: Spare mine capacity to be used for silica sand, tiles adhesives and trading to glass/ceramics industries
product_mix.quote: The spare capacity of mines will be utilized in manufacturing of other silica products, such as tiles adhesives, and silica sand industry.

fund_raise.statement: No fund raise planned; expansion to be funded through internal accruals with possible short-term loan of INR5-10 crores
fund_raise.quote: No, no, no, there is no objective of any fund raise that company is eyeing on. We are very confident about being able to self -fund it. Might be that short -term INR5 crores, INR10 crores loan for a 1 or 2 months might reflect at a very later stage during the commissioning time or something like that.

risk.statement: Mine payments fixed regardless of volume; 5-year commitment to government with fixed rates
risk.quote: The volume is fixed, the rate is fixed. So, you have committed the amount, that is going to be divided in the 5 years, and there's a complete guideline of it. So, regardless of the volume, it is not going to be there.

other.statement: 40% reduction in raw material procurement cost from Nawada mine acquisition
other.quote: We expect 40% reduction in raw material procurement cost.

other.statement: Inventory to reduce from 90-120 days to 10-15 days due to mine security
other.quote: I'm going to keep 10 days, 15 days stock in all of my plants, that's it. Right now, I'm sitting at 90 days, 120 days of inventory.

guidance.statement: Export share expected to stay 15-20% as domestic market grows 14-15%
guidance.quote: We don't say that the same momentum will continue forever, or even we are not focusing that share of business of export will be 25 % - 30%. It will remain in this range because the bottom line, that is the denominator, is increasing. The domestic market is growing at 14% to 15% for us, so with this higher base at the local market, we expect that export will continue to be between 15% and 20%.

guidance.statement: YTD June performance indicates revenue will cross INR 10,000 crores
guidance.quote: And based on YTD June performance, we will cross INR10,000 crores. And this kind of business can absorb cost of capital of new products easily.

demand.statement: First-time car buyers overtook repeat buyers last month, indicating strong demand
demand.quote: In fact, last month I was reading the first -time car buyers have now come back. The number of people who are the first -time buyers have overshadowed or overtaken the repeat buyers. Unfortunately, that ratio had changed. demand.statement: Industrial growth mixed: infrastructure-linked sectors (steel, cement, railways, renewables) strong; construction equipment negative last year, mining policy-dependent; automotive growing faster
demand.quote: I would say there has been a mix there . Some of the sectors are really good, very strong. Obviously based on the back of government policies. Clearly, when they declared that infrastructure is going to be a focused growth area, and the government is rightfully investing in infrastructure growth, all the related industries, we have seen strong traction. Steel - straightaway - cement, super. Constr

order_book.statement: Book-to-bill ratio tracked closely; kept above 1 to confirm growth trajectory
order_book.quote: So there's a 25% probability success rate, 50%, 75%. So when you're getting to 75%, you're almost sure that you want to get the order. So we kind of always try and track it. We have a visibility, but the probability is progressive there. So there are projects where at 25% itself, we have lost. There are projects we've gone to 75% and then the customer delays to kill the project. We have seen all k

capex.statement: Shoolagiri greenfield: second hall building underway; production line from Europe arriving for passenger vehicle transmission
capex.quote: We started with one hall, and we started off initially by using that as a feeding line for the existing plant. Now we are moving to a stage, we're going to start assembly of new product. In fact, as I speak, there is one production line that is on the way from Europe that we want to bring here and set it up in the current, and we are also going ahead with the second hall building as well.

pricing_cost.statement: Historically ~70% of input cost increases recovered; 30% managed via efficiencies and localization
pricing_cost.quote: Historically, usually 70% is recovered. Harsha Kadam: Acquisition is about 70%. Hardevi Vazirani: 30% has to be adjusted with our own operational efficiencies, localization, and so on

product_mix.statement: Localization at ~80%, up from 60-65% 3-4 years ago; driven by customer strategy, not a target number
product_mix.quote: If you look at our localization percentage, 3, 4 years back, we were in the range of 60% - 65%, and today we are hovering at about 80%, which means 80% of our need we locally produce is proof enough that our localization strategy is the prevalent strategy.

product_mix.statement: E-axle in Phase 2 localization: buildings and production lines being set up
product_mix.quote: We started off by when once we had the first business win on the e-axles, we started to import the e-axles, but then we have to one day or the other start localizing. So we are in the Phase 2 of localization already on the e-axles, which means we have built buildings, we're setting up production lines, so it's happening.

other.statement: Export mix: 50% Europe intercompany, 25% Southeast Asia, rest China and Americas; consciously diversified to lower geopolitical impact
other.quote: Currently on exports, our mix is like 50% is to Europe intercompany partners and 25% is Southeast Asia, and the remaining is China and Americas. So, this is how is the spread and this was very consciously done so as to have a lower impact of geopolitical disturbances.

other.statement: Railways ~13-14% of revenue, double-digit growth for at least 6 months; investing in production line capacities
other.quote: Continues to be around 13% - 14% of our revenue. Harsha Kadam: It will continue. Hardevi Vazirani: And double-digit growth, at least, 6 months. Harsha Kadam: Yes. And by the way, we're also investing in production line capacities, which are on the way. It still has to come in. And we are doing that as well

guidance.statement: FY27 revenue guidance of INR1,550-1,650 crores and EBITDA of INR240-250 crores excluding inventory and forex gains
guidance.value: INR1,550-1,650 crores revenue; INR240-250 crores EBITDA
guidance.quote: For '27, we expect to deliver a revenue of INR1,550 crores to INR1,650 crores with an EBITDA of INR240 crores to INR250 crores, excluding price fluctuation due to geopolitical-led supply chain issues and forex gain/losses, if any.

guidance.statement: 5-year aspiration to scale revenue to INR2,800-3,000 crores supported by capacity expansions and higher value-added products
guidance.quote: Further, we aspire to scale the business to INR2,800 crores to INR3,000 crores in the next 5 years, supported by capacity expansions, higher value-added offerings, so we'll go into the higher EBITDA products because, as I said, the groundwork in this last 30 years has been done, and deeper engagement with global customers as we grow from here.

demand.statement: Volume grew mid-single digits in Q1; demand strong across all sectors; healthy order book from domestic and global customers diversifying supply chains
demand.quote: Volume grew in the mid-single digit range, while demand across all the sectors remained strong.

margin.statement: Sustainable gross margins seen at 30-32% normalized, supported by higher value-added mix and operating efficiency
margin.quote: Looking beyond the near-term benefit from our higher realization, we see sustainable gross margins in the range of about 30%, 32% on a normalized basis. This is supported by the structural factors, including our higher value-added product mix and operating efficiency from debottlenecking and higher captive consumptions of the intermediates.

margin.statement: FY27 EBITDA margin guidance 15-16% at year-end
margin.quote: The end of the year EBITDA margin, we are talking of 15% to 16% in that range.

margin.statement: Q1 FY27 gross margin 37.9% vs 30% YoY, boosted by INR25 crores inventory gain; sustainable normalized gross margin range 30-32%
margin.quote: Gross margin for the quarter stood at 37.9% compared to 30% in Q1 FY26. Due to the geopolitical-led supply chain issues, there was a sharp increase in average selling price to the tune of INR25 crores positive impact on our gross profit during Q1 FY27.

capex.statement: Phase 1 capex of INR250-300 crores over next two years for existing products, funded by internal accruals and potential debt
capex.quote: We have charted about the capex of about INR250 to INR300 crores as a Phase 1 of our expansion plan towards existing products.

capex.statement: Phase 2 capex of INR250-300 crores for new R&D products with better margins, product identification and approvals in progress
capex.quote: Phase 2 expansion of nearly INR250 to INR300 crores would be targeting new R&D products with better margins. Product identification, site preparation, and the regulatory approvals are still in the progress.

product_mix.statement: Revenue mix: Acetone specialties ~40%, Phosphorus specialties ~40%, Other specialties ~20%; aim to reduce other specialties from 18% to ~10% in 5 years
product_mix.quote: In terms of revenue mix, it continues to remain stable. Acetone-based specialty chemicals contributed nearly 40% of revenue, phosphorus-based specialty chemicals nearly 40%, and the other specialty chemicals the balance 20%.

product_mix.statement: 13 new products commercialized in last 3 years across mining, agro intermediates, lubricant additives, construction emulsifiers; 40 products in R&D pipeline with 15-20% conversion rate
product_mix.quote: On product development front, we have commercialized 13 new products over the last 3 years across the mining chemicals, agro intermediates, lubricant additives, and construction emulsifiers, while we continue to invest in our R&D and developing several products across these segments.

risk.statement: Geopolitical environment fluid; monitoring crude, marine freight, currency; West Asia conflict reduced some exports but diversification offset impact
risk.quote: While geopolitical environment remains fluid, we continue to closely monitor developments across crude, marine freight, currency, and will remain focused on the maintaining the supply chain resilience and serving our customers effectively.

other.statement: INR25 crores allocated for floating roof storage tanks at Khopoli to secure acetone supply; diversifying sourcing with new east coast sources and barge transport
other.quote: If you look at my expansion plan, we have set aside INR25 crores towards the storage tank with floating roof. Floating roof so that the acetone doesn't vaporize. You don't lose the acetone to the vapors. And the company is going to invest in the next one year more than INR25 crores in the adjoining land that we have purchased at Khopoli to store the additional material.

other.statement: Combined installed capacity of ~98,000 tons per annum; Khopoli at 78,800 tons running at optimum utilization, Mahad at 19,900 tons improved from 13% to 44% utilization
other.quote: On our manufacturing plant, now we have combined installed capacity of about 98,000 tons per annum across our ISO-certified plants, operating on the zero liquid discharge basis. Khopoli plant has about 78,800 tons of capacity, running at optimum utilization in FY26. guidance.statement: Capex plan of about 2,000 crore over next three to four years
guidance.quote: We plan to invest about 2,000 crore in organic capital expenditure over the next three to four years, supporting complex generics pipeline, oncology pipeline, peptide CDMO, US operations, manufacturing and R&D infrastructure.

guidance.statement: Peptide CDMO targets $50M annual revenue run rate in three years and $100M in five years
guidance.quote: We are targeting approximately 50 million US dollar in annual revenue run rate in three years from now as an intermediate milestone to get to and cross the threshold of 100 million revenue size in five years.

guidance.statement: US ANDA filing run rate to increase to 10-15 per year
guidance.quote: When it comes to R&D, the U.S. will always remain the anchor country where, going forward, we aim to file between 10 and 15 products per year, which will further be extended to Europe and rest of the world countries.

margin.statement: Gross margin expanded ~15 percentage points to 65% and EBITDA margin by 3 percentage points to 22% over four years
margin.quote: Over four years, gross margin expanded by about 15 percentage points to 65 percent and EBITDA margin by three percentage points to 22 percent.

margin.statement: R&D investment rose from ~3% to 6% of revenue in Q1 FY27
margin.quote: At the same time, R&D investment rose from about 3 percent of revenue a few years ago to 6 percent in Q1 FY27, improving the quality of sales growth.

margin.statement: Operating leverage to improve as Genome Valley and Peptide CDMO assets ramp up
margin.quote: Once they start yielding returns, without any major investments, and operational leverage will be much better, you can you can just, do your own mathematics.

order_book.statement: Two sole first-to-file ANDAs filed (Generic Lumryz and Generic Dyanavel) with combined US market size north of $350M
order_book.quote: Generic Lumryz and Generic Dyanavel have a combined market size north of 350 million US dollars, just in the US, where we would potentially have 180-day exclusivity.

order_book.statement: Controlled substances pipeline covers 87% of methylphenidate market value, 39% approved for dexmethylphenidate, 74% for amphetamines
order_book.quote: In Methylphenidate, we only address 6% of the market value today, and our pipeline covers 87% of the value, with launches starting in the next several months. In Dexmethylphenidate, we've been approved for 39% of the value, with another 50% in the pipeline. In Amphetamines, our approvals cover 74% of the value, but we haven't yet promoted Adderall IR, which is one of the largest products.

order_book.statement: Oncology pipeline: 2 products filed, 6 more to be filed this year and early next year
order_book.quote: Oncology, we have two products that are filed. 19 − And one of those products has been extended to about 15 countries so far. And in addition to that, we have about 6 in our pipeline that we'll be filing this year and the early part of next year

capex.statement: Capex allocation focused on peptide CDMO, complex generics, oncology with milestone-based approach
capex.quote: Significant portion is, of course, will be going into three buckets largely the Peptide CDMO, complex as well as oncology and then rest.

pricing_cost.statement: Proactively working with customers on pricing mechanism to pass on raw material cost increases, possibly with a lag
pricing_cost.quote: So, the near-term challenges are there, but we are proactively working with all our customer to see how we have a pricing mechanism to pass on, maybe some could be with a lag, but medium to long term, whatever the trajectory we have set out, the growth plans we have in terms of the product portfolio and investment plans, we will be in a consistent growth mode with an improvement in quality of earn

product_mix.statement: Complex generics contribution increased from 1% of revenue in FY20 to 33% in FY26, ~45-50% of finished dosages
product_mix.quote: This strategy has been demonstrated through the contribution of complex generics that increased from 1% of overall revenue in fiscal 20 to 33% of overall revenue in fiscal 26. And as a part of, as a percentage of overall finished dosages, the contribution of complex is roughly 45 to 50% in fiscal 26.

product_mix.statement: First-to-file pipeline of 4-5 products commercializing between FY30-34
product_mix.quote: Over the next few years, we have a pipeline of four to five other first-to-files, all of which would commercialize between fiscal 30 and 34.

fund_raise.statement: Actively looking for inorganic opportunities with disciplined approach
fund_raise.quote: Yes, we are always looking for inorganic opportunities and we have been very disciplined about it, not jumping into whatever comes our way and definitely we are very actively looking at it.

risk.statement: Peptide CDMO spending tied to innovator clinical success; failures accepted as part of model
risk.quote: It's largely depending on the clinical success outcome on the innovator side. For us we ride with them, there would be successes and that those successes will bring in the lumpy upside. And there would be failures that clinical program doesn't go through from stage one to stage two and we live with that.

other.quote: The U.S., which currently represents approximately 75 percent of the overall revenue, will remain our anchor market. But the way we compete in the U.S. is evolving. Our expanding portfolio will allow us to enter the specialty and institutional segments, with our first product expected

other.statement: Top 3 in six of seven marketed ADHD products; Adderall XR share from 5% to 29%; Lisdexamfetamine now #2 generic supplier
other.quote: We are in the top three in six of the seven ADHD products that we market. In Adderall XR, our share went from 5% in 2024 to 29% as of last month. In Lisdexamfetamine, we are now the number two generic supplier, even though we are the last person to enter the market space.

guidance.statement: Q1 cost structure representative for FY27 unless further expansion; operating leverage expected in subsequent quarters
guidance.quote: So the Q1 that you see right now is pretty much what we are operating as cost structure today. So I don't see any significant change in that unless we make any change to any of our stores in future, which at the right time we will be notifying.

guidance.statement: EBITDA breakeven requires gross profit of INR55 crores per quarter on P&L basis; cash breakeven requires additional INR29 crores GP for lease payments
guidance.quote: So the calculation, back calculation up to the GP will give you an EBITDA positive straight away there, which basically means if I'm able to grow the GP to INR55 crores, it would convert to a zero EBITDA.

demand.statement: Mumbai GMV grew from INR28 crores to INR50 crores, Delhi from INR29 crores to INR39 crores, Hyderabad from INR10 crores to INR16 crores, USA from INR20 crores to INR29 crores in 3M FY27 vs 3M FY26
demand.quote: So , the growth momentum has continued in 3M of F Y '27 versus 3M of F Y '26, with Mumbai's contribution increasing from INR28 crores to INR50 crores, Delhi from INR29 crores to INR39 crores, Hyderabad from INR10 crores to INR16 crores, and USA from INR20 crores to INR29 crores.

margin.statement: Q1 FY27 gross margin retained at 36% versus Q1 FY26
margin.quote: Gross profit also increased to INR43 crores while retaining the gross margin at 36% as compared to Q1 last year.

margin.statement: Q1 FY27 EBITDA was negative INR11 crores versus negative INR4 crores in Q1 FY26
margin.quote: EBITDA stood at negative INR11 crores compared to negative INR4 crores in Q1 of FY '26.

order_book.statement: Q1 FY27 GMV increased to INR193 crores from INR133 crores in Q1 FY26
order_book.quote: In Q1 F Y '27, the GMV increased to INR193 crores from INR133 crores in Q1 of FY '26, while AOV increased from INR66,000 to INR86,000.

capex.statement: No significant expansion planned immediately after four large stores opened in FY26
capex.quote: Immediately, there is no significant expansion in sight because we have already done four large stores in las t financial year, so we want that scenario run to happen.

pricing_cost.statement: Gross margin percentage flat across price points; absolute margin higher on high-value items due to same percentage on larger ticket size
pricing_cost.quote: So hence my point, from an absolute perspective, if I'm operating let's say at an average 40% margin, I'm just giving a number, so selling a INR2 lakh piece gives me INR80,000 margin. Selling a INR20,000 piece gives me only INR8,000 margin. So from an absolute perspective, it's higher margin. But percentage perspective, it completely depends on what markdown I'm working with that brand

product_mix.statement: Women's wear above INR1 lakh grew from INR187 crores in FY24 to INR312 crores in FY26; men's wear grew from INR96 crores to INR132 crores; below INR35k women's wear declined from INR162 crores to INR86 crores
product_mix.quote: Now, in the third generation, we are sharpening the focus towards higher-value categories, which has led the 1 lakh plus women's wear generating INR312 crores GMV in FY '26 compared to INR187 crores in FY '24. risk.statement: Quarterly numbers can be erratic; advise observing cumulative performance over next few quarters for clarity
risk.quote: Now, in our business, the quarterly numbers can sometimes be erratic, so it's important to see them in a cumulative sense. Hence, I would advise as you see more quarterly numbers over the next few quarters, you will get a much better clarity in terms of ho w the inventory will be managed going forward.

other.statement: Inventory reduced from INR174 crores in Q1 FY26 to INR159 crores in Q1 FY27
other.quote: At the same time, inventory reduced from INR174 crores in Q1 of FY '26 to INR159 crores, as well as the net working capital reduced from INR105 crores in Q1 of FY '26 to INR66 crores in Q1 of F Y '2 7.

other.statement: Customer advances increased from INR37 crores in Q1 FY26 to INR49 crores in Q1 FY27
other.quote: But while assessing the performance, the revenue should be adjusted for increase in the advance received from customer, which has gone up from INR37 crores in quarter one of FY '26 to INR49 crores in Q1 of FY '27.

guidance.statement: FY27 revenue growth target of 60-65% YoY
guidance.quote: Talking about our annual performance, for FY27, we endeavor to grow our revenues by 60% to 65% over the last year.

guidance.statement: EBITDA margin expected to improve as revenue grows and assets are utilized
guidance.quote: as the revenue grows in subsequent quarters, there would be an improvement in the EBITDA margin in line with our expectation

demand.statement: Demand continues to outpace supply creating favorable environment
demand.quote: In fact, current ly, we are witnessing a market where demand continues to outpace supply, creating a favorable environment for us

margin.statement: Q1 FY27 EBITDA margin 11%; impacted by high shipping and local delivery costs
margin.quote: In terms of EBITDA margins in this quarter, we've had 11%. We would have had a better realization on our margins, but we were the shipping costs these days and the local costs, let's say, in Europe or supplying into the Middle East today, where the trucking costs are at all-time high.

margin.statement: Historical Q1 FY26 EBITDA margin was 13%; expect improvement as assets are sweated and freight normalizes
margin.quote: if you look at our Q1 numbers of FY26, and you see the margins there, we were at 13% EBITDA there. And with that revenue and as the revenue grows, and we sweat all our assets, and things on the freight either with the war situation normalizing or with -- when the new freight rates kick in, I think you should do the math and see where this could land.

capex.statement: INR900 crores capex in FY26; continuing investment in FY27
capex.quote: last year, we did INR900 crores of capex, and we continue to invest this year.

pricing_cost.statement: Contracts structured with raw material pass-through; domestic solar 4-5 months, international 8-9 months; price variation clauses for long-term orders
pricing_cost.quote: For international contracts, we have contracts for about, let's say, 8, 9 months. And for that, we -- for all our export contracts, we import the raw material. And that's how we cover those contracts by. So we are able to not take any major risk on any of the commodity prices if the supply chain, of course, is met correctly.

product_mix.statement: Renewable products 82% of Q1 FY27 revenue; transmission ~30%; targeting transmission and PEB growth to mirror solar scale-up
product_mix.quote: From a revenue mix perspective, renewal products continued to be the key revenue driver, contributing 82 % of Q1 FY27 revenues.

product_mix.statement: Transmission revenue mix target: mirror solar growth from INR20 crores to INR5,000-5,500 crores over 3-5 years
product_mix.quote: if what I spoke about previously that we have scaled up so much in solar, where we were about 20 crores, and we are going to be close to the number which I already spoke about, we would like to mirror that.

fund_raise.statement: First fundraising via IPO; proceeds to be deployed to reduce interest cost
fund_raise.quote: once we deploy the money which we have pulled it from the IPO market, definitely, the interest cost will further go down.

risk.statement: Elevated global freight and delivery costs due to high fuel prices impacting margins; expected to normalize over time
risk.quote: what's happening globally, because of fuel costs have gone up world over, and local costs of fuel, even in countries that are oil -producing, like the Middle East, like Saudi and the UAE, and US, which is a large producer of oil, the domestic cost itself of fuel cost oil has gone up. That has increased the shipment cost and the delivery costs

other.statement: Aggregated installed capacity 889,200 metric tons per annum excluding rolling and galvanizing
other.quote: As of the current quarter end, our aggregated installed capacity stood at 889,200 metric tons per annum, excluding rolling and galvanizing capacity, which are utilized for captive consumption.

other.statement: Working capital cycle improved from 67 days to 43 days to 36 days in Q1 FY27
other.quote: So from 67 days, it has come down to 43 days. And now further in this quarter, it has come down to 36 days.

guidance.statement: Target utilization of 60-65% over time; new boilers expected at 50% utilization initially
guidance.quote: Our intent is to take this utilization to 60 % to 65% of and with our experience and learning in the last decade, the newer boilers that we are commissioning, the newer boilers that we are commissioning will be expected to be in the range of 50% at the very initial months of the commissioning.

guidance.statement: EBITDA per ton of INR1,000 sustainable for steam generation sites; annual EBITDA per ton at par or better than Q1
guidance.quote: EBITDA per ton of INR1,000 can be safely assumed that it will be maintained in our steam generation and distribution sites for next few quarters, as the new facilities that are coming up are on waste and will definitely help in keeping EBITDA per ton at INR1,000 or better.

guidance.statement: Volume growth of 5-10% at current locations; 20-25% company-level volume growth achievable with new capacity
guidance.quote: Yes we can expect similar growth in at least, say, 5% to 10% for the current locations where we are already there, with the current installed capacity on smaller numbers. But as we said that we are already installing new projects, new locations, that would add to the capacity utilization basis the basis the capacity that we are installing.

margin.statement: Una project expected 8-10% EBITDA margin (pass-through model, no capex)
margin.quote: This will be instead of EBITDA margin, this should be basically the EBITDA per ton. We should be getting around 8 % to 10% clear-cut margin. We are doing no capex there. But that will depend upon what will be the fuel price when we will be billing to the customer.

margin.statement: Q1 FY27 EBITDA margin 24.05% (+702 bps YoY); PAT margin 14.26% (+529 bps); EBITDA per ton INR1,011 (+37% YoY)
margin.quote: EBITDA for Quarter 1 FY27 increased by 60.08% year -on-year to INR30.93 crores from INR19.32 crores , EBITDA margin expanded substantially to 24.05% compared with 17.03% in Quarter 1 FY26, an improvement of 702 basis points.

order_book.statement: ~70% of 345 TPH capacity tied up with customers; contracts 1-10 years with non-exit clauses
order_book.quote: Out of the 345 tons per hour capacity installed, we have -- around 70% capacity tied up for the for the customers. So, yes, that's the answer to your question.

capex.statement: INR60 crore for four under-construction projects; INR170 crore for IPO projects and Tarapur over 15-18 months
capex.quote: We'll have to do around another, INR60 -odd crores of capex to take all these four projects live. And the -- for the balance, the IPO end -use project and one of the project which is planned in Tarapur, we intend to do another INR170 crores worth capex in next 15 months to 18 months.

pricing_cost.statement: Steam supply agreements have variable component linked to coal price; pass-through predominantly monthly
pricing_cost.quote: Most of our customers are covered by steam supply agreements comprising fixed and variable components, with the variable component linked to the coal price. This contractual structure enables us to pass through changes in fuel cost.

pricing_cost.statement: Switched coal purchases from credit to cash post May 2026, lowering fuel cost
pricing_cost.quote: And we were purchasing coal on credit basis till May 2026, and post that we have converted entire credit purchases to cash purchases. So, that is also helping us in improving the margins , because you can understand that any cash purchases will help you in lowering the cost of fuel.
