pricing_cost.quote: our Loan against P roperty book is primarily a floating rate book, and we have a floating reference rate that we publish on our website. That FRR, as we call it, floating reference rate, is updated on the 16th of every month, then that's updated. So, there's a monthly cycle on which the rates are reset

product_mix.statement: Enterprise Lending disbursements up 25.5% YoY; LAP+EBL up 30% YoY; Gold loans up 60%+ YoY; Unsecured Business Loans returned to sequential growth
product_mix.quote: Q2 disbursements for the segment grew by 25.5% YoY. Disbursements for LAP + EBL, which is our mortgage book, grew by 30% YoY, and we anticipate this upward trajectory to continue. Our Gold L oan disbursements grew over 60

product_mix.statement: Consumer Finance disbursements up 25%+ YoY; Consumer Durables book up 49% YoY; Auto Loans up 22% YoY; Relationship PL up 16% YoY
product_mix.quote: Disbursements for Consumer Finance vertical grew over 25% YoY, while the book expanded 22% YoY. Consumer Durables book, which consists of loans for purchase of consumer durables and digital products, that book grew by 49% YoY, and the Auto Loan book grew by 22% YoY.

risk.statement: Drought declared in some Maharashtra districts; tractor portfolio exposure small but monitored; key risk is food inflation impact
risk.quote: drought, as of now, has been declared in some districts in Maharashtra. I think the first product that gets impacted in terms of announcement of drought is potentially agricultural loans, right. And given that we are an NBFC, we really do not do crop loans and other such product categories at this point of time.

other.statement: Borrowing mix well diversified with positive cumulative mismatch up to 5 years; total capital adequacy 21.37%
other.quote: Our borrowing mix remains well diversified and a positive cumulative mismatch across all buckets up to five years. We remain well capitalized with the total capital adequacy of 21.37% as at September 30, 2026.

other.statement: Interim dividend of ₹2 per equity share declared with record date October 23, 2026
other.quote: The Board of Directors have declared an interim dividend of ₹2 per equity share with a record date of October 23, 2026.

guidance.statement: FY27 volume growth guidance maintained at around 15% with similar EBITDA growth
guidance.quote: The order position for Q3 and Q4 looks robust, and we expect to end the year exactly as per the guidance that we had given at the start of the year, which was around 15% volume growth and a similar EBITDA growth as well.

guidance.statement: FY27 gross debt guidance maintained at INR1,000-1,200 crores, net debt around INR800 crores
guidance.value: INR1,000-1,200 crores gross, INR800 crores net
guidance.quote: Our initial guidance was that we'll maintain debt between INR1,000 crores to INR1,200 crores of gross debt and net debt around INR800 crores.

guidance.statement: Domestic branded business FY27 revenue guidance maintained at near INR550 crores
guidance.quote: So that will remain because the sales increases, I told that in India, there is a bit of seasonality. So the sales will increase in the third and fourth quarter. So that guidance, we are maintaining that.

demand.statement: Domestic branded business growing at 25% volume growth across all channels
demand.quote: The good part is that the growth momentum for the branded business continues, and we are growing at 25%, and we look forward to maintain this kind of a growth momentum going forward as well.

demand.statement: Freeze-dried demand stronger than spray-dried globally, premiumization trend accelerating
demand.quote: FD, our utilizations are much better. The FD demand in the world market has been better than the SD demand.

margin.statement: EBITDA per kg expected to remain in INR135-140 range for Q2 and full year
margin.quote: I think INR135 to INR140 we had said last time. That is where it stays.

margin.statement: EBITDA growth expected to move in tandem with volume growth at around 15% for FY27
margin.quote: Our guidance remains that both will move in tandem with each other. And in fact, if you remember, I told this last time as well that once the bases are normalized of the same proportion of FD and SD, then the per kilo EBITDA, very unlikely that it will move significantly differently from the volume growth.

order_book.statement: Q3 and Q4 order book looks robust, on track for 15% volume growth
order_book.quote: But as far as we are concerned, as I was telling that our quarter 3, quarter 4 order book looks robust, and we are well on track to get that 15% volume growth for the year.

capex.statement: Next freeze-dried expansion estimated at around INR500 crores, similar to previous expansion
capex.quote: Maybe we can add some inflation cost to that, but it won't be very different from what we did around maybe INR500-odd crores we did last time, if I'm not wrong. So it will be around that range itself.

capex.statement: Capacity expansion decision expected by Q4 FY27 or Q1 FY28, may include strategic partnerships
capex.quote: So you're absolutely right. We should be hearing something at least end of Q4 or starting Q1 next year.

pricing_cost.statement: Domestic prices adjusted both up and down across SKUs due to coffee price volatility and energy costs
pricing_cost.quote: In the domestic market, there are SKUs where we had to drop prices. But the good thing is that we did not have much of an impact because in some SKUs, we kept the prices at the similar levels also.

pricing_cost.statement: Green coffee prices range-bound at USD3,400-3,800 per ton, Vietnam crop in Nov-Dec will determine trend
pricing_cost.quote: As far as the green coffee prices are concerned, while it is still fluctuating, but has been range bound in the region of USD3,400 to USD3,800 per ton. And the Vietnam crop, which is slated CCL Products ( to come around November, December time is the time which will decide the future price trends for coffee

product_mix.statement: Freeze-dried proportion stable, product mix benefit now in base, EBITDA per kg to follow volume growth
product_mix.quote: So mostly in line, Abhishek. There could be a little at the end of the year because there is not only one thing that will play in terms of how the EBITDA will pan out apart from proportion, there are many other aspects that will come into play.

risk.statement: Coffee price outlook uncertain, mixed reports on Vietnam crop due to El Nino, clarity expected by December
risk.quote: So the exact picture, we'll know in December because as I was telling you a while earlier that there has been a mixed report. Of course, there have been reports of El Nino and that we are seeing in the Southeast Asian markets, the agri crops have taken a hit.

other.statement: Overall consolidated capacity utilization around 70%, freeze-dried higher, spray-dried sufficient for 2-3 years
other.quote: At an overall consol level, our capacity utilization is closer to 70%-odd with freeze-dried utilization higher than this. So the freeze-dried utilization is much faster. And at least for the spray dried part, we need not worry about the capacity for the next at least 2 to 3 years.

other.statement: International branded business currently around INR30 crores, Percol at INR25-30 crores, targeting profitability by next year
other.quote: As of now, we are looking at a similar kind of a number between INR25 crores, INR30 crores that we will end this year at. Having said so, we had indicated that maybe 1, 2 years -- because we are investing behind the brands also, maybe INR1 crores or INR2 crores of loss at an annualized basis. Hopefully, by next year, we should start seeing some profits also coming from that front.

guidance.statement: Full-year content cost guidance maintained at INR90-100 crores with H1 spend of INR71 crores front-loaded
guidance.quote: Please note, during the 6 months, the content cost was at INR71 crores, which is front-loaded, and we expect the content cost for the full year to be in the range of INR90 crores to INR100 crores only.

guidance.statement: Revenue and PAT growth guidance upgraded from 20% to 22-23% but management remains conservative
guidance.quote: We would exceed our 20% guidance. We don't want to put a specific number to it.

demand.statement: Revenue growth of 35% YoY in Q2 FY27 driven by both new releases and catalogue across digital and non-digital platforms
demand.quote: Revenue for Q2 FY '27 stood at INR120 crores as compared to INR89.2 crores in Q2 FY '26, representing a year-on-year growth of 35%.

demand.statement: Growth primarily volume-driven with marginal subscription price increase contribution
demand.quote: It would be primarily volume-driven growth. Marginally, it could be related to subscription, but the subscription prices is also growing at a healthy pace.

margin.statement: Q2 FY27 EBITDA margin at 70.5% and PAT margin at 54%
margin.quote: Operating EBITDA was INR84.64 crores, reflecting a Y -o-Y growth of 25% with an EBITDA margin of 70.5%. Profit after tax stood at INR65.5 crores, representing a growth of 23% over the previous year quarter, while PAT margin for the quarter was 54%.

capex.statement: Content investment strategy targets 20-22% of revenue, willing to go to 25-28% for quality content
capex.quote: I have always guided. You see, my budget is around top-line, 22%. We have to invest in content. But if we ever get the opportunity that we're getting really good content and the budget is 25% or 28%, so we can explain to people like you, that the content cost has increased here.

pricing_cost.statement: YouTube per-stream rate stable at ~INR0.05, not expected to increase; growth to come from volume and paid subscription uptake
pricing_cost.quote: No, it won't go to INR0.08, it will remain INR0.05. Only we have to see we will we should release our good new releases and we should support our catalogue and we should promote our repertoire such a way so they can perform better.

product_mix.statement: Plan to release 5-6 films annually with 4-5 in Hindi and 2-3 in regional languages
product_mix.quote: We want to release at least five films-six films a year, and four-five should be in Hindi and two-three in other regional languages. We'll achieve that.

product_mix.statement: Digital revenue contribution at 73% for H1 FY27 with subscription revenue at 10-15% of digital
product_mix.quote: Digital contribution for the first half was 73%, as we have mentioned in the presentation.

risk.statement: Content acquisition based on 4-5 year capital recovery projection, full write-off in same quarter eliminates long-term write-down risk
risk.quote: We base our content investments on the projection that we will recover our capital within 4 to 5 years if that happens, we consider it a success. Another positive aspect of our approach is that if we acquire content for, say, INR50 crores or INR100 crores in a given year, we write it off within that same quarter.

other.statement: Completed buyback of INR44.44 crores and declared interim dividend of INR6.5 per share
other.quote: We have successfully completed the buyback of shares amounting to INR44.44 crores through open market buyback. During this quarter, the Board has declared an interim dividend of INR6.5 per share.

other.statement: Released 73 songs in Q2 FY27 comprising 40 film and 33 non-film songs
other.quote: During the quarter, we released 73 songs, comprising of 40 film songs and 33 non -film songs.

guidance.statement: Revenue growth guidance of mid-single to slightly higher LFL for FY27 with healthy profitability expansion
guidance.quote: We maintain our estimated revenue growth of mid -single to slightly higher LFL FY27 and healthy expansion of profitability as already witnessed in H1.

guidance.statement: Departmental store opening guidance raised to 12 stores for FY27 from earlier 9-10
guidance.quote: From an earlier guidance of gross store openings where we had mentioned that we will open between 9 to 10 stores, we are looking at 12 store openings this year.

guidance.statement: Departmental store opening guidance of 10-12 stores per year for next 2-3 years
guidance.quote: Our guidance would be around 10 to 12 stores, of which we have mentioned 12 this year, a similar number for the year for the coming 2 or 3 years.

guidance.statement: Personal Shopper contribution target of 30% of revenue by end of FY27
guidance.quote: We are resourcing the stores through more personal shoppers and we see this contribution reaching to 30% of revenue by end of the year.

demand.statement: Strong consumer demand sustained through Q2 with healthy mid-teens LFL growth in festive season
demand.quote: The current operating and consumption environment, which started kicking in Q1 sustained the momentum through Q2. And I'm happy to share that the demand continues to remain strong.

demand.statement: Pujo calendar showing healthy mid-teens LFL growth in East market stores
demand.quote: The start of the Pujo calendar for East market has been very good, and we are witnessing a healthy mid -teen like -for-like growth in our stores.

demand.statement: Dussehra calendar showing strong upsurge with mid-teens LFL growth
demand.quote: Similarly, the Dussehra calendar too has shown a strong upsurge with a mid -teens like-for-like growth.

margin.statement: Non-GAAP consolidated EBITDA grew 56% YoY in Q2 FY27
margin.quote: While on a non -GAAP consol basis, our revenues grew by 7%, and EBITDA grew by 56%, and as a result, we were able to turn around PAT from a loss of Rs 7 crores in last year to a profit of Rs 6 crores this year.

margin.statement: New business EBITDA losses reduced by Rs 8 crores in Q2 and Rs 12 crores in H1
margin.quote: Led by improvement in INTUNE productivity and integration of SSBeauty.in into SS.com, we could reduce the EBITDA losses in new businesses by Rs 8 crores in Q2 and Rs12 crores in H1.

margin.statement: Expect further reduction in new business losses in Q3 and Q4
margin.quote: We expect the losses to reduce further in Q3 and Q4.

order_book.statement: Opened 4 departmental stores in Q2, total 6 in H1 FY27
order_book.quote: We opened four departmental stores during the quarter, Sindhu Bhavan in Ahmedabad, Jabalpur, Bailey Square in Patna and Jhansi, which means we opened total six departmental stores in H1.

order_book.statement: Opened 7th departmental store in Pacific Mall Jaipur in early October
order_book.quote: We'll be opening our seventh store for the year in Pacific Mall in Jaipur, which is North India's largest mall in next week on third October.

order_book.statement: Opened 2 beauty boutiques in Q2, total 11 boutiques now
order_book.quote: We opened two boutiques in this quarter. And with this total, we now have 11 boutiques, four Armani, three NARS, two Shiseido, one Prada and one Creed.

capex.statement: Internal accruals and balance sheet robustness to fund expansion across departmental stores, INTUNE and beauty distribution
capex.quote: All these areas, areas of profitable growth, they will need some kind of capital investments, and we'll have internal accruals as well as the balance sheet robustness to fund for that growth.

pricing_cost.statement: Festive mid-teens growth driven by 7% ASP increase and 8% volume growth
pricing_cost.quote: So, it is around 7% for ASP and the balance 8% because of volume. So we are what we are seeing is that we are able to sell more merchandise and with a higher price.

pricing_cost.statement: INTUNE testing higher price points Rs 1,299 and Rs 1,499 with strong sell-throughs, no RM pressure
pricing_cost.quote: We have not taken a price hike, but I think in our mind, we were artificially having a ceiling of Rs 999. When we started testing out this last year at the start of this year with a line of Rs 1,299, we realize that both the ROS, which is return on sales as well as the throughput, which is the sell -throughs are very high.

product_mix.statement: Premium portfolio contribution improved 390 bps to all-time high of 73%
product_mix.quote: With constant focus, the premium portfolio contribution in stores improved by 390 basis points, and they stand now at an all -time high of 73%.

product_mix.statement: ATV increased 9% to Rs 5,471
product_mix.quote: The ATV for the quarter has gone up by 9%, which now stands at Rs 5,471 showing core operational strength.

risk.statement: INTUNE store closures primarily in high street locations, learning to focus on mall spaces
risk.quote: So the few spaces that we have closed are primarily high street, this is something which we are learning on.

risk.statement: Departmental store closures of 1-2 stores expected in FY27
risk.quote: We are looking at a one or two store closure.

other.statement: Departmental store LFL grew 2% (6.5% festive adjusted) with total growth of 4%
other.quote: The like -for-like business for departmental stores grew by 2% this quarter with a total growth of 4%. Adjusted for the festive calendar shift, because Pujo date shifted from September to October, the like-for-like growth w as 6.5%.

other.statement: Customer entry grew 1% for LFL stores and 7.7% overall
other.quote: Our customer entry grew by 1% for like -for-like stores and overall growth of 7.7%.

guidance.statement: Reiterated full-year FY27 EBIT margin target of 15%
guidance.quote: We reiterate that we remain on tr ack to achieve our full-year FY27 EBIT margin target of 15

demand.statement: Broad-based growth across verticals; Communications grew 9.5% Y-o-Y, Retail 9.2%, Manufacturing 7%, Healthcare 6.2%, BFSI 4.6%
demand.quote: From a vertical perspective, in Communications, revenues grew 9.5% year-on-year, supported by the ramp-up of the Orange large deal and new strategic engagements.

margin.statement: EBIT margin expanded 40 bps Q-o-Q and 260 bps Y-o-Y to 14.8% in Q2 FY27
margin.quote: EBIT for the quarter stood at US$250 million with an EBIT margin of 14.8%, up 40 basis points on a Q-o-Q basis and 260 basis points on a Y-o-Y basis.

order_book.statement: Total deal wins for Q2 FY27 were US$1.023 billion; LTM deal wins US$4.27 billion, up 34.8% Y-o-Y
order_book.quote: Our total deal wins for the quarter stand at US$1,023 million. On a last-12-month basis, deal wins stand at US$4,270 million, up 34.8% Y-o-Y.

capex.statement: Investing in AI-era capabilities including Zero-Gravity Telco Architecture, Consumer Agentic Experience Studio, Toronto Innovation Hub, Engineering Experience Center, and Indus-Terra 30B parameter model
capex.quote: We continue to strengthen TechM Helix through strategic investments in industry solutions, engineering capabilities, and our people. Zero-Gravity telco architecture and Consumer Agentic Experience Studio are part of this effort to make AI more relevant to clients' business needs.

pricing_cost.statement: Adopting outcome-based pricing models combining human and agent token economics; early successes in F&A processes and telco use cases
pricing_cost.quote: We have seen some early successes where clients want to use that in specific portfolios. We have seen some successes in F&A processes where the clients are looking at using our Vector Squad-based pricing to really start looking at driving outcomes which was different from a typical FP or a T&M kind of contracts.

risk.statement: Expect normal seasonality in H2 FY27; some weakness in European auto manufacturing but manageable within portfolio
risk.quote: No, we expect normal seasonality. We continue to see some weaknesses in our European auto manufacturing business, but those are all manageable within the existing portfolio that we have.

other.statement: Partnered with Quantum Technology Foundation for India's indigenous 20-qubit trapped-ion quantum computer; completion expected December 2026
other.quote: In quantum technologies, we partnered with Quantum Technology Foundation to develop middleware for India's indigenous 20-qubit trapped-ion quantum computer. Completion is expected by December 2026, with commercialization activities expected thereafter.

other.statement: Return on capital employed 31.2% for quarter, up 290 bps Q-o-Q and 680 bps Y-o-Y
other.quote: Our return to capital employed stood at 31.2% for the quarter, reflecting a sequential improvement of 290 basis points. On a Y-o-Y basis, the ROCE improved by 680 basis points.

guidance.statement: Revised deposit growth guidance to 11-12% from 9-11%
guidance.quote: On guidance, I had guided for deposit growth of 9-11%, and I am revising that to 11-12%.

guidance.statement: Revised advances growth guidance to 13-14% from 11-13%
guidance.quote: I had guided for advances growth of 11-13%, and I am revising that to 13-14%.

guidance.statement: Expects NIM expansion of 5-6 basis points in Q3 FY27
guidance.quote: On NIM, I expect expansion of around 5-6 basis points this quarter, because deposits, including bulk deposits, will reprice later.

guidance.statement: Expects advances growth of 14-15% in next quarter
guidance.quote: Even so, I expect advances growth of 14-15%, and I am comfortable with that; it will not fall substantially.

demand.statement: Advances grew 16.39% YoY; corporate 9.92%, RAM 17.74% (retail 17.37%, agri 17.18%, MSME 19.06%)
demand.quote: Advances grew by 16.39%. Corporate advances grew by 9.92%, almost in double digits, while RAM advances grew by 17.74%. All segments are growing evenly: retail grew by 17.37%, agriculture by 17.18% and MSME by 19.06%.

demand.statement: Targets corporate growth of 10-12% with capacity building initiatives
demand.quote: In corporate, I am targeting growth of 10-12%. Corporate growth is also a function of capacity building; earlier, our corporate growth was only 1-2%.

demand.statement: Agricultural gold loan book grew 22% YoY to Rs.1.16 lakh crore, up 11% QoQ
demand.quote: The agricultural gold-loan book has grown by around 22% year-on-year, to Rs.1.16 lakh crore. So it has grown by around 11% on Q-o-Q basis sequentially, from Rs.1.04 lakh crore to Rs.1.16 lakh crore.

margin.statement: NIM improved 8 bps YoY; domestic NIM up 1 bp QoQ, global NIM up 2 bps QoQ
margin.quote: NIM improved by 8 basis points on a year-on-year basis. Domestic NIM increased by 1 basis point and global NIM by 2 basis points on Q-o-Q basis.

margin.statement: Cost of deposits up 9 bps QoQ; yield on advances up 8 bps QoQ; yield on investments up 2 bps QoQ
margin.quote: The cost of deposits increased by 9 basis points sequentially. The yield on advances increased by 8 basis points sequentially, and the yield on investments increased by 2 basis points sequentially.

margin.statement: Corporate yield improved from 8.36% to 8.49% QoQ
margin.quote: The corporate yield is 8.49%, compared with 8.36% in June.

order_book.statement: Corporate credit pipeline stands at Rs.63,000 crore with Rs.30,000 crore sanctioned but undisbursed
order_book.quote: The corporate credit pipeline stands at Rs.63,000 crore. Of this, Rs.30,000 crore has been sanctioned and is yet to be disbursed, in-principle approval has been given for Rs.10,000 crore, and the remaining around Rs.23,000 crore is under discussion or at a preliminary stage.

capex.statement: Approved raising up to Rs.5,000 crore through Infrastructure Bonds
capex.quote: We have taken approval to raise up to Rs.5,000 crore through Infrastructure Bonds, and we may go for that.

product_mix.statement: MCLR-linked book 43.19%, external benchmark-linked 49.65%; repo rate hike benefit started immediately on external benchmark book
product_mix.quote: The MCLR-linked book constitutes 43.19% of advances, and the external benchmark-linked book constitutes 49.65%. As you all know, the repo rate has been increased by 25 basis points, so we should see NIM expansion of perhaps 5-6 basis points going forward.

risk.statement: ECL models will take 1.5-2 years to stabilize; regulator may challenge assumptions
risk.quote: I will wait and watch for one year, because this is a new concept. It will take 1.5-2 years for the models to stabilize. They will be challenged, there will be a lot of discussion, and the regulator may not accept all our assumptions.

risk.statement: No stress seen in SME, agri, retail; drought exposure minimal (<Rs.1,000 crore)
risk.quote: Very candidly, nothing is reflecting so far. I cannot say what may emerge suddenly, but as of now there is no stress.

other.statement: Gross NPA 1.61%, Net NPA 0.14%, slippage ratio 0.69% down 8 bps QoQ
other.quote: Gross NPA declined to 1.61%, and net NPA stood at 0.14%. The slippage ratio was 0.69%, a decline of 8 basis points from the previous quarter.

other.statement: SMA book declined to 4.19% (Rs.29,748 crore) from 7.35% a year ago; SMA-2 above Rs.25 crore only Rs.400 crore
other.quote: The SMA book declined from 7.35% a year ago to 4.19%, or Rs.29,748 crore in absolute terms. SMA-2 accounts above Rs.25 crore amount to only around Rs.400 crore.

guidance.statement: USD 1 billion revenue target by late FY29 or early 2030, includes transformer + backward integration product sales, no additional capex needed
guidance.quote: It will be late part of FY29 or early 2030.

guidance.statement: Confident of achieving FY27 guidance of 25% revenue growth and 9-10% PAT margin
guidance.quote: Following our Q2 performance, we remain confident of achieving FY27 guidance and continue to remain on track with our growth plans for the full year.

guidance.statement: Maintain FY27 guidance of 25% revenue growth and 9-10% PAT margin
guidance.quote: So, our target is to reach a growth of 25% and beyond. So, we are keeping it the same.

margin.statement: Q2 FY27 EBITDA margin 16.1% vs 8.8% YoY and 13.3% QoQ, driven by operating leverage and utilization
margin.quote: EBITDA margin improved to 16.1% compared to 8.8% in Q2FY26 and 13.3% in Q1 FY27. This reflects the benefit of higher operating leverage and improved utilization level during the quarter.

margin.statement: Backward integration expected to add 200-300 bps margin expansion, full effect by FY29
margin.quote: So, we are looking at around 200 basis point to 300 basis point margin expansion through this backward integration.

order_book.statement: Unexecuted order book at Rs 7,237 crore as of 30 Sep 2026, up 32% YoY, executable over 18-24 months
order_book.quote: As of 30th September 2026, our unexecuted order book stood at 7,237 crore, up by 32% year-on-year, providing strong revenue visibility over the medium term. The order book is executable over the next 18 to 24 months.

order_book.statement: Order inflows of Rs 1,169 crore in Q2 FY27, 97% YoY growth
order_book.quote: During Q2 FY27, we received order inflows of 1,169 crores, 97% year-on-year growth over low base of last year this time.

order_book.statement: Rs 21,000 crore of inquiries under negotiation, 80% domestic and 20% export, equal government-private mix
order_book.quote: We currently have 21,000 crores of inquiries under negotiation, of which bidding for 80% is domestic orders and 20% export orders, with equal mix between the government and private customers, with utilities and industrial customers.

capex.statement: Moraiya EHV expansion to start after Changodar completion, 30% capacity addition from freed insulation space, target FY28 production
capex.quote: And pl us what will happen with our insulation and pressboard plant com ing live, the manufacturing place for insulation, which was at Moraiya, will now be added to transformer manufacturing unit. So, we will be adding about 30% plus manufacturing capacity at Moraiya

pricing_cost.statement: Raw material prices (transformer oil, CRGO) remain high but majority of orders have price variation clauses limiting margin impact
pricing_cost.quote: Yes. So sir, the prices, etcetera, are still on the higher side. But what we have, we have a majority of order which is having, say, a price variation clause. So mainly, it does not affect our margin in a big way.

product_mix.statement: Nuclear transformer content 15-18% of greenfield nuclear project cost
product_mix.quote: So, greenfield nuclear new projects would be close to about 15% to 18%.

product_mix.statement: BESS transformer inquiries ongoing, expect orders in current quarter, market assessment underway
product_mix.quote: No. We are not currently executing any BESS pipeline. But yes, there are inquiries that are currently ongoing, and we are sure that in this quarter we should get some orders for BESS transformers.

risk.statement: HVDC converter transformer qualification 1.5 years away (repair 4-5 months, testing 6-7 months, then tender participation)
risk.quote: So, we are currently repairing the transformer, so with that will be another four to five months' time, then the successful running of that transformer will take another six to seven months. And then we will qualify for the manufacturing, and then we will start participating into the tender. So at least one and one and half months one and half year is away from when we are speaking.

other.statement: Target capacity utilization of 90%, currently working towards it
other.quote: So ideally, I would want a capacity utilization of about 90%, and we are constantly working and we are constantly progressing towards that.

other.statement: Target working capital cycle of 110-120 days by end of FY27 to generate positive free cash flow
other.quote: It should be below 120 days. We are trying to, you know, reach at 120, and once we reach there, we would like to see close to between 110 days and 120 days this year.

guidance.statement: Management expects festive shift of ~INR40 crore advertising revenue from Q2 to Q3 FY27 and remains optimistic on next two quarters despite geopolitical concerns
guidance.quote: we believe there is an impact of almost around INR40 crores. Now with that shifting into Q3 and the overall momentum, what we believe is there, though in certain parts of India, the monsoon is not playing well because in Rajasthan, even there's a rains happening even today.

guidance.statement: Management endeavors to achieve high single-digit to early double-digit full-year advertising revenue growth
guidance.quote: That's what our endeavor is. Looking at this -- what we've seen in the last 7, 8 days of festival, overall momentum is good. let's hope this continues.

demand.statement: Festive season shift (Navratri moved from Q2 to Q3) impacted YoY advertising comparison; underlying advertising revenue grew positive single-digit excluding festive shift
demand.quote: As you know, last year, Navaratra festival season was in Q2, and this year, it falls in Q3. So on a like -to-like basis, D. B. Corp advertising revenue and EBITDA registered positive single -digit growth in Q2 excluding the impact of this festive shift.

demand.statement: Real estate advertising flat to single-digit; jewelry strong double-digit; banking/financial services and IPO advertising up ~50% (small base); healthcare strong double-digit; auto flat; education single-digit; FMCG down 2% YoY but ~single-
demand.quote: Real estate single digit, ideally, this should have been good double digit, but because of the real festival season going this way. So most of them are almost flat or single digit.

margin.statement: Consolidated EBITDA INR124 crore vs INR115 crore YoY; PAT INR69 crore vs INR93 crore YoY; H1 EBITDA INR289 crore vs INR297 crore YoY
margin.quote: EBITDA stood at INR124 crores compared to INR115 crores in the corresponding quarter last year, while profit after tax stood at INR69 crores against INR93 crores.

order_book.statement: Circulation at ~38 lakh copies (37.68 lakh in Q2 vs ~38 lakh prior quarter); ~30,000 copies lost QoQ; focus on maintaining core market share, non-core markets less concerning
order_book.quote: We are at around 38 lakh copies. If you compare the last quarter, numbers are almost the same. So all efforts are there to make sure that we continue having the base, but a f ew percentage here and there is the one which is bothering us.

capex.statement: No major capex planned for next 4-5 quarters; all machines and production equipment in place
capex.quote: we don't have any large capex planned because all the machines, production e quipments and all are all in place. So we don't see -- foresee any major capex coming in a couple of quarters or maybe 4, 5 quarters ahead.

pricing_cost.statement: Advertising pricing: upgrading advertisers from inside pages to premium pages (front, back, third page) to increase ticket size; no discount on premium page rates
pricing_cost.quote: What we are doing on the pric ing side, we are able to increase the ticket size, which means the advertiser who was advertising on inside page, we've been able to upgrade them, take some extra money from them and bringing them on to the premium pages of back page, third page and the front page also.

product_mix.statement: Digital app subscription price hiked from INR149 to INR199 on experimental basis (cohort testing); too early to quantify revenue impact; advertising, subscription and tie-ups all nascent
product_mix.quote: First of all, the price hike, which we have taken from INR149 to INR199, this will all be experimental basis. It's not a flat. Some places we have even tried slightly lesser, even monthly price and all that.

product_mix.statement: Digital MAU declined from 20M (Q4) to 18M (Q2) due to reduced marketing spend and subscription experiments; QoQ decline ~3-4%
product_mix.quote: We have tried to reduce the marketing spend on this entire activity because we believ e now brands should be able to sustain the readers' base based on th eir own merits and the organic. So we have reduced the marketing spend.

risk.statement: Geopolitical situation a concern for newsprint costs and overall demand outlook; monsoon irregularities in Rajasthan may affect near-term advertising
risk.quote: Especially I'm more concerned about the geopolitical situation. But having said that, looking at the overall momentum which our country has, I'm pretty optimistic on the next 2 quarters also.

other.statement: Newsprint cost per tonne increased ~21% YoY from INR47,000 to ~INR57,000 due to geopolitical situation; domestic prices follow imported; freight also higher; expects 2-3% softening in Q3-Q4
other.period: Q2 FY27, Q3 FY27, Q4 FY27
other.quote: What we were paying INR47,000 per tonne average cost, we are paying right now almost INR57,000. So there are almost 20.8% to be more precise 21% is the impact on the newsprint cost.

other.statement: Cash and bank balance ~INR1,120 crore; first interim dividend INR5/share paid in Q1; further distribution to be decided by Board
other.quote: As on today, company has a total cash and bank balance of around INR1,120 crores. And as you know, the company has already paid INR5 per share as the first interim dividend in the Q1.

guidance.statement: Management aspires for high-teens revenue growth in FY27 and double-digit growth over the long term.
guidance.quote: Over the long term, we want to aspire for a double-digit growth. And yes, for the year, we are expecting a high teens, and that's what we've just said.

guidance.statement: Management does not provide quarterly guidance.
guidance.quote: So unfortunately, I can't guide you towards next quarter or thereon.

demand.statement: Almond Drops Hair Oil delivered double-digit unit volume growth across pack groups and channels, led by small and medium packs.
demand.quote: Almond Drops Hair Oil continues with its strong performance in this quarter and has delivered double -digit unit volume growth.

demand.statement: General trade and organized trade both grew in the strong mid-20s; rural grew marginally ahead of urban; quick commerce is the fastest-growing sub-channel.
demand.quote: This quarter saw continued momentum in our general trade channel, which grew in line with organized trade, and both channels delivered growth in the strong mid-20s.

demand.statement: International business grew ahead of company average in H1 except Bangladesh which grew in the teens due to tough environment.
demand.quote: This channel for the full H1 has grown ahead of the company growth, and except for Bangladesh, most of our other ke y markets individually have also grown ahead of the company average.

margin.statement: Gross margin 59.9% in Q2 and 60.8% in H1; sequential reduction offset by fixed and employee cost savings.
margin.quote: Our gross margins for the quarter were at 59.9%, and overall for the first half of the year at 60.8%.

margin.statement: Focus is on growing absolute EBITDA pool rather than percentage margin in inflationary environment.
margin.quote: One, see, in an inflationary environment, our attempt is to protect and grow the absolute EBITDA pool rather than a percentage EBITDA pool.

margin.statement: Q2 EBITDA margin 25%, PAT margin 21%; H1 EBITDA INR167 cr (85% growth), PAT INR141 cr (75% growth).
margin.quote: On margins, we delivered an EBITDA of INR53 crores with an EBITDA margin of 25%, and a PAT of INR70 crores with a PAT margin of 21%.

capex.statement: Outsourced Guwahati factory production to third-party facility at start of FY27 for better operating efficiencies.
capex.quote: So, see, what has happened is that we have outsourced basically the production of one of our factories in Guwahati from a company-owned facility to a third-party-run facility to drive better operating efficiencies towards the beginning of this financial year.

pricing_cost.statement: Calibrated price increase of ~5% in Q3 split roughly equally between 2-3% frontal price increase and similar contribution from ml-age reductions.
pricing_cost.quote: In this round, we are approximately taking a 5% increase in consumer price, which will be split roughly equally between frontal price increase of 2% to 3% and a similar contribution coming through ml-age reductions.

pricing_cost.statement: Endeavor to pass on absolute cost increases rather than protect percentage gross margin; peers also taking price hikes.
pricing_cost.quote: And we are taking price increase which we believe would be sufficient to cover the kind of a cost impact we would need to manage our overall P&L.

product_mix.statement: Relaunched and launched new SKUs in growth portfolio: refined amla oil proposition, upgraded body lotion product and packaging, Banjara's packs extending into large adjacent categories.
product_mix.quote: In amla oils, we have refined the consumer proposition and are testing the new mix in general trade. In body lotion, we have upgraded both the product and packaging, and will test it on e-commerce. In Banjara's, we have introduced packs that extend the brand into large adjacent categories, which could offer significant growth potential for us if we are successful.

product_mix.statement: Test marketing Banjara's lip balm and color shampoo (INR15) in four southern states to leverage herbal equity and expanded distribution.
product_mix.quote: We are test marketing these in Banjara's markets core markets only, which are the four southern states. The belief which we have is Banjara's is a company which has been there in these markets for many decades, and hence, there is a very strong equity around the herbal, natural, you know, brand values which exist.

risk.statement: Biggest risk from changing consumer preferences impacts less than 1-1.5% of households; category has 91%+ penetration.
risk.quote: This is a category of ours where we operate which has a 91% plus penetration, which means nearly every single household in the country uses this. The change in demographics or the change in preferences which possibly you're referring to is what we see impacting less than maybe 1% to 1.5% of the households in the country.

risk.statement: Rural demand concerns (El Nino, harvest) are a while away; government easing measures underway; management remains optimistic.
risk.quote: See, I think it's early, but we remain optimistic. At the same point of time, I would say it is early because, you know, whatever concerns which we are talking about which included you talked about in terms of rural demand, El Niño, they are all a while away.

other.statement: A&P spend up 7% YoY in Q2 and 18% in H1; optimized non-working A&P and reworked media operating cycles for spend efficiencies.
other.quote: Our consolidated A&P spend for the quarter were up 7% over the same period last year, and are up 18% on H1 basis. We continue to maintain robust SOV/SOM ratios in traditional and digital media, and we have carefully optimized the non -working A&P and reworked our media operating cycles to create some spend efficiencies.

other.statement: Unit volume growth reported as toughest measure; excludes free volume impact; ADHO unit volume growth double-digit.
other.quote: So, the reason why we've given and reported unit volume is because it does not take into account any free volume, any benefit on account of volumes going inside it. And hence, it is a reflection of how many bottles get sold or how many times the consumer has come and bought it.

guidance.statement: AUM growth guidance of 30%-35% CAGR and profitability growth of 35%-40% CAGR
guidance.quote: Guidance, we will maintain 30% to 35% CAGR from the AUM perspective, and 35%-40% CAGR from profitability perspective.

guidance.statement: Target to reach INR10,000-11,000 crores AUM in 2-3 years
guidance.quote: Maybe 2 years to 3 years is the target for us to reach INR10,000 or INR11,000 kind of number.

guidance.statement: Digital lending to contribute ~10% of overall AUM in 2-3 years
guidance.quote: If I were to look at our journey of INR10,000 crores in next 2 to 3 years, I think digital lending should contribute around 10% to our overall AUM.

guidance.statement: Maintain ROA >4.5% and cost-to-income <15%
guidance.quote: We have also achieved all our key operating parameters: maintained nil NPA, return on assets is more than 4.5% and cost-to-income continues to remain less than 15% and we plan to maintain this in quarters to come as well.

margin.statement: Interest cost as % of income rose due to higher leverage (asset-to-equity 2.8x to 3.7x)
margin.quote: Leverage. Our asset-to-equity has gone up from 2.8x to 3.7x in last two quarters. So when the leverage goes up, mathematically the interest cost will go up. But it translates to a better return on equity.

margin.statement: Yield maintained at ~13% (12.5% ROI + 50-70bps fee income)
margin.quote: we're maintaining 13% kind of a yield. 12.5% odd as a ROI and around 50 basis point to 70 basis point as fee income, both put together, around 13% is the yield on our overall AUM whi ch we are

margin.statement: Cost of borrowing ~8% from 19 bank/NBFC relationships
margin.quote: Our cost of borrowing is around 8%. That is something unheard for NBFCs of our size and scale.

order_book.statement: Loan book at all-time high of ~INR5,700 crores in Q2 FY27
order_book.quote: Our loan book is also at an all-time high of around INR5,700 crores.

order_book.statement: Factoring contributes ~15% of loan book
order_book.quote: Around 15% contribution to our book is coming from the factoring.

order_book.statement: Disbursed >INR16,000 crores in H1 FY27 (46% YoY growth)
order_book.quote: We continue to leverage our digital infrastructure and disbursed loans of more than INR16,000 crores in H1, which means volumes of INR32,000 crores on an annualized basis, which translates to less than 2 months of payback cycle for our loan book. This volume, if you were to compare on a year-on-year basis has gone up by 46%.

capex.statement: 15% strategic stake in AI/digital technology subsidiary for in-house stack
capex.quote: We believe from a data security perspective, and from the dependency perspective, having an in-house AI digital stack is a better way forward. That's why we are beginning with a small 15% stake, which is more strategic and a long-term in nature.

product_mix.statement: Launched Factoring, TReDS, digital lending (BharatPe), and loan against property in Q2
product_mix.quote: Apart from dealer financing and deep-tier financing, we have started doing Factoring and TReDS. We have also commercialized digital lending and loan against property during the quarter.

product_mix.statement: Sector mix: ~35% steel/building products, ~20% auto, rest pharma, IT, tiles, electricals, cables
product_mix.quote: If I were to dissect it, around 35% would be steel and building products, another 20% odd would be auto, and then there are varied industry, we are into pharma, IT, Tiles, Electricals, Cables, so on.

fund_raise.statement: No equity raise planned this financial year; leverage increased to 4x instead
fund_raise.quote: No. Our mid-term target was to not leverage ourselves beyond debt-to-equity of 3x. But now considering the growth which has front-loaded, we are revising our leverage to debt-to-equity of 4x.

risk.statement: Digital lending NPA risk mitigated via FLDG, in-built cushions, anchor-led model
risk.quote: NPA does happen. But philosophy of the group is very simple - nil NPAs. And that we want to maintain in BharatPe arrangement also. Maybe at a gross level, NPA may be there. But what matters whether NPAs are hurting us or not. So we have in-built cushions in form of better commercial or FLDG from LSPs.

other.statement: Accumulated provisions ~INR25 crores (regulatory ECL/IRAC, not cash credit cost)
other.quote: Today, we have accumulated maybe around INR25 crores kind of provisions in our balance sheet, which adds to our overall strength of the balance sheet, and that's the requirement of the regulator.

other.statement: Debt-to-equity leverage cap revised from 3x to 4x; board approved incremental borrowing
other.quote: Our mid-term target was to not leverage ourselves beyond debt-to-equity of 3x. But now considering the growth which has front-loaded, we are revising our leverage to debt-to-equity of 4x. Today in our board meeting also, board has approved the incremental borrowing, so we would like to leverage ourselves more.

guidance.statement: No growth guidance provided; focus on sustainable VNB growth over medium term
guidance.quote: We don't provide guidance. We can give you what we should look at from the medium term.

demand.statement: Retail protection growth expected to moderate from 40-50% to more moderate levels in H2 FY27
demand.quote: The expectation is that as you get into H2 of this year, those growth numbers should taper down from the 40%-50% that we've been seeing to more moderate levels.

margin.statement: VNB margin expanded 130 bps to 26.0% in H1 FY27 driven by product mix shift toward protection
margin.quote: VNB margin stood at 26.0%, an expansion of 130 basis points from the full-year margin of 24.7% last year.

order_book.statement: VNB grew 22.3% YoY to ₹12.83 billion in H1 FY27; total premium grew 15.3% to ₹245.05 billion
order_book.quote: VNB growing by 22.3% to ₹ 12.83 billion in H1 -FY2027, and margins stood at 26.0%. Total premium grew by 15.3% year-on-year to ₹ 245.05 billion.

order_book.statement: Sum assured grew 30.1% YoY to ₹8.81 trillion; retail sum assured up 34.9% to ₹2.32 trillion
order_book.quote: In H1-FY2027, our sum assured grew by 30.1% to ₹ 8.81 trillion, supported by a strong 39.5% year-on-year growth in protection APE.

capex.statement: 54% of savings policies issued same day reflecting straight-through processing and automation progress
capex.quote: In H1-FY2027, 54% of our savings policies were issued on the same day, reflecting the progress we have made in straight -through processing and automation.

pricing_cost.statement: Cost to Premium ratio ex-GST reduced 30 bps to 18.3%; Savings Cost to Premium ex-GST reduced 90 bps to 11.6%
pricing_cost.quote: Our Cost to Premium ratio, excluding GST, reduced by 30 basis points year -on-year to 18.3% in H1-FY2027, and the Savings Cost to Premium ratio, excluding GST, reduced by 90 basis points year-on-year to 11.6% over the same period.

pricing_cost.statement: Operating expenses ex-GST and stamp duty reduced at 8% CAGR over 3 years; 22% absolute reduction in FY26 vs FY23
pricing_cost.quote: Our operating expenses, excluding GST and stamp duty, have reduced at a CAGR of 8% over the last three years, an absolute 22% reduction in FY2026 compared to FY2023.

product_mix.statement: Protection mix increased to 23.4% of APE from 19.3%; savings mix moderated to 76.6% from 80.7%
product_mix.quote: The overall protection mix increased from 19.3% in H1 -FY2026 to 23.4% of APE in H1 -FY2027. Consequently, the savings business mix moderated from 80.7% in H1 -FY2026 to 76.6% in H1-FY2027.

other.statement: Claim settlement ratio 99.3% with 1.1 day TAT for non-investigated claims; early claim ratio 23% best-in-class; zero NPAs since inception
other.quote: Our claim settlement ratio remained industry -leading at 99.3% in H1-FY2027, with an average turnaround time of 1.1 days for non -investigated claims. Our early claim ratio stood at 23%, which is the best -in-class in the industry.

other.statement: Embedded value grew 12.2% YoY to ₹566.69 billion; value of in-force business grew 12% to ₹423.89 billion
other.quote: Our embedded value grew by 12.2% year-on-year to ₹ 566.69 billion at September 30th, 2026. Within the EV, the value of in -force business grew by 12% year -on-year to ₹ 423.89 billion.

guidance.statement: No future guidance on equity yield targets; will optimize franchise to fullest.
guidance.quote: Sir, we don't hazard a guess on anything that is in future. I think we have been able to build a strong franchise over time. We'll obviously do our best to optimize it to the fullest.

demand.statement: Systematic transactions rose from 17 million in June to nearly 19 million in September; monthly systematic book grown nearly 5x in 5 years to INR48 billion vs industry 3x.
demand.quote: So our systematic transactions rose from about 17 million in June to nearly 19 million in September. And if we step back for a moment, monthly systematic transaction book has grown nearly 5x in about 5 years to around INR48 billion and industry in the same p eriod would have grown 3x.

demand.statement: Indian retail investors showing resilience and discipline; SIP flows grown from INR30 billion to INR325 billion monthly over 10 years; large part of equity/hybrid net flows now via SIPs giving predictability.
demand.quote: And you can clearly see in the SIP flows over the last several years. 10 years back, the monthly flow used to be 30 billion, and now we are talking about 325 billion. So there has been a consistent increase during this period.

demand.statement: SIP share growing; confident on SIP book despite competition from newer AMCs with track records.
demand.quote: And we remain confident. I think this is one of the biggest area of focus for us and remain very confident on our SIP book.

margin.statement: Revenue from operations was INR11.7 billion, up 14% year-on-year; operating profit INR9.1 billion, up 16% with operating margin of 36 basis points of AUM.
margin.quote: Revenue from operations for the quarter was INR11.7 billion, up 14% year-on-year. Operating profit was INR9.1 billion, up 16% with an operating margin of 36 basis points of AUM.

margin.statement: AIF fees sit at 80-90 bps, above mutual fund equity book; discretionary PMS earns broadly same as equity MF; non-discretionary PMS is strategic; government mandates priced competitively.
margin.quote: On the margins question, AIF is a margin-accretive business. Fees here sit above what we earn on our mutual fund equity book in the range of 80 to 90 basis points depending on the product.

order_book.statement: Quarterly average AUM was INR9.69 trillion, up 10% year-on-year and 4% sequentially.
order_book.quote: Our quarterly average AUM stood at INR9.69 trillion, up 10% year -on-year and 4% sequentially.

order_book.statement: Equity-oriented assets stood at INR6.51 trillion, representing 67.1% of AUM versus 57.5% for the industry.
order_book.quote: Equity -oriented asset s stood at INR6.51 trillion, representing 67.1% of our AUM compared with 57.5% for the industry.

order_book.statement: Actively managed equity AUM grew 14% year-on-year to INR6.08 trillion with 12.7% market share.
order_book.quote: Within this, actively managed equity AUM grew by 14% year -on-year to INR6.08 trillion with a market share of 12.7%.

capex.statement: Investing in alternatives platform with over 20 investment professionals; expanding investor servicing, operations, sales, distribution; investing in international, digital, technology, AI-led capabilities.
capex.quote: So between alternative and PMS, when I say alternative, both private equity and private credit, we've got more than 20 investment professionals now and significantly expanding our capacity on investor servicing, on operations, on the whole sales and then the distribution side, so on and so forth.

capex.statement: GIFT City subsidiary: 6 inbound funds for global investors, recently launched 2 outbound funds (developed market feeder, emerging market feeder); will keep evaluating and growing strategies.
capex.quote: We have got six funds for inbound investment that is investment by global investors in India. And recently, we have launched two products for outbound where there's an opportunity for Indian investors to invest globally.

capex.statement: Mutual fund investment team grown from ~30 to ~40 professionals; will continue to grow as AUM scales to INR20-40 lakh crores.
capex.quote: But even on the mutual fund side, team till a couple of years back was like 30 professionals. Now number is like closer to 40, and this will continue to grow.

pricing_cost.statement: Active equity yield 61 bps, overall equity 58 bps, debt 28-29 bps, liquid 13 bps for the quarter.
pricing_cost.quote: So, for active equity, our yield were 61 basis points. For overall equity fund, this was 58 basis points. Debt is around 28, 29 basis points. Liquid, 13 basis points.

pricing_cost.statement: Sequential yield improvement largely due to asset mix change, not material movement.
pricing_cost.quote: Largely asset mix change. It's not like a material movement. It's slightly upwards from previous quarter.

product_mix.statement: Launched two new AIFs: a Category II equity fund focused on private markets and a Category III fund investing in listed securities.
product_mix.quote: During the quarter, we also launched 2 new AIFs, a Category II equity fund focused on private markets. We are anticipating first close in thi s quarter and also launched the Category III fund, investing in listed securities, which achieved first close during the last quarter.

product_mix.statement: Started managing EPFO fixed income mandate during the quarter.
product_mix.quote: We have started managing EPFO fixed income mandate during the quarter that went by.

fund_raise.statement: Board distributed almost entire post-tax cash profits as dividend last year; balance sheet cash used for seed capital for alternate platforms; investment schedule disclosed in investor pack.
fund_raise.quote: For the last year, the Board ha s declared a dividend, which effectively where we have distributed the almost entire post-tax cash profits that we generate. The balance sheet that we have, currently, we are using for seed capital for all our alternate platforms.

other.statement: Newer players validate industry growth potential; HDFC AMC has comprehensive platform, deep relationships, well-developed distribution network; confident of capturing financialization of savings opportunity.
other.quote: No, I think that the entry of newer players only validates our thesis that industry has a huge growth potential. And I mean, for us, it is not appropriate to comment on any particular name or firm, but we have a comprehensive platform across active, passive, alternatives. We are continuously expanding , building deep relationship s and extremely well-developed distribution network.

other.statement: H1 cost numbers skewed by CSR expenses taken in Q1; requested to view total cost on annual basis for trend.
other.quote: Sir, actually, we had mentioned this in our last quarterly call. There were some CSR expenses which were taken up in the first quarter. And because of that, you are seeing the H1 numbers getting kind of a bit skewed.

guidance.statement: Cost-to-income ratio target of 46-47% over next 12-18 months
guidance.quote: And as we build out our teams across all our businesses, we continue to hope that we'll make it more and more efficient and try and move that 48 towards the 46 - 47 number.

guidance.statement: Cost-to-operating-income ratio improvement of 100-150 bps year-on-year guided
guidance.quote: I think we had guided for a 1 - 1.5% kind of overall improvement year-on-year. I think we are well on course to achieve that.

guidance.statement: UBS collaboration targets $600-650 million flows for current financial year
guidance.quote: So, in some senses, we've internally looked at a target of exchanging $600 odd million in flows for the current financial year.

demand.statement: UHNI segment growing at 13-15%; record IPO and monetization activity driving liquidity events
demand.quote: The UHNI segment continues to grow at 13 - 15%, and monetization events such as IPOs, block deals, stake sales, keep releasing liquidity to promoters and families.

demand.statement: Monthly SIP flows hit record ₹32,500 crores in September; 70 companies raised ₹90,500 crores via IPOs in Q2
demand.quote: Monthly SIP flows touched a record of ₹32,500 crores in September, and close to 70 companies raised ₹90,500 crores through IPOs during the quarter.

margin.statement: ARR revenue grew 27.5% YoY to ₹706 crores; ARR retention improved to 79 bps from 74 bps in Q1
margin.quote: ARR revenue grew 27.5% y-o-y to ₹706 crores. ARR now contributes 79% of operating revenues, and ARR retention improved to 79 basis points from 74 basis points in Q1.

margin.statement: Wealth ARR revenue grew 40.5% YoY to ₹503 crores; retention improved to 79 bps from 71 bps
margin.quote: ARR revenue grew 40.5% year-on-year to ₹503 crores. Retention improved to 79 basis points from 71 basis points in Q1.

margin.statement: Asset management ARR revenue ₹203 crores with 79 bps retention; operating PBT ₹108 crores
margin.quote: ARR revenue was ₹203 crores with retentions of 79 basis points, and operating PBT was ₹108 crores.

order_book.statement: Total AUM at ₹9 lakh crores, up 31% YoY; ARR AUM at ₹3,53,000 crores, up 19.7% YoY
order_book.quote: Total AUMs stood at about ₹9 lakh crores, up 31% year-on-year. ARR AUMs stood at ₹3,53,000 crores, up 19.7% year-on-year.

order_book.statement: ARR net flows of ₹12,482 crores in Q2 vs ₹10,815 crores in Q1
order_book.quote: ARR net flows of ₹12,482 crores during the quarter, compared to ₹10,815 crores in Q1.

order_book.statement: 360 ONE Plus advisory platform crossed ₹1 lakh crores AUM
order_book.quote: 360 ONE Plus, our advisory platform, has now crossed ₹1 lakh crores.

capex.statement: COMPASS AI layer live across wealth, asset management, enterprise; aims for efficiency, commercial impact, quality, control
capex.quote: COMPASS, our proprietary and governed AI layer, is live across wealth, asset management, and enterprise functions.

product_mix.statement: 50% of Q2 flows from wallet share enhancement, 50% from new mandates (vs typical 70/30)
product_mix.quote: We are quite excited about the fact that 50% of the flows actually came from enhancement of wallet share, and 50% actually come from new mandates.

product_mix.statement: ET Money Advisory/ARR/MF regular AUM at ₹3,300-3,400 crores; HNI AUM ~₹8,800 crores including ₹2,000 crores transferred from UHNI
product_mix.quote: ET Money are overall Advisory/ARR/Mutual fund and regular codes moved to around about ₹3,300 - 3,400 crores of ARR AUM.

other.statement: Clients with >₹10 crores AUM exceed 4,100, accounting for 95% of ex-custody wealth AUM
other.quote: Clients with more than ₹10 crores of AUM are over ₹4,100 and account for 95% of our ex-custody wealth AUM.

other.statement: Margins stable post 2021-22 reset; differentiation via people-product-platform moat, not pricing
other.quote: I think the big reduction or big kind of reset in margins happened in 2021-22. I think it stayed there. And I don't really see that changing dramatically.

guidance.statement: Stand-alone operating margin guidance of around 45% on annual basis for broking and distribution business
guidance.quote: we remain confident in our ability to sustain stand-alone operating margins of around 45% on an annual basis

guidance.statement: Employee cost guidance of about ₹1,100 crores including ESOP cost for FY27, flat year-on-year
guidance.quote: we'll continue to maintain our guidance of about ₹ 1,100 crores of employee costs, including the cost of stock options for this financial year, which is flat for year -on-year comparison

demand.statement: Average daily orders rebounded to 5.8 million in September, up nearly 12% from August
demand.quote: In September, average daily orders rebounded to 5.8 million, up nearly 12% from August.

demand.statement: Added nearly 1.5 million new clients in Q2 FY27, 11.6% more than Q1
demand.quote: We welcomed nearly 1.5 million new clients this quarter, 11.6% more than Q1

demand.statement: NSE active client base grew, leading to expansion in active clients market share month-over-month each month of quarter
demand.quote: We also witnessed growth in our NSE active client base, leading to an expansion in our active clients market shar e month-over-month in each month of this quarter.

margin.statement: Stand-alone operating margin reached 48.9% in Q2 FY27, exceeding guided range of 40-45%
margin.quote: At the stand-alone level, operating margins reached 48.9%, exceeding our guided range of 40% to 45%.

margin.statement: Consolidated operating margin expanded to 45.1% in Q2 FY27 from 34.5% a year ago
margin.quote: Consolidated operating margins stood at 45.1% compared to 34.5% in the corresponding quarter last year, an expansion of over 1,000 basis points.

margin.statement: Normalized consolidated operating margin stable at 43.8% in Q2 FY27 vs 43.6% in Q1 FY27
margin.quote: after normalizing for seasonal IPL expenditure and ESOP -related reversals, consolidated operating margins remained stable at 43.8% compared to 43.6% in the preceding quarter

order_book.statement: Average client funding book reached lifetime high of ₹74.5 billion, up 40.5% year-on-year
order_book.quote: Our average client funding book reached a lifetime high of ₹ 74.5 billion, up about 40.5% from a year ago.

order_book.statement: Closing client funding book reached record ₹82.1 billion, funded clients increased nearly 30% to 437,000
