other.statement: Variable rate assets INR56,000 crores exceed variable rate liabilities INR51,000 crores, positioning well for rising rate environment
other.value: INR56,000 crores variable assets; INR51,000 crores variable liabilities
other.quote: There is INR56,000 crores of assets, which are variable rate and there is INR51,000 crores of liabilities, which are variable rate, which essentially means that I have more assets where I can reprice up than liabilities where I will get repriced up.

guidance.statement: Positive outlook on demand and margins entering festive season despite macro uncertainties and elevated commodity prices
guidance.quote: Looking ahead, while macroeconomic uncertainties persist and commodity prices remain elevated, we enter the festive season with a positive outlook on both demand and margins.

demand.statement: Consumer demand remains steady despite inflationary environment
demand.quote: Encouragingly, the consumer demand remains steady despite the inflationary environment.

margin.statement: H1 cables contribution margins approximately 15%, broadly in line with long-term average
margin.quote: For H1, cables contribution margins were approximately 15%, broadly in line with the long-term average.

margin.statement: EBITDA grew approximately 30% supported by operating leverage
margin.quote: At an overall level, operating leverage supported healthy EBITDA growth of approximately 30%.

margin.statement: Cable contribution margins normal at 15-15.5% for H1; volatility due to aluminium price decline vs high base
margin.quote: Overall, I have said in the first half, we've retained 15%, which usually is the normal contribution margins overall with the product mix that we have, between 15% - 15.5%.

capex.statement: Cable expansion on track; full expansion on stream in next 18 months, focused on MV and EHV
capex.quote: I think the expansion is pretty much on track, that's what we had pointed out. And I think by in next 18 months, the full expansion will be on stream.

pricing_cost.statement: Further price hikes of 5-7% in Q3 due to sharp raw material increases
pricing_cost.quote: So, it could range between product to product, between 5% to 7%.

pricing_cost.statement: Calibrated pricing actions taken in response to sharp rise in raw material costs
pricing_cost.quote: During the quarter, we also undertook calibrated pricing actions in response to the sharp rise in raw material costs witnessed over the past several months.

product_mix.statement: Lloyd volume growth better than pricing growth; distribution actions settling down
product_mix.quote: I think volume in case of Lloyd is better because the pricing growth is more muted as compared to the Havells segments.

product_mix.statement: Cables business 80-90% aluminium heavy due to Indian market exposure
product_mix.quote: Yes, so if you look at cables, cables, we are more aluminium heavy, because still about almost 80% to 90% of our sales come from Indian markets, which is more aluminium heavy.

risk.statement: No anticipation of commodity price reduction; difficult to say if downtrend emerging
risk.quote: Right now, we are not anticipating any reduction in pricing, because some abatement which has happened is -- that has always been there every month, every quarter. So, at this moment, it is difficult to say where whether we are seeing any downtrend.

other.statement: Switchgear volume growth close to double digits
other.quote: Volume growth overall, if you see cables and wires, it's about very close to double digits.

other.statement: Renewables business developing fast; too early to guide peak revenue or margins; focus on brand and distribution stickiness
other.quote: At this point of time, it's too early to say what are the peak volumes that we will be getting out of this business, but we'll continue to strive towards making it into a healthy margin business because of we want to make it into a brand and distribution-oriented business.

guidance.statement: New businesses to contribute 14-15% of revenue in the long run
guidance.quote: we have provided an ambition where we said about 14 - 15%of our revenue would come from new businesses in the long run

guidance.statement: Medium-term EBITDA margin target of 11-12% by FY29 on a higher revenue base driven by 15% revenue growth
guidance.quote: in the presentation slide number 12, you have mentioned that the company has an ambition to achieve the EBITDA margin of 11% to 12% by FY29

demand.statement: General trade and rural trade delivered double-digit growth; e-commerce subdued due to go-to-market repositioning
demand.quote: general trade and rural trade, which are areas of particular strength of Crompton, both delivered double digit growth. E -commerce, however, was subdued on the back of efforts to reposition our go -to market in the e-commerce channel to improve channel profitability

margin.statement: Consolidated EBITDA grew 24.1% YoY to Rs 205 Cr with margins expanding 40 bps to 9%
margin.quote: EBITDA delivered Rs.205 Crores, surging 24.1% YoY, with margins expanding 40 basis points to 9% compared to a year ago

margin.statement: ECD EBIT margins improved YoY to 11.6%
margin.quote: In ECD, we delivered stellar 19.4% YoY growth with EBIT margins improving YoY to 11.6%

margin.statement: Lighting EBIT at 12.9%, lower than last year due to B2B pre-contracted orders
margin.quote: EBIT stood at 12.9% in lighting. It is lower than it was last year, largely due to the B2B business being impacted by pre-contracted orders

order_book.statement: Executed over 50% of AP government solar rooftop order book (38,000 units); expect completion in coming quarter with spillover
order_book.quote: We have executed more than 50% of our order book with the AP government. The business to consumer and commercial and industrial business of solar rooftop has also commenced in six states

capex.statement: Greenfield manufacturing plant evaluation in advanced stages for fans, appliances and wires
capex.quote: Evaluation of Greenfield manufacturing plant is in advanced stages. With this, we expect to raise our manufacturing capabilities in fans, appliances, and wires

pricing_cost.statement: About 80% of cost increases passed on; remaining to be covered via price hikes and Unnati cost savings
pricing_cost.quote: About 80% of the cost increases have been passed on. Part of this has to be dealt with the cost optimization, which, as I have noted earlier, we have a very rigorous program called Unnati

pricing_cost.statement: Price increases of 11-15% taken across businesses (ex-lighting) over last six months; fans cumulative 17-18% over nine months
pricing_cost.quote: our price increases have been between 15-16%. I don't want to get into specific numbers, but most of our businesses, outside of lighting, as lighting is coming from a period of deflation to suddenly having to inflate prices. So that's a little bit different. But order of magnitude in various businesses, you can say between 11-15% is the kind of price increase that we have taken

product_mix.statement: Butterfly core categories driving growth; Idea First series >10% of business; pressure cooker growth post-GST cut
product_mix.quote: I'm glad to say that that is more than a double-digit contribution to overall share of business for Butterfly. Second is in terms of GST. GST has not benefited across all categories, but it is in pressure cooker, which is where the GST rates have come down. We continue to see disproportionate growth in pressure cooker category

risk.statement: Commodity cost pressures and unpredictable geopolitical developments remain macro headwinds
risk.quote: The industry is currently facing commodity cost pressures and unpredictable geopolitical developments. We have and are continuing to a ddress these through disciplined combination of strategic price increases, consistent execution of Unnati cost savings

other.statement: Fan volume growth robust in general trade and rural; target 1.5-1.7x category growth driven by BLDC, regulation-driven consolidation in entry fans
other.quote: As we move forward, in the investor day, we clearly called out that Fan as a category, we want to be at 1.5x-1.7x the category growth, which means that underlying volume growth also going to come in. We see that being driven by BLDC

other.statement: Export margins similar to domestic but slightly lower, compensated by cash sales (no credit)
other.quote: the margin profile is similar to the one that we have in our domestic sales, actually a little lower, but compensated by the fact th at we don't give credit in the export business. It's cash

guidance.statement: Sambhav target 20% of home loan mix by year-end, 30% in 3-4 years; AUM growth guidance 21-23% unchanged; ROA range 2.1-2.3%
guidance.quote: We have said in the medium next year we will take it to around 20% of the home loan mix. In a longer term, longer term means I am saying 3 years, or 3.5 years, 4 year s, we'll take it to 30% of our home loan mix.

guidance.statement: COF exit March ~7.6% assuming three 25 bps hikes (61-62 bps transmission); new borrowing marginal impact 2-3 bps
guidance.quote: So, 75 bps will result into 61 -62 kind of. It doesn't factor in the new marginal cost of borrowing, so 2-3 bps plus/minuses can be there because of the new borrowing which will come. We are talking the portfolio through the portfolio impact, but the additional new borrowing, it will depend on the market scenario, how's the market scenario, how's the new borrowings available.

margin.statement: NIM compression guidance ~25 bps for FY27; 17 bps already occurred; further 1-2 bps if acquisition pricing passes only 60-70%
margin.quote: In terms of a margin, what we called out around 25 bps kind of a NIM compression, as of today, our calculation would be that we should be in that broadly the range. Even if we stress test it to a certain extent of acquisition pricing not growing in line with cost to the extent of only it grows 60%-70%, then 1-2 bps further can be the NTI pressure.

order_book.statement: Disbursements grew 25% YoY to INR19,900 crore in Q2 FY27
order_book.quote: Disbursement momentum was good during the last quarter with 25% growth, moving from INR15,900 crores to INR19,900 crores in Q2 FY27.

order_book.statement: AUM crossed INR1.5 lakh crore with 25% YoY growth; quarterly AUM addition INR8,580 crore vs INR6,329 crore YoY
order_book.quote: Total AUM stood at INR1.58 lakh crores as of 30th September, and a quarterly AUM addition was close to INR8,580 crores this quarter against INR6,329 crores in Q2 of last year.

order_book.statement: Developer finance book declined 13% YoY on higher repayments and slower disbursements; sanctions up significantly in H1; target 15-17% of portfolio
order_book.quote: It was much higher repayments during the quarter coupled with slower disbursements, both. But larger part was higher repayment because a project-led cash flows, the cash flow momentum was significantly higher. That is what resulted to the book to there. Our strategy remains to grow the book. It is not a strategic call or a conscious call from the company to reduce the growth in this portfolio.

capex.statement: Sambhav monthly disbursement run rate crossed INR500 crore; constitutes 16% of home loan originations; target INR600 crore run rate by year-end
capex.quote: Business crossed a critical milestone of INR500 crore s monthly disbursement run rate in the last quarter with quarterly improvement in disbursement growth, and now Sambhav constitutes 16% of overall home loan originations in Q2.

pricing_cost.statement: Incremental NCD cost 7.04% pre-policy (10-yr post-hedge); NCD cheaper than bank lines; no fresh borrowing post Oct 6 policy
pricing_cost.quote: Which is a incremental rate in NCD, which we last did it on I think before the policy, 1 day before the policy, a 10-year money post hedging was costing at around 7.04% for us.

pricing_cost.statement: Repo hike transmission ~80-82% to COF; portfolio re-pricing matched; 15 bps PLR hike effective Oct 16; new acquisition pricing up 15-20 bps
pricing_cost.quote: So, largely we are an optimized balance sheet with interest rate having asset to liability floating almost completely matched. So, the flow -through of a repo hike to the cost of funds should be to the extent of close to 80%-82% of the hikes which will happen, and the similar flow-through will happen in the portfolio as far as it is concerned.

product_mix.statement: Home loans AUM grew 22% YoY to 53.9% mix; LRD grew 39%, LAP 26%, DF 13% YoY
product_mix.quote: Home loans AUM improved to 22% growth in Q2 against 20% in last quarter, while LRD growth was also strong at 39% against 41% growth in Q1. LAP grew 26%, and DF grew 13% on Y-o-Y basis. AUM mix remained well -diversified with a higher home loan composition at 53.9%.

fund_raise.statement: Assignment strategy for PBC, ALM, income; off-book maintained at 11-13% of AUM; income varies by asset type assigned
fund_raise.quote: The asset strategy, the liability strategy remains same that as Gaurav has called out, 11% to 13% of the book will get assigned out, and the assignment is a strategy we follow for maintaining PBC, followed by ALM, followed by income booking.

risk.statement: Insurance commission draft guidelines may hit 10-11% of PBT; only 4-5% offset feasible in short term; opex/NTI may flatten next year
risk.quote: What we are seeing that what we will if we have to call out specifically, there's a 10% -11% of the PBT which is generated from the cross -sell income, which is the income in conversation. I think 4%-5% of that can be offset by various methods, whether higher efficiencies or there. Balance 6%-7% impact on the PBT is likely to be there, which will also have an impact on opex to NTI in the next year

other.statement: PAT grew 18% YoY to INR980 crore; ROA 2.2%, ROE 12.7%; opex/NTI improved to 19.1%
other.quote: PAT growth was 18% Y-o-Y to INR980 crores in Q2, while ROA was 2.2%, and ROE improved to 12.7%. Operating efficiency continues to improve with opex to NTI ratio at 19.1% as against 19 .7%, which was in Q2 last year.

other.statement: Sambhav ATS INR28 lakh; bureau score >750 at 65%; salaried mix 66%; centralized underwriting model
other.quote: ATS remains stable at INR28 lakhs and customer having bureau score greater than 750 increased to 65%. Salaried customers continue to have a higher mix of 66% even in this business.

guidance.statement: Long-term aspiration of 13-15% revenue CAGR with EBIT margins in 16-17% range over next 3-5 years
guidance.value: 13% to 15% revenue CAGR with EBIT margins in the 16% to 17% range
guidance.quote: This progress supports our long-term aspiration of 13% to 15% revenue CAGR with EBIT margins in the 16% to 17% range over the next 3 years to 5 years.

guidance.statement: Effective tax rate expected to remain in 26-26.5% range going forward
guidance.quote: Effective tax rate for the quarter was 26%. Going ahead, we expect ETR to remain in the range of 26% to 26.5%.

demand.statement: Clients doubling down on growth; tech spend shifting to AI Infrastructure, Silicon, Cloud, Data Centers and Time to Market
demand.quote: Across our client interactions this quarter, the common theme is that clients are doubling down on growth. This makes us cautiously optimistic about their investment plans.

margin.statement: Q2 FY27 EBIT margin at 16.3%, up 60 bps QoQ, achieving mid-16% aspiration ahead of schedule
margin.quote: EBIT margins improved 60 bps quarter-on-quarter to 16.3%, delivering ahead of timeline on our aspiration for mid-16% EBIT levels.

margin.statement: Near-term margins expected to sustain at mid-16% levels with wage hike impact of 50-80 bps in Q3
margin.quote: Near term, you should take it to be at these levels, around mid-16% EBIT levels.

order_book.statement: Q2 large deal TCV at $203 million with over 50% AI-led; order backlog and pipeline up year-on-year
order_book.quote: Large deal TCV was at $203 million across segments with over 50% of them being AI-led wins. Both order backlog and pipeline are up year-on-year.

order_book.statement: Pipeline up more than 25% year-on-year; targeting $200M+ deal pace for Q3 and Q4
order_book.quote: Our pipeline is up more than 25% year-on-year. Order bookings are up. So, knock on wood, let's see where it goes.

capex.statement: Launched new EI lab in partnership with NVIDIA for physical AI native applications
capex.quote: EI for Manufacturing and Operations, we launched a new EI lab in partnership with NVIDIA to build and deliver next-gen physical AI native applications across manufacturing, robotics and supply chain.

pricing_cost.statement: AI-led deals command premium pricing; fixed price mix improved to 35.6%
pricing_cost.quote: Fixed price mix improved to 35.6% in Q2, progressing towards higher value fixed price and outcome-based engagements.

product_mix.statement: Engineering Intelligence annualized revenue at $120 million; AI patent filings crossed 253 this quarter, total 1808
product_mix.quote: EI has an annualized led revenue of $120 million for us in this quarter.

product_mix.statement: AI revenue definition: significant part of deliverable created through AI stack; 9.5% of quarterly revenue
product_mix.quote: See, what we do is if you take any deliverable that we are creating and a significant part of the deliverable is getting created through leverage of AI stack. Then we classify that as an AI revenue.

risk.statement: European auto recovery expected in 6-12 months; Middle East conflict minimal business impact currently
risk.quote: I do believe that should clear up in the next 6, 9, 12 months, if you look at it.

other.statement: Mobility revenue up 2.3% QoQ; Auto Europe muted but expected to bounce back next year
other.quote: Mobility has delivered a phase of steady growth with revenues up 2.3% sequentially.

other.statement: Overall DSO at 78 days (billed 60, unbilled 18), well below guided 80-85 day range
other.quote: Quarter two FY27, overall DSO came in at 78 days. This is split as billed DSO of 60 days and unbilled DSO of 18 days, which remains stable versus 77 days in quarter one FY27, well below our guided range of 80 days to 85 days.

guidance.statement: Revenue growth guidance raised to at least 80% for FY27; FY29 revenue target of ₹10,000 crore expected to be achieved much earlier
guidance.quote: Friends, you will recall that we began FY27 with a revenue growth aspiration of approximately 20% over FY26. After the first quarter, we revised it to 40%, and today when I present Q2FY27 results to you, i am extremely pleased to share that, based on our current expectations and business visibility, we expect revenue growth of at least 80% in this financial year.

guidance.statement: Defence revenue target of ₹500-600 crore for FY27, ₹2,000 crore next year, aspiration of ₹5,000 crore in 3 years
guidance.quote: We remain on track towards our aspiration of approximately ₹500 crore of Defence revenue in FY27.

demand.statement: Demand accelerating across AI infrastructure, hyperscale data centres and telecom networks; no slowdown seen despite rate hikes
demand.quote: Demand continues to accelerate across AI infrastructure, hyperscale data centres and telecom networks. Encouragingly, opportunities with hyperscalers and telecom operators across international markets are steadily converting into firm contracts, strengthening our order pipeline and providing revenue visibility for long term.

demand.statement: Telcos restarting fiber purchases after 2-year pause; large telco inquiries received; Europe/Asia data centre growth to offset any US slowdown
demand.quote: Telcos have not b een buying much since last 2 years. Reason being simple, because the prices increased so much, telcos were not ready to absorb that shock. But finally, they have realized they also need to increase their fiber network because data has to be ultimately carried from the subscriber by the telcos only in most cases. So they are also going to start buying fiber.

margin.statement: EBITDA margin expanded to 25.89% in Q2 FY27 (+640 bps YoY, +264 bps QoQ); management expects margin profile to improve further
margin.quote: EBITDA margin expanded to 25.89%, improving by 640 basis points year-on-year and 264 basis points quarter-on- quarter, while PAT margin rose to 15.51%, gaining 862 basis points year-on-year and 268 basis points over the previous quarter.

margin.statement: Management confident margins will improve due to higher connectivity solutions share, backward integration, and capacity utilization
margin.quote: On an overall basis, I would say margin profile is going to get better only. There is no chance I see of getting reverse or less. It is going to get somewhat better only because more orders are coming up for connectivity solutions, more orders are coming for higher fiber capacity fiber cables, which are not so much in supply by many suppliers.

order_book.statement: Consolidated order book stands at ₹28,900 crore with multi-year visibility; pipeline of advanced-stage orders expected to convert
order_book.quote: Our order book stands at ₹28,900 crore, providing multi -year revenue visibility. Beyond this secured business, we also have a strong pipeline of orders at advanced stages likely to be converted into firm contracts in due course.

order_book.statement: Defence aerospace acquisition brings unexecuted order book of ~₹1,600 crore, expected to close this quarter
order_book.quote: Importantly, the aerospace business being acquired already has unexecuted order book of approximately ₹1600 crore, providing good visibili ty from the outset.

capex.statement: Planned investment of ~₹1,800 crore across optical fiber, cable and preform manufacturing to expand capacities and deepen integration
capex.quote: To support the next phase, our planned investment of approximately ₹1,800 crore across optical fiber, cable and preform manufacturing will expand capacities and deepen integration.

pricing_cost.statement: Fiber prices up ~20% in Q2, now stabilizing; long-term contracts have annual price reset clauses; cost pass-through balanced via negotiation
pricing_cost.quote: Prices in Q2 have really gone up. And I now see more or less stabilizing. But again, I may be completely wrong. I said this in the last quarter also that looks to be stabilizing, but then it has gone up by some 20%.

product_mix.statement: Data centre revenue share 65-75%, telco 25-35% in Q2; data centre pricing higher due to specialized fiber (180 micron A2 vs 250 micron G.657B)
product_mix.quote: I would generally say anywhere between data center would be 65% to 75%, telcos would be between 25% to 35%. Somewhere will vary between that.

risk.statement: Key risks: preform price normalization, germanium supply geopolitical risk, interest rate impact on debt-reliant data centre players, but offset by Europe/Asia/telco demand
risk.quote: So I don't foresee any big risk out of t his interest rate change, except there may be some closures, some less expansion in heavily debt -reliant companies, but that would be offset by Asia, Europe, and demand of telcos, as I have already said.

other.statement: EPC segment loss of ~₹121 crore in Q2 due to unbilled BharatNet milestones and pending Army AMC; next 2 quarters combined loss ≤₹75-100 crore; profitability expected Q1 FY28
other.quote: So the loss which we incurred because of expenses incurred, but not billed, that will not happen this quarter. So this I would say this loss, which is you have seen INR 121 crores or some crores in the current quarter, next 2 quart ers put together should not be more than INR 75 crores to INR100 crores.

other.statement: Fiber capacity expanding from 28M to 38M to 43M fkm; cable capacity from 39M to 56M to 63M fkm
other.quote: Fiber optic itself is going from 28 million to 38 million and 38 million to 43 million. Cable is going to about from 39 million fiber kilometers to 56 million and 56 million to 63 million fiber kilometers.

guidance.statement: Capex for FY27 will be similar to depreciation; some assets will be leased instead of purchased
guidance.quote: the idea is to invest as similar to what we have in terms of depreciation. However, the slight change what we have adopted is in certain cases, which will—I think as the machines will roll in, capex will roll in, what you will see at the end of the year, there will be some leased assets also will be coming in

demand.statement: MTD seeing consistent order inflow and ~50% growth for current year driven by China+1, upgrades, and auto sector (>50% of deliveries)
demand.quote: if you see the growth pattern as of now, I think it is closer to a 50% growth for the current year. demand.statement: TMD net order inflow up ~₹200 crores; 60-70% of order book are project orders for expansion
demand.quote: even this quarter, if you see the numbers. our net order inflow is up by around 200 odd crores. I think this is an indication and when we actually look at the flow of order book, it is closer to 70% is basically project orders.

margin.statement: TMD margins under pressure from unprecedented cost increases (copper, aluminum, electronics); price hike discussions ongoing but no pass-through yet; VAVE efforts underway
margin.quote: yes, the costs are hitting us, and I think the discussion on price always is there; it's on the table. But right now, the unprecedented level of cost increase, availability so if you look at copper, aluminum, you just look at apart from steel, which is probably coming much later, the availability of electrical, electronics, it's a very tough situation out there.

margin.statement: MTD 5-axis machines are high-value, low-volume with potential for higher margins vs imported machines; volume growth also drives operational efficiency and margins
margin.quote: 5 axis machines are high value, low volume. order_book.quote: With respect to the order book, we hold an order book currently of around ₹ 3,400 crores, of which an active order book is roughly ₹2,600 crores.

order_book.statement: LMW Global export order book is ₹163 crores; LMW China order book is ₹128 crores
order_book.quote: The order book for exports is closer to ₹163 crores on hand for LMW Global. In LMW China, we have been able to clock a turnover of ₹36 crores, and for the comparative period last year it stood at ₹41 crores. The order book stands at around ₹128 crores.

order_book.statement: ATC order book is around ₹1,000 crores with 70% metallics and 30% composites
order_book.quote: the order book still remains the same number; it's around 1,000-odd crores. The percentage of metallics versus composite is around 30% on composite side and 70% would still be metallics.

capex.statement: MTD capacity expansion via existing unused unit (statutory filing requirement); ₹10 cr initial spend but large ecosystem; quick ramp-up possible via multi-shift
capex.quote: what has come out is basically a statutory requirement, because we have a unit which was not used, but as per the norms we are supposed to identify it as a third unit because we are going to do our assemblies there. pricing_cost.statement: TMD: no cost pass-through currently for domestic industry (fixed price); active internal discussion on price hikes; VAVE activities to control costs
pricing_cost.quote: for us it is a fixed price. It is one of, for the entire domestic industry for TMD. So as of now, there is no pass through, but it is an active discussion internally While at the same time, a lot of effort is going internally to have control on the cost.

pricing_cost.statement: ATC and Foundry have contract clauses for cost escalation pass-through on OEM contracts
pricing_cost.quote: most businesses in terms of foundry, in terms of ATC, we got clauses, contract clauses, all that happens with respect to specifically on OEM.

product_mix.statement: MTD product mix: ~23-24% machining centers, 76% turning centers; machining centers growing faster
product_mix.quote: With respect to turning centers, machining centers, it's around 23% to 24% machining centers and 76% turning centers.

product_mix.statement: TMD revenue mix H1: 67% domestic, 8% exports, 25% spares (domestic only); exports include OEM and subsidiary sales
product_mix.quote: Textile Machinery Division: the number of what we have given is standalone, which is basically 67% domestic, 8% exports, and 25% spares. The spares are purely domestic spares, and export here includes OEM and what we export to our subsidiary abroad.

fund_raise.statement: LMW Holding investment increased from ₹206 cr to ₹377 cr; initially used to buy back LMW China subsidiary (money returned); now investing for capacity and international presence (Dubai hub for Africa, GCC)
fund_raise.quote: we had invested initially to buy off LMW India subsidiary LMW China used to be subsidiary of India. We invested initially to make that transfer, and we got that money back. risk.statement: TMD facing uncharted territories: war second-order impacts, commodity price spikes, electronics availability challenges, supply chain stress
risk.quote: we are in quite a few uncharted territories I mean to mention a few how the impact the second order impact of the war because of which the material cost all that is going to impact I think these are all We have to wait to see how these things play out.

other.statement: MTD capacity utilization is 75% to 80%
other.quote: We are operating at a utilization of around 75% to 80% in the Machine Tool Division.

other.statement: ATC capacity utilization is closer to 70%
other.quote: ATC, from a capacity standpoint, we will be closer to 70% capacity utilization in this division.

guidance.statement: Upgraded FY27 EBITDA margin guidance to 27% plus/minus 2% and reaffirmed revenue target of more than INR2,500 crores

guidance.statement: Medium-term margin target of 27% plus with additional 150-200 bps from TPU backward integration in FY28
guidance.quote: It's very clear. We are clear in our mind that we will add once the TPU comes on stream, and it starts contributing to PPF, overall company revenue should go up by these numbers. That is, you are right, 27 plus-minus plus 1.5 to 2, and then this number goes up and down.

demand.statement: Architectural films now 30% of window film sales (~INR400 crores annualized), targeting 50% share; PPF penetration in India at 3% vs 20% in US/China; domestic growth target 25-30% CAGR

order_book.statement: Peak revenue potential of INR3,500 crores with full utilization of upcoming TPU and SCF capacities
order_book.quote: With this, both these 2 capex coming in, we can reach up to INR3,500 crore s. This number actually varies little bit based on the product mixes, but we can reach INR3,500 crores with full potential of these two capacities.

The strategic MOU with Lubrizol supports our ambition to develop advanced TPU -based film solutions in India and expand into specialized applications. In parallel, our INR191 crores solar control film capacity expansion is progressing with a focus on robotics and automation. Commercial production is exp

pricing_cost.statement: Raw material costs up 4% in Q2, logistics up INR9 crores; total INR37 crores cost headwind absorbed; crude correlation low (10-15% for Sun Control, 5-7% for PPF); pricing at 85-120% of global peers for architectural
pricing_cost.quote: Our raw material costs increased in this quarter by around 4%, and logistics cost increased by INR9 crore s in absolute. Put together, there is a total INR37 crores which was like a headwind for us, or we were challenged by extra cost of that. Despite that, we have performed this.

pricing_cost.statement: Architectural film pricing raised from 30-40% to 85-120% of global leader prices over 3-4 years; Sun Control and PPF have low crude correlation (10-15% and 5-7%)
pricing_cost.quote: So, interestingly, we raised our price to 80%, 85% of that number one player. So, in a way, we doubled our prices in certain cases. So, right now, we are 80% to 85% of the global player. I am not talking of the imports from China and Korea. I'm talking of mostly American or sometimes European producers. So, we are 85% to 90% in some cases, and there are certain products which are so good that we a

product_mix.statement: H1 FY27 revenue mix: 73% CPD, 27% IPD; value-added products 86% of revenue; Q2 segment split: 51% Sun Control, 24% PPF, 25% IPD
product_mix.quote: Our H1 revenue mix comprised 73% from CPD and 27% from IPD, while value-added products accounted for 86% of revenue, highlighting the growing contribution of the niche, differentiated and higher-value products to our business.

fund_raise.statement: All past INR500 crores capex over 6 years self-funded; strong cash position (INR933 crores) enables future capex without external funding; board approval pending for next 3-year capex plan
fund_raise.quote: See, I mean, we have already done 6 capex in last 6 years, that is amounting to roughly INR500 crores. And that all has been funded by ourselves. So, we will definitely aim in next 3 years more investment, but as of now, I can't tell unless it is approved by the board, and we'll come up with that.

risk.statement: MPCB penalty of INR25 lakh for boiler trial run during modification; accepted and complied; old plant infrastructure requires ongoing compliance
risk.quote: Yes. So, there was one boiler, which was very old, because our normally plants are pretty old. And in that situation, MPCB said that it needs modification. So, we were doing the modification. While doing the modification, I think we restarted and took trial on that, which was noticed, and we accepted that.

other.statement: Received INR31 crores tariff reversal to date (INR20 crores refunded to customers, INR11 crores retained); expect INR30 crores more in Q3 (INR16 crores to books, INR14 crores to customers)
other.value: INR31 crores received, INR30 crores expected
other.quote: Till date, we have received around INR31 crores. And out of that, the refund to customer has been around INR20 crores, and INR11 crores has been in our books. And we expect in Q3 another refund of around INR30 crores, that is the last one. And out of that, roughly INR16 crores will come to our books, and INR14 crores will be refunded to the customers.

other.statement: Q2 FY27: Highest-ever quarterly revenue INR696 crores (+22% YoY, +10% QoQ), EBITDA INR189 crores (+42%), PAT INR129 crores (+42%)
other.quote: Q2 FY27 was another important milestone for us. We delivered our highest-ever quarterly revenue of INR696 crores, up 22% year -on-year and 10% sequentially, which is nearing the INR700 crores mark. EBITDA increased 42% year-on-year to INR189 crores, with a margin of 27.2%. Profit after tax also grew 42% to INR129 crores.

guidance.statement: Management targets 100-150 bps annual EBITDA margin improvement for FY27
guidance.quote: we'd like to maintain that, which would be around 100 to 150 basis points improvement in profitability year-on-year.

guidance.statement: Management targets 580+ restaurants by March 2028
guidance.quote: We continue to see significant opportunity across existing and emerging markets and remain on track for our targets of 580+ restaurants by March 2028.

guidance.statement: Management targets 60-65 new restaurant openings per year
guidance.quote: we will be delivering the guidance that we've given in terms of 60 to 65 restaurants per year.

guidance.statement: Management expects full-year capex of INR250-300 crores
guidance.quote: overall, I think our capex will be within the range of INR250 crores to INR300 crores.

demand.statement: Double-digit guest count growth each month in Q2 FY27
demand.quote: Most encouraging, guest count grew in double digits in each month of this quarter, demonstrating the strength of consumer demand and effectiveness of our brand plus value strategy.

demand.statement: Momentum continued into October with confidence for festive season
demand.quote: The momentum we saw through the quarter has continued into October, giving us confidence as we enter the festive season.

margin.statement: Operating EBITDA grew 29% YoY with margin expansion of 130 bps to 13.1% in Q2 FY27
margin.quote: Operating EBITDA grew 29% year-on-year with margins expanding by 130 basis points to 13.1%.

margin.statement: Restaurant operating margin remained healthy at 19.3% in Q2 FY27
margin.quote: Restaurant operating margin remained healthy at 19.3%.

margin.statement: Absorbed 190 bps inflationary pressure across commodities, utilities and employee costs
margin.quote: This was achieved despite absorbing over 190 basis points of inflationary pressure across commodities, utilities and employee costs.

order_book.statement: Opened 11 new restaurants in Q2 FY27, total footprint 492 across 80 cities
order_book.quote: We also continue to expand our restaurant network during the quarter, opening 11 new restaurants, taking our total footprint to 492 across 80 cities now.

capex.statement: Per store capex range INR3-3.5 crores for new stores
capex.quote: Our per store cost, we don't break down regularly, but it's within the range of INR3 crores to INR3.5 crores per store.

pricing_cost.statement: Takes price increase to absorb half of inflation as a principle
pricing_cost.quote: I think we take a price increase to absorb half of inflation in terms of the pressures that we see as a principle.

pricing_cost.statement: Reduced discounting rather than taking price increases to manage inflation
pricing_cost.quote: I would argue we've actually reduced a lot of discounting and that helped us improve some of the inflationary pressures we had without touching too much on the pricing.

product_mix.statement: Digital channels contributed over 75% of sales, up 60 bps YoY
product_mix.quote: Digital channels contributed over 75% of sales during the quarter, increasing by around 60 basis points year-on-year.

product_mix.statement: 58 million cumulative app downloads and 4.2 million monthly active users
product_mix.quote: We now have more than 58 million cumulative app downloads and approximately 4.2 million monthly active users.

risk.statement: Margin guidance assumes no dramatic adverse events; inflation volatility remains a risk
risk.quote: I would like to stick with the guidance which we have given around 100 basis points, 150 basis points for this year for sure. Now unless something drastically, dramatically happens.

other.statement: Revenue grew 16% YoY to INR7.47 billion in Q2 FY27
other.quote: Revenue grew 16% year-on-year to INR7.47 billion, our strongest top line growth in the last 13 quarters

other.statement: On-premise and off-premise channels grew 17% and 15% respectively
other.quote: Both on-premise and off-premise channels delivered a healthy growth of 17% and 15%, respectively.

guidance.statement: Revenue growth guidance raised to 15-18% for FY27; EBITDA margin guidance 13.8-14.3%
guidance.quote: Based on the strong half year performance and the visibility we see across our customer portfolio, we have increased our FY27 outlook. We now expect revenue growth of 15% to 18% for FY27 and an EBITDA margin in the range of 13.8% to 14.3%.

demand.statement: Strong demand in AI data center space across power management, cooling systems, industrial platforms
demand.quote: We are also seeing a lot of encouraging opportunities across the U.S. and Europe for digital engineering, AI-led transformation programs, data center infrastructure engineering and particularly in areas such as power management, cooling systems and intelligent industrial platforms.

margin.statement: Q2 FY27 EBITDA margin expanded to all-time high of 15.6%
margin.quote: Total income for the quarter was INR171.2 crores, while EBITDA grew 33.7% year-on-year to INR26.6 crores, with margins expanding to all-time high at 15.6%.

order_book.statement: Renewed 3-year digital engineering engagement worth INR44.5 crores with 70% value increase
order_book.quote: A major highlight this quarter was the renewal of a 3-year digital engineering engagement valued at approximately INR44.5 crores with a global construction and mining equipment leader. The contract value increased by over 70% compared to the previous term

capex.statement: Opened fourth design center in Pune; signed lease for more seats; bought office in Worli, Mumbai
capex.quote: We opened our fourth design center in Pune earlier this month, which is already expected to reach full capacity by end of November / December. We have signed a lease to add more seats in Pune, so we are building up capacity and we're hiring people as well.

pricing_cost.statement: R&D tax credit of INR2.9 crores for FY26 booked in Q2; 10-15% of UK revenue; annual benefit
pricing_cost.quote: So, the credit was through the normal course of business for the last 12 months of FY26. It's not just a credit for us, it's for every other company which operates in the U.K. So, since the amount is material for us, we report it as a special line item

product_mix.statement: AI embedded in engineering workflows; helping customers with digital engineering; 3000+ engineers focused on few customers
product_mix.quote: One is we are embedding AI into our engineering workflows in our software development, and delivery processes. We're also helping our customers accelerate their own digital engineering initiatives. And we have the required skill sets. As I said, we have now almost 3,000-plus people in our team.

risk.statement: Execution and ramping up quickly is main challenge; external factors could delay projects
risk.quote: For a company of our size, execution is the challenge. Ramping up that quickly is the main thing, and that's what we are doing as we speak.

other.statement: $1M+ annual billing customers increased from 16 to 18
other.quote: We also increased the number of customers billing for $1 million annually from 16 to 18, demonstrating our ability to expand wallet share within our existing clients.

other.statement: Net hiring of 430+ employees in H1 FY27; Q3 hiring slower due to holidays; Q4 adding few hundred net
other.quote: we've onboarded net about 430-plus employees and the RFQs that we are participating in, especially given the large demand in the AI data center space.

guidance.statement: Expect relative slowing in India market growth over next few quarters as effect of GST cuts diminish
guidance.quote: We expect a relative slowing down in market growth over the next few quarters as the effect of GST cuts diminish.

demand.statement: Europe auto market stagnant; Chinese imports expanding; EV penetration increasing; European revenue down ~10% in euro terms (partly Mexico -20%, partly EV shift reducing ICE demand ~5%)
demand.quote: In euros, we are talking about minus 10% . That's the real figure in euros. Part of it is coming from the Mexican business that had a drop of 20% and then it's true that this electrification growth is, let's say, reducing the demand on the internal combustion engine cars.

demand.statement: India market demand robust across all segments in Q3 CY26; tractor growth slowed appreciably; expect relative slowing over next few quarters as GST cut effects diminish
demand.quote: Market demand in Q3 CY26 was robust across all segments, though tractors growth slowed down appreciably compared to earlier quarters.

margin.statement: India EBITDA margin 16.3% in Q3 CY26 vs 17.3% in Q3 CY25 and 16.7% in Q2 CY26; drop due to price pressures from West Asia conflict in raw material, energy, consumables
margin.quote: The India operations achieved an EBITDA margin of 16.3%, the way we calculate, in Q3 CY26 versus 17.3% in Q3 CY25 and 16.7% in Q2 CY26.

margin.statement: Europe EBITDA margin 16.3% in Q3 CY26 vs 14.1% in Q3 CY25 and 15.9% in Q2 CY26; recovery due to last year's restructuring
margin.quote: The EBITDA margin in our European operations in Q3 CY26 was 16.3% versus 14.1% in Q3 CY25 and 15.9% in Q2 CY26.

order_book.statement: Order book healthy in Q3; INR9.7 billion new orders in India YTD 9 months CY26 across all verticals; approx INR3 billion in Europe
order_book.quote: The order book in Q3 was, let's say, quite healthy, and we got INR9.7 billion total in -- year-to-date 9 months, INR9.7 billion of new orders in all the verticals in India, and approximately INR3 billion in Europe.

capex.statement: Growth capex ~8% of sales in India (vs usual 5%); CY26 approx double last year; CY27 similar range; all verticals expanding with booked orders
capex.quote: Now we can think about 8% of sales, something like that.

capex.statement: CY26 India capex almost double last year; next year similar range; investing across all verticals including forging presses, gear plant expansion, composite presses, stamping line, foundry expansion by 2028
capex.quote: In CY26, the overall capex in India will be almost double of last year.

pricing_cost.statement: Pass-through negotiations ongoing for non-raw material cost increases (energy, gases, consumables); partially recognized; expect all customers settled by end of year
pricing_cost.quote: The pass -through negotiations are ongoing in this moment in the market with all the customers. And we have partially recognized part of this negotiation because some of the agreements are already closed.

product_mix.statement: ~10-12% of new orders in Europe for EV components; working on aluminum forging, gears for EVs; turnover lower due to smaller component size vs crankshafts
product_mix.quote: Approximately 10%, 12% of the new orders that we have got in this year are for EVs in Europe also.

fund_raise.statement: No stock repurchase planned in India; cash needed for strong organic capex plan; inorganic growth unlikely due to valuations
fund_raise.quote: In this moment, we are not thinking on stock repurchase in India, mainly because we have decided to go to a strong capex plan to expand our capacities and to expand our businesses in India.

risk.statement: Europe market tough environment; competitors struggling financially; consolidation expected but timing uncertain (2-3 quarters or more)
risk.quote: Some of our competitors are struggling financially because of the drop of the market during the last years and now especially. So we will see certain new organization, new share of the businesses between the different players in Europe.

other.statement: GKN contract renegotiated: volumes reduced ~20% but duration extended; current turnover level to remain in next quarters
other.quote: The volumes has been reduced, but we extended the length of the duration of the contract. So this has been already agreed. That means that our current turnover in Bill Forge Mexico will remain at the current level. We saw a drop of approximately 20% compared to the previous year.

other.statement: Aluminum diversifying into 4-wheeler HPDC parts requiring new lines; Stampings expanding at multiple locations for 2 main customers; Gears and Composites have EV orders; Iron castings near full foundry capacity planning expansion; Forgings
other.quote: The Aluminum division is planning to diversify into 4 -wheeler HPDC parts, and this will require new lines. Our Stampings division is planning expansion at multiple locations to meet the expectation of its 2 main customers.

guidance.statement: EBITDA margin for H2 FY27 expected to be much higher than 15%; FY28 EBITDA margin targeted towards 20%+
guidance.quote: From -- as far as for the second half of FY27, I think the EBITDA margin should fairly be much higher than 15% for the whole of FY27. And from FY28, of course, I've been mentioning in the previous calls also that it will go towards 20%.

guidance.statement: Sales guidance for FY27 expected to be exceeded; PAT growth of at least 50% YoY targeted for FY27
guidance.quote: Overall, we are on track for our guidance and hopefully exceed in terms of sales for the entire financial year.

demand.statement: Sustenance sales healthy from Q1 launches (SOBHA OneWorld, Neopolis, Crescent, Aranya); leading indicators (inquiries, walk-ins) steady despite macro concerns
demand.quote: Following significant launches in Q1 and Q2, Q2 witnessed healthy su stenance sales, particularly from our launched project in Q1, SOBHA OneWorld and SOBHA Neopolis in Bangalore and SOBHA Crescent and A ranya in Gurgaon

margin.statement: Q2 FY27 EBITDA INR119 cr (11% margin), PAT INR33 cr; H1 FY27 EBITDA INR249 cr, PAT INR84 cr; low margins due to lower revenue recognition, fixed overheads, elevated S&M costs, legacy low-margin projects
margin.quote: Quarterly EBITDA stood at INR119 crores reprojecting a margin of 11% while profit after tax was INR33 crores.

margin.statement: Revenue to be recognized INR22,040 crores from sold units carries excellent EBITDA margins; margins to improve significantly as lower-margin projects complete and higher-margin projects recognized
margin.quote: As of end of this quarter, we had INR 22,040 crores of revenue yet to be recognized from units already sold. We expect -- while the quarter level margins appear lower, we continue -- as we continue to recognize lower margin projects and as we recognize future projects, which we are on course for completion and handover s, we are quite confident that our margins will significantly improve

order_book.statement: Q2 FY27 sales value INR2,206 crores, up 16% YoY; 1.42 msf across 828 units sold
order_book.quote: In Q2 FY27, this is our second highest quarterly sales of INR2,206 crores with a growth of 16% year -on-year with 1.42 million square feet across 828 units.

order_book.statement: H1 FY27 sales value INR5,862 crores, up 47.2% YoY; 3.76 msf across 2,260 units sold
order_book.quote: H1 '27 was the strongest half year in the SOBHA's history with sales value of INR5,862 crores, a strong 47.2% year-on-year growth.

capex.statement: H1 FY27 land payments INR987 crores (~30% for old dues settlement, ~50% for new land acquisitions in Bangalore, Gurgaon, Mumbai)
capex.quote: We have made land payment amounted to INR617 crores during quarter 2 and INR987 crores for the first half.

capex.statement: Q2 FY27 construction outflow INR826 cr, sales & marketing INR103 cr, land payments INR617 cr; H1 land payments INR987 cr
capex.quote: During the quarter, real estate project -related outflow stood at INR826 crores while sales and marketing expenditure was INR103 crores. We have made land payment amounted to INR617 crores during quarter 2

pricing_cost.statement: Average price realization improved to INR15,522/sqft in Q2 FY27 from INR13,648/sqft YoY (13.7% growth); H1 FY27 realization INR15,604/sqft vs INR14,028/sqft
pricing_cost.quote: Average price realization improved to INR15,522 per square feet in Q2 from INR13,648, representing 13.7% growth.

product_mix.statement: Land bank mix: ~50% outright ownership, ~50% joint development; aggregate revenue share ~82-85%
product_mix.quote: On an aggregate level, Murtuza, out of overall sale or the inventory that we have, roughly 82% to 85% is what is our share in the sense, typically, as an overall example, is 50% is own projects and the remaining 50% are joint development projects.

risk.statement: Macro caution from interest rate increases, geopolitics, AI; but leading indicators (inquiries, walk-ins, sustenance sales) remain steady on ground
risk.quote: It's very difficult for me to comment on what exactly is going to happen on macro. But clearly, there is certain caution related to what's happening in terms of interest rate increase and the combination of geopolitics and AI.

other.statement: H1 FY27 launched 5 projects aggregating 7.91 msf with GDV ~INR11,200 crores; Q2 launched 2 projects (SOBHA Boulevard in Mysore, SOBHA Bellevue in Calicut)
other.quote: Overall, for the first half, we launched 5 projects across Bangalore, Gurgaon and Calicut, aggregating to 7.91 million square feet with an estimated sales potential of close to INR11,200 crores.

other.statement: Forthcoming launch pipeline 20.42 msf across 18 projects; confident of launching at least 9 projects exceeding 11 msf in remainder of FY27
other.quote: On forthcoming launch pipeline remains robust at 20.42 million square feet across 18 projects. We are quite confident of launching at least 9 projects, exceeding 11 million square feet during the remainder of FY27.

guidance.statement: Guided credit cost corridor of 2%-2.2% by Q4FY27
guidance.quote: We would like to reiterate that we are confident of achieving our guided credit cost corridor of 2%-2.2% by Q4FY27.

guidance.statement: NIMs + Fees guided corridor of 10% to 10.5%
guidance.quote: Our NIMs + Fees, which is another focus area for us, stood stable at 10.48% against 10.47% in Q1FY27, well within our guided corridor of 10% to 10.5%.

guidance.statement: RoA guided objective of 2.8%-3% exit Q4FY27
guidance.quote: We remain hopeful that our RoA trajectory will achieve our guided objective of 2.8% - 3% exit Q4FY27.

guidance.statement: Lakshya 2031 book growth CAGR target of 20%+
guidance.quote: We had set ourselves a book growth CAGR of 20%+ over the Lakshya period, against which we have achieved a robust 28% growth in Q2FY27

demand.statement: Strong October start; expect strong Q3 driven by Navratri and Diwali
demand.quote: We are seeing a very strong start to the October season. And across all our lines of business, we see significant uptick in business momentum, especially in the month of October, in the early part of October. And I expect the business momentum to pick up during Navratri as Navratri is currently going on and duri ng the Diwali period. So, I see a reasonably strong Q3 as well

margin.statement: Consol NIMs + Fees at 10.48% in Q2FY27 vs 10.47% in Q1FY27
margin.quote: Consol NIMs + Fees for the quarter stood at 10.48% vs 10.22% for Q2FY26

margin.statement: Weighted average cost of borrowing reduced by 25 bps in Q2FY27
margin.quote: Yes, this quarter, as you mentioned, we have actually given a very good result in terms of 25 bps reduction in the overall weighted average cost.

order_book.statement: Consolidated book at ₹1,36,635 Cr, up 28% YoY
order_book.quote: Our consolidated book stands at ₹1,36,635 Cr, reflecting a YoY growth of 28%, against ₹1,29,634 Cr in Q1FY27

order_book.statement: Retail disbursements of ₹24,027 Cr, up 27% YoY
order_book.quote: This has been achieved on the back of quarterly Retail disbursements of ₹24,027 Cr, up 27% YoY, with contributions from all our lines of business.

order_book.statement: Gold Loan disbursements ₹3,237 Cr, up 229% YoY; book ₹5,043 Cr, up 242% YoY
order_book.quote: We registered a robust quarterly disbursement of ₹3,237 Cr, representing a 229% YoY growth, with our closing book reaching ₹5,043 Cr, up 242% YoY.

capex.statement: Launched 172 new Gold Loan branches in H1FY27, reaching 502 active branches
capex.quote: having launched 172 new branches in H1FY27 to reach 502 active branches, with ~110 branches already crossing ₹15 Cr in AUM, as of September 30th, 2026.

capex.statement: Scaled to 151 Sampoorna multi-product branches in ~18 months since FY25 launch
capex.quote: we have successfully scaled our network to a total of 151 Sampoorna branches across the country in a short timeline of ~18 months since this concept was launched in FY25.

capex.statement: Plan to set up 500 Gold Loan branches and 200 Micro LAP branches
capex.quote: We want to set up 500 branches for Gold. We want to set up 200 branches for Micro LAP. So, rest of the branches will get rolled out pretty quickly.

pricing_cost.statement: Risk-based pricing implemented across Microfinance, SME, Personal Loans, Farm
pricing_cost.quote: Similarly, Microfinance, we moved to risk-based pricing. And the customers who have been with us for third, fourth cycle, naturally they have benefited. But at the same time, the new customer base gets whatever has to be charged based on risk that prevails.

pricing_cost.statement: Two Wheeler yields recovered 70-75 bps after initial Cyclops migration dip
pricing_cost.quote: we actually started off with about 75 b ps to 100 b ps lower interest being charged when we actually migrated to Cyclops. And out of that, almost 70 bps - 75 bps has already been

product_mix.statement: 92% of Two-Wheeler disbursements in prime segment
product_mix.quote: With 92% of TW disbursements in the prime segment in Q2FY27, we continue to prioritize high-quality growth and optimized risk-adjusted returns.

product_mix.statement: Large partnerships constitute 40% of Personal Loan originations; operationalised with Airtel
product_mix.quote: During the quarter, we operationalised our Personal Loan originations with Airtel. Overall large partnerships constitute 40% of our Personal Loan originations.

risk.statement: Rabi crop forecast near normal; reservoir levels at 71% pan-India
risk.quote: Our rabi crop, the overall reservoir levels are at about 71% pan-India. I think that's sufficient to support rabi crop, right. And I also foresee that the rabi crop should also be near normal.

other.statement: Credit cost moderated to 2.46% in Q2FY27, down 8 bps sequentially from 2.54%
other.quote: credit cost has moderated to 2.46% this quarter, reflecting a further sequential improvement of 8 bps from 2.54% in Q1FY27, supported by collections excellence and AI-led portfolio management.

other.statement: Rural Business Finance collection efficiency at 99.7%-99.8%
other.quote: I would like to point out that our collection efficiencies in Rural Business Finance remain in the corridor of 99.7% to 99.8%, which is in line with the best ever collection efficiency that we have ever seen.

guidance.statement: BESS installation target of 10 GWh for FY27, confident of surpassing it
guidance.quote: We are very committed to not only commission the 10 gigawatt by the end of the year, but would be definitely able to surpass it too.

demand.statement: Strong demand from AI, data centers, hyperscalers, and C&I customers for firm, dispatchable renewable plus storage solutions
demand.quote: Looking ahead, we see significant opportunities emerging from growing needs for firm and dispatchable renewable energy, rising power demand from AI, data centers and hyperscalers alongside growing demand for integrated renewables plus storage solutions fro m commercial as well as industrial customers

margin.statement: H1 FY27 EBITDA margin 93% (INR 7,957 crore, up 41% YoY); Q2 FY27 EBITDA margin 92% (INR 3,835 crore, up 51% YoY)
margin.quote: Revenue from power supply in H1 FY '27 increased 36% year-on-year to INR8,299 crores, while EBITDA grew 41% Y -o-Y to INR7,957 crores, enabling us to deliver industry -leading EBITDA margin of 93%.

capex.statement: Committed to INR 2.4 lakh crore capex program through FY30, backed by long-term contracts and prudent capital allocation
capex.quote: We remain focused on disciplined execution of our INR2.4 lakh crores capex program through FY '30, backed by securing new capacities under long-term contracts and prudent capital allocation.

product_mix.statement: Strategy combines solar, wind, BESS, and pump storage; 500 MW Chitravathi pump storage progressing to completion by year-end
product_mix.quote: While our maiden 500-megawatt pump storage project at Chitravathi is also progressing towards completion by year -end. At Khavda, the world's largest renewable energy plant, we have commissioned 10.8 gigawatt hour of solar, wind and hybrid capacity.

other.statement: 30% of loan book USD-denominated; principal and interest fully hedged per lender documents; RG2 hedged to FY30, RG1 to FY28 with rollover planned
other.quote: About 30% is in dollar denominated. Within that 30% dollar denominated, we fully hedge our principal plus interest. There is no change in that policy because that's governed by the lender documents.

other.statement: Rajat Seksaria highlighted BESS execution speed (1-10 months for world's largest plants) providing flexibility to deconstrain solar/wind from transmission delays
other.quote: So it's a relatively short period of time. We're talking about a month, 8 to 10 months for the largest plants in the world. So that leaves us an adequate amount of flexibility should the situation demand so, we now have an added tool in our arsenal to respond to that

guidance.statement: Raised FY27 ROA guidance to 5.2%-5.8% from 4%-4.8% and ROE to 21%-24% from 16%-20%
guidance.quote: We raised our profitability guidance for FY27, ROA of 5.2% to 5.8% versus 4% to 4.8% earlier and ROE of 21% to 24% versus 16% to 20% earlier.

guidance.statement: Retained AUM growth guidance of 20%-25% for FY27
guidance.quote: We retain our AUM growth guidance of 20% to 25%, supported by return to growth in Group Loan portfolio, coupled with continued momentum in Retail Finance.

guidance.statement: Raised NIM guidance to 14.4%-14.7% from 12.8%-13.2% for FY27
guidance.quote: We expect a NIM of 14.4% to 14.7% as against 12.8% to 13.2% guided earlier, driven by healthy asset quality, strong control over borrowing costs and a higher capital position.

guidance.statement: Maintained credit cost guidance of 3%-4% for FY27
guidance.quote: We're maintaining our credit cost guidance of 3% to 4%, and it should comfortably cover for any volatility on account of evolving drought-related conditions.

margin.statement: Q2 FY27 NIM expanded to 15.1% from 14.4% in Q1 FY27
margin.quote: Commenting on our margins, we saw our NIM expand to 15.1% in Q2 from 14.4% in Q1, driven by lower interest reversals in Group Loan book, higher yielding individual loan book, stable cost of borrowing and higher capital push.

margin.statement: Marginal cost of borrowing at 9.1% in Q2 FY27, average cost stable at 9.1%
margin.quote: Our marginal cost of borrowing stood at 9.1% in Q2 FY27, while average cost of borrowing was stable at 9.1%.

margin.statement: Borrowing cost expected to stay in 9.2%-9.3% range till March FY27
margin.quote: So that's where we are of a view that our borrowing cost will stay in this 9.2% to 9.3% range till March.

order_book.statement: AUM grew 19.5% YoY and 2.1% QoQ to INR 30,946 Crore in Q2 FY27
order_book.quote: Our AUM grew 19.5% YoY and 2.1% QoQ to INR 30,946 Crore.

order_book.statement: Disbursements at INR 6,355 Crore, up 19.4% YoY and 4.1% QoQ in Q2 FY27
order_book.quote: Disbursements stood at INR 6,355 Crore, up 19.4% YoY and 4.1% QoQ, taking H1 disbursements to INR 12,461 Crore.

order_book.statement: Retail Finance AUM grew to INR 7,200 Crore, now 23.3% of total AUM, up from 20.6% in Q1 FY27
order_book.quote: Retail Finance AUM grew to INR 7,200 Crore, now 23.3% of the total AUM, up from 20.6% in Q1 FY27.

capex.statement: Signed USD 175 million ECB in October, syndicated by Standard Chartered and DBS; fifth ECB in 5 years
capex.quote: We signed USD 175 million ECB loan in October, syndicated by Standard Chartered Bank and DBS Bank.

capex.statement: Mobilized INR 940 Crore domestic NCDs via private placement in FY27 YTD
capex.quote: We also mobilized INR 940 Crore of domestic NCDs through private placement process in this financial year.

pricing_cost.statement: Yield cut to flow through over 4-6 quarters; yields peaked in Q2 FY27
pricing_cost.quote: 4 to 6 quarters. So like the 50 bps cut what we took, it will at least take 4 quarters for the entire 50 bps cut to flow in.

pricing_cost.statement: Further 50 bps rate cuts planned for Q4 FY27 and Q1 FY28, contingent on credit cost holding at 3%
pricing_cost.quote: The subsequent rate cuts will only happen if the credit cost hold at 3%. If there is any increase, then we may have to revisit.

product_mix.statement: Microfinance growth expected 10-12% range-bound; retail to grow faster; overall AUM growth 20-25%
product_mix.quote: Microfinance, as we said in our strategic plan, could be range bound in the range of anywhere between 10% to 12%. Shreepal Doshi: Got it. Thank you so much for answering my questions.

risk.statement: Insurance regulation reform could impact ROA by 25-30 bps if commissions drop to draft guidance levels
risk.quote: the impact we see is around 25 bps to 30 bps on our ROA, which I think we are better placed than anywhere else in case we need to cover it through pricing to protect our ROAs.

risk.statement: Credit guarantee scheme (CGFMU) premium 1.3%-1.5% annually, covers 75% of losses, 15% pool cap; budgetary approval pending
risk.quote: Typically, under the CGFMU scheme, the annual premium cost is around 1.3% to 1.5% and it covers around 75% of the losses which you claim for and the total gap is 15% of the pool what you have insured.

risk.statement: Promoter group in active discussions for strategic investor at HoldCo level; progress expected in next couple of quarters
risk.quote: Currently, the promoters are in active discussion for a strategic investor as the whole group. That is where it is. And we should see some progress in the next couple of quarters.

other.statement: Gross NPA 1.79%, Net NPA 0.59%, PAR 90+ 1.11%, all improving sequentially in Q2 FY27
other.quote: Gross NPA stood at 1.79%, net NPA at 0.59% and PAR 90 plus at 1.11%, each improving sequentially.

other.statement: Collection efficiency (ex-arrears) 97.9%, X-Bucket collection efficiency 99.71% for September
other.quote: collection efficiency, excluding arrears, stood at 97.9% and X -Bucket collection efficiency for September stood at 99.71%.

guidance.statement: Target to open more than 100 stores in FY27 and increase store openings every year thereafter
guidance.quote: we are quite confident of our guidance of opening more than 100 stores this year

guidance.statement: Aim to improve EBITDA margin by ~30 bps annually driven by double-digit growth vs 6-7% store cost inflation
guidance.quote: EBITDA margin, we would see an improvement every year, generally speaking, I'm saying, because our growth would be double digit, whereas our cost inflation at the store level would be 6% to 7%, and that would probably improve our EBITDA margin by 30 bps every year

demand.statement: Q2 same-store sales growth of 5.4% was impacted 3-4% by festival shift; adjusted growth ~9%
demand.quote: Our same-store sales growth stood at 5.4%. The festivals this year have shifted from quarter 2 to quarter 3. This has had an impact of 3% to 4% on our same-store sales growth. Adjusting for that, our same-store sales growth in Q2 has been around 9%.

demand.statement: H1 same-store sales growth 7.7% impacted 1.5-2% by festival shift; adjusted ~9.5%
demand.quote: Same-store sales growth stood at 7.7%. The shift in festival has had an impact of 1.5% to 2% on same-store sales growth. Adjusting for that, same-store sales growth for the first half will be about 9.5%.

demand.statement: No moderation in consumer demand seen; festive season started strong in Q3
demand.quote: We are not seeing any moderation in terms of consumer and customer demand. As I mentioned, the festive season for this year started now, and we've experienced some part of that

margin.statement: Q2 operating EBITDA margin 7.7% vs 8.5% YoY due to operating deleverage from festival shift
margin.quote: Operating EBITDA for Q2 '27 was INR 262 crores, which was a growth of 3.7% over last year and a margin of 7.7% versus 8.5% in last year

margin.statement: H1 operating EBITDA margin 9.1% vs 9.4% YoY due to operating deleverage from festival shift
margin.quote: Operating EBITDA for the first half was INR 649 crores, which is a growth of 12.5% over last year and a margin of 9.1% versus 9.4% for last year

margin.statement: Gross margin impact from festival shift 20 bps in Q2; no further material gross margin impact expected in Q3/Q4
margin.quote: what you see a 30 bps drop, compared to last year on gross margin, out of that, 20 bps is on account of shift in apparel business from Q2 to Q3

capex.statement: Quick commerce expanded to 781 stores across 532 cities; registered users crossed 1.5 crore
capex.quote: Our quick commerce expanded to 781 stores across 532 cities in the country, and registered users on quick commerce crossed 1.5 crore s people across the country

capex.statement: Commissioned fully automated large warehouse in North; plans for East, South, West; investing aggressively in quick commerce advertising/digital media
capex.quote: we have commissioned a fully automated, very large warehouse in North India. We have plans to commission such warehouses in East India next, after that in South India, and the last in the Western part of the country

pricing_cost.statement: No further price increases planned at any price point; committed to stable pricing environment
pricing_cost.quote: We do not see any need to take further price increases at this stage. And at this stage, there is absolutely no plan to tinker with the pricing, even beyond the festive season

pricing_cost.statement: No price increases at opening price points (18-20% of revenue); very few at mid-price points (50%); increases only at higher price points (24-25%)
pricing_cost.quote: At the opening price points, we are not taking any price increases, because our opening price point customers are the most vulnerable amongst all our customers to inflationary pressures. At the mid-price points, there've been very, very few price increases. All our price increases have largely been on the higher price points

product_mix.statement: Private brands contributed 74% of H1 revenue; apparel mix lower in Q2 due to festival shift, higher expected in Q3
product_mix.quote: Our private brands contributed 74% to revenue in first half of '27

product_mix.statement: Belong & Co. pilot store launched in Q2; conversion >50%, repeat visits seen; still learning, future rollout depends on pilot experience
product_mix.quote: People are loving the merchandise. It's very early days, but our conversion of footfall into the store into purchase is north of 50%. So, it's very, very encouraging. And whilst it's just been a month, we have seen customers coming back to the store to buy more stuff

fund_raise.statement: Board reviewing cash reserves deployment; business has significant cash, internal accruals sufficient for store openings
fund_raise.quote: our board is looking at the cash reserves that we have on our balance sheet to ensure that what is the best way to deal with that, while ensuring that the business is never starved of cash for growth

risk.statement: Uneven monsoon causes temporary 1-2 day revenue disruptions but fundamental demand consistent across regions
risk.quote: what has been somewhat uneven is the rainfall across the different states in India. And, therefore, the very temporary disruption that you have for a couple of days when it's raining heavily, for example, in Northeast in certain months and so on, that does impact the revenue. But that's a very temporary one or two-day phenomenon

other.statement: Q3 same-store sales growth needs to exceed 10% to achieve double-digit for first nine months
other.quote: Q3 will have to be higher than 10%, as you rightly said, for the first nine months to look like double-digit growth

other.statement: 8% to 10% SSSG sufficient to offset elevated employee costs from minimum wage hikes
other.quote: Anything between 8% to 10% is good enough to offset this impact

guidance.statement: FY27 revenue guidance of INR300-350 crores
guidance.quote: This year, we believe -- we trust we should fetch revenue between INR300 crores and INR350 crores.

guidance.statement: FY27 year-end order book target of INR600-800 crores
guidance.quote: With that, I think we believe, with the end of the year, we may maintain between -- the order book may maintain between INR600 crores and INR800 crores.

guidance.statement: FY27 PAT margin guidance of 9-12%
guidance.quote: Based on the order book, the margin can be maintained between -- the PAT margin can be maintained between 9% to 12%.

demand.statement: Good demand expected for next 8-10 years in power sector
demand.quote: As per market information, next 8 to 10 years, there will be good demand for this power sector.

demand.statement: Strong demand environment supported by transmission, renewable energy, industrial expansion
demand.quote: We are encouraged by the demand environment across the tran sformer industry, supported by continued investments in transmission and distribution infrastructure, renewable energy integration and industrial expansion

margin.statement: H1 FY27 EBITDA margin 17.42%, PAT margin 10.07%
margin.quote: EBITDA has increased by 65.46% year-to-year to INR23.62 crores, with an EBITDA margin of 17.42%. Profit after tax grew by 45.09% to INR13.65 crores, with a PAT margin of 10.07%.

margin.statement: Power transformer margins slightly higher but absorbed by overheads
margin.quote: power transformers, the margin is slightly higher than the distribution transformer. But at the same time, it is absorbed by the overheads. So, it needs skilled manpower, so we have to deploy experienced people. So, this 0. 5% or 1% margin is absorbed by the -- so this margin will maintain and it will sustain

order_book.statement: H1 FY27 order inflow of 11 orders worth INR209.24 crores
order_book.quote: During H1 FY27, we secured 11 orders aggregating INR209.24 crores, with execution timelines ranging between 7 months and 17 months.

order_book.statement: Order book product mix: 75-78% power transformers, 16-17% distribution, 5% inverter duty
order_book.quote: Out of this INR565 crores, distribution is around 16% to 17%, that is less than INR95 crores. And power transformer is around INR440 crores that comes around 78% -- 75% to 78%. And inverter duty transformers is around INR30 crores, that comes 5% of the total order book.

order_book.statement: Execution timeline: INR353 crores before March 2027, INR212 crores after
order_book.quote: Actually as per customer requirements, before the end of this March 2027, INR353 crores is to be executed. After March, it's INR212 crores.

pricing_cost.statement: 70-75% of order book covered under price variation clauses
pricing_cost.quote: Importantly, around 70% to 75% of our order book is covered under price variation clauses, which provides a degree of protection against volatility in key raw material prices.

product_mix.statement: H1 FY27 revenue split: ~60% power transformers, balance distribution and inverter duty
product_mix.quote: Almost like 60% will be from power transformer and the balance from distribution and inverter duty transformers.

other.statement: Kannur facility ramp-up progressing; targeting 40-50% utilization by March 2027, 80% next year
other.quote: This year, we are expecting 50% of -- 40% to 50% before this March. And next year, almost 80%, I think we should utilize.

other.statement: Order book split: 27-28% government, 72-73% non-government
other.quote: On INR565 crores, almost 27%, 28% is from government and balance 72%, 73% from non-government.

guidance.statement: Offtake agreement with Pirelli to start in calendar year 2027 and scale to 800,000 tires per year by calendar year 2030
guidance.quote: We expect the offtake from this partnership to commence in 2027. And this will scale up to supply 800,000 Pirelli-branded tires per year by the year of 2030.

guidance.statement: JV formation deadline is calendar year 2030, subject to preset conditions
guidance.quote: We have till 2030 to announce the work on the JV, and then once we have that ready, we will probably come up with an announcement when we already. That's the deadline.

demand.statement: India passenger car market growing 6-7% annually; premium segment expected to grow faster
demand.quote: India is a fast-growing passenger car market, which is growing at 6% to 7% annually. The premium car market is expected to grow at a faster pace in India over the next few years.

margin.statement: Management declined to disclose revenue or margin potential for Pirelli offtake; stated policy of maintaining blended margins unchanged
margin.quote: I think at this stage, we would like to stay away from those numbers. We are yet working on those, and we'll come back at a later. Once we start the business, we'll have more clarity on that.

product_mix.statement: BKT will use its own technology for BKT-branded tires; Pirelli technology used only for Pirelli-branded tires
product_mix.quote: We do not want to rely on any third-party partner for their own technology or designs. We will make everything on our own. There will be a clear partition between what we produce for them and what we produce for us and using our own technology.

product_mix.statement: Pirelli offtake covers 17-inch and above tires; BKT brand will address full portfolio from 13-inch upwards
product_mix.quote: It will be 17-inch and above, which we will be giving them. And regarding the, there is no restriction on either party on supplying their own respective branded tires to whichever part of the world that respective company would like to sell to.

risk.statement: JV formation subject to preset conditions; no guarantee JV will materialize
risk.quote: There are some preset conditions which both parties have to reach. If we reach there, then that will sort of trigger the discussion for a JV.

other.statement: Pirelli targets super-premium segment (~10% of market); BKT targets full market breadth
other.quote: They are looking to address the very high end of the Indian market, which is not a very big market to start with. It's about 10% of the market is what you can classify loosely as the very high end of the market.

other.statement: Pirelli offtake primarily for Indian market; some portion may go to global markets
other.quote: Yes, there would be some component which may be used by them for their global markets, but majorly it will be for them to serve the Indian market.

guidance.statement: Cost-to-income ratio medium to long-term guidance at 25%
guidance.quote: Having said that, the medium to long-term guidance will be the cost to income will be around 25%.

guidance.statement: AUM growth guidance for FY27 cut to 15-17% from 18% earlier due to monsoon impact
guidance.quote: Looking at the impact of the war situation in West Asia and the weak monsoon, we have been growing a little less than that. The first quarter, our growth was around 15%. In the second quarter, it was 17%. We will be anywhere growing anywhere between these two 15% to 17%.

guidance.statement: Credit cost guidance remains 2% for full year with temporary 30-40 bps elevation for 1-2 quarters due to seasonal monsoon impact
guidance.quote: Credit cost, we had given a long -term guidance of 2%. But tempora rily, maybe certain geographies, it may go up by 30, 40 basis points, is what we indicated. And in the being seasonal and monsoon being weak, we are seeing a little increase in Stage 2 and Stage 1 in certain geography. I believe that it will be seasonal and it should get normalized to overall expectation of 2

guidance.statement: Gold loan book target to double in 3 years from 2.5% to 5% of AUM remains unchanged
guidance.quote: No change in there is no change. We will go as per the plan.

demand.statement: Commercial vehicle sales grew 28.7% YoY in Q2 FY27 with M&HCV up 37% and LCV up 23.8%
demand.quote: commercial vehicle sales has increased by 28.7% in Q2 FY27, and stands at 3.09 lakh units against 2.4 lakh units sold in the Q2 FY26. Within commercial vehicle, medium and heavy commercial vehicle sales recorded growth of 37% in Q2 FY2 7, and stands at 1,21,171 units against 88,431 units sold in Q2 FY2 6. LCV's sales recorded a growth of 23.8% in Q2, and stands at 1.88 lakh units versus 1.52 lakh

margin.statement: NIM expanded to 9.52% in Q2 FY27 from 8.19% YoY and 9.04% QoQ due to capital infusion
margin.quote: Our net interest margin in Q2 FY27 was 9.52% as against 8.19% in Q2 FY26 and 9.04% in Q1 FY27.
