margin.statement: Cost of liabilities on book reduced to 8.41% from 8.56% QoQ (15 bps), incremental cost of funds at 7.3% vs 7.7% previous quarter
margin.quote: The cost of liabilities on balance sheet is 8.41% versus 8.56% in the previous quarter, a reduction of 15 basis points, and from March, it is down by 18 basis points. The incremental cost of fund for the quarter was 7.3 versus 7.7 in the previous quarter.

order_book.statement: AUM grew 16.96% YoY to INR3,29,021.72 crores and 4.85% QoQ
order_book.quote: Our AUM as on 30th September 2026 registered a growth of 16.96% over Q2 FY26 and a 4.85% sequentially. Our AUM stood at INR3,29,021.72 crores as against INR2,81,309.46 crores a year ago and INR313,798. That is INR3,13,798.39 crores in Q1 FY27.

order_book.statement: Disbursements grew 25.71% YoY to INR54,079.02 crores in Q2 FY27
order_book.quote: We registered disbursement growth of 25.71% year -on-year. Our disbursement in Q2 FY2 7 this year aggr egated to INR54,079.02 crores versus INR43,019.17 crores in Q2 FY26

order_book.statement: MSME lending expanding geographically across India from southern focus, driving faster growth
order_book.quote: our MSME was mostly focused in the southern market . And as post the merger, because MSME lending was done through earlier Shriram City Union book, then we are now expanding it to all India. So, we expect MSME book to grow much faster than other segment because of th e bigger geographical reach

pricing_cost.statement: Yield differential between new and used vehicle financing 200-400 bps depending on segment
pricing_cost.quote: It is normally it depends upon segment to segment. It will be between 200 to 400 basis points.

risk.statement: West Asia crisis and weak monsoon (El Niño) creating headwinds, 51.2% of India abnormally dry, impacting rural consumption in drought-prone areas
risk.quote: As you're aware, there were multiple headwinds for us in last two quarters, one due to West Asia crisis, where the petroleum product prices went up, and so many other raw material prices went up, and secondly, now due to El Niño situation, monsoon being a weak. In spite of that, the company has performed very well.

other.statement: Construction equipment absolute GS3 down QoQ from INR874 crores to INR862 crores, GS2 stable at INR953 crores to INR963 crores, percentage increase due to denominator effect
other.quote: See, if you see the absolute amount, it is still coming down quarter-on-quarter, even though the disbursement have been better this quarter. The previous quarter's gross Stage 3 was 874 crores, absolute amount, and this quarter, it is 862. Similarly, gross Stage 2, if you see, it's 953 previous quarter, this quarter is 963, so not much of a difference as such. So it's more of a denominator effect,

other.statement: Borrowing program restarted at pre-March levels, borrowed INR27,000 crores in Q2 FY27, no excess liquidity remaining
other.quote: This quarter we have started our borrowing program, be it bonds, bank borrowing. It is back to the pre-March level. So, we have borrowed around INR27,000 crores in the last quarter. Liquidity-wise, we have brought down the liquidity, and it is now at our 3 months of future liability level. So, nothing of excess liquidity now, and our borrowing program will continue the way it was in the previous q

guidance.statement: FY27 lamination volume target maintained at 82,000+ tons
guidance.quote: FY27, I think we'll still hold on to the upgraded guidance given last quarter.

demand.statement: Strong demand visibility across data centers, railways, mining, off-highway, and specialized industrial applications
demand.quote: Beyond data centers, we continue to see strong demand visibility across railways, metros, mining, off-highway equipment, and specialized industrial applications.

demand.statement: Data center segment at 7% of revenue, seen as strong near-term growth opportunity
demand.quote: Among these segments, data centers have emerged as a strong near-term growth opportunity. As we have highlighted on multiple occasions before, the demand remains robust driven by significant power requirements of AI-led data center infrastructure.

margin.statement: Q2 FY27 EBITDA margin 15.8%, impacted by forex loss, consumable, packing, fuel and power costs
margin.quote: The EBITDA margins stood at 15.8%, impacted by an increase in forex loss, increase in consumable and packing cost, and along with increase in fuel and power costs.

margin.statement: Sustainable blended EBITDA margin 17%+ at current steel prices, 18% potentially achievable with value-added mix
margin.quote: On a blended basis, you should be looking -- I'm talking of current raw material prices. When I say current quarter two raw material price levels. Steel prices are obviously increasing and decreasing every quarter. But if you take a Q2 price level, your sustainable blended margin should be in the vicinity of 17% plus

order_book.statement: Strong order visibility from marquee customers in data centers, mining, off-highway, railways backing capacity expansion
order_book.quote: This investment was backed by strong order visibility from marquee customers across high-growth sectors such as data centers, mining, off-highway vehicles, and railways.

capex.statement: New INR450 crore greenfield lamination and machining facility in Bangalore phased through FY31
capex.quote: The total planned capex for this project is INR450 crores, comprising approximately INR125 crores towards land procurement and the remaining INR325 crores towards infrastructure, plant, and equipment.

capex.statement: Cumulative capex INR740 crores including earlier INR290 crore Hyderabad project
capex.quote: The capex announced earlier was INR290 crores. The current capex announced is INR450 crores. And the cumulative capex for the two announcements is INR740 crores.

capex.statement: Capex funding through internal accruals and debt, practically fully from internal accruals by FY31
capex.quote: Practically, it should be funded entirely from internal accruals if that clarifies.

product_mix.statement: Data center revenue share not expected to exceed 9% of overall revenue in next 3-5 years
product_mix.quote: However, I would not look at it increasing more than probably 9-odd percent of the overall revenue as a segment. We see that other segments like mining and special-purpose motors, power gen in general, will also grow, and overall mix should remain similar.

product_mix.statement: Q2 FY27 segment revenue: traction motor/railway 27%, power generation 16%, industrial/commercial 12%, mining/oil/gas 10%, special purpose motors 8%, data centers 7%
product_mix.quote: In terms of segment-wise revenue, Q2 FY27 traction motor and railway components continued to contribute the highest share of the revenue at 27%. Power generation accounted for 16%, followed by industrial and commercial applications at 12%, mining, oil, and gas at 10%, special purpose motors at 8%, and data centers at 7%.

risk.statement: Q3 FY27 volume challenge due to holiday season in India (Dussehra, Diwali) and Europe/US (Christmas)
risk.quote: Execution will be a challenge. Quarter three is always a little bit of challenge, considering the holiday season in India and Europe. We have Dussehra, Diwali, then Christmas for our European and American clients.

other.statement: Q2 FY27 lamination and assembly volumes 21,600 tons, up 26% YoY; H1 volumes 41,000 tons, up 22% YoY
other.quote: On the volumes front, total lamination and assembly volumes for the quarter stood at 21,600 tons, a growth of 26% Y-o-Y. H1 lamination volumes increased to 41,000 tons, up by 22% compared to H1 FY26.

other.statement: Q2 FY27 raw casting and machine components volume 3,086 tons, up 6% YoY; H1 6,054 tons, up 1.6% YoY
other.quote: Total raw casting and machine components volume for Q2 FY27 was 3,086 tons, growing by 6%, and 6,054 tons for H1, with a growth of 1.6%.

guidance.statement: Gross margin target of 36%-38%
guidance.quote: Basically, we're looking at the gross margin level at being approximately in the region of at least 36% -38% is what we're looking at ideally is what we should be in a position to do.

guidance.statement: Revenue target of INR2,000 crores by FY29 on track
guidance.quote: So we're not very far off track. We're fairly on track, I would say. This year, the last 6, 8, 9 months have shown that opportunities are there and the market is moving in a certain direction.

demand.statement: Revenue grew 23% YoY in Q2 and H1, supported by healthy demand across core end markets
demand.quote: Revenue for the quarter grew about 23% year-on-year to INR345 crores and H1 revenue was also up 23% at INR654 crores. Growth was supported by healthy demand across core end markets.

demand.statement: Volume growth in mid-teens, expecting continued double-digit volume growth
demand.quote: It's in the approximate high, I would say, teens somewhere I'll just put it there because I don't want to get into too much more of that, but we're approximately in the mid-teen level.

margin.statement: Q2 gross margin 34.2% due to input cost inflation and growth strategy
margin.quote: Gross margins for the quarter was 34.2%, with input cost inflation, particularly higher steel and other raw material prices, being one of the key pressures.

margin.statement: H1 EBITDA margin 11.2%, slightly higher than last year
margin.quote: Despite this pressure, EBITDA grew 9% in the quarter and H1 EBITDA margin was 11.2%, slightly higher than last year.

order_book.statement: Inventory build-up 75-80% due to order backlog, 15-20% due to steel availability concerns
order_book.quote: One is order back. So that's, I would say, 75% -80% of the reason. Another 15% -20% of the reason is availability of steel in the market was a concern.

capex.statement: Capex of INR30-35 crores for FY27, rising to INR60-70 crores for FY27-28
capex.quote: This year will be approximately INR30 -INR35 crores, which if you see the trend for the last 2 years is similar. But we do have capex planned which will be in the -- for the next 2 financial years, it will be in the region of INR60-INR65 crores to INR70 crores.

pricing_cost.statement: Steel prices increased 7-8% QoQ in Q2, calibrated price increases taken
pricing_cost.quote: Percentage increase in steel Q2 versus Q1 must be anywhere in the region of 7%, 8%.

pricing_cost.statement: Most cost increases passed through, Q2 had temporary lag in pass-through
pricing_cost.quote: All of it will get passed through -- always it got passed through a bit later than I would have liked. In Q2, it happened a bit later. Now it's getting done now.

product_mix.statement: 60-70% of incremental growth to come from product mix improvement
product_mix.quote: If I have to estimate, I'd say 60%-70% of that growth will come from product mix, which doesn't necessarily mean that it can't be at the right margin level.

risk.statement: Steel prices not softening soon, but not increasing as rapidly either
risk.quote: I don't see them softening anytime soon. I don't think they're going to be as rapidly increas ed either, but that's my perspective on it right now

other.statement: Middle East is 80-85% of export sales, expanding into US, Africa, Europe
other.quote: But the Middle East is about 80%-85% of the export sales. But we expect that the other markets will grow and these FTAs and all of that, that are coming in, we're seeing greater push, greater pull.

other.statement: Interim dividend of INR7.5 per equity share declared
other.quote: To reward our shareholders for their trust, the Board has declared an interim dividend of INR7.5 per equity share.

guidance.statement: Volume growth guidance of 15-20% YoY for next 10-15 quarters
guidance.quote: So as I've been saying, 15% to 20% volume growth year -on-year you can safely consider for Rajratan. It is a combination of growth in Thailand, in Chennai and some in Indore. So this will continue for next at least 10 to 15 quarters.

guidance.statement: Full year export target of more than 30,000 tons from India and Thailand combined
guidance.quote: This year total export target from India and Thailand is more than 30,000 tons.

guidance.statement: Consolidated volume target of 160,000 tons for FY27
guidance.quote: So this year we should end up close to 160,000 tons of business.

guidance.statement: India export target of 14,000-15,000 tons for FY27
guidance.quote: Close to 14,000 tons, 15,000 tons.

demand.statement: Thailand domestic tyre industry growing at 10-15% locally
demand.quote: if you look at regional growth, Thailand capacities are growing much faster, okay, which ar e growing at 10% to 15% locally. Domestically, Thailand tyre industry is growing

margin.statement: Thailand EBITDA expected to improve in coming quarters, India EBITDA improvement limited due to competition
margin.quote: Our projection for Thailand is better. You will see better number from Thailand in the coming quarter as far as EBITDA is concerned. We do not expect much improvement in EBITDA in the remaining 2 quarters in India.

margin.statement: Current EBITDA margins at rock bottom (12.7-13%), should not fall below this level
margin.quote: I can say that our current margins are rock bottom. It should not go below this, so anything from here will improve.

capex.statement: Thailand brownfield expansion capex of INR100 crores from now, total INR125 crores including past spend
capex.quote: Broadly, we should be able to do it in INR100 crores, ballpark number. Last year or up till now we have spent about INR20 crores in acquiring a new factory there, where we'll be shifting some of the facilities. And so there is hardly investment in infrastructure. So investment will be there only in the machines and plant and machinery. So total, including everything, it will be INR125 crores, but

capex.statement: Chennai expansion incremental capex of INR30-35 crores to reach 60,000 tons from 30,000 tons
capex.quote: I recall we had spent 270 crores for a facility of 30,000 tons, and we spent another 30 crores, 35 crores to complete it to 60,000 tons.

pricing_cost.statement: Price hikes taken in some counters, remaining to be passed on by end of Q3 FY27
pricing_cost.quote: We have been able to take some hike in some cases where prices were not finalized or we were not committed at old price, but remaining we will have to take end of this quarter.

pricing_cost.statement: Input cost pressures from energy, gas, petroleum, packing, dies, transportation and sea freight
pricing_cost.quote: The impact is more of other costs mainly energy, gas, petroleum, packing products and dies, everything has gone up, transportation cost. Yes. Export sea freights, they are like crazy.

product_mix.statement: Thailand premium customer mix to grow from 30-32% to 40% in coming year
product_mix.quote: Currently, around 30% to 32% of our sales are towards the premium customers, and as sir has mentioned, it will take time to grow, but few marquee customers are already approved and we will supply them. So we expect this to grow by 40%, means 30% will become 40% in the coming year product mix.

product_mix.statement: India premium customer share already at 50-60%, limited further consolidation expected
product_mix.quote: it won't make a big difference in India because in India, premium customers we are already at more than 50%, 60% counter share. So we are not projecting to further consolidate that market share.

fund_raise.statement: Thailand expansion funded by combination of internal accruals and bank loans below 4%
fund_raise.quote: Both. It's a combination of internal accrual. Thailand balance sheet is accruing cash on a month-on-month basis. And there are banks; loan is also at a very competitive rate, below 4% we borrow from bank. So it will be a combination of loan and internal accrual.

risk.statement: Freight rates volatile, company taking risk on DDP basis with some freight surcharge agreements
risk.quote: freight remains very volatile. We are supposed to supply material on DDP basis, deliver to their door of customer, and freight rates are fluctuating. So to mitigate that risk, some places we have built up a mark up or kind of freight surcharge; some customers have agreed.

other.statement: Major approvals from global tyre MNCs in Thailand for supply to Europe, America and Southeast Asia
other.quote: For us in Thailand, we have got major approvals from world leaders in tyres. Whom we were supplying locally, now we are supposed to supply them in their different locations in Europe, America and Southeast Asia.

other.statement: Consolidated borrowing increase driven by 27% revenue growth and higher export working capital cycle
other.quote: There has been 27% revenue growth. So majority of this is working capital borrowing. And it is more so because working capital cycle for export is higher than the local. So majority of this is borrowing for working capital, and it is in proportion to the growth of business.

guidance.statement: Full-year capex guidance maintained at around INR 10,000 crores
guidance.quote: I will still stick to INR 10,000, but it will be better to look at a full year number after the Q3 results. Plus minus INR10,000 crores.

guidance.statement: EBITDA per ton target of INR 1,400 by exit March 2028 reiterated
guidance.quote: Business as usual is what my expectation is to deliver that INR1,400. If the cost pressures come in, they will get covered by price increases. So yes, we will deliver our commitment.

guidance.statement: Net debt to EBITDA expected below 1x by end of March 2027
guidance.quote: March end, we were at 0.94x net debt EBITDA. We are at 1.26 x net debt EBITDA at the end of September '26. But by the end of March, I will be below 1x net debt to EBITDA.

demand.statement: Industry cement demand estimated to grow close to 10% YoY; UltraTech grew 13.8% in Q2 FY27
demand.quote: Industry estimates put cement demand to grow closer to 10% year-on-year. Our growth of 13.8% this quarter is comfortably ahead, which means that our presence in the market is continuously increasing.

demand.statement: Strong demand outlook through March 2029 driven by urban housing, infrastructure, data centres, private capex, and semiconductor industry
demand.quote: I think demand is what is the strongest support for the cement industry at the moment and for period ending till March '29 we should see very strong momentum in cement consumption.

margin.statement: Q2 EBITDA per ton improved despite fuel cost rising from INR 45 to INR 51.5 per bag; fixed costs per ton down 6% YoY
margin.quote: have risen from INR 45 a bag to INR 51.5 per bag. That is the contribution of fuel cost Y-o-Y as the fuel rates climbed to about INR 2.09 per kcal. This is the West Asia crisis effect, which we can discuss separately. Third, other fixed costs per ton were 6% lower for us than the last year, even after absorbing new capacity because absolute fixed costs grew only 4%, well below the volume growth of

order_book.statement: Project pipeline growing with 100 announcements worth INR 13.4 lakh crores by early September including power plants, industrial parks, data centres, metros, RRTS
order_book.quote: I believe there were 100 announcements worth about INR 13.4 lakh crores by ear ly September, which include Tamil Nadu's INR55,000 crores power plant, INR65,000 crores Gorakhpur Industrial Park, Assam's INR50,000 crores 5- year infra program, Odisha's Coastal Highway, Metro 1 in Thiruvananthapuram and the Bawal-Behror RRTS, power, industrial parks, data centres, all are growing and all are cement i

product_mix.statement: Premium cement share 37%, blended cement share 67.3% in Q2 FY27
product_mix.quote: 37% is my premium cement and blended cement would be 67.3%.

other.statement: Commissioned 4.6 million tons in September (3.6 Mt greenfield at Petnikota, 1 Mt debottlenecking); domestic capacity now 204.7 million tons
other.quote: We commissioned 4.6 million tons of capacity in the month of September, taking our domestic cement capacity to 204.7 million tons, which includes the 3.6 million tons greenfield capacity at Petnikota in Andhra and 1 million ton of debottlenecking at 3 other units.

other.statement: UltraTech growing faster than industry and delivering higher profitability consistently
other.quote: if you were to look at UltraTech's performance quarter after quarter, compare it with the rest of the industry put together on one side and UltraTech on the other side, we have consistently grown at a pace higher than the industry and delivered profitability higher than rest of the industry.

guidance.statement: Management expects PAT of 100+ crores for FY27 but declines to give quarterly profit guidance due to export market variables and SEBI norms
guidance.quote: Yes, we are very confident of repeating 100 plus this year.

guidance.statement: Average realization expected around Rs 700 per kg in second half with slightly better volumes
guidance.quote: It'll be around 700 plus.

margin.statement: Q2 EBITDA fell to 28 crores from 38 crores due to feed raw material cost increase; importing soya to reduce costs
margin.quote: Comparing to quarterly results, the sales is improved from 179 crore to 184 crore, but because of increase in feed raw material cost under this one, EBITDA is come down to 28 crores from 38 crores in between last two quarters.

margin.statement: International prices set by global competition (Europe, US, Ukraine, South America), not by Indian production costs; cannot pass on raw material inflation to export customers
margin.quote: International selling price is determined by what is being offered by Europe on egg white powder and US or your powder and other place coming from Ukraine, South America, Mexico. So international prices are not determined by our cost of production of eggs in India.

capex.statement: Board approved term loan of nearly 300 crores (200 from SBI, 100 from Axis Bank) for EC rearing house project; documents to be signed next week
capex.quote: the board has also approved a term loan of nearly 300 crores, 200 from State Bank. 100 crores from Access Bank. So, we will be signing the documents next week.

capex.statement: Dry powder capacity expansion from 7,000 to 10,000+ tons with 180 crore investment (30 crore margin, 150 crore term loan at 8.25%) expected by second half of next year
capex.quote: overall, I would like to highlight that apart from the 2.4 million birds under our own production, we are also expanding our capacity from the current 7,000 tons to 10,000 plus tons with an overall investment of 180 crores, which will come into effect may be by second-half of next year.

other.statement: Planning to import soya at ~10% cheaper than domestic prices for six-month requirement; implementation in 1-2 weeks
other.quote: Currently, we are expecting to import at least 10% cheaper than what we have, which is an important ingredient but in terms of dividend , you know, our company is in a high investment mode.

other.statement: Committed to maintaining 25% dividend payout even during high investment phase (next 2-3 years)
other.quote: we will try to maintain the 25% even during the high investment phase and the debt period.

guidance.statement: Revised FY27 guidance: credit growth 14%+, deposit growth 12%+, CASA 42%+, ROA ~1.20%, GNPA below 2%, considerable NIM improvement
guidance.quote: Based on the mid-term review, we have reassessed our guidance as indicated in the last call. The revised guidance for FY 2026-27 would be credit growth of 14% plus, deposit growth of 12% plus, CASA to be 42% plus. There should be a considerable improvement in NIM, ROA to be around 1.20% and GNPA to be below 2%.

guidance.statement: Credit growth guidance 14%+ but aiming for ~18% if retail growth continues; split 60% retail, 40% corporate; NIM to improve substantially but no specific number given
guidance.quote: Yes. The target for the year, which we had earlier set at a lower rate, we have revised it a little bit higher now at 14%. But I said 14% plus. So my aim is to reach to around 18% provided that we continue with the retail growth.

margin.statement: NIM improvement driven by 25 bps repo hike passed to 65% repo-linked portfolio, shedding high-cost deposits, no further high-cost deposits needed, further repo hikes expected
margin.quote: I just mentioned that I do not want to mention a particular number for NIM. But see, 25 bps improvement has already happened on repo, and I said 65% of my portfolio is linked to repo, which is already passed on. The next is we are in the process in the bank at the moment. We had been resorting to some high-cost deposits, which we have shed now, and we are no longer required to take any high-cost d

margin.statement: NIM compressed to 3.22% for H1; yield on advances flat at 8.55%; cost of deposits rose to 4.85%; expect NIM improvement from Q3 as yield rises and cost of deposits moderates
margin.quote: Resultantly, the NIM has witnessed compression, being recorded at 3.22% for the half year but with the expected improvement across both yield and cost, the NIM should also improve.

order_book.statement: Total business grew 19.4% YoY to INR 3.10 lakh crore; deposits up 16.3%, advances up 23.7% YoY
order_book.quote: This resilience in the domestic economy is also reflected in the Bank's business momentum with the Bank's total business growing by 19.4% Y-o-Y to INR3.10 lakhs crores as on 30th September 2026. The Y-o-Y growth across both deposits and advances has been healthy at 16.3% and 23.7%, respectively.

fund_raise.statement: Equity raise INR 1,000 crore, debt raise INR 500 crore; debt in Q3 FY27, equity at opportune time; approvals in place, readiness complete
fund_raise.value: INR 1,000 cr equity, INR 500 cr debt
fund_raise.quote: See, there are multiple factors for which we intend to raise capital. I'm not going into that. But if you ask me the quantum, I can mention that it is going to be INR1,000 crores of equity and INR500 crores of debt. Timings, I think the debt will be this quarter. And as I mentioned that the equity will be slightly dependent on the time when it is most conducive for our bank.

risk.statement: ECL implementation model almost ready, to go to Board by December; ECL hit expected below industry average; INR 300 crore buffer held; will disclose exact range in December
risk.quote: See, base figure assessment is not what I want to mention at the moment. That is why I'm not saying. Otherwise, we have a fair assessment of the ECL requirement. And the model is almost ready. It will be public -- at least it will go to the Board by the December Board meeting. So we will be ready. I mean it's not -- we are not falling back on it. We are ready.

other.statement: Raising INR 1,000 crore equity and INR 500 crore debt capital; debt raise in Q3 FY27, equity timing flexible; CAR 16.57%, CET1 13.88% as of Sep 30, 2026
other.value: INR 1,000 cr equity, INR 500 cr debt
other.quote: Capital Adequacy Ratio has been recorded at 16.57% as on 30th September 2026 with CET 1 of 13.88%. The Bank is already in the process of raising both equity and debt capital to the tune of INR1,000 crores and INR500 crores respectively and will raise the capital at an opportune time to support its future growth.

other.statement: IRDAI commission reduction to be offset by volume growth; added SBI Life and HDFC Life; J&K underinsured with high potential
other.quote: The reason why I said that we will be able to jack up our income from third-party product selling is because we have added two more insurance companies for life, that is SBI Life as well as HDFC Life. And I expect the volumes to actually compensate for the commission difference that is going to come.

guidance.statement: FY29 revenue target maintained at INR20,000 crores; EBITDA margin target upgraded to about 30% from 27%
guidance.quote: Accordingly, we are upgrading our FY '29 EBITDA margin target to about 30%, up from 27% earlier, while maintaining our FY '29 revenue target at INR20,000 crores.

guidance.statement: FY27 margin target aligned with Lakshya; aim to deliver results in line with Q2 performance and project Lakshya's 30% margin goal
guidance.quote: So we plan to deliver results which are in alignment with our project Lakshya, wherein we have already announced to increase it to 30%.

demand.statement: CRU upgraded 2026 data center optical cable demand projection to 89% YoY growth; global optical cable demand expected to reach 851 million fiber km by 2031 at 7.5% CAGR; AI data centers to capture 1/3 volume share by 2030 ex-China
demand.quote: CRU recently upgraded its 2026 demand projections for this segment to 89% year -on-year, up sharply from 63% last quarter.

margin.statement: Q2 FY27 operational EBITDA margin 27.1%, up 624 bps QoQ; H1 FY27 operational EBITDA margin 24.4%; reported EBITDA includes INR161 crore one-time US tariff refund
margin.quote: Our operational EBITDA for Q2 FY '27 came in at INR685 crores, delivering 27.1% margin or significant quarter-on-quarter expansion of 624 basis points.

order_book.statement: Open order book at record INR35,274 crores, up 4.6x from INR7,687 crores at start of FY27; INR3,021 crores scheduled for Q3 FY27 execution
order_book.quote: Our open order book stands at record INR35,274 crores, up 4.6x from INR7,687 crores at the start of this financial year.

order_book.statement: H1 FY27 order intake of INR32,000 crores, roughly 4x full FY26 orders; includes $1.2 billion 5-year hyperscaler deal and $1.11 billion prior hyperscaler award
order_book.quote: In the first half of FY '27, we secured orders worth INR32,000 crores. This is roughly 4x the orders we won in the whole of FY '26.

capex.statement: Annual capex commitment of around INR1,000 crores per year through FY29 for 50% capacity expansion in preform, fiber, cable and a greenfield pre-terminated solutions facility
capex.quote: All of this is backed by an annual capex commitment of around INR1,000 crores per year through FY '29.

pricing_cost.statement: Focus shifting to high-end cables and connectivity products under Neuralis portfolio (CONCAT, MMC, pre-terminated trunks); do not comment on specific preform/fiber pricing trends
pricing_cost.quote: Broadly from our side, our focus has been more and more of the very high -end cables, very high -end design that we've been focused on.

product_mix.statement: Attach rate reached all-time high of 24% in H1 FY27, up from 20% in H1 FY26; aim to drive 25% and beyond for current financial year
product_mix.quote: I'm pleased to report that our attach rate has reached an all -time high of 24% in H1 FY '27, up from 20% in H1 FY '26.

product_mix.statement: Data Center segment contributed 33% of H1 FY27 revenue, on track to scale to 50% in FY27; attach rate reached all-time high 24% in H1 FY27 vs 20% in H1 FY26, targeting 25%+ for FY27
product_mix.quote: Our Data Center segment saw a strong momentum, contributing 33% in H1 FY '27. Keeping us firmly on track towards scaling this segment to 50% of revenues in the current fiscal.

risk.statement: Execution risks for data center projects include land, power, water and local opposition; hyperscalers diversifying geographies (Nordics, India, Australia, Mongolia) to mitigate; no changes seen in customer conversations yet
risk.quote: But also, we have to be mindf ul that there are some local execution challenges around land, power, water and other local opposition.

other.statement: Expanding preform, fiber and cable capacities by 50% and building a new greenfield facility for pre-terminated solutions
other.quote: Finally, to power this entire growth cycle, we're expanding our preform fiber and cable capacities by 50% and building a new greenfield facility for pre-term related-solutions.

other.statement: H1 FY27 revenue mix: North America 61%, Europe 21%, Rest of World 18%; North America driven by hyperscaler AI/cloud demand
other.quote: North America shares stood at 61% in H1 FY '27, driven by robust demand across AI and cloud infrastructure, while Europe contributed 21% and rest of the world represented 18%.

guidance.statement: Net debt to EBITDA expected below 1x by end of March 2027 from 1.26x at September 2026
guidance.quote: March end, we were at 0.94x net debt EBITDA. We are at 1.26 x net debt EBITDA at the end of September '26. But by the end of March, I will be below 1x net debt to EBITDA.

guidance.statement: Ultravolt wires and cables business expected to reach matured performance by fiscal 2028; April-June 2027 quarter worth talking about
guidance.quote: My sense is April-June 2027 will be a quarter worth talking about. Right now, let us build the business.

guidance.statement: Full-year capex guidance maintained at around INR 10,000 crores; better to assess after Q3 results
guidance.quote: I will still stick to INR 10,000, but it will be better to look at a full year number after the Q3 results. Plus minus INR10,000 crores

demand.statement: Industry cement demand estimated to grow close to 10% YoY; UltraTech grew 13.8% YoY in Q2 FY27, gaining market share
demand.quote: Industry estimates put cement demand to grow closer to 10% year-on-year. Our growth of 13.8% this quarter is comfortably ahead, which means that our presence in the market is continuously increasing.

demand.statement: Strong demand outlook till March 2029 driven by data centres, private capex, semiconductor, urban housing, metro projects, and government infrastructure announcements
demand.quote: New opportunities which are surfacing, data centres coming up in a big way, private sector capex, practically, most of the industry is expanding capacities. Semiconductor industry, that's a new animal on the block, which is rising in a big way.

margin.statement: Operating leverage advantage to kick in next quarter; fixed cost per ton to benefit as volumes remain strong
margin.quote: Yes, please. The operating leverage advantage will kick in.

margin.statement: Q2 FY27 net profit up 21% YoY; operating leverage benefited from 13.8% volume growth vs 4% fixed cost growth; fixed cost per ton down 6% YoY
margin.quote: Despite increase in cost, the company has achieved an improvement in operating performance, higher capacity utilization on a higher base, higher or stable realizations, improvement in efficiency and a 21% increase in net profit.

margin.statement: Fuel cost per bag rose from INR 45 to INR 51.5 QoQ (INR 6/bag impact); kcal cost increased to INR 2.09, now around INR 2.2; expect marginal impact in Q3, more in Q4
margin.quote: Fuel costs have risen from INR 45 a bag to INR 51.5 per bag. That is the contribution of fuel cost Y-o-Y as the fuel rates climbed to about INR 2.09 per kcal.

pricing_cost.statement: South region strongest momentum in prices, volumes and utilization; West (Mumbai) up 3-4%/bag in September; North steady; Central muted; East disrupted by rains but catching up from October
pricing_cost.quote: South have been the strongest momentum in prices, volume and capacity utilization. South markets are transforming. Mark my words.

product_mix.statement: Premium cement share 37%; blended cement share 67.3% in Q2 FY27
product_mix.quote: 37% is my premium cement and blended cement would be 67.3%.

product_mix.statement: Ultravolt launched unique products (Class 5 insulation, e-beam technology) commanding premium; positioning at market parity with differentiation via product proposition
product_mix.quote: we have launched unique products, which were not existing in the marketplace. T he classic is Class 5 insulation material or e-beam technology product. That nobody has. And that product is what is commanding a premium

fund_raise.statement: Corporate guarantee given to UHG Holdings (41% UltraTech, 9% Grasim, 50% Hindalco) for aircraft/ships purchase for group business use; helps obtain finer interest rates
fund_raise.quote: End use for UHG, essentially that company will be buying aircraft and ships, which will be deployed in our business use. And UltraTech is 41% holding, 9% is held by Grasim, 50% is held by Hindalco.

risk.statement: West Asia crisis keeps fuel costs elevated (pet coke $180/ton); indirect risks: higher inflation, tighter monetary conditions, less fiscal room; no direct demand impact yet
risk.quote: The indirect risks are higher inflation, tighter monetary conditions and less fiscal room if fuel does not come down in terms of costs. We are watching all the 3 elements.

other.statement: Pet coke at $180/ton (all-time high); reduced pet coke share to 25% of fuel mix; domestic coal availability constrained as Coal India prioritizes power sector; industrial diesel at all-time high impacting mining/transport costs
other.quote: Pet coke prices have shot through the roof. They were trading around $180 per ton as I last checked. Pet coke, what we have done is we have reduced our dependence on pet coke since the last quarter. Today, we are down to about 25% of pet coke consumption in our overall mix.

other.statement: Capacity utilization 71% in Q2 FY27 vs 66% YoY on higher base; could have sold more if capacity available
other.quote: Our capacity utilization was 71%, better than 66% last year on a higher base. We could have grown more. We could have sold more cement if additional capacity was available.

guidance.statement: Medium-to-long-term AUM growth target of 16% to 18%
guidance.quote: I'm not changing our posture from a 16% to 18% medium to long-term AUM growth. That remains kind of pretty constant.

guidance.statement: Credit cost guidance maintained at 1.3% to 1.7%
guidance.quote: We have given a zip code of 1.3 to 1.7 on credit cost. I do not see any near-term to long-term challenge to that front.

guidance.statement: ROA aspiration of 2.2% to 2.5% in medium term
guidance.quote: Our aspiration is to move as a franchise to a 2.2 to 2.5 ROA.

margin.statement: Cost-to-income ratio improved to under 37% from above 40%
margin.quote: I also must point out our cost-to-income, which was earlier above 40%, has now slid to under 37%.

margin.statement: NIM challenged by rising cost of funds and fixed-rate book; loan income compressed by liquidity buffer and trade advance
margin.quote: We will have to find mechanisms to grow the revenue pie while the CoF clearly sees a incremental trend.

order_book.statement: AUM grew 15% YoY to INR 1,56,000 crores; non-wheels share at 20%
order_book.quote: Overall lending AUM, which is at INR 1,56,000 crores now you have a 20% coming in from the non-wheels and 80% from the wheels.

order_book.statement: Disbursements grew 22% YoY; holistic growth across all asset categories
order_book.quote: Our disbursement growth has grown in a steady clip of 22%. And this 22% growth has come in from clearly our core business which is the wheels business as well as growth coming from the diversification agenda.

order_book.statement: Non-wheels lending business grew 52% YoY; core wheels grew 21%
order_book.quote: The core business grew 21% and the non-wheels business at 52% is a healthy sign in that direction.

capex.statement: AI-orchestrated disbursements at INR 1,663 crores; 75% back office covered by AI workflows; 12 regional vernacular bots in collections
capex.quote: Glad to report that if you see the sequential swap-in benefits of the AI toolkits, it is adding material value to our disbursements, which are now 1,663 crores. On the operations front, 75% of our back office is now fully covered by enabled operation workflows.

pricing_cost.statement: Cost of funds on upward trajectory due to rate hikes; 25 bps hike translates to ~10 bps repricing of floating book per quarter
pricing_cost.value: ~10 bps per quarter on floating book
pricing_cost.quote: 25 basis points if it's implemented on the floating book, I think this leads to almost 10 basis points of existing stock getting repriced within, you can say, reset frequency within a quarter.

pricing_cost.statement: Incremental wheels loans to be priced higher; non-wheels floating book allows faster transmission
pricing_cost.quote: At least the incremental assets that we book will come in at a higher rate. So, in this environment, we have to be responsible, pass on what we can, and as well as price in what we can.

product_mix.statement: Growth across all vehicle segments: PV 28%, used 15%, CV/CE 16%, tractor 13%, 3W 32%, SME 13%, others 71%
product_mix.quote: We have, actually the wheels business firing on all cylinders, passenger vehicle at 28%, used business at 15%, CV/CE at 16%, tractor at 13%, three-wheeler at 32%, SME at 13%, and our other businesses at 71%.

product_mix.statement: Prime housing launched in August; early days but will be called out separately going forward
product_mix.quote: What you will see also build up there, which I will carve out separately is our prime housing, which we started doing in August.

fund_raise.statement: Priority sector lending assets (tractor, CV) used for securitization/on-lending to manage cost of funds
fund_raise.quote: We are one of the biggest suppliers of priority sector agri, considering the amount of loans that we have in underlying PSL assets, which is tractor, as well as CV, etc. So, we're able to even today offload a lot of those assets through co-lending, sorry, through on-lending, through securitization, etc.

risk.statement: Monitoring drought in 3 states and 282 districts; tractor collections half-yearly; early days to assess impact
risk.quote: We are also very carefully watching how the drought-related scenarios in the 3 states and the 282 districts are playing out. Our tractor business is very closely tied to the local economy.

risk.statement: Festive season commerce lower than last year; tractor seeing more decline; rural growth still stronger than urban in H1
risk.quote: I do want to kind of be, you know, the commerce is not as great as last year same time. We have seen some amount of departure from that.

other.statement: GS2+GS3 at all-time low of 8.1% with sequential improvement
other.quote: Looking at asset quality, 8.1% GS2+GS3, this is pretty much all-time lows in terms of our GS2+GS3 numbers.

other.statement: Sequential fall in GS3 by 3 bps and GS2 by 7 bps in Q2
other.value: 3 bps GS3 decrease, 7 bps GS2 decrease
other.quote: We, in fact, saw sequential fall in GS3 by 3 bps, as well as GS2 which was a 7 bps decrease.

guidance.statement: Growth plan to be presented in Q4 FY27; internal accruals to remain primary funding source
guidance.quote: We therefore intend to present our growth plan in Quarter 4 '27.

demand.statement: Domestic finished steel consumption grew 7.5% YoY to ~85 mt in H1 FY27; construction season pickup expected
demand.quote: Finished steel consumption in India grew 7.5% to about 85 million tons, ahead of growth in domestic production, even as the country remained a net importer of finished steel.

margin.statement: Q2 FY27 EBITDA margin 9.64% vs 16.19% Q1 FY27; compression from shutdowns and input costs
margin.quote: EBITDA for the quarter was INR111 crores, with an EBITDA margin of 9.64%, compared with the INR185 crores and 16.19% in Q1 FY27, and INR135 crores and 12.91% in Q2 FY26.

margin.statement: Captive iron ore mines targeted FY28 operational; expected INR2,000/ton EBITDA uplift once fully ramped
margin.quote: Over the medium term, solar, the Gujarat debottlenecking, and captive mines, which we expect to add about INR2,000 per ton to EBITDA once operational, will lift our margins structurally.

margin.statement: Solar plants (18 MW Siddhpur by Nov 2026, 60 MW Prayagraj by Q4 FY27) to save INR30-40 crores annually
margin.quote: Together, these are expected to save INR30 to INR40 crores annually in power cost.

capex.statement: H1 FY27 capex INR278 crores; full-year remaining spend ~INR500 crores
capex.quote: Capex during the first half was INR278 crores, of which about INR141 crores was spent in quarter 2, all funded through internal accruals.

capex.statement: Capex program INR3,000 crores; INR650 crores spent to date; FY27 balance ~INR500 crores
capex.quote: The remaining balance, the balance amount to be spent during the year is around 500 crores. Out of that, INR400 crores is for Gorakhpur plant. INR 240 crores is planned for mines, approximately INR 170 crores are planned for solar projects and INR100 crores is planned for Kutch.

pricing_cost.statement: TMT prices up ~21% YoY in Sep 2026; coal cost impact ~INR2,500/ton; iron ore cost impact ~1%
pricing_cost.quote: TMT prices in September were about 21% higher than a year ago.

pricing_cost.statement: Coal price increase affected raw material cost by 4.5-5% of sales revenue (~INR2,500/ton); iron ore up 1% (~INR3,000/ton total raw material increase)
pricing_cost.quote: So, if we say 5%, it's around INR2,500 per ton on the TMT prices. And there has been a 1% price increase on the iron ore front also. So, all put together, it's about INR3,000 a ton of price increase that we have seen in Q2 in the raw material side.

product_mix.statement: Brand premium 5-6% in UP, 3-4% in Gujarat vs unbranded TMT; held via branding (Ajay Devgn, Janhvi Kapoor) and dealer network
product_mix.quote: And if I talk about UP, we broadly command about 5% to 6% premium compared to any unbranded TMT which is coming in the market. And in Gujarat also, we command about 3% to 4% premium.

risk.statement: Growth plan depends on land acquisition and state incentives; timeline uncertain
risk.quote: A project of this nature depends on land acquisition and incentives from the state government, and we are working on that.

other.statement: Kutch rolling mill utilization 68% in Q2 FY27 vs 66% in Q1 FY27; structural improvement expected in H2
other.quote: At Kutch, rolling mill utilization, which we identified as a focus area in the last quarter, was 68% in Quarter 2, compared with 66% in Quarter 1.

other.statement: Net cash positive as of Sep 2026: borrowings INR592 crores (working capital only), cash & liquid INR426 crores + treasury INR266 crores; no term loans for projects
other.quote: Borrowings were INR592 crores, mostly working capital facilities, and we continue to carry no term loan for our project. Against this, we held about INR426 crores in bank balances and liquid investments, along with INR266 crores in short-term treasury deployment, so we remains net cash positive.

guidance.statement: FY27 revenue growth guidance of 25% to 40% year-on-year
guidance.quote: Based on our assessment of market condition, real estate activity, infrastructure development, and progress of our operations, we continue to expect year-on-year revenue growth in the range of 25% to 40%.

guidance.statement: FY27 EBITDA margin target around 18% and PAT margin approximately 10%
guidance.quote: We also remain focused on sustaining EBITDA margin at around 18% and maintaining a PAT margin of approximate 10%.

guidance.statement: Expect to reach INR600-650 crores peak revenue from existing infrastructure by FY28
guidance.quote: I think so we'll be able to reach in '28.

demand.statement: India real estate and infrastructure development driving demand for architectural glass
demand.quote: Considering the potential in India real estate infrastructure development of high-rise residential and commercial projects, so that will definitely add up the revenue in our sales and the capacity utilization.

margin.statement: Q2 FY27 consolidated EBITDA margin improved to 18.35% from 17.03% YoY
margin.quote: Consolidated EBITDA margin improved to 18.35% from 17.03%, representing the expansion of 132 basis points.

margin.statement: H1 FY27 consolidated EBITDA margin improved to 16.85% from 16.62% YoY
margin.quote: EBITDA margin improved to 16.85% to 16.62%, an expansion of 23 basis points.

margin.statement: Fire-rated glass expected EBITDA margins over 30% as value-added product
margin.quote: Margins will be definitely more in terms of EBITDA, it is more than 30%, because it is a very value-added product.

order_book.statement: UAE order book reached approximately AED78 million in September 2026 with 6-9 months visibility
order_book.quote: Our UAE order book reached approximately AED78 million in September 2026, providing visibility for execution over the following 6 to 9 months.

order_book.statement: India order book around INR85 crores with 6-8 month execution timeline
order_book.quote: It is around INR85 crores.

capex.statement: UAE tempering third line and fire-rated glass capex around AED20 million funded 60% internal accruals, 40% bank finance
capex.quote: So, the tempering third line and the fire-rated and the other facilities to be required to make this operation is around in the range of AED20 million of our total investment in terms of capex.

pricing_cost.statement: UAE COGS improved 3% due to product mix change, better vendor negotiation, efficiency gains
pricing_cost.quote: Secondly, efficiency improvement in our Dubai operations that where the COGS has been improved to 3%.

product_mix.statement: Value-added products (fire-rated, bulletproof, railway-grade, digital printed) expected 5% of FY27 revenue, 15-20% in FY28
product_mix.quote: We are expecting 5% in this year from the value-added products and next year 15% or 20%.

product_mix.statement: Fire-rated glass trial production in Q3 FY27, commercial production targeted end of Q3 FY27
product_mix.quote: The manufacturing line and associate technology has been imported and are being installed at our factory facility, with the trial production and approval progress towards the commercial production targeted to end of Q3 FY27.

risk.statement: Geopolitical tensions in Middle East increased logistics and input costs but passed on to customers
risk.quote: As of now, yes, we are doing well in spite of these geopolitical tensions over there. Of course, there is an increase in cost of some of the things because of logistic cost as shipment cost has been increased. So, input cost to certain extent has been increased, but which we are still passing on to the end users and the customers.

other.statement: Taloja tempering utilization improved from 55% to 69%, IG glass from 24% to 40% QoQ
other.quote: On the product side, has been improved, from last quarter, it was 55% on tempering in Taloja, now it is 69%. On IG glass, it was 24%, now it is almost 40% in Taloja.

other.statement: Erode tempering utilization improved from 13% to over 24%, IG glass from under 5% to over 18% QoQ
other.quote: Similarly, in Erode, the utilization of tempering line was 13%, now it is more than 24%. And on IG glass, it was less than 5% in last quarter, now it is more than 18%.

guidance.statement: Plan to add about 1,000 gross keys in the next 6 months
guidance.quote: overall, we are on track to add about 1,000 gross keys in the next 6 months. That is the current plan.

guidance.statement: Objective to reach 10,000 keys by FY30 is on track with 85% visibility
guidance.quote: Beyond the near-term additions, our objective to reach 10,000 keys by F'30 is very much on track. Currently, we have 8 ongoing greenfield and brownfield projects. And in terms of our funnel, we have 85% visibility on the F'30 target.

demand.statement: Occupancy grew 220 bps to 75.6% in Q2; resort revenue grew 15%, highest in 8 quarters
demand.quote: During the quarter, occupancy also grew by 220 basis points to 75.6%. And our resort revenue grew by 15%, which is, I think, the highest it has been in the last 8 quarters.

demand.statement: West Asia crisis causing limited occupancy impact on fly-in destinations, offset by driving holidays
demand.quote: because of the West Asia crisis, I think airfares have gone up. So what we are seeing is some destinations where people would typically fly in. I think we are already seeing some limited impact on occu pancy. But I think what has helped us is I think more people are doing driving holidays, and so that's really compensating for it

margin.statement: Standalone EBITDA INR124 crores vs INR141 crores last year, PAT INR43 crores vs INR52 crores, down 12% and 16% due to growth-linked costs
margin.quote: EBITDA stood at INR124 crores versus INR141 crores last year and PAT at INR43 crores versus INR52 crores last year, down by 12% and 16%, respectively, reflecting the impact of growth-linked costs.

margin.statement: Consolidated EBITDA increased 5% to INR194.8 crores; PAT rose 17% to INR19.7 crores
margin.quote: At a consolidated level, total income grew by 9% to INR819 crores and EBITDA increased 5% to INR194.8 crores. PAT rose by 17% to INR19.7 crores.

margin.statement: Margin pressure from investments in future capabilities, resort transformation, new properties, GST changes, solar subsidies
margin.quote: there are investments we are making on future. There are investments we are making on transformation of resorts. There are investments like new resorts, which are not profitable initiall y. And then there are some changes like GST and some solar subsidies. All of these are kind of dragging it down currently

capex.statement: H1 capex was INR312 crores, sharply up from INR166 crores a year ago
capex.quote: H1 capex was about INR312 crores. This is supporting some of the resort transformation and the new inventory projects. This is sharply up from INR166 crores a year ago.

capex.statement: Capital allocation split: ~70% towards new resorts, ~30% towards improving existing resorts
capex.quote: probably 70% of our capital will probably go towards new resorts and about 30% will go towards improving existing resorts. So that's the quick sense of how we are thinking about capital allocation.

capex.statement: Expect to spend almost an equal amount in the next 6 months to complete projects
capex.quote: in terms of the number of capex, I think we will probably spend almost an equal amount in the next 6 months to complete all of these projects.

pricing_cost.statement: Project costs have gone up in some cases due to geopolitical situation, causing delays in openings
pricing_cost.quote: where we have seen some impact is on some of the projects because the cost for delivering the projects have gone up in some cases. So that is something which and there have been delays on some other areas. So those are impacting openings a bit

product_mix.statement: Keystone total sales value including upgrades grew 6% YoY to INR141 crores; upgrade value grew 26% to INR83 crores
product_mix.quote: the total sales value, including upgrades, grew 6% year-on-year to INR141 crores, while the upgrade value grew at 26% to INR83 crores.

product_mix.statement: Average unit realization including upgrades grew 43% to INR13.4 lakhs
product_mix.quote: Our average unit realization, including upgrades, grew up by 43% to INR13.4 lakhs.

risk.statement: Strategic review of HCRO business is in progress; will communicate conclusions when reached
risk.quote: The strategic review is in progress as we speak. And I think as soon as we reach any kind of conclusi ons on that, we will come back. But at this point, it's in

other.statement: Exited 6 resorts in Q2, net reduction of 103 keys, network now 5,762 keys across 106 resorts
other.quote: during the quarter, we exited 6 resorts, taking the network to 5,762 keys across 106 resorts in September. So overall, there was a net reduction of 103 keys in the quarter.

other.statement: 442 keys currently under renovation, expected to return in Q3 and Q4
other.quote: currently, there are about 442 keys, which are in renovation. I think we expect that some of them will start coming in as early as Q3 and some of them will come into Q4.

guidance.statement: FY28 guidance: positive free cash flow and 20% reported ROE
guidance.quote: FY28, as we've been indicating, is an important year for the company where the exceptional growth of the past 2 years becomes apparent in the reported financials under project completion accounting. We expect to deliver both positive free cash flow and a 20% reported ROE in financial year '28.

guidance.statement: Full-year bookings guidance of INR40,000 crores; H2 bookings estimate INR22,500-25,000 crores; H2 collections target INR15,000 crores; H2 operating cash flow target INR7,000 crores; FY28 positive free cash flow and 20% reported ROE
guidance.quote: We only launched 1/3 of our expected annual launch pipeline in the first half of the financial year, and we're still able to deliver 43% of our annual bookings guidance, highlighting the continued strength of underlying demand in the sector.

guidance.statement: H2 FY27 bookings estimate INR22,500-25,000 crores; H2 collections target INR15,000 crores; H2 operating cash flow target INR7,000 crores
guidance.quote: We are especially focused on generating strong cash flows and expect INR15,000 crores of cash collection and INR7,000 crores of operating cash flow in the second half of the financial year.

margin.statement: Q2 total income +38% to INR2,575 crores; EBITDA -72% to INR171 crores; net profit -62% to INR154 crores; H1 total income +13% to INR3,912 crores; EBITDA -53% to INR717 crores; net profit -50% to INR504 crores; decline due to back-ended deli
margin.quote: For the quarter, our total income grew by 38% to INR2,575 crores. EBITDA declined by 72% to INR171 crores and net profit declined by 62% to INR154 crores.

margin.statement: Mahalunge JV exit and Orris settlement caused one-off P&L impact; Mahalunge future phase to have 100% economic interest and better margins
margin.quote: So that's how the line-by-line consolidation happened, whereby bulk of the profits were already accounted for in the past. And that's why you see that cuteness whereby the sales and cost of sales are almost equal because the bulk of the profit was accounted in the earlier days.

order_book.statement: Geographic sales mix Q2: NCR ~INR2,000 crores, Mumbai ~INR1,900 crores, Bangalore ~INR1,600 crores, Pune ~INR1,000 crores, Hyderabad ~INR700 crores, other cities ~INR800 crores
order_book.quote: The company's sales were well diversified geographically with key contributions from major residential markets. NCR this quarter did just under INR2,000 crores. Mumbai did about INR1,900 crores. Bangalore, we did just under INR1,600 crores, about INR1,000 crores in Pune, INR700-odd crores in Hyderabad and another INR800 crores in other cities during the quarter.

order_book.statement: 7th consecutive quarter with >INR7,000 crores booking value; 13th consecutive quarter with >INR5,000 crores booking value
order_book.quote: It is the seventh consecutive quarter in which Godrej Properties has delivered more than INR7,000 crores of booking value and the 13th consecutive quarter in which the company has delivered more than INR5,000 crores of booking value.

order_book.statement: Q2 FY27 booking value INR8,008 crores from 3,658 units (6.2 msf); H1 FY27 booking value INR16,669 crores from 7,396 units (12.3 msf); Q2 down 6% YoY and 7% QoQ; H1 up 7% YoY
order_book.quote: Godrej Properties achieved a booking value of INR8,008 crores in the second quarter from the sale of 3,658 units with a total area of 6.2 million square feet.

capex.statement: Construction and related outflow increased 31% YoY in Q2 and 42% in H1; H1 construction cash flows INR1,292 crores; expect accelerated construction momentum in H2
capex.quote: In H1, we could pull off 42% Y-on-Y growth on construction and construction-related cash flows, which is almost like INR1,292 crores.

pricing_cost.statement: Prices holding up; North markets <1% price increase; South and Mumbai ~2% increase; rest ~0.5%; Noida Godrej Crown Residences saw massive price jump tripling cluster profit, 88% sold out
pricing_cost.quote: Generally, we've not pushed pricing high in North markets, and we focused more on end user sales so that the quality of sale is higher. So it's like less than 1% price increase in some projects across South and Mumbai have seen most projects seeing 2% sort of a jump in price and again, 0.5% or so in rest of the portfolio.

risk.statement: Macro risks (oil at $115, equity markets) not changing sales playbook; product-market fit and process rigor drive consistent growth; sustenance sales 83% YoY growth proves market supportive
risk.quote: If you see what was very exciting for us is that we took the challenge of driving high quality of sales in the most difficult bucket, which is sustenance and that was at 83% Y-on-Y growth. This is clearly reflecting that the market is supportive, provided you have the right strategy and you have the right product mix to deliver on the promise that customers expect from you.

other.statement: Q3 launch approvals: 80% secured before quarter start; residual on track for post-Diwali; Q4 target 80% approvals by end-Nov to mid-Dec, residual by early-mid Jan
other.quote: I would say for quarter 3, 80% of whatever we needed was secured before even the quarter started because these were deferred launches. And the residual seems to be very much on track. And in the next few weeks, immediately after Diwali, we should be able to secure.

other.statement: Delivered 2.5 msf in Q2; on track for 13.5 msf full-year delivery
other.quote: GPL delivered projects aggregating 2.5 million square feet in the quarter, and we remain on track for 13.5 million square feet of delivery in the full year.

guidance.statement: Deposit growth guidance 13-14%, advances growth 18-20%, CD ratio around 82% over next two quarters
guidance.quote: Going forward, as per our guidance, we expect deposits to grow at between 13% to 14% and advances to grow at 18% to 20 %. So overall we expect that the CD ratio will be around 82 % over the next two quarters.

guidance.statement: RAM advances target 65% by March 2027 and 70% by March 2028
guidance.quote: As we have said earlier, our guidance is that the RAM advances percentage could be around 65% for the current year, and we will take it up to 70% by March 2028 (FY 2027-28).

guidance.statement: Business target Rs.3 lakh crore by end FY27 and Rs.4 lakh crore by end FY29
guidance.quote: The bank is in the pivot of now reaching a Rs.3 lakh crore business by the end of this financial year and Rs.4 lakh crore by the end of FY '29.

guidance.statement: Gross NPA below 2% by March 2027, Net NPA guidance 0.65%, recovery and upgradation Rs.1,000 crore+
guidance.quote: We continue to expect the gross NPA to be below 2% by the end of March. Net NPA, we have given a guidance of 0.65%, we are already at 0.61%. We’ll now continue to reduce it further. On recovery and upgradation, we have given a guidance of Rs.1,000 crores

order_book.statement: Corporate credit pipeline ~Rs.20,000 cr (Rs.12,000 cr pipeline + Rs.8,000-9,000 cr in-principle sanctions)
order_book.quote: On the corporate credit side, we already have a pipeline of around Rs.12,000 crores, and in-principle sanctions of around Rs.8,000 crores to Rs.9,000 crores. So overall around Rs.20,000 crores of pipeline we have already created.

fund_raise.statement: Capital raise planned via QIP; approvals and merchant bankers in place; awaiting right market opportunity
fund_raise.quote: We have the necessary approvals for capital raising, and we have already interacted with investors. We have appointed merchant bankers for the same and we would just like the right opportunity to go to the market and raise some funds. So, we are exploring all the avenues to raise capital, primarily through the QIP route.

other.statement: Branch expansion targeting 300 potential centres in top 200 districts; recruiting at LBO, PO, CSA levels
other.quote: We have identified the top 200 districts which account for 80% of the country's banking business . We are expanding them to those areas where we are not present so far. We have already found out 300 potential centres. The branches will get opened as the premises get finalized, as we appoint more and more workforce at various levels.

other.statement: TWO book Rs.7,344 cr; recovering ~10% annually (Rs.247.88 cr so far this year)
other.quote: We continue to hold almost Rs.7,344 crores of TWO book and if you look at the results over last few years, we have been recovering around approximately 10% of the book. This year also, so far the recovery has been almost Rs.250 crores, to be precise Rs.247.88 crores.

guidance.statement: Revenue target INR900-1,000 crores by FY29 with EBITDA margin 18-21%
guidance.quote: Looking ahead, our aim is to reach a revenue of INR900 crores to INR1,000 crores by FY29 with an EBITDA margin of 18% to 21%.

demand.statement: Formulation business rebounded 82% YoY; API exports grew 28.5% YoY; domestic API moderated in Q2 but grew 10.1% YoY for H1
demand.quote: Our formulation business rebounded strongly, growing 82% year -on-year, as we had expected at the end of Q1. API export grew 28.5% year -on-year.

margin.statement: Q2 EBITDA margin 18.2% (up from 17.8% Q1); H1 EBITDA margin 18.1%; gross margin 48.3% flat QoQ; exports and formulations have better margins than domestic API
margin.quote: EBITDA margin improved sequentially from 17.8 to 18.2.

order_book.statement: Genrx acquisition approved by NCLT; expected INR200-250 crores revenue in 2-3 years; oncology API plant INR200 crores in 2-3 years; peptide facility INR70-100 crores first year, INR300 crores cumulative
order_book.quote: So, Genrx, as we are having a different divisions like ointment, tablets, so in next two to three years once this facility start, we should grow around INR200 crores to INR250 crores from that unit.

capex.statement: FY27 capex expected INR65-80 crores; INR50-60 crores annually thereafter to reach INR1,000 crores revenue
capex.quote: Total expected capex for FY27 will be around INR65 crores to INR80 crores.

pricing_cost.statement: Domestic API pricing under pressure, expected to remain flat; export and formulation margins better; prices stabilized but volatile due to Gulf crisis and freight costs
pricing_cost.quote: Over the period of time, there not be much improvement in the API pricing. It will be a straight line.

product_mix.statement: Formulation share 20-24% currently, targeting 45-50% in 3-4 years; API 50-55%; Cenobamate launched via 8 partners with repeat orders; 6 peptide APIs developed at pilot scale
product_mix.quote: Over the next 3 to 4 years, if you see, formulation business will be anywhere between 45 % to 50% and same thing with 50% to 55% of the API and 45% to 50% is of formulation.

risk.statement: West Asia crisis driving inventory buildup; API pricing volatile due to freight and interest rates; DMF approvals take 2-3 years; peptide facility real turnover FY28-29
risk.quote: As you know, there is a dispute in the Gulf area, so our facilities should not be stop in between, so we have increased our inventory.

other.statement: Magnesium L-Threonate contributes 11-12% of turnover supplied to US patent holder; formulation export dossiers filed in Africa, Myanmar, Philippines, Vietnam, Latin America
other.quote: In that, if you see the Magnesium L-Threonate, which we supply to the patent holder in U.S., which contributes to around 11% to 12% of the overall turnover.

other.statement: API exports 28.5% YoY growth; CEP filings in Europe, KDMF in Korea, Whitelist in Egypt, ANVISA in Brazil; formulation export vertical established for ROW branded generics
other.quote: API export grew 28.5% year -on-year. Together, API export and formulation crossed INR100 crores in quarterly revenue and now makes up to close to 60% of our revenue.

guidance.statement: Operating expense growth guided at 18-20% over next 6-8 quarters

demand.statement: Equity net sales market share high single digits touching ~10%, stable QoQ; flows diversified into multi-cap, large-cap, hybrids

order_book.statement: Total AUM including MF, Managed Accounts, Offshore and GIFT City at INR 8.68 trillion

order_book.statement: Monthly systematic book rose 2% YoY to INR 37 bn, annualized INR 445 bn; SIP book ex-STP grew 9% YoY

pricing_cost.statement: Yield compression due to telescopic pricing from high equity AUM growth; regulatory changes already reflected in Q1
pricing_cost.quote: The compression in yield was mainly on account of the increase in the equity AUM and due to telescopic pricing.

product_mix.statement: Stopped lump sum in small-cap fund 3 years ago; flows dispersed into multi-cap, large-cap, hybrids; HNI exits from large-cap at industry level

risk.quote: Yes, market volatility does impact the investor sentiment. We are seeing now HNI investors slowly taking exits from large -caps.

risk.statement: Offshore AUM decline due to rupee depreciation and FPI outflows; recovery dependent on global macros and West Asia resolution
risk.quote: The reasons for offshore AUM overall has been that because owing to, the rupee depreciation for the last one year or so, there has been decline in flows from FPIs into India.

other.statement: Board declared interim dividend of INR 9.50 per share for Q2 FY27
other.quote: Also, happy to share that the Board of Directors has declared an Interim Dividend of INR 9.50 per share along with the Q2 FY27 results.

other.statement: H1 FY27 Operating Profit up 28% YoY, PAT up 12% YoY

guidance.statement: Capex for FY27 guided at INR100-110 crores, mostly in contract logistics and 2x2 JV
guidance.quote: Capex spending will be as per our guidance that we gave, it will be closer to like INR100 crores kind of a number, plus minus INR10 crores here and there. So you can almost take it like INR110 crores kind of a number.

demand.statement: Contract logistics revenue grew 28% YoY in Q2 FY27 driven by new customers and wallet share
demand.quote: Quarter two revenue grew 28% Y -o-Y, while gross margins grew 20% Y -o-Y, demonstrating that the growth and profitability are improving together.

demand.statement: MESPL revenue grew 69% YoY in Q2 FY27 with EBITDA improving from -INR9.1 cr to +INR2.3 cr
demand.quote: Q2 revenue grew 69% Y-o-Y, while EBITDA improved from a loss of INR9.1 crores in quarter one of last year to a profit of INR2.3 crores in quarter two of this year.

demand.statement: Mobility revenue grew 33% YoY in Q2 FY27 with gross margin up 19% YoY
demand.quote: In our mobility business, we continue to deliver profitable growth. Q2 revenue grew 33% Y -o-Y, with gross margin showing 19% Y -o-Y growth, underscoring the strength of our operating model.

margin.statement: Contract logistics gross margin improvement target of 100 bps over medium term from exit of FY26
margin.quote: We are looking overall for a 100 bps improvement in our gross margin, and we stay committed to that.

margin.statement: MESPL (Rivigo) turned EBITDA-positive in Q2 FY27 and H1 FY27
margin.quote: MESPL (Rivigo) turned EBITDA-positive during the quarter and for H1 FY '27 as a whole, also, demonstrating that the business has reached a critical inflection point and is beginning to realise the benefits of scale, operating leverage, and disciplined execution.

margin.statement: LMD business pivoting from no-loss strategy to profitable growth strategy
margin.quote: We are now pivoting this business from a no-loss strategy to a pivot towards growth, and we are feeling more excited and more confident about this business.

capex.statement: Capex approved by Board, focused on contract logistics and 2x2 JV for auto/tractor carriers
capex.quote: Mostly in contract logistics, we have put capex and also in our 2x2 joint venture where we do car carriers for our auto and tractor business for Mahindra, we have added capex. So, mostly on contract logistics and 2x2.

pricing_cost.statement: Fuel cost pass-through completed in Q2, manpower cost pass-through delayed due to PF slab change to INR25k and minimum wage pressure
pricing_cost.quote: Whatever was the fuel stress in the previous quarter, that has been completely passed on. So, there is nothing, and you can see that effect coming in the 30 bps improvement that we have seen. Apart from that, there was a big issue last quarter on the manpower cost, which is still playing out. That has not been passed o ut fully.

product_mix.statement: Contract logistics shifting mix toward warehousing over transportation for better margins
product_mix.quote: We are trying to improve more warehousing compared to transportation, because warehousing has bet ter margin than transportation.

risk.statement: Freight forwarding H2 FY27 as build phase, real growth expected in FY28; geopolitical issues impacting container rates

other.statement: M&M share of consolidated revenue remains ~60%, no internal target to reduce it

other.statement: Standalone debt-free since Sep 2025, consolidated debt INR55 cr (vehicle loans), net cash INR308 cr

demand.statement: Domestic market supportive with lower dimer acid imports improving realizations and margins

product_mix.statement: New novel technology product (fatty acid derivative) expected to launch in Q3 FY27 after Diwali, import substitution with export potential
product_mix.quote: As you know, we have put up a small capacity plant and which we expect to commence in October-December quarter. After Diwali, we expect it to start.

risk.statement: Middle East crisis and global macro uncertainties remain; Europe cosmetic demand slowing; US freight costs high

guidance.statement: Steady state NOV per day per store could reach INR 11 lakh

guidance.statement: Food delivery margins expected to remain flattish over next 1-2 years
guidance.quote: Directionally, we want to maintain margins broadly and reinvest in growth as much as it makes sense to continue to drive the growth upwards. That's what the operating principle is. It's hard to project or comment on margin trajectory every quarter but broadly, over the next 1 or 2 years, we expect the margins to remain flattish.

guidance.statement: $1 billion Adjusted EBITDA guidance for FY29 maintained

demand.statement: Competitive intensity in food delivery higher in Q2 vs previous quarters, partly driven by Zomato

demand.statement: Food delivery investing aggressively in growth across new customer acquisition and frequency
demand.quote: In both new customer acquisition as well as in driving frequency of our existing customer base, we have increased the amount of investments we have done consistently over the last few quarters, and that trend is likely to continue.

demand.statement: Blinkit mature cities still growing rapidly, MTU multiple times Zomato's in those cities
demand.quote: For example, in our mature cities, Blinkit MTU is already multiple times that of Zomato, and we don't see any plateau there yet. We don't want to speculate on how large the top markets can be but suffice to say that whether you look at NOV growth or MTU growth, the larger markets are still growing at a very rapid pace.

margin.statement: Food delivery strategy prioritizes absolute Adjusted EBITDA growth over percentage margins
margin.quote: We feel that we can drive more growth in absolute Adjusted EBITDA by investing more in growth rather than optimizing for margins. We've been doing that consistently for a few quarters now, and we will continue on that path until we see the outcomes.

margin.statement: Blinkit Adjusted EBITDA margin expansion driven by operating leverage during expansion phase
margin.quote: Broadly, what we should look at is the overall Adjusted EBITDA margin, and a lot of the improvement we see there is on account of operating leverage. Till the time we continue expanding, that is what will drive most of the margin expansion.

margin.statement: Blinkit indirect costs growing 15-20% QoQ, partly variable (tech server costs) and FX-impacted
margin.quote: For example, technology server costs are below contribution. So, as the business scales, those costs will go up. And some of those costs are priced in dollars, so the exchange rate also doesn't help there.

order_book.statement: Blinkit at steady state 90-95% 1P SKUs, no incremental working capital change expected
order_book.quote: Jignanshu, we are at that steady state now where about 90-95% is 1P, and we don't expect any more incremental working capital change on that account, if that was your question.

product_mix.statement: Blinkit assortment in expansion cities is subset of metros, but harder-to-find products sell faster
product_mix.quote: The assortment in our expansion cities is a subset of what we are selling in the metros. But of course, the product mix might be different because some of these cities are picking off a different base, and we do see that some of the products which are harder to find in these cities start selling a lot faster compared to the uptick they see in the metros, because there they are much more easily ava

product_mix.statement: NAOV stability driven by assortment expansion in tier 1 cities offsetting lower tier 2 NAOVs, not gourmet stores
product_mix.quote: Most of the offset for the NAOV is assortment expansion in tier 1 cities, which leads to higher NAOVs in tier 1, and that balances out some of the lower NAOVs from tier 2 cities.

risk.statement: Dark.ai is zero-to-one bet; if it works could be global multibillion-dollar business, if not will kill it
risk.quote: It's definitely nascent. We don't have a point of view on whether this could become big or not. If it works, it will become really big; it's more like a zero-to-one bet at this point. If it works, it's a global business and it will generate extremely high shareholder value over the next few years. But if it doesn't work, it's something we'll kill.

risk.statement: Dark.ai currently in 'Others' segment, costs not meaningful; capex only if blockbuster response requires GPU infrastructure
risk.quote: On your other question, this product has been in the works for about a year, and it's not monetized yet, so all the costs here are accounted for in our 'Others' segment. So they are already carved out. They're not very meaningful at this stage, and we don't expect the capex or cost to become meaningful, at least as of now, unless, of course, we receive a blockbuster response to this product. Then

other.statement: Bulk of new Blinkit store expansion will be in smaller cities (tier 2/3)
other.quote: Directionally, we've also mentioned in the letter that the bulk of the expansion of these new stores will be in smaller cities. We do expect that to be the focus from here on, and we are seeing great outcomes in terms of payback on these stores in these markets that we've expanded into in the last few quarters.

other.statement: Plan to nearly double dark stores over next 6-7 quarters
other.quote: Incrementally, you're talking about nearly doubling dark stores over the next 6 to 7 quarters.

guidance.statement: Combined Q2 and Q3 FY27 KFC SSSG expected to be high single digit

demand.statement: Pizza Hut India SSSG 5% in Q2 FY27, highest in 7 quarters

demand.statement: Sri Lanka business SSSG 5% in Q2 FY27

margin.statement: Consolidated restaurant EBITDA margin 11.5%, up 20 bps YoY

margin.quote: Consolidated adjusted EBITDA was INR62.4 crores, up 39% Y-o-Y and consolidated adjusted EBITDA margin was 7.1%, up 100 basis points.

margin.statement: KFC restaurant EBITDA margin 14.5%, up 70 bps YoY
margin.quote: restaurant EBITDA came in at 14.5%, up by 70 basis points over last year.

capex.statement: Added 15 KFC and 1 Pizza Hut Sri Lanka stores in Q2 FY27; total count 1,086
