capex.statement: Pizza Hut India store expansion paused in CY2026, awaiting CCI approval for brand strategy alignment
capex.quote: On the Pizza Hut expansion, we called out that the last calendar year, we did not open any store, even this calendar year, largely, it will be neutral in terms of store opening.

capex.statement: KFC store expansion mix: 60-67% in metros (>1M population), 70-80% in existing cities
capex.quote: Typically, over the years, we called out that almost 60% to two -thirds of the stores which we open are in metro towns with a population of more than 1 million.

pricing_cost.statement: KFC and Pizza Hut took 2-3% price hikes in April-May and June respectively
pricing_cost.quote: Yes. We did at the beginning of this financial year, somewhere in April or May, that was also in the range of 2% to 3%.

product_mix.statement: KFC dine-in and takeaway mix improved to 57% driven by entry value promotions
product_mix.quote: Dine -in and takeaway mix improved to 57% for KFC. This is on back of aggressive entry value promotions and offers in dine-in and takeaway exclusively.

product_mix.statement: Pizza Hut delivery mix increased to 52%, dine-in and takeaway at 48%
product_mix.quote: Here, the delivery mix has improved from 50% to 52% in the quarter and dine -in and takeaway came at 48%.

other.statement: KFC consumer recruitment via INR99/INR149 meals driving transaction growth; 60-70% repeat rate

other.statement: KFC targets expanding consumer base from 40-45M to 100M annually

guidance.statement: Management expects hotel gross take rate to edge up over next 3-4 quarters but gave no specific target for next year
guidance.quote: Over the next 3 to 4 quarters, you will see them edge up for sure. But I'm not giving any guidance right now on where we'll be next year. It's just that we will be higher. That is a certainty.

guidance.statement: Management expects hotel segment to continue investing for 2-3 years before profitability becomes priority
guidance.quote: So it will not be a different journey. But yes, for 2 to 3 years, we expect to continue investing in getting to a scale where we become comfortable that profitability becomes more important.

guidance.statement: Management aims to become largest hotel OTA in budget to mid-market category on room night basis in 4-5 years
guidance.quote: if I were to give you longer -term guidance, like 4 to 5 years, we want to be the largest hotel OTA in the budget to mid-market hotel category on a room night basis

demand.statement: Train recovery encouraging with advanced bookings for Dussehra and Diwali helping volumes

demand.statement: Bus segment growing faster than overall OTA bus market for close to 3 years
demand.quote: In buses, AbhiBus has been growing faster than the overall OTA bus market for close to 3 years. Expanding supply, building our brand in markets where we have room to grow, and improving the travel experience continue to drive that performance.

margin.statement: Hotel contribution margin improved from -55% to -15% of revenue YoY with contribution loss of INR 1.2 crores
margin.quote: Contribution margin improved from minus 55% of revenue a year ago to minus 15%, with a contribution loss of INR 1.2 crores this quarter.

margin.statement: Flight contribution margin fell 10% YoY to INR 35.68 crores, held at 43% of revenue due to higher discounts
margin.quote: Revenue fell 8% to INR 82.66 crores, and the contribution margin fell 10% to INR 35.68 crores. Gross take rate fell from 9.4% to 7% as the base payer and the international mix increased. With pure bank offers in the market, we funded more discount, which is why -- and that is the base in this, which is why the contribution margin as a share of revenue held at 43%.

margin.statement: Train contribution margin grew 29% YoY to INR 47.23 crores at 32% of revenue
margin.quote: Revenue grew 16% to INR 149.14 crores, and contribution margin grew 29% to INR 47.23 crores. PM is at 32% of revenue.

order_book.statement: Hotel GTV grew 2.6x YoY to INR 111.34 crores with 4.7 lakh room nights and gross take rate over 12%
order_book.quote: Hotels are now reported as a separate segment, where GTV grew 2.6x to INR 111.34 crores, with approximately 4.7 lakh room nights and a gross take rate of over 12%.

order_book.statement: Hotel room nights per day net of cancellations now over 5,100, up 3.9x YoY and 50% QoQ
order_book.quote: We now do more than 5,100 room nights per day net of cancellations, 4.7 lakh room nights for the quarter, a growth of 3.9x compared to last year and a growth of over 50% versus the comparable Q1 number.

order_book.statement: Direct hotel supply increased to over 12,000 hotels across 1,100 towns from 10,000 last quarter
order_book.quote: Out of the 70,000 hotels in India that we sell, we are now tied up directly with over 12,000 hotels across about 1,100 towns, up from 10,000 hotels last quarter.

capex.statement: Hotel investment of ~INR 11 crores this quarter including INR 1 crore above contribution margin and INR 10 crores below in people and technology
capex.quote: According to management estimates, we would have spent a further 10 crore in the people and technology line for hotels, taking the total investment in hotels to slightly north of INR 11 crores this quarter.

product_mix.statement: 86% of hotel bookings from captive users on existing platforms
product_mix.quote: The reason why our unit economics are able to develop some headroom is that more than 86% of our hotel bookings came from travellers which were already on our platforms or our captive users.

product_mix.statement: International flight GTV grew 59% YoY while domestic flights faced capacity constraints
product_mix.quote: International travel has been more encouraging, with our international flight GTV growing 59% year-on-year.

other.statement: Train OTA market share now close to 64%
other.quote: Our share of the OTA rail market is now close to 64%.

guidance.statement: Expects further commodity cost increase of 150-200 bps in Q3 FY27
guidance.quote: We expect a further commodity cost increase in Q3 in the range of around maybe 150 to 200 bps, depending upon where some of the major commodities do settle.

guidance.quote: I do see a potential of the EV salience reaching easily up to 20%.

margin.quote: EBITDA was about ₹2,800 crores, up 31% at a margin of 11.7%. While EBITDA margin was down 90 basis points YoY, it held flat sequentially despite a commodity headwind intensifying further during the quarter.

margin.statement: Commodity inflation impact of 590 bps YoY almost entirely offset by operating leverage, cost efficiency and improved realization
margin.quote: To summarize, a 590 bps commodity headwind has been almost entirely offset by operating leverage, cost efficiency, and improved realization.

order_book.statement: Indonesia order of ~70,000 units to be delivered over FY27 and FY28 at 4,500-5,000 units/month
order_book.quote: Indonesia order to a large extent will be delivered over two years, so this financial year and the next financial year. And currently, we are supplying at the rate of anywhere between 4,500 to 5,000 a month. The total order is almost of 70,000.

pricing_cost.statement: Four pricing actions taken in FY27: ~1% in Jan, ~2% in Apr, 2.5% in Jul, 1-2% from Oct 1
pricing_cost.quote: On pricing, as you are aware, we have taken already four pricing actions during the year, around 1% in January, around 2% in April, 2.5% in July, and then from 1 October, we have taken another 1% to 2% increase depending upon the segment.

product_mix.statement: Non-vehicular business ~20% of revenue; focus area to hedge CV cyclicality
product_mix.quote: Our non-cyclical business, if you look at it on an overall basis, would approximately be around 20% of the revenue.

risk.statement: Diesel price increases and interest rate hikes (25 bps) remain key monitorables for transporter profitability and demand
risk.quote: I think on the headwinds, as I said in the beginning, diesel prices will continue to be a very important monitorable, as also the interest rates. I think a 25-basis point hike has already been taken.

other.statement: Supply chain bottlenecks in castings, machining, sheet metal stamping and EV battery cells; targeted in-house debottlenecking actions underway in Q2-Q3
other.quote: I would also add that, in case of some proprietary items, there has been a shortfall one has seen in Q2. And the third category, of course, is the imported aggregates, especially the electric vehicle aggregates. And within that, I would say the battery cells and batteries have been constrained by capacity.

other.statement: Fleet utilization improved progressively through Q2; freight rates strengthened; transporter profitability recovered after initial diesel price pressure
other.quote: fleet utilization remained broadly stable to improving gradually during the quarter, indicating sustained operating intensity across the fleet. The freight rates also strengthened during Q2, providing support to transporter economics.

guidance.statement: Full-year FY27 revenue growth guidance of 15% on value and 10% on volume, aiming to outperform industry by 2-3%
guidance.quote: If exports stay fine or exports revive from here, then around 15% growth on value and 10% on the volume side. Better than the industry, we will try to outperform the industry by 2% to 3% if the industry grows.

guidance.quote: As I told you, it is 76% right now. That will improve to around 80% to 85% utilization. Growth will come by improving utilization.

demand.statement: Domestic GVT volume growth 14% YoY H1; exports declined 18% revenue, 18% volume due to container/freight issues

pricing_cost.statement: H1 average price hike of 17% (14% in Q1, 3-3.5% in Q2) vs 14% input cost increase; current gas price INR92/SCM, average 80-85
pricing_cost.quote: Average we took it in Q1 itself. In Q1, we took around 14%, and added 3% to 3.5% in Q2. So, average price hike of H2 is 17%.

pricing_cost.statement: No immediate price hike planned despite gas price rise to INR92; 3% leeway as price hikes (16-17%) exceed input cost increase (14-15%)
pricing_cost.quote: No, we are not going to take one right now because, as I mentioned, our input cost increased by 14% to 15% versus the price hike of 17% we have already taken.

product_mix.statement: Within GVT, shift to higher-value larger sizes (6x4, 8x4 feet) driving 3.5% realization improvement from mix
product_mix.quote: Within GVT as well, higher margins as I mentioned, 18 different sizes and 20 different surfaces. Within that, the sales of high-value products are improving where margins are higher.

risk.statement: No seasonality but H1 40-42% of revenue, H2 larger; export recovery dependent on freight normalization and geopolitical situation
risk.quote: There is no seasonality as such, but our first half is slightly around 40% to 42%, and the second half is larger. Seasonality as such is not there, but between the first half versus second half, there is a gap.

other.statement: IPO fresh issue of INR320 crores used for debt repayment; interest cost going forward almost zero
other.quote: Our IPO was of INR708 crores. INR320 crores was a fresh issue, through which we are going to do debt repayment. The interest cost, going forward, will become almost zero.

other.statement: Simola divested: H1 FY26 revenue INR60 crores vs H1 FY27 INR9 crores; focus on bottom line over volume
other.quote: Last year in the first half, INR60 crores was accounted for, versus this year in the first half, INR9 crores has been accounted for.

guidance.statement: Planning to bid INR1,000-1,500 crores in new tenders with ~30% success rate
guidance.quote: And we are planning to bid around INR1,000, INR1,500 crores in new tenders. And looking at our past, we have a success rate of around 30%.

guidance.statement: Expect full-year FY27 growth in line with previous year due to order book and seasonality
guidance.quote: So, basically, with the order book in place and the seasonality factor, we expect that the overall growth of the company on a full-year basis would be in line with previous year.

guidance.statement: Targeting closing order book of INR1,500-2,000 crores by March 2027
guidance.quote: We are expecting closing at order book of around INR 1500-2000 crores. Yash Somani: Okay. Management: In March '27

guidance.statement: Expect to maintain past growth rate (~40% CAGR revenue) with EBITDA growth of 1-2% higher due to lesser competition
guidance.quote: We will try to maintain the same growth rate like we have done in the past. So you can very well visualize our turnover and EBITDA and PAT that we will achieve in next five years. And with lesser competition, we expect a growth of EBITDA by 1% to 2% in future.

margin.statement: Q2 EBITDA margin improvement driven by revenue composition with more commissioning/erection work and final milestones
margin.quote: Basically, margins are a factor of our revenue composition. And largely, this quarter of this half year, there was a larger composition of order commissioning and erection, which took place, plus there were also some final milestones, which were achieved during the -- for the orders on the order completion stage.

order_book.statement: Unexecuted order book increased to approximately INR1,420 crores, providing strong business visibility
order_book.quote: Our unexecuted order book has increased to approximately INR1,420 crores, providing strong business visibility.

order_book.statement: Added around INR950 crores of new orders in the last six months
order_book.quote: During the year, we have added around INR950 crores of new orders booking, which has been done during the year.

order_book.statement: Received a large order of INR600 crores from Maharashtra at end of Q2, executable over two years
order_book.quote: So, in end of Q2, we received a large order of INR600 crores, approximately from Maharashtra. That was a huge order.

capex.statement: No specific capex guidance provided; focus on efficient order execution and scaling operations
capex.quote: Our focus remains on efficient order execution, sustainable margins, and prudent working capital management as we scale the business.

pricing_cost.statement: All contracts have price escalation clauses with no ceiling limit, providing back-to-back pass-through on monthly basis
pricing_cost.quote: Whatever tenders we bid, so there are three, four key criteria which we select, while bidding the tenders. One is that there should be a price variation or price escalation clause in the tender document itself before bidding. And the second one is the funding agency of the project. So every project we are bidding is hedged by price escalation clause, and there's no ceiling limit for that. So be it

product_mix.statement: Order book split: 85% distribution, 8% renewable, 6% transmission; combined orders include substation, underground cabling, RMU units
product_mix.quote: Largely, we distribute our order book into three major segments. One is the distribution segment, which contributes around 85% of our order book. Then is the renewable, the new segments, which we are entering, or we have entered into last couple of years, or I would say, a year, and a half. That is the renewable segment and the transmission segment. So renewable contributes around 8% of our order

other.statement: Historically last quarter contributes ~40% of annual turnover; expect good revenue pickup in Q3 and Q4
other.quote: And historically, our last quarter contributes around 40% of our entire turnover. So, as you can see, we have already touched INR200 crores in this H1, another INR200 crores in next quarter.

other.statement: Annual working capital requirement expected to be around H1 levels as government budgets clear in H2
other.quote: Regarding working capital, I feel this that H1 working capital is something which should be our annual working capital requirement should be in and around the H1 working capital requirement itself because as the year-end comes, lot of budgets and everything ease out from government side, and the working capital situation also eases out typically in H2.

guidance.statement: Targets ₹500 crore revenue over next five to seven years
guidance.quote: I am proud to say that we continue to progress towards our long-term strategy of becoming a ₹500 crore company over the next five to seven years.

demand.statement: Q1 FY27 sales grew ~18% YoY
demand.quote: We have continued to see this growth momentum in the current financial year, FY 2026 –2027. During the first quarter, we registered year-on-year sales growth of approximately 18%.

demand.statement: FY26 revenue grew ~12% YoY crossing ₹100 crore milestone
demand.quote: I am pleased to share that FY 2025 –2026 was a year of strong progress for Sintercom, with the Company crossing the important milestone of ₹100 crore in annual revenue.

margin.statement: Profit after tax more than doubled in FY26; strong PBT and EBITDA growth
margin.quote: Our year-on-year sales growth was approximately 12%. We also witnessed strong growth in our profit before tax and EBITDA.

order_book.statement: Received nomination for soft magnetic composite stator components for EVR electric motors
order_book.quote: During FY 2025–2026, we received a business nomination for the manufacture and supply of soft magnetic composite stator components for EVR electric motors intended for automotive and industrial applications.

order_book.statement: Tenneco export PPAP approvals delayed; some parts in serial production, rest under testing
order_book.quote: Samples have been submitted to the customer. However, PPAP approvals have been delayed on the customer's side, possibly due to tariff-related issues.

order_book.statement: Received Bajaj Auto approval to supply GPDN gears using rolling technology
order_book.quote: We have also received approval from Bajaj Auto to supply GPDN gears manufactured using rolling technology.

capex.statement: Will continue investing in skills, technical capabilities, leadership development and automation
capex.quote: As we prepare for the future, we will continue to invest in skills, technical capabilities, leadership development and a culture of continuous improvement.

product_mix.statement: Focus on increasing high-value, technology-oriented products and diversifying into non-auto industrial segments
product_mix.quote: Our overarching objective is to systematically increase the share of high-value, technology-oriented products within our portfolio, thereby diversifying our revenue mix and mitigating concentration risks.

risk.statement: Tenneco PPAP delays possibly due to tariff-related issues
risk.quote: However, PPAP approvals have been delayed on the customer's side, possibly due to tariff-related issues.

other.statement: Crossed ₹100 crore annual revenue milestone in FY26
other.quote: Crossing the ₹100 crore revenue milestone is a proud moment for the entire Sintercom family.

other.statement: Operating cash generation turned positive in FY26; inventory and receivables increased
other.quote: During FY 2025 –2026, we also made progress in improving our operating cash generation, which turned positive during the year.

guidance.statement: PAT target of INR 1,100 crores plus by FY28 reiterated
guidance.quote: We remain confident in achieving our previously guided target of INR 1,100 crores plus PAT by FY28.

demand.statement: Carbon Black capacity utilisation at 88% in Q2 FY27; guided at 88-95% for coming quarters
demand.quote: during the current quarter, we had a capacity utili sation of 88%. And we are looking forward at these levels only 88% to 90%- 95% capacity utilisation

margin.statement: New products (anthraquinone, carbazole, LFP) expected to be margin accretive from start of operations
margin.quote: Yes, definitely, these products will start from the start only. They will add to the incremental margin.

margin.statement: EBITDA per metric ton at INR 20,990 in Q2 FY27 vs INR 17,910 YoY; sustainable range guided at INR 20,000-24,000
margin.quote: So overall, if you look, 17,910 was the EBITDA margin on corresponding quarter last year. And today, it is 20,990.

order_book.statement: Birla Tyres trading revenue INR 140 crores with INR 1 crore EBITDA in Q2 FY27; on track for breakeven post-merger
order_book.quote: We do a trading sales from Himadri and we achieved a top line of INR 140 crores on which we have an EBITDA of INR 1 crores as a trading margin.

capex.statement: Ardent Impex FZCO incorporated in Dubai Airport Free Zone as wholly owned subsidiary for global sales, marketing, trading and procurement
capex.quote: During the quarter, we incorporated Ardent Impex FZCO in Dubai Airport Free Zone Area as a wholly owned subsidiary.

capex.statement: Capex spend of INR 250 crores in Q2 FY27; FY27 total expected at INR 800-900 crores
capex.quote: And we expect in this year to be around INR 800 crores to INR 900 crores of spend in total.

pricing_cost.statement: Raw material pass-through model with 9-10 days inventory; freight cost spike impacted margins due to higher export share
pricing_cost.quote: We are only having 9 days, 10 days of raw material inventory in order to take care of this volatility.

product_mix.statement: Export share increased from 26% to 33% of total sales YoY
product_mix.quote: Corresponding quarter last year, we had 26% as export, today, we have 33%.

product_mix.statement: Silicon carbon anode capacity 10x energy density vs graphite (4,000+ vs 360 mAh/g); pricing far higher; capex announcement pending engineering completion
product_mix.quote: The product is very high end of anode technology. So the normal anode has 360 milliampere per gram of capacity and silicon carbon has 4,000 plus.

fund_raise.statement: Sicona secured AUD 45 million funding from ARENA for next-gen silicon carbon anode technology
fund_raise.quote: Sicona has secured AUD45 million in funding from Australian Renewable Energy Agency (ARENA) to advance its next -generation October 22, 2026 Himadri Speciality Chemical Ltd silicon carbon anode technology

risk.statement: Geopolitical freight rate spikes and raw material price volatility cited as temporary margin headwinds
risk.quote: Because of that, there has been some hit. So these are temporary phenomenon, which has -- short-term to medium-term business impact of the company.

other.statement: Carbon Nanotube 200 TPA facility targeted for Q4 FY27 commissioning
other.quote: Our 200 TPA Carbon Nanotube facility remains targeted for commissioning in Q4 FY27.

other.statement: Anthraquinone and carbazole full 5,300 TPA capacity targeted for Q4 FY27 commissioning
other.quote: In anthraquinone and carbazole, our in-house engineering team has enabled us to accelerate execution with full capacity 5,300 TPA now targeted for commissioning together in Q4 FY27.

guidance.statement: Operating margin guidance maintained at 20% to 22% for FY27
guidance.quote: Our operating margin guidance is 20% to 22%.

guidance.statement: Revenue growth guidance revised to 1% to 2% YoY in constant currency for FY27
guidance.quote: We are revising our full year re venue growth guidance to 1% to 2%, reflecting softer-than-expected H1 performance and our updated assessment for the rest of the year

margin.statement: H2 margins to be impacted by compensation hikes, softer seasonality, AI productivity sharing and large deal ramp-up, partly offset by Project Maximus
margin.quote: H2 margins will be impacted by compensation hikes, softer revenue seasonality, continued sharing of AI driven productivity benefits and ramp-up of large deals. These headwinds will be partly offset by initiatives under Project Maximus.

margin.statement: Q2 operating margin at 21%, down 10 bps sequentially due to post-sales support and acquisition impacts
margin.quote: Q2 operating margins were at 21%, decline of 0.1% sequentially.

order_book.statement: Q2 large deal wins at $5.2 bn TCV with 62% net new, second highest quarterly TCV in five years
order_book.quote: We won 19 large deals in Q2 with a TCV of $5.2 bn, which is second highest quarterly TCV in the last five years. Of this, 62% was net new.

order_book.statement: H1 large deal wins total $8.8 bn, up 28% YoY with 62% net new
order_book.quote: This takes H1's total large deal wins to $8.8 bn, which is a YoY growth of 28% with 62% net new.

order_book.statement: Net new $2 bn+ seven-year mega deal with financial services client expected to contribute over 1% growth in FY28
order_book.quote: This includes an entirely net new $2 bn plus seven year mega deal with a financial services client. Transition is expected to begin in the second half of Q4. This deal is expected to contribute over 1% growth for the company in FY28.

capex.statement: Compensation hikes rolling out effective October 2026 and January 2027
capex.quote: As mentioned last quarter, we are rolling out compensation hikes to most of our employees effective October '26, with the next phase effective Januar y '27

pricing_cost.statement: Pricing pressure increased due to competitive intensity and AI productivity expectations across clients and industries
pricing_cost.quote: If you look at what we ar e seeing today is a pricing pressure on the back of competitive intensity, which has increased in the la st couple of quarters

pricing_cost.statement: At lower end of guidance, pricing assumed similar to slightly deteriorating; at upper end, improvement assumed
pricing_cost.quote: at the lower end of the guidance, we have assumed similarto slightly deterioration on the pricing. At the upper end, we have assumed improvement

product_mix.statement: Onsite mix reduced to 22.6%, down 0.7% in H1, reflecting sustained offshore shift for client cost reductions
product_mix.quote: Onsite mix reduced further to 22.6%, reflecting our sustained efforts to help clients achieve cost reductions. For H1, onsite mix was down by 0.7%.

other.statement: AI-first revenue now 10.5% of total revenue with 29% sequential growth
other.quote: Q2 AI revenue is now 10.5% of total revenue with strong sequential growth of over 29%.

other.statement: Free cash flow at $928 mn, 113% of net profit; cash and equivalents at $4.7 bn with debt-free balance sheet
other.quote: Free cash flow generation was strong at $928 mn at 113% of net profit. We ended the quarter with cash and cash equivalents at $4.7 bn and a debt-free balance sheet.

guidance.statement: No extra channel inventory; placement only where water situation is certain
guidance.quote: We have taken a very conscious effort this year because this year, given there was a highly uneven rainfall distribution, we have gone with a more market-based approach, only place the product in the markets, where there's a demand water situation is certain.

demand.statement: Domestic agri-input demand hit by deficient rainfall, crop-mix changes, subdued farm economics and competitive intensity
demand.quote: India's agri -input sector faced significant headwinds during the 2026 Kharif season amid deficient and erratic rainfall, crop-mix changes, subdued farm economics and heightened competitive intensity.

margin.statement: Q2 EBITDA fell 18% to ₹126 cr; PAT down 17% to ₹85 cr
margin.quote: Overall EBITDA for Q2FY27 stood at ₹ 126 cr, lower by 18% compared to ₹ 154 cr in Q2 of the previous year. Profit after tax stood at ₹ 85 cr versus ₹ 102 cr of Q2FY26, which is 17% lower than the same quarter of previous year.

margin.statement: H1 EBITDA grew 2% to ₹311 cr; PAT grew 6% to ₹210 cr
margin.quote: H1FY27 EBITDA stood at ₹ 311 cr vs ₹ 304 cr of H1FY26, resulting in growth of 2%. H1FY27 PAT stood at ₹ 210 cr vs ₹ 197 cr of H1FY26, resulting in growth of 6%.

order_book.statement: Q2 revenue flat at ₹858 cr vs ₹861 cr; 5% price growth offset by similar volume de-growth
order_book.quote: Our Q2FY27 revenue stood at ₹ 858 cr as against ₹ 861 cr for the same period last year resulting in an overall flat growth. Pricing growth of 5% was offset by similar volume de-growth.

order_book.statement: CSM (B2B sub-category) revenue grew ~12x to ₹27 cr from ₹2 cr on PEKK volume rebound
order_book.quote: CSM (sub-category of B2B) Q2FY27 revenue displayed promising growth by lodging ~12x growth by registering revenue of ₹ 2 7 cr from ₹ 2 cr in Q2FY26 , driven by rebound in PEKK sales volumes.

capex.statement: H1 capex very low; H2 will be higher than H1; full year a little more than ₹50 cr
capex.quote: H1, we may have a little bit higher number than that to prioritize some of the growth initiatives as well as some of the important sustenance capex initiatives. So I can say that broadly H2 will be more than H1, that way.

pricing_cost.statement: Tried to pass on cost increases early in season but demand fell; had to roll back price hikes
pricing_cost.quote: Now this year, in the beginning of the season, we did try to pass on some of the cost increases to the customer, but season did not take off as expected. In fact, demand went down. As a result, it became unrealistic to hold on to the cost increase which we are trying to pass on.

product_mix.statement: Seeds revenue fell 31% to ₹70 cr on 26% volume decline; EBITDA turned negative
product_mix.quote: Seed's Revenue de-grew by 31% to ₹ 70 cr in Q2FY27 from ₹ 101 cr in Q2FY26 due to 26% volume decline. EBITDA decreased to ₹ (0) cr in Q2FY27 from ₹ 25 cr in Q2FY26.

product_mix.statement: Crop Care revenue grew 4% to ₹788 cr on 6% price growth; Domestic B2C de-grew 1%; B2B grew 17%
product_mix.quote: Crop Care revenue grew by 4% to ₹ 788 cr in Q2FY27 from ₹ 760 cr in Q2FY26 due to 6% price growth. EBITDA decreased by 2% to ₹ 126 cr in Q2FY27 from ₹ 129 cr in Q2FY26.

risk.statement: Herbicide prices already crashing in North India ahead of wheat season; excess supply persists in key segments
risk.quote: Now wheat crop, you can already see pressure on the prices of herbicides. So obviously, we are not a large player, so it may not impact me. And that's why I said. So in every season, every crop, it depends on what your portfolio is, but there's a significant pressure on the prices of herbicide in Northern India already.

other.statement: Exports grew ~2.5% to ₹165 cr on 10% price growth; volumes hit by lower Pendimethalin demand in Europe, China pricing pressure, raw material constraints and shipping delays
other.quote: Exports (sub-category of B2B) topline grew by ~2.5% to ₹ 165 cr from ₹ 161 cr due to 10% growth in price. There was lower demand for Pendimethalin AI in Europe, coupled with pricing challenges from China market.

other.statement: Cash and liquid balance of ~₹211 cr as of 30th Sept 2026
other.quote: We have cash and liquid balance of ~₹ 211 cr as of 30th Sept '26.

guidance.statement: Plan to open 50 hotels in FY27, 30 in H2
guidance.quote: We are also on track to achieve our target of 50 hotel openings this year. That means 30 hotels are expected to open in the second half of this year.

guidance.statement: Revised FY27 consolidated revenue growth guidance to 15-17% from 12-14%, Hotel segment 17-19%
guidance.quote: we are confident of exceeding our previously communicated FY27 consolidated revenue growth guidance of 12% to 14% by 300 basis points. Accordingly, we are revising our full year growth guidance upwards to 15% to 17%.

guidance.statement: Management fee growth guidance of high teens CAGR, targeting INR1,000 cr in 2 years
guidance.quote: we remain confident of sustaining management fee growth at a high teens CAGR, supported by a strong pipeline of hotel openings and incremental contributions from newly added hotels.

demand.statement: Double-digit RevPAR growth across all brands, occupancy up to 82% from 75%, domestic demand resilient despite geopolitical headwinds
demand.quote: Despite these challenges, domestic demand remained resilient, supported by multiple large MICE events such as the BRICS Summit. We delivered double-digit RevPAR growth across all our brands

demand.statement: Structural shift in domestic consumption, foreign tourist arrivals CAGR 3.9% vs domestic 11%, WTTC summit next year potential upside
demand.quote: there is a structural shift when it comes to India, the consumer behavior has changed. The consumption is for now. And it's not for like 5 years from now, we will do this or 3 years from now, we'll do that.

margin.statement: Consolidated operating EBITDA margin 28.4% (+50 bps YoY), Standalone 38.9% (+400 bps YoY)
margin.quote: Operating EBITDA grew 24% year -on-year to INR706 crores, yielding operating EBITDA margin of 28.4%, an expansion of 50 basis points.

order_book.statement: Revised 700 hotel target expected before end of FY27, update by mid-November
order_book.quote: We will revert to all the investors by middle of November with a revised target of the 700 because we should get to that number definitely before the end of this financial year.

order_book.statement: Portfolio at 670 hotels with 69,000+ keys, 390 operational, 94% pipeline capital-light
order_book.quote: taking our portfolio to 670 hotels with over 69,000 keys in operation or under development. With 390 operational hotels, we are on track to cross the 400 hotel milestone in November or latest before the end of Q3.

capex.statement: H1 capex 20-30% higher than annual average of last 7-8 years, continuous renovation of iconic assets
capex.quote: if you look at our capex spend in the first half of this year is higher than what we used to spend annually. It's 20% to 30% higher what we spend annually on an average for the last -- for the preceding 7, 8 years.

pricing_cost.statement: Asset management upgrades driving pricing power, Taj Palace Delhi room revenue up 132%, crossed INR100 cr monthly revenue
pricing_cost.quote: A strong example is Taj Palace, New Delhi, where room revenue grew 132% in Q2 FY27 versus last year. In September, the hotel crossed INR100 crores in monthly revenue for the first time

product_mix.statement: Select service brands scaling: Ginger 100 hotels, Qmin 130 outlets, Ama 400 villas, Tree of Life 50 resorts, Ginger EBITDA margin 40%
product_mix.quote: Ginger became India's first hotel brand. Yes, it became India's first hotel brand to reach 100 operational hotels and is on track to reach 150 by March 31, FY27. Qmin now has over 130 outlets. Ama Stays & Trails has crossed 400 villas and bungalows and Tre e of Life has grown to a portfolio of over 50 resorts.

risk.statement: Geopolitical tensions in West Asia impacting airline capacity, airfares, TajSATS and international markets, fuel/power costs up
risk.quote: Ongoing geopolitical tensions in West Asia resulted in elevated fuel prices, leading to reductions in airline capacity and higher airfares, which moderated travel demand, particularly in certain international and long-haul corridors.

other.statement: OHL merger announced, 25:117 share swap, 6-7% standalone revenue upside in FY28, effective April 1 2027
other.quote: The all-stock transaction with a share exchange ratio of 25 IHCL shares for every 117 OHL shares is expected to drive 6% to 7% upside in our stand-alone operating revenue in FY28.

other.statement: Gross cash reserves over INR4,350 cr, healthy balance sheet for investments and upgrades
other.quote: Our balance sheet continues to be healthy with gross cash reserves of over INR4,350 crores. This provides us with the flexibility to contin ue investing in brand and revenue -enhancing initiatives

guidance.statement: Management expects FY27 to be better than FY26, with H2 performance continuing to do well despite Middle East uncertainty.
guidance.quote: we feel comfortable that FY27 will do better than FY26. But there are some of these geopolitical uncertainties and that is a little out of control for us.

guidance.statement: EBITDA margin target is to improve by at least 160 bps in the medium term from current 14.4%.
guidance.quote: Our endeavor will be to improve by at least 160 bps in the medium term. However, the velocity of improvement will be to some extent dependent upon macro and geopolitical factors.

demand.statement: North America order backlog grew over 50% YoY with strong deal momentum in Healthcare, Retail, Manufacturing and AI transformation deals.
demand.quote: our total order backlog for the geography, if you do a year -on-year comparison, has grown by more than 50%.

demand.statement: UK order book softened due to deferred decisions awaiting new government budgets and policy direction.
demand.quote: few of the contracts that were to be decided have been put on hold or canceled, these are the orders in pipeline, and would be hopefully launched back after the budgets have been finalized.

demand.statement: Middle East outlook remains uncertain with significant dip in performance versus plan.
demand.quote: the overall outlook for Middle East continues to be uncertain. And we are closely observing the situation, especially the situation that is unfolding in Saudi Arabia.

margin.statement: UK margin pressure of ~200 bps from sovereignty and security-cleared resource requirements increasing onsite mix.
margin.quote: The reason for the low margin was primarily sovereignty ask, and security clear ed resource ask mainly in the UK territory. We have seen a drop in the margin in that particular segment. The impact of that is around 200 bps.

margin.statement: AI transformation deals running at 40%+ gross margins, sometimes north of 50%; AI productivity deals more price aggressive with compressed margins initially.
margin.quote: AI transformation or AI foundation kind of deals are running with a good margin of 40% plus gross margin and sometimes even running north of 50% plus gross margin kind of businesses.

margin.statement: EBITDA margin 14.4%, down 100 bps QoQ due to 190 bps impact from salary hikes and ESOPs, partially offset by AI productivity and extra working days.
margin.quote: EBITDA was down 100 bps sequentially, led by increments and ESOPs, which had a 190 bps impact, which was partially offset by AI-led productivity efficiency and additional working days.

order_book.statement: 12-month order backlog at $286.2M, down 7.7% QoQ but up 2.3% YoY in USD due to deferred starts and slower consumption.
order_book.quote: We closed the quarter with a 12 -month backlog of $286.2 million, a sequential decline of 7.7%, and YoY growth of 2.3% in USD and 10.4% in INR terms.

order_book.statement: North America backlog improved 7.8% sequentially and 47.9% YoY with 53 AI deals closed, ~45% of total order book.
order_book.quote: North America closed yet another quarter of healthy order book, as mentioned by Umang earlier, improving the total backlog position by 7.8% sequentially and 47.9% YoY.

capex.statement: Sale of Chennai property completed, profit reflected in exceptional items, offset by workforce restructuring costs and old receivable write-offs.
capex.quote: We completed the sale of property in Chennai, resulting in a profit, which is reflected in exceptional items. The profit was offset by workforce restructuring cost due to AI -led efficiencies and writ e-off of old receivables in the book.

pricing_cost.statement: Subcontractor cost at 18-20% of revenue; may fluctuate +/-1% due to UK security-cleared resource demand but not structurally higher.
pricing_cost.quote: Traditionally, our subcon cost has been around 18 % to 20% of our revenue, and that is exactly where it is even now. I don't see these numbers going up significantly.

product_mix.statement: Over 40% of deals in Q2 were AI deals across AI Transformation, AI Foundation, AI Productivity and Service-as-a-Software.
product_mix.quote: more than 40% of our deals even in this quarter are AI deals and these deals are really helping shape Mastek towards the future of becoming a Data and AI organization.

other.statement: Paid Rs. 55 crore loan repayment in Q2; net cash position increased by Rs. 36 crore despite dividend and repayment.
other.quote: During the quarter, we paid a dividend of Rs. 50 crore plus loan repayment of around Rs. 55 crore. Despite that, we were able to add almost Rs. 36 crore to our net cash and investments.

other.statement: Headcount reduced by 87 to 4,810 due to workforce restructuring and onsite/offshore mix change; LTM attrition down 1.2% to 15.2%.
other.quote: Total closing headcount is 4,810, a reduction of 87 due to workforce restructuring and change in onsite/offshore mix. Our last 12-month attrition rate is down for the second consecutive quarter by 1.2%, from 16.4% to 15.2%.

guidance.statement: Effective tax rate expected around 28% for rest of FY2027
guidance.quote: We continue to expect the ETR to be around 28% for the rest of the year.

guidance.statement: Semiconductor breakeven expected in FY2028, possibly deferred by a quarter or two
guidance.quote: The breakeven timeline remains intact. We will breakeven somewhere in FY 2028. We just might be deferred a little bit.

guidance.statement: DET cost optimization to support margins through FY2027 and offset wage hikes in Q3 and Q4
guidance.quote: We expect it to keep supporting margins through FY2027 and to help offset the wage increases we are expecting in Q3 and Q4.

demand.statement: Semiconductor industry in strong demand cycle driven by AI, but supply constraints persist
demand.quote: The industry is in a strong demand cycle, driven by AI, but supply is tight. Foundries are running at full utilization and capacity is constrained across the ecosystem, which is leading to higher wafer prices and longer planning cycles.

demand.statement: Transportation & mobility grew 4.5% QoQ and 16.5% YoY in constant currency, sixth consecutive quarter of growth
demand.quote: transportation and mobility again grew strong at 4.5% quarter-over-quarter and 16.5% year-over-year in constant currency terms. It is the sixth consecutive quarter of growth for this particular segment.

demand.statement: Networks & infrastructure flattish with slight degrowth of 0.3% QoQ in constant currency

margin.statement: Group EBIT margin 10.2%, up 52 bps QoQ and 83 bps YoY
margin.quote: Group EBIT margins was 10.2%, up 52 basis points sequentially and 83 basis points year-on-year.

margin.statement: TAO Digital EBIT margins similar to Cyient DET, EBITDA margins higher
margin.quote: after taking into account all the intangibles and amortization and interest costs, etc., their margins are very close to our margins, s o, more or less, they will be at the same level as what Cyient is operating

order_book.statement: DET Q2 order intake $158.4M, up 21% YoY, highest ever Q2 order intake
order_book.quote: We recorded highest ever Q2 order intake of $158.4 million, up nearly 21% year-over-year, with positive momentum across both new businesses in existing and new customers from an order intake perspective.

order_book.statement: €50M annual framework agreement signed with global consumer products leader, not included in order intake
order_book.quote: In addition to the order intake in this segment, we signed a multi-year frame agreement with a potential to execute up to €50 million annually as the upside potential for a global leader in consumer product groups.

order_book.statement: DLM order book at record high with book-to-bill ratio above 1.6x for six consecutive quarters
order_book.quote: The business has maintained positive order book momentum for six consecutive quarters, with book-to-bill ratio in excess of 1.6 times. The order book surpassed the record level achieved in the previous quarter and is highest it has ever been.

capex.statement: Semiconductor high voltage chip to tape out early next year, substantial revenue expected in FY2028
capex.quote: The high voltage chip will tape out as it is called, which is basically released for production early next year and we should start to see substantial revenue from that chip during the course of FY2028

capex.statement: CTO office created for Horizon 2 and 3 technologies including physical AI, robotics, quantum
capex.quote: Looking further ahead, we are evolving our technology organization through the creation of a C TO office with a focus on research and development in Horizon 2 and Horizon 3 technologies

pricing_cost.statement: Wage hikes planned in two phases across Q3 and Q4 with roughly equal P&L impact
pricing_cost.quote: we are doing the wage hikes in two phases. I think it will be done over Q3 and Q4 with roughly an equal impact in terms of the headwind that will create for us on the P&L

fund_raise.statement: Semiconductor segment raised $20M debt and $10M equity (convertible preference shares)
fund_raise.quote: The fundraising Semiconductor had two elements. There is a $20 million worth of debt and a $10 million worth of equity. So it is accordingly a position in the balance sheet. The $10 million is a convertible preference share.

risk.statement: Commercial aviation headwinds from oil prices and inflation, pivoting to defense to hedge
risk.quote: We continue to see that, yes, potentially there is a headwind with what is going on with oil prices and potentially a negative turn for commercial aviation in the future, but these are risks that are out there, but for the time being, we continue to see that momentum and we probably will for the next couple of quarters in terms of visibility. We are also planning in terms of hedging against potent

other.statement: DET free cash flow Rs.214 Crores, 140% PAT conversion, driven by 3-day DSO reduction
other.quote: On cash flow, DET free cash flow was Rs.214 Crores or nearly 140% conversion of PAT that is up 87.9% sequentially and 36.3% year-on-year. The drivers were higher operating profit, three-day reduction in the net DSO and favorable working capital movements.

other.statement: $120M debt raised for TAO Digital acquisition at SOFR plus spread, 5-year tenor with interest rate swap
other.quote: We have funded largely through debt. I think $120 million debt is on the books today because of this acquisition. So we are at a very attractive interest rate. It is linked to SOFR plus a spread that the bank has given us. We have also taken interest rate swap so that there is a lock-in of those rates for the next five years. It is a 5 year loan.

guidance.statement: FY27 residential pre-sales guidance of ₹4,500-5,000 crore
guidance.quote: I think the first part is we have given a guidance for this financial year of 4500 to ₹5000 crores, somewhere between that.

guidance.statement: Business development target of ₹10,000-20,000 crore GDV addition for FY27
guidance.quote: I think last time when we spoke, I had given a number of anything between ₹10,000-₹20,000 crores is something that we will do.

demand.statement: Slight slowdown in sales velocity due to macro sentiment, but branded developers gaining market share
demand.quote: One is while the sales velocity or say the absolute numbers are moderating, but what is happening is the corporate developers or the branded developers are actually still continuing to gain the market share.

margin.statement: Cost savings of ₹25 crore recognized in H1 from projects with OC received 6+ months ago
margin.quote: So, this is the cost savings we realized from our existing projects. There was not one particular project. We had a few projects like Tathawade, Nostalgia, Eden, Luminare, and Vicino where the OCs have been received for more than six months.

order_book.statement: H1 FY27 residential pre-sales of ₹1,988 crore, 66% YoY growth
order_book.quote: On the Residential side, we did about ₹1,988 crore of pre-sales in H1 FY27, which is a 66% year-on-year growth.

order_book.statement: H1 FY27 GDV addition of ₹7,100 crore, total GDV at ₹50,000 crore
order_book.quote: Good momentum on the BD side. GDV addition of ₹7,100 crores and the total continue to be at a healthy ₹50,000 crores.

capex.statement: Land acquisition spend of ₹332 crore in H1 FY27, plus ₹400 crore for K2 closure in Q3
capex.quote: As far as the land outflows is concerned, we had spent about ₹332 crores in the first half of the year and with a healthy closing cash balance system-wide at ₹1,036 crores.

pricing_cost.statement: Maintaining price discipline, not offering discounts to artificially boost velocity
pricing_cost.quote: We're also making sure that we are disciplined about pricing. To artificially inflate velocity, we'll have to give higher discounts or make payment terms or pricing more attractive. That's something we are loathe to it.

product_mix.statement: Sustenance sales contributed 41% of H1 FY27 residential sales, up from launch-heavy mix
product_mix.quote: We are in H1 at 41% in terms of sustenance sales, as a percentage of overall sales. And we want to continue to work on that space.

risk.statement: Land prices out of sync with market economics, careful BD assessment with over-cost under-price hurdles
risk.quote: The land prices expectation are still high. But the market economics may be slightly lower, from a sentiment point of view, from a cost point of view. So, we are doing very careful assessment of the pipeline. Over cost, underprice as we look at our business development pipeline to make sure that those deals will work.

other.statement: Residential collections of ₹1,152 crore in H1 FY27, expected to pick up in Q3
other.quote: On the Residential collections side, we did about ₹1,152 crore. Some of the billing milestones and the launches collections are stacked up towards the end of September. So, you would see that collections picking up in Q3 of this year.

other.statement: Estimated net cash flow of ₹15,280 crore from existing and pipeline projects over next few years
other.quote: From a project breakdown perspective, we have an estimated cashflow of roughly about ₹15,280 crores, overall. This includes our existing ongoing projects, future phases of current projects, and also the pipeline projects to be launched.

guidance.statement: Revised full-year volume growth guidance to 4-6% from 7-9% and EBITDA per ton guidance to INR 20,000-22,000 from INR 18,000-20,000; capex and net debt guidance unchanged
guidance.value: 4% to 6% volume growth; INR 20,000 to INR 22,000 per ton EBITDA
guidance.quote: In this dynamic environment, JSL revises its full -year volume growth guidance to 4% to 6%, from earlier 7% to 9% and EBITDA per ton guidance to INR20,000 to INR22,000 per ton, up from earlier INR 18,000 to INR20,000 a ton.

guidance.statement: Capex guidance unchanged at INR 2,400-2,600 crores and net debt guidance at INR 2,500-2,800 crores for FY27
guidance.value: INR 2,400 crores to INR 2,600 crores capex; INR 2,500 to 2,800 crores net debt
guidance.quote: The capex and net debt guidance range remains unchanged at INR2,400 crores to INR2,600 crores and INR2,500 to 2,800 crores, respectively.

guidance.statement: Long-term sales volume target of 3.5 million tons per annum by FY29 remains on track
guidance.quote: it is important to reiterate JSL's commitment to deliver on its sales volume target of 3.5 million tons per annum by FY29.

demand.statement: Domestic market grew 14% quarter-on-quarter in Q2 FY27 highlighting strong demand momentum
demand.quote: Domestic demand remained robust across key end -use segments, with the domestic market growing 14% quarter -on-quarter, highlighting strong demand momentum in the country.

demand.statement: Domestic demand remained healthy across automotive, railways, metros, lifts, elevators, and white goods supported by robust economic growth
demand.quote: Domestic demand remained healthy across our key end -user segments, including automotive, railways, metros, lifts, elevators, and white goods.

margin.statement: Consolidated EBITDA increased ~2% YoY to INR 2,762 crores; PAT rose ~9% YoY to INR 1,666 crores in H1 FY27
margin.value: INR 2,762 crores EBITDA; INR 1,666 crores PAT
margin.quote: Consolidated EBITDA increased by around 2% year -on-year to INR 2,762 crores, while consolidated PAT rose by approximately 9% year-on-year to INR 1,666 crores.

margin.statement: Revised EBITDA per ton guidance upward to INR 20,000-22,000 reflecting focus on value-added product mix
margin.quote: EBITDA per ton guidance to INR20,000 to INR22,000 per ton, up from earlier INR 18,000 to INR20,000 a ton.

capex.statement: Capex spend of INR 895 crores in Q2 FY27, total H1 FY27 capex INR 1,555 crores in line with guidance; all announced projects on track
capex.quote: During the quarter, our capex spend was approximately INR 895 crores, bringing the total capex in this fiscal to INR1,555 crores, in line with our guidance.

product_mix.statement: Q2 sales volume mix: 37% 200 series, 47% 300 series, 16% 400 series
product_mix.quote: In Q2 27, going in the order of 200, 300, and 400, it was 37%, 47%, and 16%.

product_mix.statement: Developed India's first high-aluminum stainless steel grade for catalytic converters and two new 400 series grades, one opening South Africa market
product_mix.quote: Key achievements include the development of India's first high-aluminum stainless steel grade for catalytic converters and development of two new 400 series grades, one of which has opened up a new market in S outh Africa

risk.statement: Gas price volatility risk acknowledged; sharp movements could impact margins short-term but pass-through expected longer-term
risk.quote: Yes, beyond the point if the things move, then the movement in the gas prices will also come, and if the sharp movement comes, it impacts the industry in the shorter run.

risk.statement: Import surge of substandard Chinese 200 series products after QCO suspension hurting MSME players and public safety; industry representing to government for QCO reinstatement and ADD
risk.quote: The domestic market co ntinued to face import pressure. Since April 2026 f ollowing the suspension of the quality control order, imports of substandard products, particularly from China and of Chinese origin, have increased significantly.

other.statement: Exports grew 20% QoQ and 36% YoY, accounting for 11% of total volumes in Q2 FY27
other.quote: Exports also registered a strong growth of 20% on quarter-on-quarter and 36% on year-on-year terms, accounting for 11% of total volumes in Q2 FY27.

other.statement: Chromeni plant running at ~85% utilization; Rathi at ~79% utilization; RVPL cold rolling equipment to be operational next year
other.quote: Chromeni is concerned, because that is where our biggest stakes were, and very strategic investment, and because it helps us in a lot of our balancing, because this is the plant where we do huge quantities or large quantities of the cold rolling, that we are now running at approximately 85% of utilization. Rathi is around 79% utilization.

guidance.statement: Annual grey cement volume guidance of 23 million tons for FY27 maintained; confident of achieving target
guidance.quote: we are confident that the guidance which we gave at the beginning of the year of closing at 23 million tons, we are on track, well on track on that number.

guidance.statement: Net debt-to-EBITDA expected to peak at 2.25-2.35x by end of FY27, then decline toward 1.5x over 2-3 years
guidance.quote: net debt-to-EBITDA may reach, you know, say about 2.3 , 2.35 or between 2.25 to 2.35. That is the peak, which will be at the mostly at end of fiscal '27.

guidance.statement: Capex of INR3,500 crores in FY27; INR2,500 crores annually for FY28-FY30 for brownfield expansions
guidance.quote: capex would be in the range of INR2,500 crores yearly in the coming years.

guidance.statement: Net debt expected to peak near INR6,000 crores at 50 million ton capacity
guidance.quote: It could peak up to closer to INR6,000 crores.

demand.statement: Maharashtra and Karnataka water shortage impact minimal; UP election disruption possible but not before March; confident on 23 million ton guidance
demand.quote: we do not foresee that any significant impact would be there. And whatever is our -- we are hopeful that we will achieve our annual target numbers in those regions.

margin.statement: Power and fuel cost expected to increase by INR80-100 per ton in each of Q3 and Q4
margin.quote: we should see power and fuel cost increasing by between INR80 to INR100 in each of the quarters.

capex.statement: JK Maxx paint plant of 75,000 KL approved at INR130 crores within overall INR600 crores paint business limit
capex.quote: The Board also noted and approved the JK Maxx proposal, which was to put up a white cement -- a paint plant of 75,000 KL and with the overall cost of INR130 crores.

pricing_cost.statement: Cement prices increased by ~INR20 per bag from mid-September across trade and non-trade; further INR10-15 per bag needed to cover cost pressures
pricing_cost.quote: there has been an overall increase in price of around INR20 per bag, both trade, non-trade combined.

pricing_cost.statement: Packaging cost has peaked; no further increase expected unless rupee depreciates
pricing_cost.quote: I don't think the packaging cost has already peaked out. I think we should not see any further increase in the packaging cost.

product_mix.statement: Premium products yield ~INR150 per ton extra profit; premium share increasing across all markets to improve trade mix and profitability
product_mix.quote: premium products normally you get between about INR150 average extra profit.

other.statement: Wall putty plant of 0.6 million tons commissioned at Nathdwara; total white cement and putty capacity now 3.65 million tons

other.statement: Market share maintained in North; gained share in Central India due to 6 million ton expansion completed in March 2026

guidance.statement: Full-year cost of funds guidance at 10.5%; currently at 10% as of Q2 FY27

guidance.statement: NIM guidance range-bound around 6% annualized; currently at 5.7% in Q2 FY27

guidance.statement: Long-term ROE target 15-18% sustained annualized; ROA target 4-4.5% annualized
guidance.quote: On a long-term basis on our ROE framework, I think we'll target somewhere around the 15% to 18% range on a sustained annualized basis. On an ROA basis, we are at about 3.3%, 3.4% so anywhere between 4%, 4.5% is a good level on an annualized basis for us.

guidance.statement: App launch targeted by end of Q3 FY27 (around Christmas/New Year); metrics from Q1 FY28
guidance.quote: we are targeting the app to go live in quarter 3, which is ongoing right now by the end of this quarter 3 and probably start sharing the metrics on the strategy by quarter 1 of next fiscal year because we are targeting somewhere around -- releasing it around Christmas or towards the New Year's part of it

demand.statement: Demand visible in mobility, machinery, movable asset financing in Maharashtra; healthy across mobility and agri in UP; opportunities in machinery/mobility in Haryana, Rajasthan; broad-based credit demand in Delhi NCR
demand.quote: Despite seasonal backdrop, demand remains visible in mobility, machinery and other movable asset financing in Maharashtra supported by industrial and urban activity. demand.statement: Uptick in credit offtake among MSME/SME borrowers across emerging markets driven by working capital and business expansion needs

demand.statement: Rural demand muted in drought-affected pockets (Maharashtra, parts of Karnataka, AP, Telangana); tightened underwriting, moderated rural disbursements, stepped up collections

Customer demand in these areas has been relatively muted and we have responded by tightening underwriting guardrails, moderating rural disbursements

margin.statement: Total Income up 24% YoY to INR2,773 million; Net Interest Income up 17% YoY to INR1,476 million in Q2 FY27
margin.quote: Total Income for the quarter increased by 24% year-on-year to INR2,773 million while Net Interest Income grew by 17% to INR1,476 million.

margin.statement: Cost of borrowing declined ~50 bps YoY to 10% in Q2 FY27
margin.quote: Our Cost of Borrowing declined by approximately 50 basis points year-on-year to 10% reflecting the continued diversification of our liability franchise.

order_book.statement: AUM reached INR72,659 million as of September 30, 2026, up 33% YoY
order_book.quote: Assets Under Management reached INR72,659 million as of September 30, 2026 representing growth of 33% year-on-year.

order_book.quote: Disbursements increased by 42% year-on-year to INR15,673 million during quarter 2 and reached INR32,982 million for H1 financial year '27 representing 77% year-on-year growth.

pricing_cost.statement: Yield moderation in Q2 due to late-quarter fund deployment (denominator effect); yields to normalize in Q3/Q4; no product mix or competitive pricing changes
pricing_cost.quote: it was mostly that yield factor was coming because a majority of the disbursement that took from the transition of quarter 1 to quarter 2 happened towards the end of the quarter of the quarter 2, which created a denominator effect temporarily affecting yields. fund_raise.statement: Raised ~INR294.9 cr via public NCD under INR900 cr shelf, INR124.47 cr via dual-rated unsecured private placement NCDs in Sept, and >INR177 cr via CP in H1 FY27
fund_raise.quote: We have successfully raised approximately INR294.9 crores through our public NCD issuance under the INR900 crores shelf program followed by INR124.47 crores listed dual-rated unsecured private placement of NCDs in September. other.statement: Gross NPA 0.66%, Net NPA 0.46%, Collection Efficiency 98.3% as of September 30, 2026
other.quote: Gross NPA improved by 15 basis points year-on-year to 0.66% as of September 30, 2026 while net NPA improved by 19 basis points to 0.46%. Collection Efficiency stood at 98.3%.

other.statement: Credit cost declined to 0.4% in Q2 FY27 from 1.1% in Q2 FY26; H1 FY27 loan losses and provisions down 47% YoY to INR155 million
other.quote: Credit cost declined to 0.4% in quarter 2 financial year '27 compared with 1.1% in quarter 2 financial year '26. While H1 financial year '27 loan losses and provision declined by 47% year-on-year to INR155 million from INR295 million in H1 financial year '26.

guidance.statement: Management expects consolidated EBITDA margin to be maintained above 15% for FY2027.
guidance.quote: we should be maintaining our margin -- more than 15% should be maintaining our margin. So that is what we estimate at this stage.

demand.statement: India installed over 20 GW solar in H1 FY2027; no sector slowdown observed.
demand.quote: by H1, we have already achieved more than 20 gigawatt. So, there is no slowdown as such in this particular sector.

demand.statement: Domestic solar EPC order pipeline exceeds 30-35 GW; international pipeline around 9 GW.
demand.quote: the order pipeline, which we are following is more than 30, 35 gigawatt domestic and international.

margin.statement: Solar EPC margins better than T&D; consolidated margin expected above 15% for FY2027.
margin.quote: This solar EPC is giving better margin as compared to T&D. And the solar, the way these orders are in hand, and we are likely to execute, we should be maintaining our margin -- more than 15% should be maintaining our margin.

margin.statement: T&D (APSPL) EBITDA margin currently 9-10%, expected to improve in coming quarters.
margin.quote: Margin profile as of now is around 9% to 10%. That is going to improve because -- that we should be improving in the coming quarters.

order_book.statement: Consolidated unexecuted order book stands at over INR5,500 crores as of 30th September 2026.
order_book.quote: As of 30th September 2026, our consolidated unexecuted order book stands at more than INR5,500 crores.

order_book.statement: EPC solar and BESS order book is over INR3,300 crores; T&D order book is over INR2,200 crores.
order_book.quote: Of this, more than INR3,300 crores from EPC of solar and BESS and balance of more than INR2,200 crores from T&D vertical.

order_book.statement: Added 1.7 GW peak of new orders in Q2 FY2027.
order_book.quote: our order book has strengthened during the quarter with the addition of 1.7 gigawatt peak of new orders.

capex.statement: Expanding manufacturing with additional Azamnagar facility of 1 lakh metric tons capacity for T&D.
capex.quote: We are expanding our manufacturing capabilities through the additional facility of Azamnagar with a capacity of 1 lakh metric tons.

product_mix.statement: Solar EPC to remain core growth driver, supported by T&D and BESS integration.

risk.statement: Q2 solar execution impacted by developer-side land handover delays; not a recurring issue.

other.statement: Executed 456 MWp in Q2 FY2027; H1 FY2027 execution at 1,345 MWp.

other.statement: APSPL acquisition contributing revenue; order pipeline over INR20,000 crores; FY2026 revenue ~INR2,000 crores.
other.quote: they also have around more than INR20,000 crores worth of order pipeline, which the company is following. Last year, they have achieved around INR1,995 crores.

guidance.statement: Long-term credit cost expectation of 90-100 bps through-the-cycle

guidance.statement: ROA outlook of 1.8% maintained despite insurance fee income headwinds
guidance.quote: We have been guiding for this 1.8% ROA outlook consistently.

guidance.statement: Cost-to-assets ratio expected to improve YoY on full year basis
guidance.quote: We expect cost to assets ratio to improve YoY on a full year basis.

guidance.statement: Deposit growth target of around 25% YoY linked to nominal GDP growth of ~10%
guidance.quote: Our target is to grow in the range of 25% year-on-year. But it will depend on the market and the overall condition.

margin.quote: Sequentially, margin declined by 9 bps to 5.8% driven by higher share of investments to total assets and seasonality. Sequential loan spreads remained broadly stable with decline in loan yields (by 9bps) being offset by 7 bps decline in cost of funds.

margin.statement: 30% of loan book is floating rate; 25 bps repo hike transmission over next 3-4 months
margin.quote: ~30% of our book is floating rate and 70% is fixed rate. So this 30% floating rate book, the recent repo hike that has happened of 25 basis points, that'll get transmitted over the next 3 to 4 months.

margin.statement: Deposit rate tenure elongated from 18 months to 36 months peak rate to help NIM
margin.quote: what we have d one is we had elongated our deposit rate retail deposit tenure, the peak rate from 18 months to 36 months. So that should also help

other.statement: Deposit rate premium of 80-100 bps over peers to continue; not driven by market optics
other.quote: So, I think 80-90, or maybe 100 bps premium to other banks, we want to be on that strategy only, because we haven't seen any rates coming down because of FCNR deposits.

demand.statement: H2 volume growth expected in line with industry (~7-8%)
demand.quote: I think we should look at second half volume growth in line with the industry. I would just put it at that. I think we have maintained that position. Internally, we are trying to chase aggressive targets. But for you to pick a number, let's take industry growth as the number that we are chasing.

demand.statement: Cement demand grew high single digit YoY in Q2 supported by government capex and low rainfall
demand.quote: Cement demand has als o remained robust, growing in high single digit on a Y-o-Y basis during this quarter. This was supported by continued government capex spending, along with relatively low rainfall in several parts of the country

margin.statement: Central India EBITDA dilution expected to widen to INR 100-125/t in Q3 FY27

margin.statement: Targeting Central India breakeven by Q4 FY27 and Dalmia-standard EBITDA by FY28
