pricing_cost.statement: Further fuel cost impact of ~INR 75/t expected in Q3 FY27 at petcoke >$180/t
pricing_cost.quote: With external cost pressures persisting and petcoke prices remaining above $180 per ton, we expect a further cost impact of around INR75 per ton in quarter 3.

product_mix.statement: Phasing out Konark brand to sharpen premiumization focus
product_mix.quote: Konark, which has been a cornerstone of our portfolio and a trusted brand for decades, is now getting phased out as we sharpen our focus on premiumization. This marks an important milestone towards reinforcing our brand positioning and building a stronger, more unified Dalmia brand.

product_mix.statement: Premium product share rising; Weather365 launch getting exceptional response, accelerating rollout
product_mix.quote: Premium product share continues to increase, and we expect this trend to deepen over coming quarters as we continue to drive this initiative of premiumization. Our recently launched premium offering, Weather365, has received an exceptional response from th e market, prompting us to accelerate its rollout into newer

risk.statement: Near-term risks from rising inflation, potential rate hikes, and crude >$100/bbl keeping petcoke >$180/t
risk.quote: Having said that, rising inflation and potential onset of rate hike cycle pose near-term risks. But I believe India's growth story is much bigger than the near-term challenges we see today.

other.statement: Central India (Jaypee) assets targeting 35-40% utilization by end FY27
other.quote: I'm confident that we are on track to achieve a 35% to 40% utilization of these assets by end of financial year '27.

other.statement: Committed to maintaining leverage below 2x Net Debt/EBITDA sustainably; currently at peak due to acquisition and lower EBITDA
other.quote: Guided by this, we remain committed to maintaining leverage below 2x on a sustainable basis, which will create a strong financial foundation for the Dalmia's next phase of growth.

guidance.statement: Targeting 20% year-on-year volume growth in H2 FY27
guidance.quote: So, sir, our infrastructure and our team is geared up to deliver 20% volume growth consistently. And that is still our target.

guidance.statement: EBITDA per ton target range of Rs 7,000-7,500 for FY27
guidance.quote: Sir, our thought process is that we should maintain our margins at about Rs. 7,000 to Rs. 7,500. That has been our goal for this year.

guidance.statement: Cumulative operating cash flow target of Rs 800 crore over FY27 and FY28 combined
guidance.quote: As communicated earlier, we are targeting cumulative operating cash flow generation of approximately Rs. 800 crores over FY '27 and '28 combined.

guidance.statement: Near-term ROCE target of 25%
guidance.quote: We have consistently maintained that our near-term objective is to achieve 25% ROCE.

demand.statement: Healthy demand across automotive, infra, agriculture, power and general engineering sectors
demand.quote: We continue to see healthy demand across the various industries we serve. One of our biggest strengths of Bansal Wire has been our diverse presence across sectors such as automotive, infra, agriculture, power and transmission, and general engineering.

demand.statement: Positive medium to long-term outlook for steel wire industry in India
demand.quote: We remain positive about the medium to long-term outlook for the steel wire industry in India, supported by increasing industry activity, infrastructure development, and growing demand for specialized wire products.

margin.statement: Long-term EBITDA per ton target of Rs 8,000-10,000+ as specialty wires ramp up
margin.quote: In the long run, yes, we would definitely look at Rs. 8,000 to Rs. 10,000. Rs. 10,000 or higher than Rs. 10,000 kind of range once our specialty wire numbers also start coming in.

margin.statement: IHT-OHT specialty wires generating Rs 15,000-20,000 EBITDA per ton
margin.quote: So, the whole of specialty-wire segment, I think, on an average, for IHT-OHT, we can take about INR 15,000-20,000 per ton kind of EBITDA number, which we already see us generating.

margin.statement: LRPC EBITDA per ton at Rs 5,000-8,000 but currently not profitable due to excess capacity
margin.quote: Sir, LRPC generally gets around Rs. 5,000 to Rs. 7,000 or Rs. 8,000 a ton. But that also varies quite a lot. Right now, LRPC is not a good product for us because there is excess capacity in the country.

capex.statement: Indicative annual capex of Rs 200-225 crore
capex.quote: Our indicative annual capital expenditure remains in the range of Rs. 200 crores to Rs. 225 crores.

capex.statement: Sanand greenfield facility capex of Rs 150 crore excluding land
capex.quote: Sir, we are looking at about Rs. 150 crores of CapEx there apart from land.

product_mix.statement: Low carbon wire share at 55% of volumes (lower end of 55-60% range) improving blended EBITDA
product_mix.quote: So, actually, in last quarter, although our estimates or our strategy is that low carbon should be about 55-60% of our total volumes, last quarter, our low carbon was about 55%. So, lower end of 55-60% range. Because of that, at the lower end, our blended EBITDA is better.

risk.statement: Raw material shortages may cause temporary volume hits but not expected to hamper annual targets
risk.quote: Yes, that is true. But I mean, through these years, we faced such issues before. And this is temporary. This I do not see as a long-term glitch in our system.

other.statement: Overall capacity to increase from 6.8 lakh tons to 8.3 lakh tons by end of next year
other.quote: With these expansions, we expect our overall manufacturing capacity will increase from 6.8 lakh tons and reach approximately 8.3 lakh tons by the end of next year.

other.statement: IHT-OHT capacity to reach 15,000 tons within this year
other.quote: So, hopefully, within this year, we will be able to increase our total capacity of IHT-OHT to about 15,000 tons.

guidance.statement: Full-year FY27 revenue and EBITDA growth expected to outperform H1 levels (27% revenue, 34% EBITDA), beating prior 15%/20% guidance
guidance.quote: We therefore expect to keep outperforming for the full year as well, similar to the H1 delivery.

guidance.statement: Management revises FY27 guidance upward to match H1 growth rates of 27% revenue and 34% EBITDA
guidance.quote: We are saying that we are revising our 15% and 20% upwards given the fact that H1 delivery has beaten our initial estimates for the full year.

margin.statement: Consolidated EBITDA margin 61.4% in Q2 FY27, up 340 bps YoY; H1 margin 60.9%, up 310 bps YoY
margin.quote: EBITDA for this quarter clocked in at INR 2,445 million, growing 39%, with margins at 61.4%, which is 340 basis points above the same time last year.

margin.statement: India standalone EBITDA margin 69.5% in Q2 FY27, down 340 bps YoY due to investments in people, marketing, commissions
margin.quote: EBITDA margins stood at 69.5% versus 72.8% in the previous yea r. It is down 340 basis points. Obviously, this has been driven by certain investments that we made from an employee leadership standpoint plus additional marketing plus commission expenses

order_book.statement: Issued 4.35 million reports in Q2 FY27, up 26% YoY; India volumes up 19% YoY
order_book.quote: We issued 4.35 million reports in the quarter. That is 26% more than the same quarter last year. In India, the volumes grew 19% on a year-on-year basis.

capex.statement: Investing in capacities, geographies, technology; recently started Italy operations, preparing Saudi Arabia, set up Botswana entity in September
capex.quote: Our priorities, as articulated during the Investor Day, remain unchanged. We invest in capacities, geographies, and technology, selective bolt-on acquisitions, and return surplus cash.

pricing_cost.statement: ARP INR 891 in Q2 FY27, up 4% YoY; 2% from AGL consolidation, 2% from higher LGD mix (54% vs 52%)
pricing_cost.quote: The ARP for the quarter reported at INR 891, registering a 4% improvement versus the previous year. The AGL consolidation gave us 2% gains, and the base business ARP has grown 2% on a higher LGD loose stone mix.

product_mix.statement: LGD mix increased to 54% in Q2 FY27 from 52% YoY; LGD jewelry grew 47%, colored stones 331% YoY
product_mix.quote: If you were to look at the LGD mix for this quarter, it was 54% versus 52%. That is the key driver for effectively 2% increase in the ARP if you were to discount the AGL consolidation.

other.statement: H1 operating cash flow INR 4,157M (89% of EBITDA, 118% of PAT); receivables fell from INR 2,885M to INR 2,402M releasing INR 662M
other.quote: Operating cash flow for the half-year was INR 4,157 million, 89% of the EBITDA and 118% of the PAT delivery, helped by a working capital release of around INR 662 million as receivables have fallen from a peak of around INR 2,885 million to INR2,402 million.

other.statement: Cash and bank balance INR 10,749M as of quarter close (corrected from INR 10,074M spoken)
other.quote: As of the quarter close, the group reported a cash and bank balance of INR1,0749 -- for ease, it is INR10,074 million ** of cash and bank balance.

guidance.statement: Company targets 20-25% revenue growth for next 3-5 years with sustained EBITDA margins of 23-24%
guidance.quote: To conclude, at Beta, we'll continue to deliver 20%, 25% growth for next three to five years with a sustained margins between 23% to 24%.

guidance.statement: FY27 own-brand sales target of INR150 crores
guidance.quote: We are on track to do INR150 crores sales from our own brand for this FY27.

guidance.statement: FY27 export sales guidance of INR90-100 crores
guidance.quote: For this year, I think we have guided to closer to between INR90 crores to INR100 crores of sales on the export side.

guidance.statement: Branded oncology growth guidance of 20-22% for FY27
guidance.quote: in terms of the growth in the branded onco, we are still sticking to our original guidance of 20% to 22% growth for the whole year.

margin.statement: H1 FY27 EBITDA margin 23.18% including other income, 22% excluding other income
margin.quote: if we exclude the other income, then the margin is 22%. And if we include other income, then margin is 23.18%.

order_book.statement: 872 new export registrations in pipeline over next 2-3 years, 50 expected in FY27
order_book.quote: Total of 872 new registrations are in pipeline, which we will be getting in next two to three years. In export, we are on track and will deliver a major growth in coming next two to three years down the line.

order_book.statement: 12 EU registrations expected in FY27 from 20 dossiers filed
order_book.quote: We have also successfully cleared the audit of Azerbaijan and file d 20 new dossiers, of which 12 registrations are expected in FY -- in by in FY27

product_mix.statement: OSD contribution increased to 50% of total business
product_mix.quote: The OSD, oral solid forms contribution to the business has increased up to 50% in total business.

product_mix.statement: Four new products launched in FY27, six more planned
product_mix.quote: We have successfully launched four new products in FY27 and are on a plan to launch six more in coming months.

risk.statement: EU GMP audit timing uncertain (2-4 months), dependent on dossier filing and auditor schedule
risk.quote: Maybe it can happen in 2 months, 3 months, 4 months. So, we are expecting an audit very soon from EU.

other.statement: Forex impact positive ~INR2.5 lakhs in quarter
other.quote: our foreign exchange fluctuation is on a positive side, close to INR3 lakhs or INR4 lakhs. If I go precisely, it is INR2.5 lakhs.

other.statement: Nivian acquisition delivered 75% growth (INR18 to INR31 crores), 60% prescriber base increase
other.quote: Nivian has delivered 75% growth, that is from INR18 crores to INR31 crores sales in first half of FY27. The acceptance of these products has been in the corporate hospital, which is a major increase in this FY. There has been a significant 60% increase in the prescriber base also.

guidance.statement: Medium-term target PAT Rs 25-30 crore and EPS Rs 5-6 by 2028-29
guidance.quote: Our plan is to provide maximum benefit to shareholders till 2028, 2029 and do PAT of Rs. 25 crore to Rs. 30 crore. And our EPS becomes Rs. 5 to Rs. 6.

demand.statement: Next two quarters turnover expected to increase 30-40% above previous expectations
demand.quote: And secondly, as you said, in the next two quarters, we hope that the turnover will increase by 30% to 40% more than what we expected.

margin.statement: Imported goods operating margin 3-4%; manufacturing gross margin 21%
margin.quote: Actually, in imported goods, we have an average margin of 3% to 4% and the average margin in trading activity and in manufacturing activity, there is 21% gross profit.

capex.statement: Launching AMPM brand and 8-10 new premium models in coming 2-3 months
capex.quote: We are launching a lot of new models. And we are launching new AMPM brand in this year. And we are doing more production of premium clocks. And we have launched a lot of new models in these two months. And in the coming two, three months we will launch eight to ten new models.

product_mix.statement: FY26 full-year manufacturing revenue Rs 60 crore out of Rs 171 crore
product_mix.quote: In Rs. 171 crore, manufacturing was Rs. 60 crore.

product_mix.statement: H1 FY27 manufacturing revenue Rs 20 crore out of Rs 195 crore; trading/imports balance
product_mix.quote: The manufacturing in this year, in the half year. The revenue growth for the half year, hello, Rs. 19 crores, Rs. 20 crores is our actual manufacturing. And balance is what we import and we also sell imported goods

risk.statement: Uncertainty on war environment and crude oil prices affecting raw material costs
risk.quote: See, we do not know till when the war environment will be there. And what will happen. Either of us cannot tell anything, the situation is like that.

other.statement: Capacity utilisation currently 52%; export impacted by higher freight costs
other.quote: The capacity utilization for now is 52%. Actually this year freight cost has increased in export. So, according to that export is a little less.

other.statement: Focus shifted to domestic premium segment due to high export freight costs
other.quote: Yes, the focus is more on domestic now. Naturally, because now the price has increased a lot in exports. Freight cost has increased a lot. So according to that, we are focusing more on domestic now.

guidance.statement: Expect double-digit volume growth to continue for next 2 quarters (H2 FY27)
guidance.quote: And going forward also, we are very positively looking at a double-digit volume growth in the coming 6 months in the future also.

guidance.statement: Volume growth to remain double-digit in FY28 but value growth will be lower due to no inflation
guidance.quote: Also, the volume growth will remain in double digit, but the value will be -- will not be much higher than what it was this year because there was some inflation in this year, which will not be there in the next year.

guidance.statement: Employee cost run rate ~INR141-142 cr per quarter
guidance.quote: So It should be INR141 crores to INR142 crores.

demand.statement: 10% YoY volume growth in Q2 FY27 led by better demand and market share gains across all regions and segments
demand.quote: In quarter 2 F '27, we achieved 10% year-to-year volume growth led by better demand and gaining market share.

margin.statement: Management expects margins to remain stable and will pass any extra benefit to gain volume share
margin.quote: I would say we expect margins to remain stable going forward also, around the same numbers what we have given in the quarter. And any extra benefit we might get, we would like to pass on to the market to gain more volume share.

margin.statement: Bathware margins lower due to new plant underutilization but will match tile margins next year; adhesives margins very good and margin-accretive
margin.quote: Margin in Bathware has been lower this year. I mean it used to be earlier 14%, 15%. But because of the new plant, we have put up where the capacity utilization is much lower. The margin is very low in Bathware. It still improved this year partially. And next year and onwards, it will be matching -- nearly matching the tile margin. And the adhesive also margin is very good.

margin.statement: EBITDA margin improved to 19.5% in Q2 FY27 from 17.9% YoY; expect margins to remain stable around current levels
margin.quote: EBITDA margin for quarter 2 F '27 stood at 19.5%.

capex.statement: Srikalahasti capex increased to INR240 cr from INR210 cr due to larger shed, warehouse and racking; future expansions in same shed only need machinery cost
capex.quote: So, I'll explain to you. What happened was earlier, we were making only a 5 lakh square feet shed for 1 production line. But then later, we reali zed that when we increase our production capacity, we had also gone to China, we also went to Italy, and we also understood that it is better to increase our capacity. And then for that, we had to increase our shed as well so that when the next expansion

pricing_cost.statement: Price hikes of 12-13% in North/South plants and 18-19% in Morbi across all product categories taken till date
pricing_cost.quote: Basically, in our North and South plants, we increased the prices are roughly 12% to 13% and it was across all product categories, be it ceramics, be it PVT , be it GVT . And the Morbi price increase was commensurate with the price increase at the Morbi level, which is 18% to 19% across all product verticals.

pricing_cost.statement: No price hike taken in Q2 FY27 and no intention to hike in Q3 FY27 as of now
pricing_cost.quote: No, we have not taken any price hike last quarter, Q2, and we don't need intend to take any price hike in this quarter as well as of now.

risk.statement: Gas situation tight due to US-Iran conflict; spot prices up drastically; propane prices rose INR12.5/SCM recently; expect further propane increases with Brent at $116
risk.quote: Sneha, gas prices have not changed much for this quarter. But going forward, gas position is very tight because of this America-Iran war. And I foresee with the knowledge which I have gathered from GAIL and others that gas situation will be tough going forward, as of today.

other.statement: Expect significant gas cost reduction from January via cheaper gas sourcing and firing cycle reduction
other.quote: So, we hope from January, we'll get some significant reduct ion in our gas cost. That will be partly because of some cheaper gas might be and reduction in firing cycle.

other.statement: Biofuel ~30% of fuel cost in North plants (Gailpur, Sikandrabad, Malootana); new expansions to maintain same ratio; South uses biofuel, West uses coal
other.quote: Biofuel is -- in North, it's about 30% because we are not used to -- not allowed to use coal. So, biofuel is roughly about 30% of the cost at 3 plants, which is Gailpur Sikandrabad and Malootana. And the new expansion will have the same ratio.

guidance.statement: Q3/Q4 performance expected reasonably better or similar to Q2 given demand outlook and cost actions
guidance.quote: And what I see in quarter 3 and quarter 4 with the demand and with the kind of work that we have done on the cost, we should be able to come up with a reasonably better, if not similar numbers on performance as we did in quarter 2.

margin.statement: Consolidated EBITDA rose ~4% YoY to INR1,016 cr; EBITDA/t fell to INR966 from INR1,055 due to higher fuel cost
margin.quote: Consol EBITDA rose by about 4% from INR974 crores to INR1,016 crores. However, consolidated EBITDA per ton declined to INR966 from INR1,055 a year ago, primarily due to a higher fuel cost.

pricing_cost.statement: Freight cost reduced in Q2 due to shorter lead distance, railway lean-season discounts, and data-driven freight optimisation; no one-offs
pricing_cost.quote: One is our run to market has come down. Second is that this is a period when we get some special discounts from railways as part of the lean season discounts. Third is that we are having some new processes where freight fixation is now a little more databased using some modern tools, which is allowing us to correct a lot of freight across markets

other.statement: Consolidated net cash at group level INR8,168 cr
other.quote: Consolidated net cash at the group level is INR8,168 crores.

other.statement: Remembered late Special Advisor Mr. Ashok Bhandari who passed away after Q1 call; credited with significant market cap growth during tenure
other.quote: Before we begin, I want all of us to remember Mr. Ashok Bhandari, our Special Advisor, he passed away suddenly 2 days after our Q1 results call. Many of you know him from these calls. He earned the trust of the investor community. During his tenure, the market cap of Shree Cement grew significantly.

guidance.statement: Guided Capital Foods and Organic India to grow 25-30% going forward
guidance.quote: But overall, I would continue to expect 25% to 30% growth that we had guided for Capital Foods and Organic India going forward.

guidance.statement: Guided growth categories to grow 30%+ for next 2-3 years
guidance.quote: My growth categories will grow 30% plus. So -- and that view we see continuing for at least the next 2 to 3 years.

guidance.statement: Guided RTD business for 30% growth
guidance.quote: But 30%, I think, is par for the course.

guidance.statement: Guided Sampann growth at 25-30%
guidance.quote: So it's in the same 25% to 30% is what is aspiration, and we are quite in the ballpark on that one.

demand.statement: Salt volume up 9%, revenue up 15% in Q2; value-added salts growing 2x base business
demand.quote: Volume was up 9%, revenue was plus 15%. Value -added and premium salts continue to deliver 2x the growth of the base salt business.

demand.statement: Sampann revenue up 57% in Q2; dry fruits and cold-pressed oils ARR over INR1,000 crores
demand.quote: Sampann, strong quarter, revenue up 57%, driven by strong volume growth as well. Dry fruits and cold -pressed oil now combined ARR of INR1,000 crores plus.

demand.statement: RTD volume up 34%, revenue up 47% in Q2
demand.quote: RTD, having reset the entire business, has now started delivering strong results, volume up 34%, revenue up 47%.

margin.statement: International and non-branded segments had substantial profitability improvement in Q2
margin.quote: Both international and non -branded had a very substantial improvement in profitability and leading to an overall improvement in segment margins by 50 basis points.

margin.statement: Sampann margin expanded 270-280 bps year-on-year
margin.quote: I think we had at 270, 280 bps of expansion on margin on Sampann as well.

margin.statement: India segment margin contracted in Q2 due to tea and salt inflation
margin.quote: India for the quarter, there was a bit of a contraction of the margin, largely on account of the inflationary pressures that we are seeing on tea and salt.

order_book.statement: Growth businesses now contribute 38% of India business revenue
order_book.quote: Growth businesses up 40%, now contribute to 38% of India business.

order_book.statement: HoReCa channel at INR200-225 crores run rate with 10,000+ outlets
order_book.quote: So HoReCa is roughly at a INR200 crores, INR225 crores top line run rate, and we are upwards of 10,000 outlets right now.

capex.statement: AI deployment across sales, operations, procurement, consumer insights, trade spend optimization
capex.quote: We've started our significant transformational journey with AI with about 1,600 / 1,700 salesmen, which we have on date as of now with an objective by December to reach 100% of our salespeople operating.

pricing_cost.statement: Tea pricing increased 8-10% from Q1 to cover inflation; current weekly inflation 2-3%
pricing_cost.quote: We have taken pricing roughly, I would say, between Q1 to now, you would have seen roughly around 8% to 10% pricing, which is in line with the inflation that we've seen in tea.

pricing_cost.statement: Salt price increased from INR30 to INR32 in May, then to INR34 in October
pricing_cost.quote: We moved from INR30 to INR32 for the orange bag in May. October first week, we moved another Rs. 2. So the INR32 has become INR34.

product_mix.statement: 22 new product launches in Q2, 36 in H1 focused on health, wellness, convenience, premiumization
product_mix.quote: We had 22 new product launches in Q2, total 36 for the first half, as I said, focused on differentiated propositions in health and wellness, convenience and premiumization.

product_mix.statement: Launched Tata Salt Plus, Gold Reserve tea, Chakra Select, Kanan Devan Gold, Tata Lyfe alkaline, Tata Spring Alive water
product_mix.quote: We've launched Gold Reserve, which is at a higher than gold. We've launched Chakra Select, which is at a lower than Chakra, trying to grow penetration and market share down south. And we've launched the Kanan Devan Gold, which is at a 1 notch higher than Kanan Devan.

risk.statement: Tea industry volumes down ~6% per third-party data; competitive intensity not a spoilsport this year
risk.quote: I think if I look at overall third -party numbers, it's about negative 6% is what the number shows. So in that perspective, I think we are in a not too bad space.

risk.statement: Mundra port strike (10 days) and shipping disruptions impacted international business in Q2
risk.quote: Mundra, there was a port strike for roughly around 10 days. So shipping got disrupted a bit apart from the fact that now a lot of shipping is getting diverted instead of going through the Middle East, it's going all the way around.

other.statement: Salt market share at 39.8-39.9%, growing share
other.quote: Our market share is now close to 40%, 38.8% -- sorry, 39.8%, 39.9%. So, we are growing market share as well.

other.statement: Sampann categories mostly #1 or #2 on quick commerce platforms
other.quote: Actually speaking, if you look at it, Sampann across the portfolio all our categories are either mostly Number 1 or a few of them are Number 2 positions across platforms.

guidance.statement: Management will operate the business in the medium term within an EBITDA frame of 21% to 24% and grow volume at least 1.5x to 2x the market growth rate.
guidance.quote: I can only say that we will operate the business in the medium term within an EBITDA frame of 21% to 24%. And within that frame, we will keep investing in the brand to grow the volume and gain market share.

demand.statement: Overall volumes may remain soft in the short to medium term; rural and industrial growth engines expected to grow ahead of market.
demand.quote: Overall volumes may remain soft in the short to medium term. However, our growth engines, rural and industrial continue to grow, and we expect these to grow ahead of the market.

margin.statement: Management emphasizes margin per liter as true measure; margins per liter are steady to slightly higher and fully absorbed cost inflation.
margin.quote: While unit profitability margin remains intact. In this time of extreme volatility, for us, margin per liter is a true measure. And on that basis, we have fully absorbed cost inflation. Margins are steady to slightly higher.

margin.statement: Q3 EBITDA margin was approximately 15%, down from 26% in Q2; 9-month EBITDA margin was approximately 21%.
margin.quote: EBITDA was INR262 crores, down 19% year-on-year and 47% sequentially. This translates to an EBITDA margin of approximately 15% for the quarter.

order_book.statement: Industrial business added close to 400 net customers in the last 9 months, driving double-digit volume growth.
order_book.quote: In the full year and9 months that has followed, we have added close to 400 customers net, and that helped us generate new business as well as drive the top line growth.

capex.statement: Historical capex range is INR 100-150 crores annually; will continue investing in growth drivers (rural, industrial) and plant innovation.
capex.quote: Historically, we spent about INR100 crores to INR150 crores, and we spend them on key business drivers of ensuring that innovation in the plant and capacity in the plants is maintained.

pricing_cost.statement: Early pricing actions taken in anticipation of raw material inflation helped moderate margin impact; pricing strategy is diverse across channels.
pricing_cost.quote: The pricing actions that we took early in the year in anticipation of the raw material inflation helped moderate the impact on margins, and we have held market share across categories.

product_mix.statement: Launched Magna CTX circulating oils, Hysol 35 XBB and Hysol 61 XBB boron-free metalworking fluids; localized products for better raw material cost control.
product_mix.quote: We have also launched Magna CTX, a range of circulating oils designed for demanding industrial lubricant applications. We have also localized a lot of our products, and this is in pursuit of getting better control on our raw material costs.

risk.statement: Operating environment remains volatile and inflationary; crude oil fluctuated $80 to $115; margin recovery timing uncertain until volatility subsides.
risk.quote: We expect the operating environment to remain volatile and inflationary. Overall volumes may remain soft in the short to medium term.

other.statement: Plants running at 70% to 80% utilization; range maintained for the full year with seasonal flexibility.
other.quote: I think we've commented on this in the past as well, that our plants run at around 70% to 80% utilization. We are in that same thing.

other.statement: Fast Scan platform verified mechanics increased 24% year-on-year to 180,000.
other.quote: Fast Scan platform has now got verified mechanics, mechanics who have confirmed their identity to Castrol, which is up almost 100,000 to 180,000, which is 24% more than last year at the same time.

guidance.statement: Expects blended EBITDA margin to improve to 6-7% from current 4-5% over next 9-12 months
guidance.quote: So we expect that our business should be generating sustainable EBITDA of 6% to 7% going forward, which right now is 4% to 5%.

guidance.statement: Maintains 50%+ earnings CAGR for next 3-4 years and expects to achieve INR300 crore EBITDA in FY27
guidance.quote: Although we have maintained that the business model is capable of generating 50% plus earnings CAGR for the next three , four years.

margin.statement: Backward integration of coated steel in Raipur (9-12 months) to add 2-3% to blended EBITDA margin
margin.quote: So right now we are buying coated steel from the market, but as our first backward integrati on plant will start in next 9 months to 12 months in Raipur, it will inch up our EBITDA margin by 2% to 3%.

margin.statement: Service center EBITDA ~INR2,000/ton; profiles INR4,000-5,000/ton; solar structures INR3,000-4,000/ton, all stable QoQ
margin.quote: So, EBITDA per ton, if you see, I mean, for service center business, it is around like INR2,000 per ton plus minus, and it's been like stable Q -o-Q.

order_book.statement: Solar order book >50,000 tons with ~1-year visibility; quarterly run rate ~11,000 tons
order_book.quote: We have order book of more than 50,000 tons currently. Okay, we were waiting to book orders, because steel prices were going u p.

pricing_cost.statement: CRCA sheets sell at INR2,000-3,000/ton premium over HR coil; pre-galvanized sheets also planned
pricing_cost.quote: So over HR coil, it is sold around INR2,000 to INR3,000 per ton higher.

other.statement: Dombivli: all specialties started except transplants (next couple of quarters) and radiation oncology (under commissioning, next quarter)
other.quote: Pretty much all. Transplants have not yet started. Should start in the next couple of quarters. Oncology, basic services have been started. The radiation oncology is under commissioning, which should start in the next quarter.

guidance.statement: Revised PAT growth guidance from 80% to 100% YoY for FY27
guidance.quote: Hence, we would like to take our guidance up, which was originally increase of 80% in PAT to 100% of PAT. So we should double our PAT this year versus last year.

guidance.statement: Maintains advances growth guidance at 19-21% and deposits growth at 23-25% for FY27
guidance.value: 19% to 21% for advances and 23% to 25% for deposits
guidance.quote: While we are maintaining the guidance for both advances and deposits at 19% to 21% for advances and 23% to 25% for deposits.

margin.statement: NIM improved to 7.54% in Q2 FY27 from 6.5% in Q2 FY26 due to better loan mix and lower cost of funds
margin.quote: First is our net interest margins at 7.54% for Q2 up from 6.5% last Q2. And one of the contributors to this net interest margin improvement, other than the various components which have gone into build the asset book, we've obviously seen a growth of MFI, which was a negative growth till last year.

margin.statement: Expects NIM to remain around current 7.5% levels in H2 FY27 as asset mix stays similar and cost of funds stable
margin.quote: I think, or rather our expectation is the NIM will be around these levels now. And why I say so like this. See, what drives NIM is what is the composition of our asset book. I don't see any real big drive in MFI, which is our primary large NIM business to go faster.

order_book.statement: Gross advances grew 22% YoY to INR 38,752 crores; secured advances grew 24% YoY
order_book.quote: So first is our growth , which is 22% year -on-year at INR 38,752 crores. Secured obviously growing faster at 24%.

order_book.statement: Q2 disbursements at INR 4,414 crores, up 7% YoY and 5% QoQ
order_book.quote: Our disbursements in the second quarter, which is INR 4,414 crores is 7% higher year -on-year and 5% quarter -on-quarter.

order_book.statement: Vehicle loans grew 76% YoY; expects robust growth to continue via geographic expansion
order_book.quote: I did want to mention it because the vehicle loans have a 76% year -on-year growth. It will maintain very robust growth , not for any change in credit criteria or any aggression on our side.

capex.statement: Opened 40 of planned 78 branches in H1; ahead of branch opening schedule
capex.quote: We planned to open 78 branches. We have finished opening 40. We've also given you how many are new branches, how many branches we're splitting and what the relocations are.

product_mix.statement: Launching Credit Line on UPI (employee POC), Loans against Shares/Mutual Funds in November, Trade FX (AD-1 license) by December
product_mix.quote: On the product launch, this has been going on for some time, but we're finally getting there in terms of we are doing employee POC right now in Credit Line on UPI. So that should go live. We had focused on wealth management. So loans against shares and mutual funds will go live in November. And trade FX, that means our AD -1 license going live, and we're doing export, imports and FX trade. That wi

product_mix.statement: Secured assets at 73.7% of book, targeting 80%; MFI at 26% of gross loan book
product_mix.quote: I'm very glad to report that our best ever PBT is accompanied by growth in secured assets, which has seen a secular improvement year -on-year, and now we stand at 73. 7%. For folks who are joining this call the first time, we have several times said that our intention is to be around 80% of secured assets.

risk.statement: Drought in 226 talukas (Karnataka) and 265 talukas (Maharashtra) may cause minor additional slippages but not material; Iran war impact marginal on portfolio, cautious on shipping-cost sensitive sectors
risk.quote: In Karnataka, we have about 29 districts, 226 talukas. And in Maharashtra, we have about 34 districts, 265 talukas, which have been declared as drought affected. Now combined with that, the SLBCs in these locations have also given us a guidance on moratoriums. But we are handling it on a case-to-case basis as we come. We will expect a little bit of maybe additional slippages on the account of that

other.statement: Credit cost at 0.92% for H1 FY27; expects H2 credit cost lower than H1, full year below 2%
other.quote: If you add up the first half, it is 0.43% and 0.49%. That comes out to a 0.92% for the first half. We do expect second half, which is quarter 3 starting, slippages to get lower. So I would expect that our second half credit cost will be lower than the first half. Overall, certainly below 2%.

other.statement: Unsecured book GNPA INR 673 cr with INR 377 cr provisions; INR 296 cr uncovered but fully under guarantee program (INR 319 cr total)
other.quote: You can see our total unsecured book gross NPA is INR 673 crores. The provisions we have against is INR377 crores, leaving uncovered book of INR296 crores. But this INR296 crores is completely under the guarantee program. In fact, the guarantee program is at INR319 crores.

guidance.statement: FY27 organic revenue growth guidance maintained at low double-digit in constant currency
guidance.quote: we are continuing with our guidance of low double-digit organic revenue growth in constant currency for FY '27.

guidance.statement: FY27 adjusted EBITDA margin guidance raised to 25-26% from 24-25%
guidance.quote: we are raising our FY '27 adjusted EBITDA margin guidance from our earlier 24% to 25% to a new 25% to 26%.

demand.statement: Demand remains healthy with clients prioritising investments showing clear measurable value
demand.quote: Demand remains healthy, and clients are more deliberate in how they make decisions. Clients are prioritising investments that address immediate business pressures and show a clear path to measurable value.

margin.statement: Q2 adjusted EBITDA margin at 26.3%, highest in six quarters, up from 24% in Q1
margin.quote: Turning to our margins, we delivered our highest adjusted EBITDA margins in six quarters, improving from 24% in quarter one to 26.3% in quarter two.

margin.statement: Margin improvement driven by operating leverage, cost management, delivery efficiencies and FX tailwinds despite wage hikes
margin.quote: This improvement reflects stronger operating leverage, disciplined cost management, delivery efficiencies, and favourable foreign exchange movements. This was despite the continued impact of statutory wage revisions and our annual compensation increases.

order_book.statement: Won large payment integrity engagement from Big Ten health plan covering 10M+ members with $10M+ minimum ACV
order_book.quote: This quarter, we won a large payment integrity engagement from a Big Ten health plan covering over 10 million members. This win demonstrates our growing ability to secure larger, higher value engagements. The deal has a minimum potential of over $10 million in ACV and could possibly be much more.

order_book.statement: Deal ACV increased 18.2% YoY to $40.2M across 31 existing and 1 new client
order_book.quote: Moving to new deal wins, deal ACV increased 18.2% year-on-year to $40.2 million, with wins across 31 existing clients and one new client.

capex.statement: H1 FY27 fixed asset additions of INR 1,168M
capex.quote: After fixed asset additions of INR 1,168 million, free cash flow was I NR 5,176 million.

pricing_cost.statement: Statutory minimum wage impact fully baked in: INR 148M in Q2 vs INR 70M in Q1
pricing_cost.quote: The only item I would want to highlight at this point is the impact of statutory minimum wage revisions. Quarter two reflects the full quarter impact of about INR 148 million compared to about INR 70 million in quarter one.

risk.statement: AI productivity gains largely passed to clients; some retained to fund investments and operating costs
risk.quote: On the AI front, like I said, a lot of the productivity gains that we gain from AI will basically be passed on to our clients. However, we will still retain some portion of those benefits, obviously, to fund our investments, and to compensate for the opera ting cost of some of those.

other.statement: Employee strength at 51,486; quarterly voluntary attrition improved to 25.7% from 28.6% in Q1
other.quote: Employee strength stood at 51,486 at the end of Q2. Quarterly voluntary attrition improved to 25.7% from 28.6% in Q1 FY '27 and was also lower than in Q2 FY '26.

other.statement: Top 10 client groups each exceed $20M trailing 12-month revenue for first time
other.quote: At the end of Q2, we had 105 active client groups, and for the first time, each of our top 10 client groups are now more than $20 million in revenue on a trailing 12 -month basis.

guidance.statement: Food delivery GMV growth guidance 18-20% YoY for full year
guidance.quote: And we see us maintaining the 18-20% stand-alone guidance on Swiggy.

guidance.statement: Quick commerce contribution margin guided at 0 to -100 bps with sequential improvement
guidance.quote: What we had called out even in the previous quarter was that we need a bit of reset in terms of our growth. And the 0 to -100 basis points guidance that we have given was keeping that flexibility in mind.

guidance.statement: Adjusted EBITDA improvement of 100 bps guided for current quarter
guidance.quote: So, as I said, it's hard to give a specific number, but what we have guided is for 100 basis points improvement in Adjusted EBITDA in the current quarter.

guidance.statement: Food delivery Adjusted EBITDA margin target 5% of GOV
guidance.quote: 5% of GOV trajectory is an outcome which is what we have stated. And you should continue to see operating leverage in our business, which we continue to accrue.

demand.statement: Quick commerce frequency metrics up 4% QoQ and retention metrics improved
demand.quote: We've seen our retention metrics go up and our frequency metrics have go up by 4% QoQ.

demand.statement: Food delivery back to 20%+ growth in Sep-26
demand.quote: In Sep-26 we were back on 20% plus growth just talking about Swiggy.

margin.statement: Food delivery take rate exceeding 26%, highest ever
margin.quote: You may have seen our monetization, it is at the highest ever with take rate exceeding 26%.

margin.statement: Food delivery added INR 50 crores absolute Adjusted EBITDA in quarter
margin.quote: As you have seen, we've added close to INR50 crores on an absolute Adjusted EBITDA for the quarter.

margin.statement: Quick commerce orders per day per store up ~9% sequentially to ~1,200
margin.quote: Orders per day per store have actually gone up by close to 9%. If you look at even the average NOV per store has gone up by 9% sequentially.

capex.statement: Inventory model transition starting mid current quarter, full transition over 2-3 quarters
capex.quote: We will start the process in the middle of current quarter, and it is expected to fully transition over the next two to three quarters.

product_mix.statement: Differentiated assortment (Noice, Nectr) ~20% of orders, 1 in 8 orders is Noice
product_mix.quote: Nearly 20% of our orders today are on differentiated assortment. This gives us higher retention. And therefore, this helps us in our profitability and our Adjusted EBITDA journey.

product_mix.statement: Toing users 70-80% sub-30 years, younger than core Swiggy demographic
product_mix.quote: Our sense is that for Toing, the audience is far younger. And probably 70-80% of the users are sub 30 years of age.

risk.statement: Toing experiment evaluation needs another 1-2 quarters; investments range-bound
risk.quote: You should probably give us another quarter or two before we call out whether this experiment has worked. But enough we see to be able to give you that direction is the right direction.

risk.statement: Quick commerce focus on resilience and Adjusted EBITDA breakeven before geographic expansion
risk.quote: Our first job is to build a stable, resilient business that has clear line of sight to Adjusted EBITDA zero and the optionality's come after that.

other.statement: New dark store opened when existing store crosses ~2,000 orders/day; reaches 2,300-2,500 orders/day at maturity
other.quote: We typically start the decision to open a new store in that zip code when the store crosses around 2,000 orders a day. And by the time the store is up, which typically takes 2-3 months, those stores start doing roughly 2,300-2,500 orders per day.

other.statement: ~5-7% of dark store network maxing out capacity each quarter
other.quote: As I mentioned, every quarter, roughly 5-7% of network is close to that.

guidance.statement: Aspirational revenue target of Rs 1,000 crores in three years via organic growth, scaling smaller businesses, and inorganic opportunities
guidance.quote: We had aimed that in three years, we'd be at that number. So one was an organic growth, and that's something that we are pushing. Second was to grow the smaller business within the company operation. And that's also what we're trying to achieve in the distribution, in the cleaning and hygiene, as well as in the construction chemical space. So both of these are something that we can do within our c

demand.statement: All end-user segments including refining, petchem, chemicals, agrochemicals, fertilizer, power, steel, cement saw volume growth with no industry slowing down
demand.quote: Most of the segments that we cater to, not only most, all the segments have seen volume growth. Whether it's across the board, there's not one industry that is slowing or which has slowed down. refining, pet chem, chemical manufacturing, agrochemicals, fertilizer, power, steel, cement. Every segment, Janal has experienced growth.

margin.statement: Management expects margin recovery in 1-2 quarters if Iran war diffuses and crude/logistics normalize, with new business at higher prices providing tailwind
margin.quote: if the Iran war diffuses completely and crude and all the logistics lines come back to pre-war levels, we expect that in one or two quarters we should be able to see all the effects of the, you know, cost increases be overcome.

order_book.statement: Order book very strong, continuing well into next financial year; Q4 historically high sales/profit quarter expected to be similar this year
order_book.quote: the order book is very strong. There's also all the continuing orders go well into the next financial year. So there is no doubt that this momentum will continue for the remainder of this year. And Q4, which has historically been a high quarter, high sales and profit quarter should also be nothing different this year.

pricing_cost.statement: Input cost increases (solvents, China-sourced materials, freight, domestic supply disruptions) outpacing price pass-through; sales teams face fatigue from repeated increase requests
pricing_cost.quote: costs have been increasing at a pace that's faster than us being able to pass them on to our customers. There is a little bit of delay in customer acceptance because these increases have been happening repeatedly through this last six months, ever since this Iran war has broken out.

other.statement: Regulatory shift from elemental chlorine to oxidative treatments in public sector contributes only 4-5% to growth uptick; not primary driver
other.quote: There's also certain amount of regulatory change and the move in public sector from elemental chlorine to using other oxidative treatments. But that impact In our performance has been not even 4 to 5%, so that uptick is not driven primarily by regulatory.

other.statement: Competitive landscape largely unchanged; one competitor acquired by larger process chemical firm, transition expected to last few quarters and viewed as positive for Chembond
other.quote: There's been, of course, a little bit of change in one of our competitors who's been taken over by another process chemical manufacturing company. And I think that transition phase will last for a few more quarters and we expect that, and I continue to maintain that that should be a positive for us because it's a larger, better organized company

guidance.statement: Management reiterates it will not give figurative growth targets and will disclose guidelines only after compliance.
guidance.quote: Sir we will not go further on figurative matters. After compliance, I will definitely disclose the guideline also.

guidance.statement: Management declines to provide forward revenue, EBITDA or PAT margin guidance for the next two to three years.
guidance.quote: Sir, let me say first; at present we are not going to give any f orward figure. So, at present, we are not giving the guideline regarding the EBITDA or topline o r bottom line at present right now

demand.statement: Company expects rapid growth to continue, driven by prescription generation model and expanding acute, chronic, OTC and wellness portfolio.
demand.quote: So, we are growing very rapidly and we expect that our hard work will pay off in the future as well.

product_mix.statement: Focus on strengthening acute and chronic therapy portfolio while developing OTC, wellness and service verticals.
product_mix.quote: We intend to strengthen our acute and chronic therapy portfolio while continuing to develop opportunities across all these other categories.

product_mix.statement: Revenue mix: acute therapy ~44%, chronic and semi-chronic ~20%, wellness and OTC ~20%, services ~16%.
product_mix.quote: acute therapy contributed approximately 44% sales, chronic and semi-chronic therapies contributed ar ound 20% sales, wellness and OTC products contributed approximately 20%, and sal es of services represented around 16% of the

risk.statement: Management acknowledges next phase of growth requires careful execution, organisational development and financial discipline.
risk.quote: We believe it gives us a stronger platform from which to pursue a strategic objective. At the same time, we understand that the next phase of growth will require more careful execution.

other.statement: Target 46% geographic coverage across India by March 2027; long-term pan-India footprint by 2029 with product in every medical store.
other.quote: Our target is to achieve a 46% geographic coverage across India by March 2027.

other.statement: Aim to have Aptus products available in all 8.5 lakh pharmacies and medical stores in India by 2029.
other.quote: More than 8.5 lakh pharmacies and medical stores are available in India. So, it will be available in every medical store.

guidance.statement: Expects ethanol allocation of 40-42 crore liters for new supply year starting November 2026
guidance.quote: In addition to that, for the new ethanol supply year, we expect an allocation of at least about 40 crores to 42 crore liters, that's the expectation.

guidance.statement: Targets average capacity utilization of 75-80% going forward
guidance.quote: Going forward, we expect that the capacity utilization increases and we lock in an average capacity utilization of at least about 75% to 80%.

margin.statement: Ethanol EBITDA margin may drop 1-2% from current average for FY27
margin.quote: I'm not be able to give you an absolute number, but once the tenders are located, we might expect maybe a 1% or 2% drop in the EBITDA margins of the average that we've been doing so far.

margin.statement: CBG EBITDA margin track record 60-70%; expects 50-55% going forward
margin.quote: So that's the track record that we've had so far, but you can keep it somewhere around 50%, 55% is what we are expecting.

margin.statement: Q2 EBITDA margin 14.03% due to 25-30% maize price increase; expects recovery in Q3/Q4
margin.quote: While the H1 margin remains healthy, the moderation in Q2 EBITDA margin compared with the first quarter is due to increase in the raw material prices during the quarter of maize went up by 25% to 30%.

order_book.statement: Has 8.5 crore liters pending orders from last ethanol supply year for Oct-Nov supply
order_book.quote: So, we already have about 8.5 crores liters of orders still left to be supplied for the month of October and for the month of November.

order_book.statement: H1 FY27 ethanol sales volume 19.07 crore liters (Q1: 8.29 cr, Q2: 10.78 cr)
order_book.quote: For H1 FY27, we have sold the total volume of ethanol, what we have sold in Q1, is 8.29 crores and Q2, we have sold 10.78 crores. So, for the entire H1, we have sold 19.07 crores liters of ethanol.

pricing_cost.statement: Maize-based ethanol realization ~INR68/ltr; damaged food grains ~INR64; FCI rice ~INR60; blended avg ~INR64-65 vs INR67 last year
pricing_cost.quote: the average realization this year, let's say, maize-based ethanol is at around INR68-odd a liter. And also, there's a ban on sugarcane juice and B-heavy molasses. So, ethanol derived from damaged food grains is at about INR64 and from FCI rice is about INR60. So, I expect an average blended rate of about INR64 to INR65 from the past year, which was at about INR67.

pricing_cost.statement: CBG gas price increased from INR84/kg to INR104/kg (up to INR116-120 for high purity)
pricing_cost.quote: Along with that, the price of the gas has also increased from INR84 a kilo to now it has gone up to about INR104 a kilo. And also, if the purity is higher, we can get a price of as high as about INR116 to INR120 a kilo also.

fund_raise.statement: Expects INR25-30 crores CBG capital subsidy (25% of INR120 cr eligible) by Dec/Jan
fund_raise.quote: So, for the quarter or even say their math of a timeline for the next quarter, first or second month by, sir, we are definitely expecting a INR25 crores to INR30 crores i.e., 25% of INR120 crores means, you can work out to close to INR30 crores of subsidy we are expecting by December or January.

other.statement: Expects additional debt of INR70-80 crores for CBG plants via term loan with GAIL JV
other.quote: and of which we are expecting this debt to be raised to the extent of additional INR70 crores to INR80 crores as a primary transfer of the first disbursement on the term loan side of outstanding along with the JV partner with GAIL.

other.statement: Inventory reduced from INR528 cr (Mar'26) to INR206 cr (Sep'26); receivables from INR406 cr to INR367 cr
other.quote: Importantly, we also see a meaningful reduction in certain working capital items. Inventory reduced to a maximum of approximately will be INR528 crores, in March '26 to INR206 crore in September '26. Trade receivable also reduced from approximately INR406 crores to INR367 crores.

guidance.statement: Aerospace revenue growth target of 4-6x by FY31 reaffirmed
guidance.quote: We are not deterring away from the 4 to 6x the guidance of 2031. So that means that capital will be required.

guidance.statement: Consumer EBITDA breakeven milestone recalibrated; no new date given; aerospace on track for the year
guidance.quote: We are, therefore, recalibrating the milestone. Rather than give you a new date today, we want to take the time to work through the scenarios, particularly the pace of the learning curve in consumer electronics and the volume ramp-up in Mattel, in toys.

guidance.statement: Consumer PAT breakeven expected by FY30
guidance.quote: Look, we have already guided it is going to be FY '30 when we are PAT positive from consumer.

margin.statement: Aerospace Q2 EBITDA INR783 million at ~22% margin, up 24% YoY; H1 EBITDA up 29% YoY
margin.quote: Segment EBITDA increased 24% to INR783 million at a margin of approximately 22%. For H1, aerospace revenue grew 42% year-on-year, while segment EBITDA grew 29%.

margin.statement: Consumer Q2 EBITDA loss INR401 million vs INR77 million loss YoY; H1 loss INR763 million vs INR151 million loss YoY due to expensing of new capacity costs and ramp-up costs
margin.quote: Segment EBITDA was a loss of INR401 million in Q2 compared with a loss of INR77 million in Q2 FY '26 and a loss of INR763 million in H1 compared with INR151 million last year.

margin.statement: Consolidated Q2 EBITDA INR245 million at 6% margin vs 16% YoY; sequential improvement from 5% in Q1
margin.quote: Q2 reported EBITDA stood at INR245 million with a margin of 6% compared to 16% in Q2 last year. The year-on-year change is driven by the consumer business for the reasons I just outlined. And the two figures are, therefore, not directly comparable. Sequentially, EBITDA rose 14% and margins improved to 6% from 5% in Q1, partly supported by other income, which increased from INR67 million to INR106

order_book.statement: Aerospace order book reached USD 1.1 billion, up 9% this quarter
order_book.quote: Our order book reached USD 1.1 billion, up 9% this quarter, alongside further expansion of our portfolio.

order_book.statement: Signed new long-term agreement with 6 Safran entities expanding scope across critical aerospace components including landing gear for Hosur ecosystem
order_book.quote: After the quarter ended, we signed a new long -term agreement with and expand the relations hip with 6 Safran entities. They broaden our scope across critical aerospace components drawing on the capabilities we already built at Belagavi, and they include landing gear contract for our upcoming Hosur ecosystem

capex.statement: INR289 crore of preferential funds allocated to capex (Belagavi, Hosur, consumer), INR100 crore to working capital, INR100 crore to JV investments and strategic initiatives
capex.quote: So see, in terms of overall utilization, about INR289 crores would be allocated towards the capital expenditure, which will include existing aerospace, Belagavi, Hosur as well as some bit to consumer as well. In terms of working capital, we are allocating about INR100 crores towards working capital. And then there will be another INR100 crores towards JV investments and new strategic initiatives,

capex.statement: Promoter group committed INR6,500 million via preferential warrants; INR3,250 million upfront, balance by end of December next year
capex.quote: To support our next phase of growth, the promoter group has committed an investment of INR6,500 million through preferential warrants, reflecting the strong confidence in Aequs ' growth plans and continued commitment to the business.

capex.statement: H1 FY27 capex INR1,597 million; full-year capex may be significantly lower than initial INR660 crore guidance
capex.quote: On the overall capex, if you see first half of the year, we have done about INR160 crores of capex, again, predominantly towards aerospace. And second half, you will see that the capex deployment would be almost equal. So our initial guidance what we had given INR660 crores. We may end up doing much lesser than that.

pricing_cost.statement: Aerospace material costs passed through in long-term contracts; no pricing pressure
pricing_cost.quote: And aerospace continue to perform. We have a long-term contract. There is no pricing pressure because it's a long-term contract. Our materials are passed through. So we don't see that as an issue.

product_mix.statement: Aerospace titanium content increasing; superalloy (Inconel) machining expanding, to be focused at Hosur for engine and landing gear components
product_mix.quote: And also to a certain extent, our titanium content is increasing as a business. So whenever you do titanium content, typically because material side increases. So that also kind of contributes to a certain extent. But that's -- sometimes it's quarter-to-quarter variation that happens.

fund_raise.statement: Promoter group committed INR6,500 million preferential warrants; external equity fundraise still possible in FY28 to support 2031 growth trajectory
fund_raise.quote: We see the significant capital requirement is going to be there still for our growth, what we have seen laid out in aerospace itself. And because we have given an overall guidance of 4 to 6x growth in 2031. So that does require capital requirement.

risk.statement: Consumer ramp slower than expected due to longer qualification cycles, supply chain constraints, weather-related logistics disruption; recalibrating profitability timeline
risk.quote: The direction has been right. Our processes are maturing and our customer relationships are deepening, but the ramp has taken longer than we expected and raw material shortages in toys has slowed it further. We are, therefore, recalibrating the milestone.

other.statement: Aerospace added 9 CNC machines in Q2, total 229 machines, 2.12 million annualized machining hours; utilization 69% overall, 76% in India
other.quote: In the quarter, we added 9 CNC machines, taking us to 229 machines, and 2.12 million annualized machining hours. Even with that new capacity, aerospace utilization was 69%, up 8% year-on-year and 76% in India.

other.statement: Consumer electronics utilization target 40-50% by year-end
other.quote: See, first is coming to the consumer utilization, we still are targeting 40% to 50%. So that still remains there.

guidance.statement: FY27 top-line growth guided at 25-30%, EBITDA and PAT growth at 30-35%
guidance.quote: On year-on-year basis, in FY27, based on our H1 performance, current order book of INR20 crores and order pipeline of INR54 crores business opportunity identified and under progress is close to around INR189 crores. We are confident of achieving a growth of 25% to 30% top line, 30% to 35% in EBITDA and PAT.

demand.statement: 60% of INR54 crore pipeline are repeat orders; tender flow and repeat orders increasing
demand.quote: And the effect of this particular tailwinds we are able to see in the form of number of tenders coming out, good amount of repeat orders happening, and as you can see, the numbers which have been projected during Shashank's talk, there out of that, especially that INR54 crores of orders in pipeline, out of them, 60% are repeat orders, what we are talking about, which we are likely to pick up in 3

order_book.quote: No. INR54 crores what has been put there are the ones very clear orders in pipeline, which are in different stages. Some of them negotiated, awaiting the purchase orders. So, all these numbers of 54 what has been put ar

order_book.statement: Order book of INR20 crore to be billed by mid-February 2027
order_book.quote: See, this order book whatever has been projected here, this has -- we are looking to bill this by worst-case scenario by February 2027. Some of them are some of them are with a minimum delivery schedules, but few of them are system integration orders. All put together, we are working towards concluding and billing these orders by mid of February '27.

capex.statement: Project Udaan civil construction roof of first floor completed; contractor committed to finish by end-March 2027
capex.quote: Construction has started in the AGM meeting. We have put a video also showing the actual construction, what is happening. But as on today, as I'm talking, first floor kind of roof construction concrete is already over, and there as per the commitment given by my contractor, he was supposed to finish it by end of March when it comes to civil construction of, end of March in 2027.

other.statement: H1 FY27 revenue INR34.96 crore (+91% YoY), EBITDA INR7.81 crore (+126%), PAT INR4.76 crore (+151%)
other.value: Revenue INR34.96 cr, EBITDA INR7.81 cr, PAT INR4.76 cr
other.quote: In terms of financials, our revenue grew by 91% from INR18 crores to INR34.96 crores. Our EBITDA grew by a healthy 126% from INR3.45 crores to INR7.81 crores, and our PAT grew from INR1.9 crores to INR4.76 crores in H1 FY2 7, thus registering a growth of 151%.

other.statement: Inventory build-up in H1 due to work-in-progress and pre-ordering long-lead items for H2 deliveries by March
other.quote: So, there are two reasons why it has gone up. So, one, to the extent of work-in-progress and orders on hand. And two, what we have also regularly do is when we have slightly better visibility on an order and since we have to deliver by mid of Feb, what we also do is we anticipate and we pre-order those inventory and keep it on hand because which will have a longer lead time. So, because of that, y

guidance.statement: FY27 AUM growth guidance 25-30%, credit cost 3.5-4%, NIM 14.25-14.75%, opex 8.25-8.75%, ROA 4-4.5%
guidance.quote: At the start of the year, we guided for AUM growth of 25% to 30%, credit cost of 3.5% to 4%, net interest margin of 14.25% to 14.75%, and operating expenses of 8.25% to 8.75%, yielding a return on asset of 4% to 4.5%, and these are return on total assets.

guidance.statement: 3-year vision targets 28-33% AUM CAGR and ROA 4-4.5%
guidance.quote: Beyond this year, our focus remains on building a stronger and more sustainable lending franchise in line with the 3-year vision that we had shared in July, which essentially targets 28% to 33% AUM growth CAGR, return on assets of 4% to 4.5%.

demand.statement: Steady demand in core micro-MSME segments; festive pick-up expected in H2
demand.quote: The grassroot micro-MSME segment in India is showing a steady momentum supported by government initiatives for increasing formalization, and we continue to see this constructive demand in our markets for working capital across our core segments.

margin.statement: Q2 NIM 15.6% vs guidance 14.25-14.75%; upside from lower rate hikes and rating upgrade
margin.quote: Net interest margin was 15.6%, comfortably above our full-year guidance of 14.25% to 14.75%.

margin.statement: Blended cost of borrowing fell 15 bps to 10.63%; incremental cost 10.04%
margin.quote: The overall blended cost of borrowing also, not only the incremental cost, but blended cost overall has declined 15 basis points to 10.63% in Q2 FY27 as compared to 10.78% in quarter 1.

order_book.statement: AUM INR 7,597 cr, up 26% YoY and 4% QoQ; disbursements INR 1,403 cr, up 10% YoY and 15% QoQ
order_book.quote: Our assets under management stood at INR7,597 crores, which is up 26% year-on-year and 4% quarter-on-quarter, keeping us within our full-year guidance of 25% to 30% growth. Against this backdrop, our disbursements for Q2 FY27 stood at INR1,403 crores, up 10% year-on-year and 15% quarter-on-quarter.

order_book.statement: H1 FY27 disbursements INR 2,622 cr, up 15% YoY; 49,000 new borrowers added in Q2
order_book.quote: This took our first half FY27 disbursements to 2,622 crores, which is 15% up year-on-year. Historically, the first half year typically accounts for around 40% of our annual disbursements.

capex.statement: 30+ new branches to open in Q3 FY27; 35-40 new branches and 30-40 splits planned for FY27
capex.quote: In quarter 3, 30-plus new branches will also become operational, and this will further add fillip to our disbursements, and this is as per plan.

pricing_cost.statement: Insurance commission impact absorbable via 50 bps opex improvement, 10-25 bps credit cost drop, 25 bps funding cost benefit next year
pricing_cost.value: 50 bps opex, 10-25 bps credit cost, 25 bps funding cost
pricing_cost.quote: Roughly 50 basis points in OER, 25 basis points in interest rate, and another 10 basis points to 25 basis points in credit costs. This is much more than the impact of the interest rate on our books.

pricing_cost.statement: Opex ratio fell 32 bps to 8.61% QoQ; cost-to-income 49%; AUM per employee up 18% YoY to 0.67 cr
pricing_cost.quote: The operating expense ratio, which fell down to 8.61% in quarter 2 versus 8.93% in quarter 1, so in a single quarter, we have seen a 32 basis points reduction in operating expense ratio. This is the reason our cost-to-income has reduced to 49%.

product_mix.statement: Cattle portfolio 25-28% of AUM; underwritten with high-yielding cattle (4-6 min) and strict verification; performing better than rest of book
product_mix.quote: We still don't want to aggressively grow the cattle book, because cattle book is very easy to grow, but we believe that we want to still maintain that diversification, which is diversified into multiple states, and hold ourselves in the 25% to 27%, 28% range.

product_mix.statement: Gold loan pilot planned in select branches in existing cities; targeting 20% existing customers with gold loans; North India focus initially
product_mix.quote: On gold loans, we realize that our existing micro-enterprise customer, almost 20% of them have some gold loan either before we lent to them or even after we lent to them. So, that's a market that we want to retain and increase our share of wallet with the customer.

risk.statement: Slowed disbursements in drought-affected districts in Maharashtra, Karnataka, MP (18% of AUM); monitoring non-OD collection and bounce rates
risk.quote: Together, these states account for about 18% of our AUM, and we have consciously slowed our disbursements in some of these districts, as we believe that in lending discretion should be a better part of valor.

risk.statement: Mortgage PAR X up ~1% QoQ to ~6%; identified slippages in MP and Gujarat branches; tightened credit policies
risk.quote: On the mortgage front, we have seen that PAR X has jumped by about 1% in the last one quarter, but still the PAR X levels of mortgage today are trending at about 6%, lower than the hypothecation loan, which should be the case, and significantly better than the overall industry averages that we are tracking.

other.statement: Credit cost 3.82% (-21 bps QoQ, -119 bps YoY), within guided 3.5-4% range; expect to trend toward 3.5% by year-end
other.quote: On the credit costs, our credit costs for the quarter came in at 3.82%, which is an 21 basis points improvement from 4.03% in quarter 1, and 119 basis points year-on-year. We are now within our FY27 guided range for credit costs where we had guided for 3.5% to 4%.

other.statement: Collection efficiency: non-OD 99.2%, Bucket 1 52.8%; large states Bihar, UP, Rajasthan performing well
other.quote: Collections remained healthy, with overall non-OD collection efficiency at 99.2% and Bucket 1 collection efficiency at 52.8%.

demand.statement: Monthly SIP inflows steady at about INR 3,900 crore
demand.quote: Monthly SIP inflows continue to remain steady at about INR 3,900 crores.

demand.statement: Nearly 2/3rd of SIP inflows from B-30 markets
demand.quote: Our strong presence across Tier 2 and Tier 3 cities is reflected in the healthy B-30 contribution, with nearly 2/3 rd of SIP inflows originating from these markets

margin.statement: Equity yield ~62-63 bps, debt yield ~34-35 bps, liquid yield ~11-12 bps in Q2 FY27
margin.value: 62-63 bps equity, 34-35 bps debt, 11-12 bps liquid
margin.quote: In Q2 FY27, equity yield would be closer to about 62-63 bps on an average, our debt yields are in the range of about 34-35 bps and liquid around 11-12 bps.

margin.statement: Gross margins across equity, debt, liquid, passive remained stable; gross yields expanded YoY
margin.quote: Gross margins across equity, debt, liquid, and passive strategies remained stable during the quarter, and there has been a continued expansion in gross yields on a year-on-year basis.

order_book.statement: Active equity QAAUM grew 9% YoY to INR 8.99 lakh crore
order_book.quote: As on September 30, 2026, our active quarterly average AUM was INR 8.99 lakh crores, reflecting 9% year-on-year increase

order_book.statement: Passive QAAUM at INR 4.15 lakh crore, up 11% YoY, largest passive manager
order_book.quote: On passive front, we remain the largest passive asset manager with quarterly average AUM of INR 4.15 lakh crore, up by 11% year-on-year

order_book.statement: AIF QAAUM at INR 7,437 crore, up 27% YoY
order_book.quote: Our AIF platform continues to scale well, with QAAUM at INR 7,437 crores, reflecting 27% year-on-year growth.

capex.statement: Invested in cloud infrastructure, AI-driven systems, and new data center going live in couple of months
capex.quote: We are also coming up with our own data center, which is going live in a couple of months. Some of these costs would get moderated as we move our cloud instance to an on-prem instance.

pricing_cost.statement: Revenue neutral from April 1 under new SEBI pricing methodology; no distribution commission change
pricing_cost.quote: we already clarified in last quarter that 1 st April onwards, we are revenue neutral in terms of new pricing methodology of the regulator. So that has been already factored. There is no change in

product_mix.statement: SIF market share ~16%+; 2 of 6 SEBI-approved SIFs launched; more Cat II and Cat III AIFs planned
product_mix.quote: We have about 16%-plus market share in that segment and continues to grow. We have only launched two funds till now and we still have 4 more to go out of the total 6 SEBI-approved options.

product_mix.statement: Launched 5 new products in Q2 including 1 SIF; Magnum Equity Ex-Top 100 Long Short Fund among largest in category
product_mix.quote: During Q2, we launched five new products, including one SIF, further strengthening our overall product suite. Among the filed offerings, both the Magnum Equity Ex-Top 100 Long Short Fund, and SBI Balanced Hybrid Fund saw stronger investor responses.

fund_raise.statement: No capital allocation to AIF as subsidiary yet; starting as own division for some years
fund_raise.quote: We are not looking at capital allocation like a subsidiary kind of thing. We are starting with our own division for some years. On ce it is a full-fledged kind of business unit, then we will think of a substantial capital allocation

risk.statement: Investor sentiment shifting to safety; SIPs and hybrid schemes seeing higher demand amid volatility
risk.quote: In the last quarter, when the market has been volatile and not meeting anyone's expectations, there is a safety feeling coming back to the customer's mind. This is why the SIP inflows are growing. Although markets are quite volatile and I think you can also look at point-to-point NIFTY is coming down with YTD correction of 8.2%, SIP flows are still increasing.

other.statement: Recurring employee cost ~60% of Q2 increase; one-time costs 30-40% to moderate
other.quote: The cost structure which was one-time will go down by 30-40%. So, 60% will be kind of recurring.

other.statement: SBI channel contributes ~20% of net inflows, stable vs last quarter
other.quote: So SBI channel contributes to around 20% of the net inflows, which is also like the same level as AUM, similar in the last quarter as well.

guidance.statement: FY27 leasing target of 6.5 million sq ft, representing 30% growth over FY26
guidance.quote: We had set ourselves a very ambitious leasing target of 6.5 million square feet for this fiscal year 2027, representing a 30% growth to the previous fiscal 2026.

guidance.statement: FY27 development target of 6 million sq ft, with nearly 50% achieved in H1
guidance.quote: We delivered six new buildings spanning 1.8 million square feet, taking our total development completions to 2.7 million square feet in the first half, having already achieved nearly 50% of our fiscal 27 development target, and very confident that we are on track to deliver the 6 million square feet this fiscal.

guidance.statement: Contracted revenue run rate crossed INR1,000 crores
guidance.quote: So that's what I put in my INR1,000 odd crores, the INR1,004 crores of revenue guidance that we are giving on a contracted basis is effectively on the 94% occupancy that we have on our stabilized assets.

guidance.statement: In-city portfolio to deliver ~6 million sq ft over next 3-4 years at 2x-3x rental premium to big format parks
guidance.quote: We expect this portfolio to deliver approximately 6 million square feet over the next 3 to 4 years, while also benefiting from the rental levels that are typically 2x to 3x of those of the big format parks.

demand.statement: Industrial customers accounted for >80% of H1 FY27 leasing, up from ~2/3 in FY26
demand.quote: Importantly, more than 80% of our first-half leasing came from industrial customers, which again underscores the strength of this particular segment.

demand.statement: Demand for Grade A industrial/logistics space remains extremely robust driven by flight to quality, industrialization, and consumption
demand.quote: Demand for grade A industrial and logistics spaces remains extremely robust, driven by the three structural mega trends that we discussed on our first quarter earnings as well. First, the flight to quality, second, the industrialization, and third, the

margin.statement: Q2 FY27 EBITDA margin at 81%, sustained above 80%
margin.quote: EBITDA margins continue to remain strong at 81%.

order_book.statement: Re-leased 1.2 million sq ft in H1 FY27 at 12% spread
order_book.quote: We've also improved 1.2 million square feet of re-leasing at a very healthy 12% spread, which further re-emphasizes the continued rental growth that we are seeing in institutional-grade real estate.

order_book.statement: Leased 2.5 million sq ft in Q2 FY27 across 14 transactions; 4.4 million sq ft in H1 FY27 across 27 transactions
order_book.quote: Your company leased 2.5 million square feet in the second quarter alone across 14 unique transactions and we onboarded eight new customers to our family.

capex.statement: Rooftop solar potential 150-200 MW on 30M sq ft; currently 38 MW operational/under implementation
capex.quote: 30 million square feet today effectively allows me to build anywhere between 150 megawatt to 200 megawatt. We've even allowed to play out the entire roof spaces.
