pricing_cost.statement: Weighted average in-place rent ~INR27/sq ft; incremental big format park rents INR30-35/sq ft; in-city rents 2x-3x big format
pricing_cost.quote: Today we are already at about INR27 of weighted average range across our portfolio. Incrementally, we are seeing this at anywhere between a INR30 to INR35 range on a big format parks.

fund_raise.statement: Raised INR1,650 cr in Dec 2025 and INR2,600 cr in Aug 2026 via IPO to repay INR4,000 cr debt
fund_raise.quote: We had raised about INR16 -- INR1,650 crores in December of the previous year. We raised INR2,600 crores in August this year. The intent was to repay our INR4,000 crores of debt.

risk.statement: Q3 leasing closures may slow due to festivities (Diwali) and global year-end shutdowns
risk.quote: Third quarter typically sees a little bit of slowdown with the festivities, both Indian and international, Diwali coming up and you'll obviously see a shutdown in the global markets from mid-December to early January.

other.statement: Operational area ~31.5 million sq ft; stabilized occupancy 94% excluding ~1 million sq ft recent completions
other.quote: Today we stand at about 31.5 million square feet of completed assets, give or take. Of that, our stabilized occupancy is nearly 94%.

other.statement: Fully paid land bank supports ~30 million sq ft future development (29 million sq ft precise)
other.quote: Today, we have further development potential of nearly 30 million square feet, 29 million to be precise.

guidance.statement: Revenue CAGR of 40-45% expected for FY27, FY28, FY29 vs FY26 base
guidance.quote: So, for FY27, '28 and '29, we expect a CAGR growth of between 40%-45%.

guidance.statement: FY27 revenue growth of 40-45% year-on-year versus March 2026
guidance.quote: For FY27 we expect a growth between 40-45% when compared to March 26.

guidance.statement: EBITDA margin expansion of 80-120 bps over next 4-6 quarters
guidance.quote: Over the next 4-5 quarters, we expect about 80-120 bps increase in our EBITDA margins over a period of next 4-6 quarters.

guidance.statement: Gold price assumed constant at Rs 50,000 per gram (24-karat) for revenue guidance
guidance.quote: Estimating a 40% to 50% revenue CAGR growth for the next two years, we have taken the gold price to be constant at a rate of 24-karat rate of Rs. 50,000.

demand.statement: Shift from invoice sales to job work due to retail customers exchanging old gold instead of cash purchases, driven by gold price rise and PM's appeal
demand.quote: As you say, our company has seen a slight fall in the sales through invoice basis because of the fact that the customers at the retail level have shifted their purchase from cash purchase to old gold. margin.statement: Job work realization fell ~11% YoY (Rs 202 to Rs 178/gram) due to SKU mix shift to plain gold, not pricing change
margin.quote: If we compare our Rs. 202 in the 2nd Quarter of last fiscal year, my job work, my realization has come down to 178. So, this is about 11% fall. So, this is mainly because of shift towards more of plain gold sales and not studded jewelry sales.

margin.statement: Q2 FY27 EBITDA margin 7.24% (down YoY) due to higher plain gold and 18K mix; H1 FY27 EBITDA margin 7.95%
margin.quote: For the 2nd Quarter of the Financial Year 2027, revenue from operations grew 25% YoY to INR 626 crores. EBITDA stood at INR 45 crores, registering a YoY growth of 17% with EBITDA margins at 7.24%.

order_book.statement: Sales office opened in Vijayawada; second sales office planned in Chennai in December (Q3); third in Bangalore in April-May
order_book.quote: With the success that we got in Vijayawada, we plan to replicate the same by opening an office in Chennai in the month of December and another office in Bangalore in the month of April-May.

capex.statement: Hyderabad manufacturing facility commenced operations in September 2026, spread across ~6,700 sq ft
capex.quote: One of the key developments during the period was the commencement of our in-house manufacturing facility in Hyderabad in September 2026. The facility, spread across approximately 6,700 square feet, marks an important step in strengthening our internal manufacturing capabilities.

pricing_cost.statement: Own processing realization fell from Rs 14,500 to Rs 12,600/gram due to lower gold price, higher plain gold share, and higher 18K share
pricing_cost.quote: When we come to the 1st Quarter, we have seen a fall in the gold price as well, and as well as more of a sale of plain gold jewellery as well as a slightly higher sale of 18 karat gold jewellery. And hence the realization per gram has gone down.

risk.statement: Gold price fall of 50% would impact gross margins by only ~60 bps (based on 50% gold price rise FY25-26 expanding margins 62 bps)
risk.quote: When compared to fiscal '25 and '26, in fiscal '25, the average gold price that we sold was about Rs. 8,000 per gram which increased to Rs. 11,950 per gram. So, a 50% increase in the gold prices has resulted to an expansion of margin by 62 basis points. So, yes, from today onwards, if we see a fall in the gold price to 50%, this might impact our gross margins at only 60 bps.

other.statement: Hyderabad facility capacity: 1.5 tonnes annually at single shift, up to 2.5 tonnes at double shift
other.quote: Our current manufacturing facility at a single shift basis can manufacture about 1.5 tonnes annually. And working at a double shift, it can go up to 2.5 tonnes annually.

other.statement: In-house manufacturing volume ramp-up: Q1 13%, Q2 21%, Q3 ~40%, Q4 ~50% of total volume
other.quote: In the 1st Quarter a total of 65 kgs which is 13% of our total volume has been processed in the facility. In the 2nd Quarter this has expanded to 167 kgs which is about 21% of our total volume processed. In the 3rd Quarter we expect this percentage to be close to 40% and in the 4th Quarter we expect it to be around 50%.

guidance.statement: FY27 revenue growth 25-30% and 5-10% margin increment confirmed
guidance.quote: You know, we have given a guidance of 25 % to 30% of revenue growth and a 5 % to 10% increment in the margins.

guidance.statement: FY27 revenue growth guidance 25-30% with 5-10% EBITDA margin increment
guidance.quote: Our FY '27 guidance indicates revenue growth of 25 % to 30% with further improvement in EBITDA margins.

demand.statement: Festive and winter season important; winter sales picked up in October
demand.quote: Also, there is a certain crisis in the market in terms of sourcing because of the crude going up, not just the pricing , but also the availability has become an issue where we think we are well -placed because we have well-planned our inventory and growth.

margin.statement: H1 FY27 EBITDA margin 11.74% up 115 bps YoY; PAT margin 7.63% up 69 bps
margin.quote: EBITDA margin also improved to 11.74% from 10.6%, a year-on-year increase of 115 basis points. Net profit stood at 99.91 million compared to 58.08 million, registering year-on-year growth of 72%, while diluted earnings per share were Rs. 5.68 compared with Rs . 3.3 per share, representing year-on-year growth of 72.1%. PAT margin improved to 7.63% from 6.93%, an increase of 69 basis points.

margin.statement: Quick commerce margins at least 25% cheaper than e-com with higher margins
margin.quote: Otherwise, Quick Comm is at least 25% cheaper and has more margins than e-com.

order_book.statement: White label closing order book Rs 17.8 crore at end March 2026
order_book.quote: The white label business contributed approximately 21% of FY '26 revenue and a closing order book of Rs. 17.8 crores at the end of March 2026.

capex.statement: Ad spend target 4% of revenue; may vary 1% plus minus with quick commerce growth
capex.quote: So, the target is 4% of the total revenue. But if the quick commerce grows faster, 1% plus minus can happen.

pricing_cost.statement: Input costs up 25-30%; pricing increased 7-8%; volume growth ~40%
pricing_cost.quote: So, the product input cost, in fact, has increased by good 25%-30% because of the current global situation. But we were able to consolidate and increase our pricing by approximately 7% to 8%. So, I think the product overall range of the growth is 56%. The total volume growth should be around 40%.

pricing_cost.statement: Plan to increase prices after festive season to cover higher input costs
pricing_cost.quote: So, after this festive season, we want to increase the prices a little to ensure that whatever new input cost is increased should be camouflaged and should be taken care.

product_mix.statement: TRIBE FY27 revenue target Rs 30-35 crore; grew ~2.1x in FY26
product_mix.quote: TRIBE, our sem i-premium bottom wear brand, is being scaled across distribution marketplaces and quick comm. It grew approximately 2.1 x in FY '26, and our FY '27 revenue target is anywhere between 30 crores to 35 crores.

product_mix.statement: Fitness Exchange launch Q4 FY27 with ~100 opening SKUs split apparel/accessories
product_mix.quote: For fitness exchange, our athleisure and sport accessories brand, product development and sourcing is half done, and it is almost at the closing stage, with a planned launch in Q4 FY '27, comprising around 100 opening SKUs, split approximately equal between apparel and accessories.

fund_raise.statement: Preferential warrants 25% converted; balance 75% over next 6-7 months
fund_raise.quote: So, the initial 25% has already been converted. The balance 75%, we have a timeline of next, I think, till May or June, we have the timeline. So, next six to seven months we should be able to convert all of that.

risk.statement: Cash positive cycle expected in 1.5-2 years as quick commerce matures
risk.quote: We have given us a medium-term sight of maybe 1.5 to 2 years.

other.statement: Distribution target 700-800 distributors and 25,000+ retail touchpoints by March 2027
other.quote: With FY '27 milestones of 700-800 distributors and more than 25,000 retail touchpoints by March 2027, we are firmly aligned with those targets.

other.statement: Quick commerce receivable cycle ~45 days
other.quote: With Quick Comm, it is generally 45 days.

guidance.statement: Revenue targets for FY27 and FY28 remain intact
guidance.quote: Both the revenue targets for given for this financial year and the financial year upcoming remain intact.

margin.statement: Management will pass INR300-400 per ton benefit to customers, not retain full INR1,400 saving
margin.quote: We are going to pass INR300, INR400 to them also. So, it's going to be a win-win situation for the company and for the customers, all of us. So, I'm not going to tell you that that entire INR1,400 is going to come to me.

margin.statement: Margin improvement drivers: 35% operating leverage, 35-40% premiumization, 10-20% inventory timing
margin.quote: Sir, I would say 35% would be of the operating leverage, 35% to 40% would be of the premiumization of better rate realization, and the next 10%, 20% is, again, we are being ahead in terms of inventory.

order_book.statement: Customer retention rate 73.6% in Q2 FY27, highest till date
order_book.quote: So, our customer retention rate for this quarter would be around 73.6%, which would be highest till date.

other.statement: New plants expected to reach good utilization in 10-12 months
other.quote: So, whatever new projects we bring, you could expect 10 to 12 months from there to see good utilization out there.

other.statement: Greenfield Metallurgica unit commenced commercial production on 10 Oct 2026
other.quote: Our Greenfield capacity commenced commercial production on 10th October 2026.

guidance.statement: Hospital business expected to contribute INR150-200 crore in FY28
guidance.quote: The hospital business should be able to give us around -- in a range of INR150 crores to INR200 crores.

guidance.statement: FY27 PAT margin target of 11% to 12%
guidance.quote: The margins in '27 would be in 11% to 12%, but with INR150 crores of revenue pumping in into the INR500 crores of the next year, the margins which were envisaged at 14% to 15% should move to 17% to 18%.

guidance.statement: FY28 PAT margin target raised to 17% to 18%
guidance.quote: The margins which were envisaged at 14% to 15% should move to 17% to 18%, and that too on 17% to 18% because it's only 150 versus 350.

guidance.statement: FY28 revenue target of INR500 crore remains intact with improved profitability
guidance.quote: Yes, we are still on track for that, and we are more than confident on that than earlier because with this hospital business starting and, in fact, the first hospital being breakeven an d next five hospitals coming in this quarter itself, that INR500 crores in FY28 is still very much intact with a far better profitability than what was earlier discussed

demand.statement: Hospital demand accelerated launch; first 30-bed Delhi hospital breakeven in September 2026
demand.quote: Our first 30 -bed Ayurveda hospital in Delhi achieved an operating breakeven milestone in September 2026. This is an encouraging early indicator, although we recognize that sustained profitability must be demonstrated over time.

margin.statement: H1 FY27 EBITDA INR14.5 crore, up 47.7% YoY, margin 12.7% (+180 bps)
margin.quote: EBITDA increased 47.7% to INR14.5 crores, and EBITDA margin improved by 180 basis points to 12.7%.

margin.statement: H1 FY27 PAT INR9.25 crore, up 26.7% YoY
margin.quote: Profit after tax was INR9.25 crores, representing 26.7% growth.

order_book.statement: H1 FY27 consolidated revenue INR113.9 crore, up 26.4% YoY
order_book.quote: Coming to the financial numbers for H1 financial year '27, consolidated revenue from operations stood at INR113.9 crores, a year -on-year increase of 26.4%.

capex.statement: Capital allocation priority: hospitals first, US second, no factory expansion, marketing at 40% of product revenue
capex.quote: Topmost would be the hospitals. Second in line is US. Factory, we have no plans to enhance the and put the capital in the factory. And marketing, as I said, we would like to maintain at the 40% level.

capex.statement: Gurgaon hospital opening around Diwali; Dehradun, Amritsar interiors underway; Jaipur, Lucknow closings in 15 days
capex.quote: We are already the Dehradun -- the Gurgaon hospital would be o pening somewhere around Diwali, in next 10 days. In fact, we have two in Gurgaon. Dehradun is under construction. The interiors are going on. Amritsar, too, the interiors are going on. Then we're working on -- very much close to closing two hospitals, one in Jaipur and one in Lucknow, which we would close in next 15 days.

product_mix.statement: Fertility contributes 60% of hospital revenue

product_mix.statement: Men's wellness and de-addiction products growing fastest with highest margins

risk.statement: Lowered FY27 revenue guidance (5-10% below INR300 cr) to accelerate hospital entry for margin improvement
risk.quote: Yes, I am lowering, if you take it that way, I am lowering my guidance with a rider that hospitals were brought in because we thought that margins should improve as such for a company. When I'm lowering my guidance, I'm improving the margins.

other.statement: Next hospitals targeting breakeven in 60-90 days, 25-30% PAT at steady state
other.quote: Per unit breakeven, this hospital took us time, but now the next hospitals which are coming should be breakeven in anything from 60 to 90 days. That's our target. And once 60 to 90 days breakeven is achieved per unit, then coming to the profitability levels in a year's time, crossing 25% to 30% PAT is very much achievable.

other.statement: Repeat customer revenue share 23.5% in H1 FY27
other.quote: 23.5% is what we get from our repeat customers.

guidance.statement: Management stands firm on commitment to reach presales of INR15,000 crores by FY29
guidance.quote: We stand firm to our commitment of reaching presales of INR15,000 crores by FY '29.

guidance.statement: On track to exceed INR10,000 crores business development guidance for the year; already achieved ~INR6,200 crores in 6 months
guidance.quote: In a 6 months' time, as I mentioned, we have guided for about INR10,000 crores. So, we have already achieved INR6,000 crores in a way. But I'm pretty confident that we should be able to cross the INR10,000 crores guideline that we had mentioned at the beginning of the year.

guidance.statement: Management refrains from giving short-term presales guidance for FY27, expects to miss INR8,000 crores target, but commits to long-term presales of INR15,000 crores by FY29
guidance.quote: We will continue to add more value to our investors, stockholders to the project, et cetera, and continue to optimize and improve the GDV and the value. So, yes, I mean, it is not INR8,000 crores for sure for this year. But as I mentioned, we will refrain from giving a clear guidance, and rather I'll be happy giving you a long-term guidance.

margin.statement: Birla Tisya recognized EBITDA of INR181 crores at 28% margin; Birla Navya contributed INR39 crores at 35% margin
margin.quote: In terms of profitability, Birla Tisya recognized EBITDA of INR181 crores at 28% EBITDA margin, while Birla Navya contributed INR39 crores at 35% EBITDA margin.

margin.statement: Project-level EBITDA margins range from 25% to 30%
margin.quote: Our EBITDA margin for every project ranges from 25% to 30%.

margin.statement: Niyaara project margins are 40% and above
margin.quote: Broadly, Niyaara's margins are 40% and above.

order_book.statement: 2QFY27 booking value stood at INR298 crores with Birla Taranya and Birla Niyaara in MMR as largest contributors
order_book.quote: 2QFY27 booking value stood at INR298 crores, with Birla Taranya and Birla Niyaara in MMR being the largest contributors, supported by sustenance sales across our key markets.

order_book.statement: Collections increased 39% Y-o-Y to INR1,465 crores in 1HFY27; Q2 collections were INR752 crores, up 47% Y-o-Y
order_book.quote: Collections increased 39% Y-o-Y to INR1,465 crores in 1HFY27. This Q2 collection was INR752 crores, up 47% Y-o-Y.

order_book.statement: Cumulative collections across projects crossed INR10,000 crores milestone
order_book.quote: We also crossed the landmark milestone of INR10,000 crores in cumulative collection across our projects.

capex.statement: Construction cost expected for full FY27 is around INR1,300 crores
capex.quote: The construction cost, which we are expecting for the entire financial year would be around INR1,300-odd crores is what we are expecting to spend.

capex.statement: Commercial capex of INR1,400-1,500 crores over next 4 years for 1.3 msf building at Niyaara
capex.quote: So, a combination of debt and equity, I mean, which we have around INR1,500-odd crores -- INR1,400 crores, INR1,500 crores.

pricing_cost.statement: Acquisition cost historically 15-17% of GDV added; will maintain similar range for future BD
pricing_cost.quote: Broadly, the acquisition cost would range between what we have been doing in the past. It has been around 15% to 17% of the GDV value –that we are adding.

other.statement: Worli Tower C redesign increases net GDV by INR1,900 crores; launch deferred to Q2 FY28
other.quote: The revised plan has approximately INR1,900 crores of net GDV and is expected to be highly accretive to profitability, while the resultant deferment of the launch to the next financial year may impact current presales.

other.statement: Target to grow commercial portfolio annual income from INR150 crores to INR1,500 crores
other.quote: I think we want to kind of hedge our bets by increasing the commercial portfolio annual income from INR150 crores to INR1,500 crores.

guidance.statement: Reiterated FY27 EBITDA margin guidance of 18.5% to 20% and U.S. exit run-rate of $1 billion annualized revenue
guidance.quote: Yes. So for the -- we are maintaining both the guidance that the exit run rate for the U.S. would be $1 billion. And for the EBITDA guidance for the full year will be 18.5% to 20%. We are not changing the guidance.

guidance.statement: Guided full-year R&D expense at 6% to 7% of revenue
guidance.quote: We continue to guide for the full year expense in the range of 6% to 7% of the revenue.

guidance.statement: Expect sequential EBITDA margin improvement in Q3 and Q4 FY27 to meet full-year guidance
guidance.quote: So right now, what we can say is we are expecting sequential improvement for the remaining 2 quarters of this financial year. And then I think by the start of next year, we'll provide the guidance for next year.

demand.statement: One India branded prescription business grew 15% YoY, outperforming IPM, led by chronic portfolio
demand.quote: In our branded prescription business, we continue to outperform the market, delivering 15% growth, which was led by the chronic portfolio as per IQVIA YTD September '26.

demand.statement: GLP-1 portfolio (tirzepatide) seeing month-on-month growth of 5% to 10%, no saturation expected
demand.quote: And we are seeing month -on-month growth rates of somewhere between 5% to 10%. So we expect that trajectory to continue. Yurpeak has become the second largest brand in the rankings on GLP.

demand.statement: South Africa private market secondary growth of 6.5% vs market 5% per IQVIA MAT August '26
demand.quote: In South Africa private market, we achieved a strong secondary growth of 6.5%, which outperformed the market of 5% as per IQVIA MAT August '26.

margin.statement: EBITDA margin (ex-other income) 18.7% in Q2, up 200 bps QoQ, in line with sequential expansion guidance
margin.quote: The EBITDA margin, excluding the other income, stood at 18.7% for the quarter, reflecting a sequential improvement of 200 basis points. This performance is in line with the guidance of sequential margin expansion.

margin.statement: Gross margin after material costs 64.4%, up 7% QoQ due to improved product mix
margin.quote: The reported gross margin after material costs stood at 64.4%, up 7% quarter-on-quarter, supported largely by an improved product mix.

order_book.statement: Planning 45 to 50 U.S. filings over next 3 years, all complex assets
order_book.quote: We are progressing well on the organic pipeline development with approximately 45 to 50 filings planned over the next 3 years.

order_book.statement: Pipeline includes 3 significant U.S. launches this fiscal year (2 respiratory, 1 peptide) plus 4 biosimilar programs under development
order_book.quote: Our pipeline for this financial year includes 3 additional significant launches for the U.S., which is in line with our previous guidance. This includes two more respiratory assets and 1 key peptide opportunity. Additionally, we have four biosimilar programs under development for global markets.

capex.statement: Expense increase of 4% QoQ reflects planned investment in upcoming product launches and manufacturing readiness
capex.quote: Total expense for the quarter stood at INR3,382 crores, reflecting an increase of 4% quarter-on-quarter. This increase reflects our planned investment in the upcoming product launches and enhanced manufacturing readiness.

pricing_cost.statement: Consumer health operating profitability improved, reflecting strength and scalability of strategy
pricing_cost.quote: Operating profitability improved, reflecting the strength and scalability of our consumer health st rategy.

fund_raise.statement: No fund raise mentioned; evaluating selective acquisition opportunities for complex/differentiated assets in North America/Europe
fund_raise.quote: we are -- we will look at opportunities to acquire assets. We have been selective about that, as we mentioned earlier. We are looking at complex or differentiated opportunities, which are more likely to be on North America side or Europe side

risk.statement: Oncology trade margin cap discussion ongoing; no significant impact expected on business
risk.quote: The one thing which the government had announced was around margin cap on high- priced oncology products, which we -- which will benefit the patients, and we don't believe it will have any significant impact on our business.

risk.statement: Lanreotide not included in FY27 exit run-rate; pursuing Pharmathen remediation and new North America site filing
risk.quote: Lanreotide we don't anticipate being bad for this financial year. We are pursuing two parallel paths. One is to work with Pharmathen for their remediation and representing back to the FDA to resume supplies of Lanreotide from there. Second is a new site, which we are working in North America to file Lanreotide.

other.statement: Pithampur facility received 7 Form 483 observations; no repeats or data integrity issues; working to resolve and convert to VAI
other.quote: U.S. FDA also conducted a follow-up GMP inspection at our Pithampur facility in India in this previous quarter and issued 7 observations in Form 483. We continue to engage constructively with the U.S. FDA and remain committed to maintaining the highest standards of quality and compliance across our network.

other.statement: Debt including lease liabilities INR 699 crores; net cash equivalent INR 9,823 crores as of 30 Sept
other.quote: As of 30th September, the debt on our balance sheet, including lease liabilities, stood at INR 699 crores with a net cash equivalent balance of INR9,823 crores.

guidance.statement: Management expects 25% year-on-year presales growth for full year FY27
guidance.quote: We have been always maintaining that we are looking at a growth of 25%, which we are, again, very confident because H1, there was no major launches and still we could achieve a 19% year-on-year growth in H1.

guidance.statement: Reported margins will continue to converge towards embedded EBITDA margin of presales
guidance.quote: Reported margins will continue to converge towards the embedded EBITDA margin of our presales.

demand.statement: Q2 FY27 presales mix: uber luxury 25%, premium luxury 51%, aspirational luxury 25%
demand.quote: The segment mix of our presales remains well balanced in quarter 2. Uber luxury contributed 25%, premium luxury, 51% and aspirational luxury, 25%.

demand.statement: H1 FY27 presales grew 19% year-on-year to INR1,611 crores despite no major launches
demand.quote: Presales stood at INR824 crores in quarter 2 of FY '27 and INR1,611 crores in H1 of FY '27.

margin.statement: H1 FY27 embedded EBITDA margin expanded 160 bps to 30%
margin.quote: In H1, revenue grew 16% to INR5.1 billion, EBITDA, 23% to INR1.6 billion, with an embedded EBITDA margin expanding 160 bps to 30% and PAT, 20% to INR1 billion.

margin.statement: New acquisitions must meet minimum project-level EBITDA margins of 30% to 35%
margin.quote: Every new acquisition must clear the same filters we have always applied, a high IRR, a high equity multiple and a minimum project level EBITDA margins of 30% to 35%.

order_book.statement: Total GDV stands at INR469 billion with INR260 billion launched or to be launched
order_book.quote: With this addition, our total GDV stands at INR469 billion, of which INR260 billion is already launched or to be launched, providing us several years of launch visibility.

order_book.statement: FY27 launch pipeline excluding Dubai is INR70 billion weighted towards H2
order_book.quote: Our launch pipeline for FY '27, excluding Dubai, stands at INR70 billion and the second half is weighted towards launches.

order_book.statement: Mira Road 2 project GDV estimated at INR1,200-1,400 crores, Andheri West project at INR1,250-1,500 crores
order_book.quote: We are looking at close to INR1,200 crores to INR1,400 crores GDV from there. And Andheri West, the new project once again on the Western Express Highway. There, we are looking at a GDV again, close to similar INR1,250 crores to INR1,500 crores.

capex.statement: Acquired 4.5 acre land parcel at Borivali West through outright purchase for INR80 billion estimated GDV
capex.quote: During the quarter, we have acquired a new land parcel of 4.5 acres at Borivali West through an outright purchase. This takes our assembled landholding at Borivali West from 7 acres to 11.5 acres, and with an estimated GDV value of INR80 billion.

capex.statement: Invested INR3.9 billion in business development during H1 FY27
capex.quote: This surplus was delivered investing INR3.9 billion in business development during the half.

capex.statement: Spent close to INR800 crores on business development in FY26 and INR400 crores in H1 FY27
capex.quote: And you must have seen in the last 2 years, last year, we spent almost close to INR800 crores in business development. And in H1, we have almost spent close to INR400 crores.

product_mix.quote: Till now in Sunteck Sky Park, we have launched 3 towers, of which Tower 3 was launched just a few months back, and it has done pretty well for us. other.statement: H1 FY27 net operating cash flow surplus grew 27% year-on-year to INR3.5 billion, 63% of FY26 full year
other.quote: On cash flows, our net operating cash flow surplus for H1 grew 27% year-on-year to INR3.5 billion, which is 63% of FY '26 record full year surplus, and 45% of collections, up from 40% a year ago.

other.statement: Net debt to equity ratio is 0.09 with strong cash flows enabling continued business development
other.quote: If you see, in fact, we have last -- looking at our strong cash flows and our strong balance sheet, our net debt is only 0.09.

guidance.statement: Targets export revenue of at least INR1,500 crores in three years, potentially INR2,000 crores
guidance.quote: But for sure, we will target in 3 years' time an export of at least INR1,500 crores, if not INR2,000 crores, but INR1,500 crores is visible in 3 years' time for us.

guidance.statement: Guided FY27 top-line growth over 20% and EBITDA per wheel above INR310; H1 exceeded both and management is extremely confident of strong remaining two quarters
guidance.quote: At the start of the year, we guided a top line growth of over 20% and EBITDA per wheel of more than INR310. Our first half performance has exceeded both, and we are extremely confident of having a very strong guidance for the remaining 2 quarters based on what we have achieved in the last quarter.

demand.statement: Alloy wheel volumes ~12 lakh units in Q2, 23 lakh in H1; driven by premiumization, rising EV share, increasing alloy penetration and strong OEM demand; upward trajectory expected to continue
demand.quote: Volumes reached approximately 12 lakh units in Q2 and 23 lakh units for the whole of the first half. Volume growth was driven by premiumization in passenger vehicles and the rising share of EVs in India, while higher aluminum prices also supported revenue. Given increasing alloy wheel penetration and strong OEM demand, we expect this upward volume trajectory to continue.

margin.statement: Q2 FY27 EBITDA margin improved to 12.3% from 9.6% YoY; EBITDA per wheel rose to INR404 from INR242
margin.quote: Stand-alone EBITDA, including other income, stood at INR237 crores, up 107% Y-o-Y. EBITDA margin improved to 12.3% from 9.6% in quarter 2 of last financial year. And EBITDA per wheel rose to INR404 from INR242 same quarter last year.

margin.quote: So I can say that the aluminum segment, which comprised of aluminum wheels and aluminum knuckle is about 40% more than the steel segment, the EBITDA per wheel. So more or less, I can't reveal to you the exact numbers in each segment. But I can tell you that, that's more or less the ratio.

margin.statement: Management expects EBITDA per wheel of INR404 to be sustainable and potentially exceedable; October was a great month and if trend continues Q3 will be better
margin.quote: So going forward, these things, enhanced capacity output from Mehsana, increased demand for CV products, CV is on an absolute tier. And so this is all heralding and exports are doing great. And so all this means that going forward, this EBITDA level of INR404 should be sustainable and perhaps we will exceed that depending -- I mean, for example, October has been a great month. If this trend contin

order_book.statement: Won OEM export certifications for lightweight truck wheels (MAN, Scania, Daimler) after 12 years; volumes to start Q4 FY27 and accelerate next year
order_book.quote: We've won certain certifications for lightweighting wheels, which were very difficult to get by. It took us 12 years to get them, but now luckily or like it has happened. And we have this approval for selling to OEMs like MAN, Scania, all the big guys, Daimler, for example. So that thing is going to play out. It will start playing out in the fourth quarter this year itself, financial year and next

capex.statement: FY27 capex over INR600 crores: INR420 crores for Bhuj facility, INR120 crores for tractor wheel capacity increase of 0.5 million sets in Dappar, ~INR70 crores for machinery replacement and automation
capex.quote: We expect a total expenditure of over INR600 crores in this financial year. INR420 crores is allocated to the Bhuj facility, INR120 crores will go towards increasing our tractor wheel capacity by almost 0.5 million tractor sets in Dappar, and approximately INR70 crores will go towards machineries replacement and automation, which is our big focus area now and has been for the last couple of years

product_mix.statement: Alloy wheels contributed ~45% of Q2 revenue and ~42% of H1 revenue; richer product mix with higher aluminum share drove margin improvement
product_mix.quote: The alloy wheel segment remained our key growth driver, contributing to about 45% of our total revenue for the quarter and about 42% for the first half year.

product_mix.statement: Steel wheel segment seeing increased demand for high vent hole wheels (steel wheels resembling aluminum at lower cost); pursuing opportunity and gaining market share
product_mix.quote: In the Steel Wheel segment, we saw that there was an increased demand for high vent hole wheels. These are wheels that are similar looking to aluminum wheels, but are made out of steel. So the cost is much less than the aluminum wheel, and we are pursuing this opportunity wholeheartedly and gaining market share in this segment.

risk.statement: Freight cost volatility currently impacting exports; Iran war shock withstood; CV and tractor demand could taper from high base affecting EBITDA per wheel
risk.quote: So right now, we withstood the shock of the Iran war, I don't think worse is going to happen. From here on, things are going to get better. So if they don't fall into play the way they are at the moment, then yes, it will affect our EBITDA per wheel

other.statement: Bhuj aluminum wheel plant adds 1.2 million wheels annual capacity taking total beyond 6.2 million; aluminum knuckle facility adds 1.1 million units; knuckle commercial production in Q4 FY27, aluminum wheel start early April next year
other.quote: The aluminum wheel plant will add 1.2 million wheels of annual capacity, taking our total aluminum wheel capacity beyond 6.2 million. With our existing alloy wheel capacity running at near full utilization, this expansion is well timed. The aluminum knuckle facility will have an annual capacity of 1.1 million units. We are on track to commence commercial production of knuckles in the last quarter

other.statement: Mehsana aluminum wheel capacity debottlenecked by 10% to ~5.4 million annualized; will cross 5 million this month
other.quote: We have done a lot of -- necessity is the mother of invention. So we got more orders than we had capacity for, but we were able to debottleneck the factory. And you will be happy to note that we have increased our capacity by 10% in this month of October, we will cross 5 million. So it could be close to a number of 5.4 million annualized basis.

guidance.statement: Raw material basket expected to increase 4-5% in Q3 FY27; NSR planned increase of 4-5% in Q3 FY27
guidance.quote: And our guidance going ahead for Q3 would be a further increase of about 4% to 5%.

guidance.statement: Capex guidance for balance of FY27 is around Rs 500 crore
guidance.quote: This is going to be roughly around INR500 crores for the balance period.

guidance.statement: Volume growth from capex expected at 1:1 to 1:1.1 asset turnover; Rs 1,130 crore expansion underway and Rs 5,000 crore planned in phases
guidance.quote: The volume growth on account of the capex would be roughly around 1:1 the asset turn, which we are expecting rather 1:1.1 you can consider because we are now taking up expansions immediately for INR1,130 crores, which is going on and then thereafter in phases for around INR5,000 crores capex.

demand.statement: Demand healthy and steady for Q3 FY27; Q4 expected to be strong due to OEM year-end closing
demand.quote: We see the demand being steady in Q3. And Q4, as we know, that will be the year-end closing for most of the OEMs also, there will be good demand coming in.

demand.statement: Replacement market seeing healthy growth momentum continuing; TBR high single-digit, PCR mid-single-digit medium-term outlook
demand.quote: So replacement market, we are seeing a healthy growth momentum, which would continue. And Q2 has definitely shown that. We are seeing category-wise, we are seeing a high single digit coming in the TBR. We are seeing a mid-single digit in the passenger car coming in the medium-term outlook.

margin.statement: Consolidated EBITDA margin improved to 7.1% in Q2 FY27 from 6.8% in Q1 FY27
margin.quote: EBITDA margins (Consolidated) were recorded at 7.1% v/s 6.8% in Q1FY27.

margin.statement: Management expects some improvement in EBITDA margins in Q3 FY27 despite raw material cost pressures
margin.quote: So I see that some basic points going forward in Q3, definitely, there would be some improvement in terms of the margins.

order_book.statement: Domestic volumes up 22% YoY (OE 25%, replacement 20%); export volumes up 7% QoQ; 2/3W replacement volumes more than 2x YoY
order_book.quote: Domestic markets recorded a healthy volumes growth of 22%, driven by a robust 25% in OE Market and a similar 20% in replacement markets.

order_book.statement: Highest-ever consolidated revenue of Rs 4,850 crore in Q2 FY27, up 20% YoY; domestic sales up 32% YoY with OE up 65%
order_book.quote: We have achieved our highest-ever turnover of Rs.4,850 crore, up by 20% on a Y-o-Y basis.

order_book.statement: TBR OE volumes up 76% YoY, PCR OE volumes up 35% YoY; EV volumes surged 24% QoQ
order_book.quote: TBR and PCR segments continue to remain the cornerstone of our products strategy with an extremely robust double-digit OE volumes growth of 76% and 35%, respectively, on YoY basis.

capex.statement: Rs 1,400 crore projects recently completed; Rs 1,130 crore expansion underway; Rs 5,000 crore planned in phases
capex.quote: And the 2 nd point is because we have undertaken certain expansion projects for TBR and PCR in addition to what we have completed recently for INR1,400 crores projects.

pricing_cost.statement: Crude-based raw materials constitute 65-70% of basket; carbon black, synthetic rubber, butyl, steel cord all increased YoY and QoQ
pricing_cost.quote: As you know that crude oil-based raw material is almost in the tune of about 65% to 70%. And there, definitely carbon black, synthetic rubber, butyl, steel cord, they have all increased on a Y-o-Y basis and even on a Q-o-Q basis.

pricing_cost.statement: Raw material basket increased ~9% QoQ in Q2 FY27, cumulative ~30% in last 6 months; NSR increased 7% QoQ in Q2, cumulative 11-12% in 6 months
pricing_cost.quote: We have seen the raw material whole basket increased by 9% on a Q-o-Q basis, which is on a Q1 to Q2 basis. We have seen, obviously, because of the inflationary pressure and supply chain constraint because of the West Asia. Cumulatively, we have seen a staggering 30% increase in the last 6 months.

product_mix.statement: Premium SKUs (16 inch+) constitute ~30% of passenger line volumes in H1 FY27, growing at ~20% CAGR over 2-3 years
product_mix.quote: At JK Tyre, nearly 30% of passenger line volumes sold in H1 are towards premium SKUs i.e. 16 inch & above tyres. This segment has maintained a high CAGR of nearly 20% over the past 2-3 years.

product_mix.statement: Standalone revenue mix: replacement 60%, OEM 30%, exports 10%; category mix: TBR 56%, PLR 28%, 2/3W 6%, non-truck bias 10%
product_mix.quote: Market mix for the replacement market mix is 60%, the OEM is 30% and export is 10% of the total revenue on standalone basis.

risk.statement: West Asia conflict creating inflationary pressures via commodity prices and supply chain disruptions; raw material costs up 30% in 6 months
risk.quote: The steep increase in the prices of key raw materials due to West-Asia crisis and continued volatility have triggered the inflationary pressures, impacting the profitability margins in the near term.

other.statement: Capacity utilization in India above 90% across key segments including TBR, PLR, 2/3W
other.quote: Capacity utilization levels in India remained high at above 90% across key segments including TBR, PLR, 2/3W etc.

other.statement: JK Tornel Mexico-to-US exports showing triple-digit volume growth QoQ; expecting normal sales comparable to last year by Q4 FY27
other.quote: And just to add to it that –sales from Mexico to U.S., which we call it as an export from Mexico, there we've had a triple-digit growth in terms of volume push.

guidance.statement: H2 FY27 expected to be similar or slightly better than H1 based on current order positions
guidance.quote: Right. So the H2 for the company is looking very similar or if possible, slightly better than H1, considering the current order positions, etcetera, that the company is enjoying.

demand.statement: Global food colors market USD3.5 bn in 2025, projected USD5.6 bn by 2033 at 5.9% CAGR; India growing 7-9% annually
demand.quote: The global food colors market siz e was valued at USD3.5 billion in 2025 and is projected to grow to USD3.7 billion in 2026, all the way up to USD5.6 billion by the year 2033, which means at a CAGR of 5.9% from '26 to '33.

demand.statement: Strong customer demand and acceptance for CoatIcon; vendor approvals underway with domestic and international pharma companies
demand.quote: We have been experiencing strong customer demand and acceptance for our products. And we are aggressively following up on the vendor approval process for these products with several prestigious pharmaceutical companies domestically and internationally.

margin.statement: Q2 FY27 EBITDA INR26.4 cr, up 49.2% YoY; PAT margin 12.9% vs 14.1% YoY
margin.quote: The EBITDA stood at INR26.4 crores compared to INR17.7 crores for the corresponding quarter last year, thus registering a growth of 49.2% year-on-year.

margin.statement: H1 FY27 EBITDA INR52.4 cr, up 37.1% YoY; PAT INR34.7 cr, up 49.3% YoY
margin.quote: The EBITDA stood at INR52.4 crores versus INR38.2 crores for the half year ended September '26, which is an increase of 37.1% year -on-year.

capex.statement: Dahej expansion capex INR75-85 cr, construction starts Q4 FY27, commissioning mid-to-end FY28
capex.quote: Expected investment also, I have informed you all of around INR75 crores to INR85 crores. And the targeted commissioning would be somewhere in the middle to end of FY28, which is when this facility is expected to come in commercial production.

capex.statement: CoatIcon capex INR25-35 cr at Roha, starting within 2-3 months
capex.quote: And that too, we will be starting within the next 2 to 3 months. But there, the investment is not so much. It will be to the tune of INR25 crores to INR35 crores.

pricing_cost.quote: For example, we have a very big customer in the U.S. and the outward freight to Chicago, which used to be around USD2,000 to USD2,200 during the quarter in question was around USD10,000 to USD11,000. so 5x, this is an extreme example, but freight costs to other long destinations have increased at least 3x to 4x in some cases.

risk.statement: Middle East conflict disrupting shipping, raising freight 3-5x, increasing energy/input costs, hurting export competitiveness and working capital
risk.quote: International shipping has become more expensive an d unpredictable that insurance premiums have increased, vessels have had to reconsider their routes, delivery schedules have become uncertain, cost of energy and essential industrial inputs have risen very sharply.

other.statement: Dahej full capacity utilization targeted in FY27; effective capacity 7,500 tons at 90% utilization with current product mix

other.statement: Dahej ETP upgrades to add 50-75 tons per month from Q4 FY27
other.quote: Also, additionally, as far as the Dahej facility is concerned, we are making certain changes to our effluent treatment plant and the way it functions, which will also have an impact in increasing the volumes manufactured out there by about 50 to 75 tons per month.

guidance.statement: FY27 global advances growth target 15-16% and global deposits growth target 16-17%
guidance.quote: Against this backdrop, our guidance for FY27 is - global advances to grow by 15-16%, and global deposits by 16-17%.

order_book.statement: Total credit pipeline ~Rs 86,000-87,000 crore including corporate Rs 65,000 crore, RAM Rs 20,000 crore, supply chain Rs 4,000 crore, digital Rs 3,000 crore
order_book.quote: So in total, if you see the pipeline, which is a very secular pipeline, not only corporate but also RAM, digital lending, pool & co-lending and also supply chain, we have a total pipeline of somewhere around Rs. 86,000-Rs. 87,000 crores total, including corporate credit.

capex.quote: Investment in AI. So, frankly speaking, we have just approved our AI policy from our Board as per the RBI guidelines. We have already started scouting for certain AI kind of features which are there. But at a very preliminary level, we already have now this, our Data Lake project in which we are using AI as a predictive AI, not a generative AI, as a predictive AI kind of thing which is there. The

capex.statement: Corporate credit pipeline includes Data Center, EV, batteries, renewables, infra, steel, cement, textile; sanctions and in-principle approvals given for AI/GPU capex both infra and hardware

guidance.quote: In H2 at this point of time based on all the information available, our margins are expected to be in the normal kind of a range as per the historical levels. We are not expecting significant any adverse factors in either revenues or any kind of margin, which you refer to.

capex.statement: Maintenance and debottlenecking capex of INR50-70 crores annually, additional projects to be announced when approved by parent company and Board

capex.statement: Evaluating additional capex for parent company's global needs; will update when approved by parent and Board.

product_mix.statement: Key specialty brands (SumiMax, Meshi, Excalia Max, Portion, ProGibb, Nature Dip, TriBasic Copper) grew ~22% in value in H1 FY27 despite weak monsoon.

fund_raise.statement: No plan to return INR2,500 crores cash to shareholders currently, believe growth opportunities in India agro business are attractive, Board will decide future deployment

risk.statement: Growth acceleration depends on external environment support; internally channel, team, fundamentals strong with product launches lined up for next 2 years

other.statement: Innovation turnover index (new product revenue share) at high single digits, targeting 9-10% year-on-year.

guidance.statement: Management declined to provide specific revenue growth guidance for the next 3-5 years, focusing instead on qualitative growth.
guidance.quote: As of now, we can't really give that future guidance. We can't just set those numbers because we are just focused on delivering qualitative growth.

guidance.statement: Management stated they are not giving exact growth rate guidance for the next 5 years.
guidance.quote: We are not giving exact guidance right now. As you know, I just entered the job, but what I can say is that we are consistently going to expect growth, both organically and inorganically.

demand.statement: Demand remains healthy across all industry segments except healthcare compliance

order_book.statement: Seven consecutive quarters of >6% sequential operating revenue growth; healthy order pipeline and demand

pricing_cost.statement: No pricing pressure observed; revenue growth outpaces headcount growth; profit increasing

risk.statement: Macro environment (Trump government) and visa norms not materially affecting business due to offshore-heavy model (<50 onsite employees out of ~1,900)

guidance.statement: October disbursements ~Rs 550 crores (muted due to holidays); expect pickup in Nov-Dec to achieve good growth over Q2

guidance.statement: Expect flattish credit slippages and credit cost for rest of FY27 despite industry headwinds

guidance.statement: Confident of comfortably crossing AUM growth guidance given for FY27

margin.statement: NIM stable at 19.87% vs 19.97% QoQ, up 16 bps YoY; cost of funds on book eased to 8.78% from 8.80%

margin.statement: Yield increase of 1% on incremental loans will take 24-36 months to fully reflect on book; book is fixed rate so existing yields unchanged

Now, for that to get absorbed on the book will take 8 quarters or so. So you will not see any meaningful impact of the yield increases on the yield for this year, but then it will gradually keep going up.

pricing_cost.statement: Incremental yield hike of ~1% (100 bps) effective Oct 2026 across risk categories; yields to move from 21-23% to 22.5-23.9% range

product_mix.statement: Top-up loans ~10-15% of disbursements (~Rs 200-300 crores); incremental disbursal on top-ups ~50% of outstanding; minimum 12-18 months vintage, no DPD threshold breach, credit score not deteriorated

And roughly, the incremental disbursal on these top-up loans will be anywhere around 50%.
