capex.statement: Capex Rs 214 cr in H1 FY27 vs Rs 163 cr in Q2 FY26, at 4.9% of revenue
capex.quote: Our CAPEX spent during the quarter has increa sed to Rs. 214 crores in H1 FY27 as compared to Rs. 163 crores in Q2 F Y26. The CAPEX as a percentage of revenue is 4. 9% of the total revenue

product_mix.statement: Chronic share ex-BSV expanded 80 bps YoY to 37.4% in Q2 FY27, driven by cardio, anti-diabetic, respiratory outperformance
product_mix.quote: our chronic share excluding BSV expanded by 80 bps year -on-year to 37.4 % led by 1.1x outperformance in cardio and anti -diabetes excluding tirzepatide and a strong 1.9x outp erformance in chronic respiratory during the quarter.

product_mix.statement: New divisions planned in cardio, gastro, dental; Vistaar multi-therapy division expanding
product_mix.quote: While we are expanding our recently launched multi-therapy mass-market division - Vistaar, we are also progressing towards the launch of new divisions in cardio , gastro and dental therapies.

risk.statement: Monsoon weakness had limited impact as growth driven by chronic, gastro, vitamins not season-dependent
risk.quote: We have seen our growth trend in last quarter, it has not been based on anti -infectives, if you see. So, seasonality and monsoon affects more or less, anti-infective on acute part. But our growth has been dominated by chronic part mostly, and to some extent, gastro and multivitamins, which is not dependent on season.

other.statement: Net debt reduced to Rs 2,639 cr as of Sep 30, 2026, net debt/EBITDA 0.6x, on track to repay acquisition debt by FY28
other.quote: In line with our prudent financial strategy , we have reduced our net debt to Rs. 2,639 crores as on 30th September 26 resulting in the net debt to adjusted EBITDA ratio of 0.6x in Quarter 2 FY27 on trailing 12-month basis. We remain on track to repay the acquisition related debt by FY28.

other.statement: Gynecologist coverage increased from 33,000 to 37,000 in 18-24 months, IVF clinic expansion including chains
other.quote: Secondly, we've also increased the gyneac coverage over the last 18 -24 months from 33,000 to now 37,000. And also we've been expanding our IVF coverage, especially into, the IVF clinics like Indira and the chains.

guidance.statement: Guides 5-7% quarterly AUM growth going forward
guidance.quote: We continue to guide for a 5% to 7% growth on a quarterly basis from here on.

guidance.statement: Guides 25 bps Opex reduction for FY27
guidance.quote: We continue to guide for a 25 basis reduction in Opex for FY '27.

guidance.statement: Expects credit cost to stabilize or reduce from current 1.37%
guidance.quote: We are at 1.37% now, we should stabilize here or possibly reduce unless something drastically changes in the environment.

guidance.statement: Expects ROA to hold around 4.5-4.6% in near term
guidance.quote: Over a short period, we think we should be able to hold on to this.

margin.statement: Yields at 18%, up 10 bps Q-o-Q; cost of funds at 8.41%
margin.quote: Yields held up at 18%, up 10 basis points, while our cost of funds stood at 8.41%.

margin.statement: Raised PLR by 25 bps in October to pass on higher borrowing costs
margin.quote: We did a PLR increase of 25 basis points this month.

margin.statement: Spreads at 9.6%, above guided 9-9.25% range
margin.quote: Spreads came in at 9.6%, up from 9.4% last quarter and above our guided range of 9%.

order_book.statement: AUM at INR 12,592 crores, up 6% Q-o-Q and 27% Y-o-Y
order_book.quote: Overall, our AUM stood at INR 12,592 crores, up 6% Q-o-Q and 27% Y-o-Y.

order_book.statement: MSME AUM at INR 9,669 crores, up 18% Y-o-Y and 4.3% Q-o-Q
order_book.quote: Our MSME AUM is at INR 9,669 crores, which is 77% of our AUM with a growth of 18% on a Y-o-Y basis and 4.3% on a Q-o-Q basis.

order_book.statement: MSME disbursements grew 6% Q-o-Q to INR 855 crores
order_book.quote: MSME disbursements grew 6% in the quarter to INR 855 crores.

capex.statement: Added 1 branch in Q2, 6 in H1; total 257 branches
capex.quote: We upfronted the branch expansion in H2 of FY '26 and therefore, we have only added 1 branch during the quarter and 6 branches in the half year, bringing the total branch count to 257 as on September 2026.

pricing_cost.statement: Competitive intensity rising in gold loans, pricing rationalization likely
pricing_cost.quote: Competitive intensity in gold is rising and some pricing rationalization is likely.

product_mix.statement: Repositioned from sub-INR 7 lakh to INR 10-25 lakh+ secured MSME segment
product_mix.quote: We have repositioned our lending mix, strengthened our focus on secured MSME customers, and are now seeing the early benefits of that transition.

other.statement: Gold loans adding ~INR 40 lakhs net growth per branch per month
other.value: INR 40 lakhs per branch per month
other.quote: Each branch is adding approximately INR 40 lakhs a month in net growth, that's roughly INR 1.2 crores per branch per quarter.

other.statement: Gold loan customers have low overlap with MSME borrowers (~7-8%)
other.quote: The total exposure that they have to gold loan is in single digits, probably 7% or 8% of them have a gold loan.

guidance.statement: FY27 consolidated EBITDA guidance around INR3,000 crores
guidance.quote: So that is where on a fulsome basis, we can say that around about INR2,950 crores to INR3,000 crores range, which is there, we are targeting to end FY27.

guidance.statement: FY27 logistics EBITDA margin guidance revised to 28% from 24%
guidance.quote: In line with the accounting treatment for the specialized rakes business, we have revised the FY27 logistics EBITDA margin guidance to 28% from 24%, while retaining the overall logistics EBITDA target of INR400 crores.

guidance.statement: FY27 port EBITDA expected around INR2,550-2,560 crores
guidance.quote: From a port perspective, instead of INR2,600 crores, maybe we may end up somewhere around about INR2,550 crores to INR2,560 crores.

guidance.statement: FY27 domestic cargo growth expected 8-10% YoY in H2
guidance.quote: And Y-o-Y, it would be broadly in the same range. That's what we expect between 8% to 10%, that's what we would expect in this H2 period.

demand.statement: India operations grew 10% YoY in H1 FY27 vs industry 5%
demand.quote: During H1 FY27, we handled 60.5 million tonnes of cargo, including 29.4 million tonnes in Q2, and our India operations grew 10% year-on-year, significantly ahead of industry growth of 5%.

demand.statement: Third-party volumes in India grew 11% YoY in H1 FY27
demand.quote: In our India operations, third-party volumes reached 28.1 million tonnes, registering growth of 11% year-on-year.

demand.statement: Navkar domestic cargo volumes grew 26% YoY, EXIM volumes grew 7% YoY in H1 FY27
demand.quote: Navkar Corporation delivered another strong performance during the period, with domestic cargo volumes growing 26% year-on-year and EXIM cargo volumes increasing 7% year-on-year in H1 '27.

margin.statement: Port segment EBITDA margin 49.4% in Q2 FY27 vs 53.1% YoY
margin.quote: Operational EBITDA for the port segment stood at INR594 crores, up from INR585 crores. The EBITDA margin was 49.4% versus 53.1% a year ago, the dip in port EBITDA margin was primarily driven by absence of volume, contribution from Fujairah and incremental volumes coming from coal terminals like Paradip Coal, Ennore Bulk, Mangalore Coal and Tuticorin Bulk Terminals.

margin.statement: Logistics segment EBITDA margin expanded to 29% from 15% YoY in Q2 FY27
margin.quote: Operating EBITDA for the logistics segment stood at INR81 crores, up from INR25 crores, representing a 3.3x increase Y-o-Y. EBITDA margin expanded to 29% from 15%, driven by the growing contribution from rail logistics business.

margin.statement: Rail rake business EBITDA margin around 90%
margin.quote: The EBITDA margin is around 28% overall, whereas the margins for the rake business stood at around 90%, because in the revenue part, we only take the premium and the rebate. The haulage charges are netted off.

order_book.statement: H1 FY27 cargo handled 60.5 MTPA, Q2 FY27 29.4 MTPA
order_book.quote: During H1 FY27, we handled 60.5 million tonnes of cargo, including 29.4 million tonnes in Q2.

order_book.statement: Navkar domestic cargo 459,000 MT in Q2 FY27, up 16% YoY
order_book.quote: Domestic cargo volumes stood at 459,000 metric tonnes, up 16% compared with the same period last year.

order_book.statement: Navkar EXIM volumes 88,000 TEUs in Q2 FY27, up 12% YoY
order_book.quote: EXIM volumes reached 88,000 TEUs, representing 12% Y-o-Y growth.

capex.statement: Cumulative capex spent INR8,250 crores up to September 2026
capex.quote: The company has incurred a cumulative capex outlay of approximately INR8,250 crores up to September '26, including INR1,500 crores spent during the quarter towards ongoing and existing growth projects.

capex.statement: Committed capex orders of INR6,000 crores placed for machinery and civil work
capex.quote: In addition, the company has already committed a further INR6,000 crores of capex by placing orders for machinery, long-lead items and other civil work towards ongoing projects across port and logistics businesses.

capex.statement: Outstanding capex creditors of nearly INR950 crores
capex.quote: Further, the company has an outstanding capex creditors of nearly INR950 crores.

risk.statement: Paradip Iron Ore volumes impacted by transportation moisture limit restrictions after ship sinking incident
risk.quote: So actually, if you remember on August 22, ship sank of the coast of Paradip around 240 nautical miles of Paradip Port, carrying iron ore. This was not from our terminal, but it was carrying iron ore and it sank in the coast there. So after that, there's a concept called transportation moisture limit, which is applicable for iron ore traffic. So there has been very -- because of the rainy season.

risk.statement: Fujairah operations disrupted, insurance claims pending war declaration by state
risk.quote: No. See, claims are still being assessed by the insurance company. One is obv iously forensic study and all has been done on that. They are also awaiting for the state to declare whether it is a war or not. So that is one fundamental thing which the insurance agencies are awaiting

other.statement: Rail rake fleet expanded from 42 to 78 rakes in Q2 FY27
other.quote: Our rail rake fleet expanded from 42 rakes in Q1 FY27 to 78 rakes currently, reflecting the rapid scale-up of our logistics business.

other.statement: Target to increase rail rake fleet to at least 110 rakes by March 2027
other.quote: We remain on track to further increase the fleet to at least 110 rakes by March '27.

demand.statement: Ather inquiries up 109% YoY to ~10 lakh; preorders up 108% YoY to ~1.8 lakh in Q2 FY27
demand.quote: Ather inquiries were up even more at about 109%, crossing 10 lakh inquiries for Q2 FY27. And preorders were up at about 108% year-on-year, hitting about 1.8 lakh preorders in Q2 FY27.

demand.statement: Industry E2W registrations grew 82% YoY to ~6 lakh units in Q2 FY27; pan-India penetration crossed 10% for the first time at 11.2%
demand.quote: industry registrations hitting a growth of 82% year-on-year, netting out at about 6 lakh sales for the entire quarter.

margin.statement: Structural margin improvement of 5.3% vs Q4 FY26 from price hikes and VAVE; commodity inflation hit 9.4%; SKU management added 2.7% temporary lever
margin.quote: All of that put together has given us a 5.3% improvement in gross margin. Commodity inflation has come much worse than we would have liked, at a 9.4% hit to gross margins overall. But very smart SKU management by the teams have yielded and has created -- essentially opened up a new lever for us in the business, and it's improved margins by 2.7% in Q2.

margin.statement: Average gross margin (AGM) at 24% in Q2 FY27, up 1.6% from Q1 FY27; H1 FY27 AGM at 23%; EBITDA improved 1,450 bps YoY to +4.9%
margin.quote: Netting out Q2 FY27 AGM at 24%, which is a 1.6% improvement over Q1 FY27, I think roughly, yes.

order_book.statement: Wholesale volumes grew 42% YoY to 93,000 units; registrations up 60% YoY to 92,500 units in Q2 FY27
order_book.quote: Wholesale volume grew from 65,000 units same time last year to 93,000 units in Q2, 42% growth year-on-year.

capex.statement: AURIC Phase 1 base capacity of 42,000 units/month to finish capex installation by Q4 FY27; trial production starting in next few weeks
capex.quote: AURIC Phase 1, which is going live and will finish complete installation of its capex by Q4 FY27, adds an incremental 42,000 units.

pricing_cost.statement: No further price hikes planned in Q3 FY27; commodities appear flat recently but volatile; Konarc offers better unit economics than Rizta
pricing_cost.quote: No, we are not taking any more price hikes in Q3. As I guided the quarter before, we will stay put with these prices for a while. Let Konarc also stabilize for the first next few quarters. At this point, commodities seem to be on balance flat.

pricing_cost.statement: Weighted average ex-showroom price rose from INR 150,000 in Q4 FY26 to INR 164,000 in Q2 FY27 (+INR 14,000); AtherStack Pro attach rate 94%; non-vehicle revenue 15%
pricing_cost.quote: our average ex-showroom price across the country -- weighted average ex-showroom price average was roughly about INR150,000 in Q4 FY26, including Pro Pack sales that we do, Ather Pro Pack sales that we do. That number for Q2 FY27 came in at INR164,000, so INR14,000 increase in average ex-showroom price.

product_mix.statement: Konarc launched in phased manner: mid variants (SR2, SR3) first in North/West markets; entry variant (SR1) by Q4 FY27 when AURIC capacity available; high-end Z variant later
product_mix.quote: So we changed the sequence a little bit, which is why Konarc's mid variants, SR2 and SR3 have gone live today. SR1 will go live a few months later. It will go live by Q4. And SR1 going live is the one that we obviously believe can drive a much larger volume.

product_mix.statement: Konarc like-to-like a few thousand rupees cheaper than Rizta at launch; long-term estimate 6-7% better gross margins vs Rizta
product_mix.quote: Konarc like-to-like is a few thousand rupees cheaper compared to Rizta already right off the bat. And we believe that with stabilizing production, this difference will expand quite materially. Again, it's -- sorry, Gunjan, it's very, very variant dependent, but I would not be surprised if a like-to-like version of Konarc is 6%, 7% better in gross margins to Rizta in the long-term.

risk.statement: Current demand trajectory implies ~20,000 units/month unrealized retail; even with 77,000 units/month capacity (Hosur + AURIC base), limited headroom if demand at 50-60k/month
risk.quote: on current demand trajectory from the current stores, our team's internal estimate is that we have roughly about 20,000 units per month of unrealized retail that we are not tapping into yet.

risk.statement: Commodity costs (aluminum, copper, plastics, memory) worse than expected; aluminum and copper elevated due to geopolitical and AI demand; memory remains expensive with no near-term solution
risk.quote: Q2, though in the last few days, it's showed some signs of cooling down, so fingers crossed. Copper has run really far ahead, particularly because of prebuying by U.S. and much higher AI demand. Plastics also remained disrupted for much longer because of the Hormuz crisis. I'm again hoping that, that peak is hopefully not like -- hopefully behind us now. Unfortunately, memories continue to be real

other.statement: Tier 2 city penetration rising fastest, especially in Middle India (Maharashtra, Madhya Pradesh) at ~18-19%; not present in rural markets yet
other.quote: Particularly in the western part of the country, in places like Maharashtra, Madhya Pradesh -- sorry, particularly in Middle India by our definitions, we are seeing phenomenal Tier 2 penetrations. I think Tier 2 penetrations in Maharashtra at about 18%, 19%.

other.statement: Dealer network expansion to restart aggressively from end of Q3 FY27; hundreds of LOIs held back; noticeable numbers from Q4 FY27
other.quote: expect us to start focusing on network expansion in a big way from the coming -- actually from pretty much end of this quarter itself. So you will start seeing noticeable numbers from Q4 there.

guidance.statement: Full-year FY27 EBITDA margin guidance maintained at 17-19%
guidance.quote: We are firmly on track to meet our full year FY27 EBITDA margin guidance of 17% to 19% and you will start seeing further improvements in the balance year.

guidance.statement: Full-year FY27 pre-sales growth guidance maintained at minimum 20%
guidance.quote: We remain firmly on track to achieve our full-year guidance of 20% minimum pre-sales growth, return on capital employed of 20% and our EBITDA margins for the year will range between 17% to 19% and the PAT margin will be 9% to 10%.

guidance.statement: Next 5-year pre-sales CAGR target of approximately 20%
guidance.quote: So, you can expect an approximately 20% CAGR as far as pre-sale is concerned over the next 5 years.

margin.statement: Q2 FY27 EBITDA margin improved to 15% from 14% YoY
margin.quote: And through an optimized product mix and disciplined cost management, our EBITDA also rose from 14% to INR115 crores with margins now at 15% as compared to 14% in the corresponding quarter.

margin.statement: Margins expected to normalize progressively as more projects reach mid-stage
margin.quote: While our margins naturally fluctuate by project phase due to upfr ont marketing and construction setup costs, they are expected to normalize progressively as more of our projects go in mid-stage as this year progresses and moves into next year also

order_book.statement: Total portfolio GDV stands at approximately INR52,000 crores including INR8,500 crores added in H1 FY27
order_book.quote: Our total portfolio now stands at an impressive GDV of approximately INR52,000 crores, which includes what we have added in H1 of approximately INR8,500 crores in Parel.

order_book.statement: Two launches planned in H2 FY27 in Mahim with combined GDV of INR4,100 crores
order_book.quote: So, H2 will see two launches from us. Both of these launches are going to be in Mahim. The combined GDV of these projects is about INR4,100 crores approximately.

order_book.statement: Q2 FY27 pre-sales nearly doubled YoY without new launches
order_book.quote: We achieved a landmark milestone this quarter by nearly doubling our quarterly pre-sales without any new launches, driven entirely by robust sales velocity and steady price realizations within our existing product portfolio.

capex.statement: Plan to add INR8,000-10,000 crores GDV annually through business development
capex.quote: Given our strategy, there is a lot of interest that we have. As far as business development and GDV is concerned, going forward, if we add about INR8,000 crores to INR10,000 crores worth of GDV every year, it should give us this kind of a target easily.

pricing_cost.statement: Construction costs fixed via fixed-price contracts with contingencies for ongoing projects
pricing_cost.quote: But the projects which are under execution as of now, where contracts have already been given, there, these are all fixed price contracts, there is no provision of increases that anybody can ask for.

pricing_cost.statement: Future projects will factor in cost inflation, partially passed to customers and partially absorbed
pricing_cost.quote: The projects which will get launched in future will definitely have that impact. But we are factoring that in our planning and the way we are pricing them. So, part of it will get passed on to the customer and part of it we will absorb in our contingencies.

fund_raise.statement: Subsidiary raised INR210 crores from ICICI Prudential AMC AIF via OCPRS for Mahim project
fund_raise.quote: We are also very happy to share that Raymond Realty's subsidiary company has raised INR210 crores from AIF, which is promoted by ICICI Prudential AMC Limited.

fund_raise.statement: Promoter committed INR400 crores equity infusion, first tranche coming shortly
fund_raise.quote: Apart from that, the promoter himself has committed about INR400 crores of equity that he is infusing and the first tranche of that is going to be received shortly as per the schedule and balance will be as has been approved by the shareholders in their -- in the AGM.

other.statement: Q2 FY27 net debt at INR912 crores, gross debt at INR1,200 crores, debt-to-equity at 0.8x
other.quote: We closed the quarter with a net debt of INR912 crores and a gross debt of INR1,200-odd crores with a healthy debt-to-equity ratio of 0.8x.

other.statement: Debt expected to remain in INR1,200-1,500 crores range for next 1-2 years
other.quote: So, debt is a avenue we will definitely resort to and it will remain around this range, in the middle of INR1,200 crores to INR1,500 crores, I think I don't see any challenge in maintaining that kind of range, and it will still be within 1:1.

guidance.statement: Expect AOV growth of 10-15% even when gold prices are flat, driven by repeat customers buying at higher values; buyer growth to drive larger part of growth in Q3
guidance.quote: So, 10%, 15% kind of ticket growth or AOV growth is something that historically, even when gold remained flat, happens as people mature in your system. As you have more and more repeat and those repeat actually start buying at higher value, there's a natural, let's say, 10%, 15% ticket growth which is always sitting there.

demand.statement: Revenue grew 44% YoY to INR 738 crores in Q2 FY27; EBITDA more than doubled; fourth consecutive profitable quarter on standalone basis
demand.quote: Revenue grew 44% year-on-year to INR 738 crores, EBITDA more than doubled, and this is our fourth consecutive profitable quarter on a standalone basis.

demand.statement: Growth trends broad-based across Tier-1, Tier-2, Tier-3 cities; no behavioural difference; benefiting from omnichannel shift, lightweight jewellery trend, and unorganized-to-organized shift
demand.quote: We're basing our hypothesis on three broad trends which are happe ning. One is move towards omnichannel, where people are doing more and more research online before deciding to purchase anything. Second is the m ove towards lightweight jewellery, where we have a significant play, and third is move from unorganized to organized, and we are beneficiary of all these three tailwinds

capex.statement: Flagship store launched at Park Street, Kolkata as experiment to expand product lines beyond casted jewellery into handmade, Kundan techniques; may try 1-2 more stores before strategizing
capex.quote: Essentially, here, the idea is to expand our product lines also, to handle a lot more use cases, a nd to expand beyond the casted jewellery, so basically to also try with, let's say, handmade, Kundan, and few other techniques which work very well for a certain customer segment

product_mix.statement: Redesigned entry-level range taking more space in stores to bring first BlueStone piece within reach of more people
product_mix.quote: Our redesigned entry - level range is now taking more space in our stores, which br ings a first BlueStone piece within reach of many more people

product_mix.statement: No target product mix; studded vs non-studded mix is consumer-driven outcome; GMROI similar across categories due to margin-turn trade-off; focus on ROIC/GMROI not margin mix
product_mix.quote: So, a studded has a higher margin, but generally a lower turn. Non - studded has lower margin, but much higher turn. So, the capital productivity that you get from these two is a function of the brand, the pricing power, and thus the GMROIs are not very

risk.statement: Lab-grown gold news is a PR gimmick; creating gold via nuclear fusion is hypothetical, experimental, produces radioactive unstable gold; not a business concern
risk.quote: s a PR gimmick. I think first thing that will come out is a fusion reaction . Devanshu Bansal: Okay. Gaurav Singh Kushwaha: So okay. Producing electricity from fusion reaction, which has been ongoing for last 30 years, okay, because you have to stabilize those hydrogen atoms. And first someone needs to do that, that itself is 5, 10 years away. After that operating on mercury's nucleus to create go

other.statement: Crossed 1 million customers in Q2 FY27
other.quote: During the quarter, BlueStone crossed 1 million customers.

other.statement: Lab-grown diamonds taking share mainly from solitaire segment (1 carat+), which is <1% of BlueStone's business and low in Indian market; design-led jewellery customers still prefer natural diamonds; LGD disruption limited in design-led prod
other.quote: So, those kind of customers are kind of opening up to LGD, and that was a space which was not a big space for us anyways. Our share of solitaire was less than 1%. I think, in general, the overall share of solitaire in Indian jewellery market is relatively very low.

guidance.statement: Expect to reach 150,000 to 155,000 desks by March 2027 and 190,000 to 200,000 desks eventually, with supply for FY28 and FY29 under negotiation
guidance.value: 150,000 to 155,000 desks by March 2027; 190,000 to 200,000 desks eventually
guidance.quote: We expect to reach about 150,000 to 155,000 by March of 2027 and on the way to about 190,000 to 200,000 seats, with supply for FY28 and FY29 already under negotiation.

demand.statement: Members grew 32.5% YoY to 121,700, ahead of capacity growth; occupancy at 83.7% (up 357 bps YoY), mature centres at 88%; growth centres at 64.8% occupancy, up from 51.4% a year ago
demand.quote: Members grew 32.5% to about 121,700, ahead of capacity, and occupancy grew 357 basis points year-over-year to about 83.7%, with mature centres at nearly 88%.

margin.statement: EBITDA margin expanded 138 bps QoQ to 21.2% in Q2; centre-level EBITDA margin at 28.4% (up 109 bps YoY); H1 centre-level margin at 28.1% (up 284 bps); structural margin expansion driven by operating leverage and higher-margin VAS/digital re
margin.quote: EBITDA grew 37.6% year-on-year and 17.8% quarter-on-quarter to INR162.9 crores, with margin expanding 138 basis points sequentially to 21.2%.

product_mix.statement: Platform revenue (VAS + digital) growing faster than core, at higher margins (digital ~80% EBITDA margin, VAS margin-accretive); customization revenue ~INR18 crores in Q2, ~INR30 crores in H1, amortized over contract terms
product_mix.quote: Digital operates at close to 80% EBITDA margin, and VAS is margin accretive. So, as both keep growing faster than the core, they will continue contributing disproportionately to our profitability, all the way down to PAT.

risk.statement: One large customer (Commonwealth Bank of Australia) may move out in next year to a 1.2M sq ft built-to-suit campus; timing uncertain but backfill and large contracts being pursued to offset churn
risk.quote: we do have one company we have that might be moving out in the next year, but it is not fully certain right now in terms of timing, which month and things like that. But Commonwealth Bank of Australia, that's been a large customer of ours for nearly 7 years, has taken up a large built -to-suit campus with Embassy in Manyata itself of about 1.2 million

other.statement: VAS revenue grew 35% YoY to INR79.6 crores; digital revenue grew 46% to INR29.2 crores; combined VAS+digital at INR108.8 crores (up 38%), outpacing core revenue growth of 31.7%
other.value: INR79.6 crores VAS; INR29.2 crores digital; INR108.8 crores combined; 38% YoY growth
other.quote: The highlight of this quarter is the platform. VAS grew 35% year-on-year to INR79.6 crores, and digital 46% to INR29.2 crores. Together, they reached INR108.8 crores, up 38%, well ahead of 31.7% growth in our core business.

other.statement: Net cash position of INR23.1 crores as of September 2026, from net debt of INR310.5 crores a year ago; credit rating upgraded from A- to A+; average borrowing cost down 184 bps to 8.5%
other.value: INR23.1 crores net cash; A+ rating; 8.5% avg borrowing cost
other.quote: We closed September with a net cash of INR23.1 crores, compared with a net debt of INR310.5 crores a year ago. Our credit rating was upgraded from an A- to A+ over the year, and our average cost of borrowing fell 184 basis points to 8.5%.

guidance.statement: Full-year FY27 revenue target of Rs. 150 crores plus or minus 10%
guidance.quote: We are targeting around Rs. 150 crores plus or minus 10%.

guidance.statement: FY28 revenue target of Rs. 225-230 crores
guidance.quote: Around Rs. 225 crores to Rs. 230 crores.

guidance.statement: Full-year FY27 PAT margin guidance of 14-16%
guidance.quote: Yes sir, pad will be around 14% to 16% like previously shown.

demand.statement: Pelican EduSupply e-commerce vertical onboarded 100 schools for coming academic year; targeting Rs. 50 crores turnover
demand.quote: Right now, in the e-commerce, last year, we have achieved around 50 schools. We did a turnover of around Rs. 25 CR from that. And this year, we have signed, onboarded around 100 schools. Another 20 pipeline, but we are also restricting it because looking at the size and our warehouse capacity to pack all this and distribute on time. So, we want to limit it around 100 schools, which will generate a

margin.statement: H1 FY27 margins lower due to higher paper costs and marketing spend; expects recovery in H2
margin.quote: There are certain parameters like because of the war; some paper prices have gone up and down. So, that was one reason. And we have spent more money on marketing and sales this year so that in the next two quarters we will be generating more margin.

margin.statement: PageCraft in-house manufacturing margin ~12% vs traded notebook margin ~6-7%
margin.quote: In the traded product, we had a pad of around 67%. Now, we will have around 12%.

capex.statement: Additional Rs. 10-20 crores investment may be needed beyond FY27 if receivables collection slows
capex.quote: Beyond that, we might trade another Rs. 10 crores or Rs. 20 crores. But we will see that on the need basis. If the receivables are coming faster, then I don't think we would need much of a cash. If not, then we might go for another raise or whatever.

product_mix.statement: Traded notebooks (10-12% of turnover) and stationery (7-10%) being shifted to in-house PageCraft manufacturing

other.quote: Our exports are, I mean, not large. It's about ranging between 4% to 5% of the turnover. But the opportunities, particularly wi th FTAs with EU and UK, could open up new opportunities because these are segments where India could enjoy a differential duty compared to China or South Asian countries.

guidance.statement: Expects overall volume growth in FY27 to be better than last year if US midterm elections settle geopolitical issues

demand.statement: EPS demand in India estimated at 165,000-170,000 tons for current year

demand.statement: Domestic demand good in October, partly due to festival season; non-OEM segment back in market in Q2
demand.quote: After the close of the last quarter to till now, domestic demand is good. Since it is a festival season, that could be one of the reasons. But the demand so far is good.

order_book.statement: Q2 FY27 sales volume 95,242 MT, up 24% YoY and 35% QoQ; H1 FY27 volume down 3% YoY to 166,085 MT due to lower exports
order_book.quote: Our total sales volume for Q2 FY27 stood at 95,242 Mf registering a 24%o year-on-year and 35% quarter-on-quarter increase. However, HI FY27 sales volume declined 3% year-on-year to 1,66,085 MT primarily due to lower exports amid supply constraints, longer transit times and higher freight

capex.statement: New wide-width XPS insulation board line of 150,000 cubic metres and compounding capacity expansion from 50,000 to 80,000 tons per annum remain on track
capex.quote: On the growth front, our expansion plan remains on track, including the new wide-width insulation board line with a capacity of 1,50,000 cubic metres and the expansion of compounding capacity from 50,000 tons to 80,000 tons per annum.

capex.statement: XPS insulation board commercial production starts Q1 FY28; full capacity absorption expected in 24-30 months
capex.quote: Commercial production will start in the first quarter of FY27-28 and the capacity would be ramped up over a period of time and we expect that the full capacity of 1,50,000 cubic meter should be able to go to the market and be absorbed in the market in the next 24 months to 30 months.

pricing_cost.statement: ABS compound pass-through better than mass ABS
pricing_cost.quote: Yes, certainly, yes. That's right.

product_mix.statement: Specialty product mix increased to ~40% of overall volumes from previous 30-35%
product_mix.quote: We have expanded and on increased volumes we are at around 40%.

product_mix.statement: OEM and non-OEM sales split roughly 50-50 in Q2; non-OEM demand recovered after Q1 subduedness
product_mix.quote: They're almost the same, 50-50.

risk.statement: Geopolitical uncertainty (US midterm elections, Gulf war) makes projections difficult; raw material constraints and freight volatility persist
risk.quote: The changing global environment and current geopolitical conditions, are very difficult to project. I said before you joined that in the month of October the demand so far has been good and that this could be possible because of the festivities, but demand is good in the month of October. Going forward, how things shape up post midterm elections in the U5, whether the war clouds settle down, thing

other.statement: ABS operating at 85% of truncated capacity (65% of rated capacity) due to unrepaired equipment
other.quote: Of the truncated capacity of the ABS, because of the equipment which got bad and that has still not been fully repaired and replaced. So we had announced that we will be operating at 65% of our rated capacity and of that 85% we are utilizing currently.

other.statement: Company remains debt-free with investable surplus of Rs 886 crores as of September 2026; capex funded through internal accruals
other.quote: Company continues to remain debt-free with an investable surplus of Rs.886 crores as of September 2026. Our capital expenditure continues to be funded entirely through internal cash accruals, reflecting our strong financial position and disciplined capital allocation.

guidance.statement: Rooftop revenue growth 58% YoY in Q2 FY27; inverter response positive; complete solution with modules expected to drive future growth
guidance.quote: Rooftop business has been quite good. So, as we informed you last time, our inverters have received quite a good response in the market. So, in this quarter, compared to the same quarter last year, we had a good 58% growth in the revenue.

guidance.statement: PM-KUSUM 2.0 approval expected in ongoing quarter with execution results in following quarter
guidance.quote: We continue to remain optimistic about the PM-KUSUM 2.0 scheme and expect approval in the ongoing quarter, with positive execution results anticipated in the following quarter.

margin.statement: Raw material costs increased ~3% QoQ; cost optimization offset 2%, limiting net EBITDA impact to 1%
margin.quote: Our margins depend on selling prices and raw material costs, which increased by approximately 3% quarter on quarter. However, our initiatives to manage expenses such as advertising expense optimisation, Kaizen initiatives, and tighter cost management, helped us reduce costs by 2%, limiting the net impact on EBITDA to only 1%.

margin.statement: Margin improvement expected from solar panel manufacturing commencement, selling price stabilization, raw material cost normalization, and continued Kaizen/cost optimization
margin.quote: Exactly. We expect margins to improve once our solar panel manufacturing commences, with further expansion as selling prices stabilize. Although raw material prices recently increased by 3%, we offset 2% through effective cost management and Kaizen initiatives. We continue to pursue these measures to protect and maintain our EBITDA.

order_book.statement: Installed 23,865 solar pumps in Q2 FY27, ~7% YoY growth
order_book.quote: In this quarter, we installed 23,865 solar pumps, which is a major feat for our company. Compared to the same quarter of previous year, we have achieved approximately 7% growth in the number of installations.

order_book.statement: Order book sufficient to cover Q3 FY27; KUSUM 2.0 orders expected from Q4 FY27 alongside Magel Tyala and export/domestic orders
order_book.quote: According to the order book we have, we can easily cover this quarter. And with KUSUM 2.0 expected to come through in the ongoing quarter, so starting next quarter, we will begin execution of those orders as well, alongside orders in Magel Tyala too.

capex.statement: 2.2 GW solar cell plant scheduled for completion in FY28 with strong revenue contributions after March 2028
capex.quote: The 2.2 GW facility is scheduled for completion in FY28, with strong revenue contributions expected after March 2028.

capex.statement: Total capex plan INR 1,700 crores; ~INR 200 crores spent on 2.2 GW solar cell plant; ~INR 400 crores expected in H2 FY27
capex.quote: Our total capex plan is INR1,700 crores. Of this, approximately INR200 crores have been spent so far on the 2.2 GW solar cell plant. Regarding the other projects under QIP 1, development of the pump and motor facility is currently underway.

pricing_cost.statement: Sales realization flat QoQ with ~1% impact from sales mix; improvement expected once next tender price derived
pricing_cost.quote: Sales realization is almost at the same le vel, sir. There was an impact of approximately 1% due to the sales mix

pricing_cost.statement: Pricing flexibility limited in solar business (majority of sales); single active tender in Maharashtra Magel Tyala
pricing_cost.quote: as far as selling price is concerned, as of today, pricing flexibility remains limited in the solar business, which accounts fo r majority of our sales. product_mix.statement: In-house manufacturing of VFDs, structures, pumps, motors, controllers gives cost advantage over outsourcing competitors
product_mix.quote: We expect some improvement in rates now because we manufacture everything on our own, we manufacture VFDs, structures, pumps, motors, and controllers in-house. which we believe gives us a cost advantage over players that outsource components and incur higher manufacturing costs.

risk.statement: War-related disruptions around Strait of Hormuz causing raw material price increases (MS, steel, copper); expect stabilization in coming period
risk.quote: The conflict around the Strait of Hormuz has led to a renewed increase in raw material costs. There was no expectation at all that MS, steel, and copper prices would increase in this quarter, yet they did increase. In the co ming period, We expect war-related disruptions to ease and raw material prices to stabilise

other.statement: Pump and motor capacity utilization at ~68% in H1 FY27
other.quote: We are utilizing approximately 68% capacity.

other.statement: Q2 FY27 revenue: Solar EPC INR 543 cr (23,865 units), Exports INR 95 cr, Domestic/Industrial/Others INR 40 cr
other.quote: We did around INR543 crores in solar EPC, which corresponds to 23,865 units. Apart from this, we did around INR95 crores in exports. And combining domestic, industrial, and other segments, it was approximately INR40 crores.

guidance.statement: Raised FY27 constant currency revenue growth guidance to 10.5%-13% from 10%-13%; reaffirmed EBIT margin guidance of 12.25%-12.75%
guidance.quote: Based on our H1 performance and the visibility we have for the second half, we are raising the lower end of our FY27 revenue guidance. We now expect constant currency revenue growth of 10.5% to 13%, compared with 10% to 13% earlier. On margins, we are reaffirming our EBIT margin guidance of 12.25% to 12.75%.

margin.statement: Q2 EBIT margin 12.5%, up 100 bps YoY and 10 bps QoQ; eighth straight quarter of sequential margin expansion
margin.quote: EBIT margin for the quarter was 12.5%, up 100 basis points year-on-year and 10 basis points on a quarter-on-quarter basis, respectively. This is our eighth straight quarter of sequential margin expansion.

order_book.statement: Signed 4 large deals (ACV >$5M) in Q2, 2 from new logos; 7th straight quarter with 4+ large deals; added 17 new logos including 6 strategic
order_book.quote: In Q2, we signed four large deals, two of which came from new logos. As you are aware, we consider a deal with an ACV of over US$5 million as a large deal. During the quarter, we added 17 new logos, one of our highest quarterly additions. It includes six strategic logos.

capex.statement: Capitalizing costs directly attributable to Kairos platform development; still work in progress, not fully capitalized
capex.quote: Yes, we capitalize costs that are directly attributable to it. It is still work in progress. Kairos is not yet fully capitalized as a platform, but there are some costs which we need to capitalize.

pricing_cost.statement: Absorbed first phase of annual wage increments in Q2 (frontline/mid-level); senior increments in Q3; margin expanded despite wage hikes and 3,000 onboarding costs
pricing_cost.quote: One of the things to also bear in mind is this quarter, we've expanded margins despite absorbing the first phase of annual wage increments as well and the cost of onboarding 3,000 people largely ahead of revenue coming in as well.

product_mix.statement: Shift to productized services via Kairos OS; domain harness captures skills/playbooks; intelligent context framework gives AI memory; governed autonomy for regulated industries
product_mix.quote: Kairos, our AI-native operating system, serves as the engine for delivering, measuring, and scaling productized services. Our domain harness captures the skills, playbooks, and compliance guardrails of our best operators once and makes them available to our people and AI agents alike, portable across the models and platforms that our clients choose.

risk.statement: Healthcare payer program recalibration after CMS rate adjustments caused timing challenges; transformative payer BPaaS engagement wind-down largely behind
risk.quote: While it grew 5% year-on-year in Q2 and 11% in Q1, one of the things that you have seen is also the fact that we talked about the fact that there was a timing challenge with some of the payer program as Medicare Advantage clients recalibrated scope after some o f the CMS rate adjustments. As you are aware, based on what we discussed also last quarter about the wind -down of the trans formative pay

other.statement: Normalized DSO 67-69 days; FCF to PAT 150% for Q2, 126% for H1
other.quote: Normalized DSO continued to be in the range of 67 to 69 days. Our FCF to PAT for the quarter was 150% and for the half year it was 126%.

other.statement: Net debt INR 15.3B vs INR 17.1B end of June 2026; cash and bank balance INR 4.1B
other.quote: Turning to the balance sheet, our cash and bank balance stood at INR4.1 billion and net debt was INR15.3 billion versus INR17.1 billion at the end of June 2026.

guidance.statement: Lead volumes expected to grow at 18-20% CAGR over next three years
guidance.quote: So irrespective of the past two quarters being not so good, we believe that going forward, the lead would grow at around 18% to 20% for the next three years in volume terms.

guidance.statement: Copper EBITDA per kg sustainable at INR65-70 near term, rising to INR80-90 in 2-3 years with backward integration
guidance.value: INR65 to INR70 per kg; INR80 to INR90 per kg
guidance.period: next few quarters; next 2 to 3 years
guidance.quote: In copper, we expect that for the next few quarters, you will have a sustainable number of around INR65 to INR70 per kg. But going forward in the next 2 to 3 years, once our recycling facility is there as backward integration to the RMIL business, the EBITDA would grow to around INR80 to INR90.

demand.statement: Lead volume decline due to raw material availability, not demand; value-added products 64% of H1 FY27 sales
demand.quote: It's primarily because of the raw material availability. If you look at the EBITDA numbers, if you look at the value-added products, so with whatever raw material was available to us, we tried to maximize the value. So it's very clear that the demand is not an issue.

margin.statement: Q2 FY27 adjusted EBITDA up 28% YoY to INR143.37 crores, margin over 10%; PAT up 6% YoY to INR102 crores, margin over 7%

margin.quote: Adjusted EBITDA increased 28% year-on-year to INR143.37 crores, with EBITDA margin remaining healthy at over 10%. Consolidated PAT grew 6% year-on-year to INR102 crores, while PAT margin remained over 7%.

margin.statement: EBITDA per ton in Q2 FY27: Lead INR22,620, Aluminum INR22,664, Plastic INR10,334, Copper INR84,671
margin.quote: EBITDA per ton for the lead, aluminum, plastic and copper segment stood at INR22,620, INR22,664, INR10,334 and INR84,671, respectively, during Q2 FY27.

order_book.statement: Lead scrap bookings started from new geographies in last quarter; material expected to reach in Q3 FY27; domestic procurement improving due to reverse charge mechanism

capex.statement: Total capex of INR1,680 crores planned through FY29; INR815 crores for existing businesses, balance for new verticals including lithium-ion and copper
capex.quote: In line with our long-term expansion strategy, we have embarked total capital expenditure of INR1,680 crores through FY29. capex.statement: Mundra copper recycling capacity addition of 59,200 MTPA at ~INR64 crores, phased commissioning by March 2029, funded by internal accruals

capex.statement: Mandvi copper recycling facility of 29,400 MTPA at ~INR160 crores on track for commissioning within 12 months, funded by internal accruals
capex.value: 29,400 metric ton per annum; INR160 crores

product_mix.statement: Value-added products contributed 64% of consolidated revenue in H1 FY27, progressing toward Vision 2030 target of 60%+
product_mix.quote: Value-added products contributed 64% of consolidated revenue during the period, marking further progress towards our Vision 2030 target and deriving approximately 60% plus of revenue from value-added offerings.

other.statement: US subsidiary Gravita Recyclers USA, Inc. incorporated with US$50,000 capital to set up scrap procurement yards in US for copper, lead, and battery scrap

The proposed entity will focus on setting up scrap procurement network in the U.S. and other neighbouring countries.

other.statement: RMIL contributed INR420 crores revenue in Q2 FY27 with 8.5% EBITDA margin
other.quote: RMIL contributed INR420 crores to consolidated revenue during Q2 FY27 with an EBITDA margin of 8.5%.

guidance.statement: Long-term EBITDA margin guidance for IndiaMART standalone is 33%
guidance.quote: IndiaMART, we have been guiding long-term 33% margin.

order_book.statement: Consolidated deferred revenue grew 16% YoY to Rs 2,029 crores in Q2 FY27
order_book.quote: Consolidated deferred revenue grew to Rs. 2,029 crores, representing a 16% year-on-year growth.

capex.statement: Advertising spend running at Rs 8-9 crores per quarter, targeting top quartile categories; may double once better handle achieved
capex.quote: If you see our advertising expenses in the entire of last year are now running at Rs. 8 crores, Rs. 9 crores per quarter, and this is almost touching the Rs. 10 crore per quarter budget.

product_mix.statement: Silver subscription churn remains elevated; management not pressing gross additions until churn improves
product_mix.quote: This decrease can primarily be attributed to an elevated churn at the Silver subscription.

risk.quote: So yes, there might be certain losses that are occurring from Google landing. And you would remember that at the same time, Google AI Overviews had expanded from 10%, 20% now to 50% of the searches or even higher. So, yes, 10%, 15% decline on that is happening.

risk.statement: AI benefits volatile over next 2-4 years; provides downside protection but net impact uncertain
risk.quote: So I guess a net -net benefit, as I said, over the next two, three years, four years, can remain very volatile. The good part is that with the tighter understanding and deeper understanding of ours in this particular area, I think if we don't grow too much, at least we are not going to go heavily in the red or completely do away.

other.statement: Platinum and Gold customers contribute ~50% of customer base and ~75% of revenue with good upsell and retention

other.statement: BUSY sold ~11,000 new licenses in Q2 FY27, total licenses sold 466,000
other.quote: In Q2, we sold approximately 11,000 new licenses, bringing our total licenses sold to 4,66,000.

guidance.statement: EBITDA margin guidance maintained at 23-25% range for next 2-3 years despite mix shift and inflation
guidance.quote: I don't think there is any reason to change our range, I think 23 -25 is fair.

guidance.statement: Medium-term aspiration implies ~25% CAGR across three business leaders (driveline, motor, railway)
guidance.quote: We've already given our aspiration which actually does imply a 25% CAGR.

demand.statement: EV business grew 129% YoY; BEV revenue now >50% of automotive revenue for first time
demand.quote: Our EV business grew by almost unbelievable 129% year on year.

margin.statement: Q2 EBITDA margin declined 230 bps YoY to 23% due to product mix change and higher input prices
margin.quote: EBITDA margin was 23%, which was lower by 2.3% compared to the same quarter last year.

order_book.statement: Q2 order additions of Rs 36 billion (3rd highest ever); net order book at Rs 251 billion (2nd highest ever)
order_book.quote: So if you look at the quarter as a whole, we won 36 billion worth of new business, which is the 3rd highest quarter for order additions.

capex.statement: Railway business has multiple new products in serial production (air springs, HVAC, electric panels) with 5-year product pipeline
capex.quote: We have multiple products which have started or gone into serial production and we have orders.

pricing_cost.statement: Input cost inflation from steel, copper, oil derivatives; freight rates nearly doubled QoQ
pricing_cost.quote: Freight rates have also risen sharply, they've nearly doubled from the previous quarter's level.

product_mix.statement: Traction motor business grew ~50% QoQ, pulling down overall margin percentage due to lower margin profile
product_mix.quote: Traction motor demand has significantly exceeded even our own internal expectations. The business has grown almost 50% quarter on quarter.

product_mix.statement: Suspension motor business reached ~7% of revenue, fastest growing product driven by success in China with Nio
product_mix.quote: EV Suspension Motors was our fastest growing business this quarter, and I think it's already reached 7%.

fund_raise.statement: Additional borrowings of Rs 224 crore in H1; ESOP exercises brought Rs 108 crore inflow
fund_raise.quote: There were cash inflows on account of additional borrowings of 224 crores.

risk.statement: Near-term margin predictability difficult due to traction motor mix shift and West Asia inflation uncertainty
risk.quote: Both these factors are larg ely beyond our control, which makes near -term predictability a little difficult.

other.statement: Eastern markets now contribute ~2/3 of revenue vs 1/3 at time of 'look east' strategic decision two years ago
other.quote: Eastern markets contributed about 1/3 of our revenue at that time. This quarter, if you look at that chart, they contribute almost 2/3 of our total revenue.

other.statement: Three new products commercialized in single quarter (helical LSD, air springs, rear radar sensor) - highest ever
other.quote: We commercialized 3 new products, the most we have ever done in a single quarter.

capex.statement: Upgraded core CRM platform to Salesforce to optimize D2C acquisition; scaled AI bots across acquisition and service channels processing over 7.5 million minutes at less than 20% of human cost

product_mix.statement: Focus on sub-40 consumers; launched Young Star neo product targeting younger age cohorts; D2C channel attracts younger customers with higher sum insured

order_book.quote: During the quarter, the disbursement stood at INR267 crores compared to INR233 crores in corresponding quarter of the previous year.

capex.statement: Technology spend ~INR2 crores annually; 28-person tech team; disbursement TAT reduced from 3.5-4 days to 1.5-2 days, targeting same-day
capex.quote: on an average yearly, we spend around INR2 crores on the technology. And this is what -- because what we understood that NBFC, the speed and innovation is the essence of success.

pricing_cost.statement: Operating expenses up 28% YoY due to Karnataka expansion and sales hiring; management says YoY comparison not appropriate due to expansion
pricing_cost.quote: operating expense has been increased by 28% is compared to September '25, first of all. And second thing, from September '25 to this September '26, we have increased our locations as well as Karnataka state, where we have recruited the salesperson in every -- lots of salesperson recruited during the season also.

product_mix.statement: Used 2-wheeler yield 27-28% IRR; top-up/personal loan ~32% IRR; MSME LAP/small business loan 27-28% IRR
product_mix.quote: used 2-wheeler loan at various locations, almost added 100-plus dealers in last 6 months. And of course, the yield is 27 to 28 IRR with a good processing fee and less payout will definitely add and a nice good yield.

product_mix.statement: Product mix: 2-wheeler 83.1%, top-up 5.7%, 3-wheeler 3%, used vehicle 1.6%; over 95% portfolio secured
product_mix.quote: Talking about the product mix for the period under review, 2-wheeler accounted for 83.10 percentage, top-up loan 5.70 percentage, 3-wheeler 3 percentage and used vehicle loan 1.60%.

fund_raise.statement: Preferential issue of ~INR100 crores approved, funds expected by 6th November, will boost capital adequacy
fund_raise.quote: we are successfully raising approximately INR100 crores through a preferential issue, further strengthening our capital base and providing additional headroom to support a future loan book expansion.

risk.statement: Battery replacement financing for EV 3-wheelers launched 2 months ago; pilot for own customers only; will test for 18 months before scaling
risk.quote: we have introduced this product to support our own AUM, which we have blended in 3-wheeler electric rickshas. So today, introduced 2 months back only, and we are focusing only for our own customers only because we want to understand how it runs.

other.statement: Average bounce rate 18-20%; 7-8% customers remain in bounce across tenure
other.quote: So, generally, our bounce rate is 18% to 20%. So, this keeps on revolving because once the customer will bounce, then next time he pays also. So, on an average, there are 7% to 8% customers are there who remain bounce across the tenure.

other.statement: Added 3 MSME LAP branches in last 2 months, 2 more planned this quarter; 7 BC partners active, 3 in due diligence
other.quote: we've added 3 more branches in last 2 months and 2 more branches we are going to add in this quarter. So, the new 5 to 6 branch will also give additional INR3 crores to INR4 crores of disbursement in the small business loan.

guidance.statement: Expect H2 FY27 revenue higher than H1 with similar margins driven by semiconductor, nuclear and steady run-rate
guidance.quote: Based on our current order book and delivery schedules, we expect H2 revenue to be higher than H1 with similar margins.

guidance.statement: Aspiration to achieve INR1,000 crore revenue; gross block ~INR500 crore by FY27 end including JV; ~2-2.5x asset turns
guidance.quote: While we are not giving any forward-looking guidance, we are working towards an aspiration of achieving INR1,000 crore revenue. This is a broader indication and if you see the capex number or the gross block number by end of this financial year will be roughly around INR500 crore with all our JV business also put in place.

demand.statement: Semiconductor revenue small in H1 (~3% of PCA), step-up expected in H2; 60 FAIs qualified, 20 more targeted by CY end; 1 established + 2 pipeline customers
demand.quote: Though we have started seeing some accretions happening from our semiconductor OEM in the revenue from PCA, but as we indicated on overall basis, PCA business contributed 33% of the revenues, of which primarily 3% has been coming from PCA as a mix.

margin.statement: H1 FY27 EBITDA margin 38%, Q2 40%; gross margin H1 67%, Q2 69%; employee cost 15%, opex 14% of revenue
margin.quote: EBITDA margin for the quarter was robust at 40% with H1 margin at 38%, indicating strong business performance.

margin.statement: Expect H2 margins similar to H1; at INR1,000 crore scale mix shift to 50-50 tooling vs PCA may cause 1-2% compression plus R&D spend
margin.quote: Maybe, I mean, fair guess is around 50%-50% could be there. I mean, the precision component is generally, slightly lower margin than tooling, so, you would see some kind of compression, but I do not indicate, large compression in the margin.

order_book.statement: Consolidated order book at INR855 crore as of Sep 30, up 715% YoY, anchored by firm POs and multi-year LTAs
order_book.quote: Our consolidated order book stands at a strong INR855 crore, up 715% Y-o-Y. This is anchored by a mix of firm POs and multi-year long-term supply agreements and award letters.

capex.statement: Saudi JV capex outlay INR200-250 crore for oil & gas facility; Hobel machine capex for customer demand
capex.quote: To capture the oil and gas demand, we are putting up a capex for the Saudi JV that we have. This will be roughly a INR200 crore, INR250 crore of outlay that we will be putting across.

capex.statement: Special process cells and assembly lines at existing facility: trials this month/next, commissioning by Dec 26, Nadcap by Mar 27
capex.quote: We are installing dedicated automated special process cells and assembly lines at our existing facility. Trial runs are taking place this month and next. Commissioning will be completed by December 26th, and Nadcap certification is targeted for March 27th.

pricing_cost.statement: Subcontracting costs low at 2% of revenue; gross margin supported by high-value orders and favorable mix
pricing_cost.quote: Subcontracting costs continued to remain at lower trend at 2% of our revenue. EBITDA margin for the quarter was robust at 40% with H1 margin at 38%, indicating strong business performance.

product_mix.statement: H1 revenue mix: Aero Tooling 67%, PCA 33% (Hobel 30% of consolidated); PCA ex-Hobel momentum just begun
product_mix.quote: From a business mix perspective, Aero Tooling contributes approximately 67% of total H1 revenue. The remaining 33% came from precision component assembly, PCA business. Within this, Hobel contributed 30% of total H1 consolidated revenue.

fund_raise.statement: Evaluating equity fundraise in early CY2027 for next-leg capacity expansion beyond INR1,000 crore and potential inorganic growth
fund_raise.quote: To support our future expansion plan, we are evaluating options and expect to consider an equity fundraise in early calendar year 2027, subject to final requirements and market conditions.

risk.statement: Turned down 1-2 opportunities requiring FAIs without serial production horizon; will not be a shop doing FAIs with no production visibility
risk.quote: There have been one or two that we have turned down where there's an ask that we basically prove out and then they will give the order for the larger serial production. Some of them we said, unless you give us the overall order, we are happy to do the FAIs and then turn it into production, but we will not be a shop where we will just keep doing FAIs for you with no horizon for serial production.

other.statement: Target over 590 qualified parts by end FY27 combining 250+ qualified base with 340+ in throughput pipeline
other.quote: We expect to exceed 590 qualified parts by the end of the year by combining our established 250 plus qualified base with 340 plus parts currently in throughput.

other.statement: Hobel expected to contribute ~20% of INR1,000 crore revenue vision
other.quote: Yes, it is built in, the INR1,000 crore vision, approximately 20%, of the total vision, will be achieved from Hobel side.

guidance.statement: Movement hire target of 3.6-3.7 million pallet movements for FY27
guidance.quote: This year, what we have said to the market is that we will do round about 3.6 million to 3.7 million.

guidance.statement: FY27 revenue guidance of INR918-920 crores, ~50% EBITDA margin, PAT around INR90 crores; PAT growth target 60-80%
guidance.quote: So, this is this is something that we have actually shared with our investors, which is INR918 crores, INR920 crores of top line, and again a 50% EBITDA to that, and a PAT margin, which is -- and a PAT of around INR90 crores.

demand.statement: MHE revenue grew 60% YoY, EBITDA grew 28% YoY in Q2 FY27
demand.quote: If you looked at our MHE business, we have grown by 60% on revenue and round about 28% on our EBITDA.

demand.statement: Q2 FY27 revenue INR216 crores, up 22.5% YoY; EBITDA INR110 crores, up 24.8% YoY; PAT up 62% YoY (109% excluding break cost)
demand.quote: So, as compared to last year's quarter 2, we have done INR216 crores of turnover. We have grown by 22.5%. We have done INR110 crores of EBITDA, which is we have grown by 24.8%.

margin.statement: Q2 FY27 EBITDA margin 50.8%, up 91 bps YoY; H1 FY27 EBITDA margin 52.1%
margin.quote: With respect to EBITDA was INR1,097 million, up 25%, with EBITDA margin at 50.8%, up 91 basis points year-on-year, supported by higher income, cost optimization, and network synergies.

capex.statement: FY27 capex guidance of INR450 crores; H1 FY27 capex INR213 crores delivering 21% growth
capex.quote: overall, this year, we will be having a capex of INR450 crores, and near to that we are looking at our EBITDA.

pricing_cost.statement: Plastic granule costs up 30-50%, limiting automotive crate additions; timber costs controlled within 2-3% fluctuation via Plinova and FOB contracts
pricing_cost.quote: But you can look at it that this time the granule cost has gone overboard, plastic cost has gone overboard. Automotive sector has done fantastically well. If they have asked for four crates, we have been able to deliver only 1.5 crates to them.

product_mix.statement: Vimprotech adds in-house mold-making, design, and plastic manufacturing; target 100% in-house production over time; currently 50-50 split
product_mix.quote: So, currently, it will be 50-50. Currently, they have two lines. Two lines can only take up 50%. Once we see their productivity and the kind of mix that they take out, and we check the strength and all those stuffs. On the basis of that, over a period of time, we will continue to improve. And over a period of time, 100% of our production will be in-house.

fund_raise.statement: IPO fresh issue INR480 crores; INR3,596 million used for debt repayment; INR1,200 million earmarked for general corporate purposes
fund_raise.quote: Of the INR4,800 million fresh issue, INR3,596 million has been used to repay debt, and INR1,200 million is unmarked for general corporate purposes.

risk.statement: Textile and plastic goods sectors weak due to granule cost fluctuations; operating at 20% capacity; automotive demand strong but supply constrained by crate costs
risk.quote: We were looking at 10 times growth in textile, but the textile industry is only not functioning. They are functioning at 20% of their overall production capacity. So, textile industry is not doing well because of the cost of the granules. Plastic good industry is also absolutely hit due to the granule rate fluctuation.

risk.statement: Timber cost risk if current situation persists after March 31, 2027; currently controlled via Plinova and FOB contracts
risk.quote: We may have to look at it if the current situation prevails after March 31, 2027, but currently we are completely under control.

other.statement: Agreed to acquire 100% of Vimprotech and TIPS for equity value of INR142 crores via slump sales into wholly owned subsidiaries
other.quote: The most important development this quarter is our agreement to acquire 100% of the business of Vimprotech and TIPS for an equity value of INR142 crores.

other.statement: Revenue mix: ~64% pallets, 20-22% automotive containers, 14-16% MHE; mix stable
other.quote: technically, it is again 64% contribution from pallet side, round about 20-odd percent, 20% to 22% contribution from auto side, and 14% to 16% contribution from MHE side.

guidance.statement: Aims to maintain EBITDA margin around 30% plus or minus 2 percentage points
guidance.quote: Going forward, we aim to maintain an EBITDA margin of approximately 30%, plus or minus 2 percentage points, supported by disciplined procurement, manufacturing efficiency and appropriate pricing.

order_book.statement: Order book approximately Rs 68-70 crore, 78% export and 22% domestic
order_book.quote: The current order book is approximately Rs. 68 – 70 crore, of which around 78% is export orders and 22% is domestic orders.

capex.statement: Machinery worth Rs 50 million commissioned and orders placed for additional Rs 300 million
capex.quote: Machinery worth Rs. 50 million has been purchased and commissioned, and orders have been placed for additional machinery worth approximately Rs. 300 million.

risk.statement: Defence testing rigorous and may take six months; industrial and defence shafts require testing and validation before revenue contribution
risk.quote: Defence testing is rigorous and may take six months because vehicles operate across difficult terrain. We expect to launch some industrial shafts in the next financial year.

other.statement: Added approximately 13 new customers in the quarter; 87.4% of product sales from repeat customers
other.quote: We made progress in expanding our customer base during the quarter, adding approximately 13 new customers. At the same time, 87.4% of our product sales came from repeat customers, reflecting the strength of our established relationships.

other.statement: Peak annual revenue potential of approximately Rs 2,500 million after full ramp-up by Q4 FY28
other.quote: Following commissioning, we are targeting a full ramp-up by Q4 FY28. At that scale, the expanded manufacturing platform could support peak annual revenue of approximately Rs. 2,500 million.

guidance.statement: H2 FY27 expected to be better than H1 FY27
guidance.quote: No, it will be better than H1. Definitely will be better than H1.

guidance.statement: Top line and bottom line growth expected in FY28 with margin expansion
guidance.quote: So, FY 28 will show the full result of the Tarapur expansion. So definitely expansion of turnover as well as profitability is something that will be seen.

guidance.statement: Top line growth and significantly higher bottom line growth expected in FY29 from Dahej expansion
guidance.quote: As we get into FY 29 and FY 30, the expansion of bottom line will be much more visible because of the kicking in of the Dahej factory. So top line and bottom line growth in FY28 and a little top line plus much more bottom line growth in FY29 is what the investors can expect.

margin.statement: Both Tarapur and Dahej expansions expected to be EBITDA accretive from day one with margin improvement
margin.quote: All of these expansions are expected to be an EBITDA positive from day one and in fact it will add to the margins because our fixed cost won't increase substantially henceforth.

margin.statement: Organic peroxides and salicylates drive margins; acrylic emulsions drive volume
margin.quote: The organic peroxide and the fragrance industry, that is our salicylic acid and derivatives are a super-duper specialty industry. So, they do help us with a better margin representation and the acrylic emulsion side help us in developing a larger growth picture with bigger numbers.

order_book.statement: Acrylic expansion driven by supply shortage; unable to meet current customer demand
order_book.quote: And as far as the orders are concerned, dear sir, we are already running short of supply. And that is the key reason we are expanding that facility. So, orders are not a major problem for us.

capex.statement: Tarapur expansion investment of Rs 15-20 crore funded by debt
capex.quote: Total Tarapur investment would be around 15 to 20 crores, which we are already ongoing with it, for which we have taken a debt.

capex.statement: Dahej expansion to be funded primarily via QIP and warrant issue
capex.quote: And for Dahej investments, we are already planning a QIP for that the warrant issues and everything. The most probably major amount chunk of it will be contributed from that.

pricing_cost.statement: In-house raw material development for peroxides yields ~40-50% cost saving vs external quotes
pricing_cost.quote: The raw materials that we are going to produce the manufacturing cost is nearly only 50 to 60 percent that of what we were quoted earlier. So, the cost savings seems to be very huge over there.

product_mix.statement: Opaque binder technology (hybrid core-shell polymer) to be produced first in India/globally
product_mix.quote: We would also be amongst the first, we would rather be the first manufacturers in India and maybe throughout the globe as well to produce opaque binders.

product_mix.statement: Developed DTA and DTBH peroxide molecules; five more in pipeline; 12+ downstream salicylates in development
product_mix.quote: Through our in-house R&D capabilities, we have developed Di-tert-amyl Peroxide, which is also called DTA, and we have developed 2,5 Dimethyl 2,5 Di-tertiary butyl peroxyhexane, which is also called as DTBH. And we are also working towards and progressing with the development of five additional peroxide molecules.

fund_raise.statement: Preferential issue of 43.95 lakh warrants; MD subscribing to 30 lakh warrants
fund_raise.quote: The proposed preferential issue of 43.95 lakh warrants includes my proposed subscription to 30 lakh warrants, reflecting my confidence in the company's future and my commitment to its growth journey.

risk.statement: Geopolitical situation (Strait of Hormuz) cited as biggest challenge impacting peroxide exports to GCC
risk.quote: Geopolitical situation. If that would have been smoother, you would have given much better numbers in this year.

other.statement: Tarapur facility running at 100%+ utilization; Dahej peroxide at ~40% due to geopolitical shipping constraints
other.quote: Current utilized position in Tarapur, we are fully utilized 100% or maybe more. That is why we are increasing the capacity in Tarapur. In Dahej, we are utilizing approximately 40% of the capacity on peroxide business.

other.statement: Operating cash flow turned positive Rs 1.84 crore in H1 FY27 vs negative Rs 8.99 crore in H1 FY26
other.quote: Net cash generated from our operating activity was positive at 1.84 crore in H1 FY27 compared with net operating cash outflow of negative 8.99 crore in H1 FY26.
